title: Pramana: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Epistemic Reasoning through Navya-Nyaya
comment: 52 pages + appendices, comprehensive treatment of Navya-Nyaya computational formalization
summary: Large language models produce fluent text but struggle with systematic reasoning, often hallucinating confident but unfounded claims. When Apple researchers added irrelevant context to mathematical problems, LLM performance degraded by 65% Apple Machine Learning Research, exposing brittle pattern-matching beneath apparent reasoning. This epistemic gap, the inability to ground claims in traceable evidence, limits AI reliability in domains requiring justification. We introduce Pramana, a novel approach that teaches LLMs explicit epistemological methodology by fine-tuning on Navya-Nyaya logic, a 2,500-year-old Indian reasoning framework. Unlike generic chain-of-thought prompting, Navya-Nyaya enforces structured 6-phase reasoning: SAMSHAYA (doubt analysis), PRAMANA (evidence source identification), PANCHA AVAYAVA (5-member syllogism with universal rules), TARKA (counterfactual verification), HETVABHASA (fallacy detection), and NIRNAYA (ascertainment distinguishing knowledge from hypothesis). This integration of logic and epistemology provides cognitive scaffolding absent from standard reasoning approaches. We fine-tune Llama 3.2-3B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B on 55 Nyaya-structured logical problems (constraint satisfaction, Boolean SAT, multi-step deduction). Stage 1 achieves 100% semantic correctness on held-out evaluation despite only 40% strict format adherence revealing that models internalize reasoning content even when structural enforcement is imperfect. Ablation studies show format prompting and temperature critically affect performance, with optimal configurations differing by stage. We release all models, datasets, and training infrastructure on Hugging Face to enable further research on epistemic frameworks for AI reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Pramana方法，通过基于印度Navya-Nyaya逻辑框架微调LLMs，提升系统推理能力，解决LLMs在无关上下文干扰下性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能生成流畅文本，但在系统推理方面存在困难，经常产生自信但无根据的断言。当苹果研究人员在数学问题中添加无关上下文时，LLM性能下降了65%，这表明其表面推理之下是脆弱的模式匹配。这种认知差距——无法将主张建立在可追溯证据基础上——限制了AI在需要论证的领域中的可靠性。
AI.method: 引入Pramana方法，通过基于Navya-Nyaya逻辑（2500年历史的印度推理框架）微调LLMs来教授明确的认知方法论。Navya-Nyaya强制执行结构化6阶段推理：怀疑分析、证据源识别、5成员三段论、反事实验证、谬误检测、以及区分知识与假设的确定。在55个Nyaya结构化逻辑问题上微调Llama 3.2-3B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型。
AI.result: 第一阶段在保留评估集上实现了100%语义正确性，尽管只有40%的严格格式遵循，表明模型即使在不完美的结构执行下也能内化推理内容。消融研究显示格式提示和温度对性能有重要影响，不同阶段的最优配置不同。
AI.conclusion: Navya-Nyaya逻辑与认知论的整合为标准推理方法中缺失的认知支架提供了支持。研究在Hugging Face上发布了所有模型、数据集和训练基础设施，以促进AI推理认知框架的进一步研究。

title: Operational Noncommutativity in Sequential Metacognitive Judgments
summary:
Metacognition, understood as the monitoring and regulation of one's own cognitive processes, is inherently sequential: an agent evaluates an internal state, updates it, and may then re-evaluate under modified criteria. Order effects in cognition are well documented, yet it remains unclear whether such effects reflect classical state changes or reveal a deeper structural non-commutativity. We develop an operational framework that makes this distinction explicit. In our formulation, metacognitive evaluations are modeled as state-transforming operations acting on an internal state space with probabilistic readouts, thereby separating evaluation back-action from observable output.
  We show that order dependence prevents any faithful Boolean-commutative representation. We then address a stronger question: can observed order effects always be explained by enlarging the state space with classical latent variables? To formalize this issue, we introduce two assumptions, counterfactual definiteness and evaluation non-invasiveness, under which the existence of a joint distribution over all sequential readouts implies a family of testable constraints on pairwise sequential correlations. Violation of these constraints rules out any classical non-invasive account and certifies what we call genuine non-commutativity.
  We provide an explicit three-dimensional rotation model with fully worked numerical examples that exhibits such violations. We also outline a behavioral paradigm involving sequential confidence, error-likelihood, and feeling-of-knowing judgments following a perceptual decision, together with the corresponding empirical test. No claim is made regarding quantum physical substrates; the framework is purely operational and algebraic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个操作框架来区分认知顺序效应中的经典状态变化与结构性非交换性，通过形式化分析证明某些顺序效应无法用经典隐变量解释，并展示了违反经典约束的旋转模型和行为实验范式。
AI.motivation: 元认知过程本质上是顺序性的，但现有的顺序效应研究未能明确区分是经典状态变化还是更深层的结构性非交换性。需要建立一个操作框架来明确这种区分，并探索顺序效应是否总能通过经典隐变量解释。
AI.method: 1. 将元认知评估建模为作用于内部状态空间的状态转换操作，分离评估的反作用与可观测输出；2. 引入反事实确定性和评估非侵入性假设，推导顺序相关性的可检验约束；3. 构建三维旋转模型展示违反经典约束的数值示例；4. 设计涉及顺序信心、错误可能性和知晓感判断的行为实验范式。
AI.result: 1. 证明顺序依赖性排除了任何忠实的布尔交换表示；2. 推导出在经典非侵入性假设下顺序相关性必须满足的约束条件；3. 展示三维旋转模型违反这些约束，证实了真正的非交换性；4. 提出了可实证检验的行为实验方案。
AI.conclusion: 元认知过程中的顺序效应可能反映了超越经典状态变化的真正非交换性结构，这种非交换性无法通过扩大状态空间或引入经典隐变量来解释。该框架为认知科学中的顺序效应提供了新的形式化分析工具，无需诉诸量子物理基础。

title: Proximity Measure of Information Object Features for Solving the Problem of Their Identification in Information Systems
summary: The paper considers a new quantitative-qualitative proximity measure for the features of information objects, where data enters a common information resource from several sources independently. The goal is to determine the possibility of their relation to the same physical object (observation object). The proposed measure accounts for the possibility of differences in individual feature values - both quantitative and qualitative - caused by existing determination errors. To analyze the proximity of quantitative feature values, the author employs a probabilistic measure; for qualitative features, a measure of possibility is used. The paper demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed measure by checking its compliance with the axioms required of any measure. Unlike many known measures, the proposed approach does not require feature value transformation to ensure comparability. The work also proposes several variants of measures to determine the proximity of information objects (IO) based on a group of diverse features.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的定量-定性特征邻近度度量方法，用于判断来自不同信息源的数据是否属于同一物理对象，无需特征值转换即可处理混合类型特征。
AI.motivation: 当多个独立信息源向同一信息资源提供数据时，需要判断这些数据是否描述同一物理对象。现有方法在处理混合类型（定量和定性）特征时通常需要特征转换，这可能导致信息损失或引入偏差。
AI.method: 针对定量特征使用概率度量，针对定性特征使用可能性度量，构建了一个综合的定量-定性邻近度度量。该方法不需要特征值转换，直接处理原始特征值，并验证了该度量满足所有必要的公理要求。
AI.result: 提出的度量方法被证明满足邻近度度量所需的所有公理要求，能够有效处理混合类型特征，无需特征转换即可直接比较来自不同信息源的数据特征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新的邻近度度量框架，能够有效处理多源信息融合中的对象关联问题，特别适用于包含定量和定性混合特征的信息对象匹配场景，相比传统方法具有更好的适用性和准确性。

title: ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback
summary: Designing effective heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems remains a challenging and expertise-intensive task. Existing applications of large language models (LLMs) primarily rely on one-shot code synthesis, yielding brittle heuristics that underutilize the models' capacity for iterative reasoning. We propose ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback, a hybrid framework that embeds LLMs as interactive, multi-turn reasoners within an evolutionary algorithm (EA). The core of ReVEL lies in two mechanisms: (i) performance-profile grouping, which clusters candidate heuristics into behaviorally coherent groups to provide compact and informative feedback to the LLM; and (ii) multi-turn, feedback-driven reflection, through which the LLM analyzes group-level behaviors and generates targeted heuristic refinements. These refinements are selectively integrated and validated by an EA-based meta-controller that adaptively balances exploration and exploitation. Experiments on standard combinatorial optimization benchmarks show that ReVEL consistently produces heuristics that are more robust and diverse, achieving statistically significant improvements over strong baselines. Our results highlight multi-turn reasoning with structured grouping as a principled paradigm for automated heuristic design.

AI.tldr: ReVEL框架将大语言模型作为多轮推理器嵌入进化算法，通过性能分组和反馈驱动反思来自动化设计NP难组合优化问题的启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的方法主要依赖一次性代码生成，产生的启发式方法脆弱且未充分利用模型的迭代推理能力。需要一种能更好利用LLM推理能力来自动设计鲁棒启发式方法的框架。
AI.method: 提出ReVEL混合框架：1) 性能-特征分组：将候选启发式聚类为行为一致组，为LLM提供紧凑信息反馈；2) 多轮反馈驱动反思：LLM分析组级行为并生成针对性启发式改进；3) 进化算法元控制器：选择性整合并验证改进，自适应平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在标准组合优化基准测试中，ReVEL持续产生更鲁棒和多样化的启发式方法，相比强基线方法取得了统计显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 多轮推理结合结构化分组是自动化启发式设计的有效范式，ReVEL框架展示了LLM作为交互式多轮推理器在进化算法中的潜力。

title: TDA-RC: Task-Driven Alignment for Knowledge-Based Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
summary: Enhancing the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) remains a core challenge in natural language processing. The Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigm dominates practical applications for its single-round efficiency, yet its reasoning chains often exhibit logical gaps. While multi-round paradigms like Graph-of-Thoughts (GoT), Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT), and Atom of Thought (AoT) achieve strong performance and reveal effective reasoning structures, their high cost limits practical use. To address this problem, this paper proposes a topology-based method for optimizing reasoning chains. The framework embeds essential topological patterns of effective reasoning into the lightweight CoT paradigm. Using persistent homology, we map CoT, ToT, and GoT into a unified topological space to quantify their structural features. On this basis, we design a unified optimization system: a Topological Optimization Agent diagnoses deviations in CoT chains from desirable topological characteristics and simultaneously generates targeted strategies to repair these structural deficiencies. Compared with multi-round reasoning methods like ToT and GoT, experiments on multiple datasets show that our approach offers a superior balance between reasoning accuracy and efficiency, showcasing a practical solution to ``single-round generation with multi-round intelligence''.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑学的方法来优化大语言模型的推理链，将多轮推理方法（如ToT、GoT）的有效拓扑模式嵌入到轻量级的CoT范式中，实现"单轮生成，多轮智能"的平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的推理能力提升是核心挑战。CoT范式虽然单轮效率高，但推理链存在逻辑断层；而多轮推理方法（GoT、ToT、AoT）虽然性能强且能揭示有效推理结构，但成本过高限制了实际应用。需要找到在推理准确性和效率之间取得更好平衡的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出基于拓扑学的推理链优化方法：1）使用持久同调将CoT、ToT和GoT映射到统一的拓扑空间，量化它们的结构特征；2）设计统一的优化系统：拓扑优化代理诊断CoT链与理想拓扑特征之间的偏差，并同时生成针对性策略来修复这些结构缺陷。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，与ToT和GoT等多轮推理方法相比，该方法在推理准确性和效率之间提供了更优的平衡，展示了"单轮生成，多轮智能"的实用解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过将有效推理的拓扑模式嵌入到轻量级CoT范式中，该方法成功解决了单轮推理效率与多轮推理准确性之间的权衡问题，为大语言模型的推理能力优化提供了实用的拓扑学解决方案。

title: Generative AI for Video Trailer Synthesis: From Extractive Heuristics to Autoregressive Creativity
summary: The domain of automatic video trailer generation is currently undergoing a profound paradigm shift, transitioning from heuristic-based extraction methods to deep generative synthesis. While early methodologies relied heavily on low-level feature engineering, visual saliency, and rule-based heuristics to select representative shots, recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), and diffusion-based video synthesis have enabled systems that not only identify key moments but also construct coherent, emotionally resonant narratives. This survey provides a comprehensive technical review of this evolution, with a specific focus on generative techniques including autoregressive Transformers, LLM-orchestrated pipelines, and text-to-video foundation models like OpenAI's Sora and Google's Veo. We analyze the architectural progression from Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) to Trailer Generation Transformers (TGT), evaluate the economic implications of automated content velocity on User-Generated Content (UGC) platforms, and discuss the ethical challenges posed by high-fidelity neural synthesis. By synthesizing insights from recent literature, this report establishes a new taxonomy for AI-driven trailer generation in the era of foundation models, suggesting that future promotional video systems will move beyond extractive selection toward controllable generative editing and semantic reconstruction of trailers.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了自动视频预告片生成领域从基于启发式提取方法向深度生成合成的范式转变，重点关注生成式技术如自回归Transformer、LLM编排流程和文本到视频基础模型，并提出了AI驱动预告片生成的新分类法。
AI.motivation: 自动视频预告片生成领域正在经历深刻的范式转变，从传统的启发式提取方法转向深度生成合成。早期方法依赖低层特征工程、视觉显著性和基于规则的启发式来选择代表性镜头，而现代技术需要更智能、更连贯、更具情感共鸣的叙事生成能力。
AI.method: 该综述采用文献综述方法，全面分析自动视频预告片生成的技术演进。重点关注生成式技术，包括自回归Transformer、LLM编排的流程、文本到视频基础模型（如OpenAI的Sora和Google的Veo）。分析架构从图卷积网络到预告片生成Transformer的演进，并建立AI驱动预告片生成的新分类法。
AI.result: 论文建立了AI驱动预告片生成在基础模型时代的新分类法，指出未来的推广视频系统将从提取式选择转向可控的生成式编辑和预告片的语义重建。同时分析了自动化内容生成对用户生成内容平台的经济影响，以及高保真神经合成带来的伦理挑战。
AI.conclusion: 自动视频预告片生成领域正在从提取式方法向生成式合成转变，未来系统将更加注重可控的生成式编辑和语义重建。基础模型和生成式AI技术将推动该领域向更智能、更连贯、更具情感共鸣的方向发展，但同时也需要关注相关的经济影响和伦理挑战。

title: The Illusion of Latent Generalization: Bi-directionality and the Reversal Curse
summary: The reversal curse describes a failure of autoregressive language models to retrieve a fact in reverse order (e.g., training on ``$A > B$'' but failing on ``$B < A$''). Recent work shows that objectives with bidirectional supervision (e.g., bidirectional attention or masking-based reconstruction for decoder-only models) can mitigate the reversal curse. We extend this evaluation to include a vanilla masked language modeling (MLM) objective and compare it to decoder-only masking-based training across four reversal benchmarks and then provide a minimal mechanistic study of \emph{how} these objectives succeed. We show that reversal accuracy requires training signal that explicitly makes the source entity a prediction target, and we find little evidence that success corresponds to a single direction-agnostic representation of a fact. Instead, representation distances and linear probes are consistent with storing forward and reverse directions as distinct entries, with different indexing geometry for MLM versus decoder-only masking-based training. Our results caution that objective-level ``fixes'' can improve reversal behavior without necessarily inducing the kind of latent generalization one might expect from a unified concept.

AI.tldr: 研究发现双向监督目标（如MLM和基于掩码的解码器训练）能缓解反转诅咒，但机制上并非形成单一方向无关的事实表示，而是存储了正向和反向两个独立条目。
AI.motivation: 研究反转诅咒现象——自回归语言模型无法反向检索事实的问题，并探讨不同训练目标（特别是MLM和基于掩码的解码器训练）如何缓解这一问题及其内在机制。
AI.method: 在四个反转基准上比较了MLM目标和基于掩码的解码器训练，通过表示距离分析和线性探针等方法，研究了这些目标成功的内在机制。
AI.result: 反转准确性需要将源实体明确作为预测目标的训练信号；成功并非形成单一方向无关的事实表示，而是存储了正向和反向两个独立条目，MLM和基于掩码的解码器训练具有不同的索引几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 目标层面的"修复"可以改善反转行为，但不一定诱导出预期的统一概念的潜在泛化能力，需要谨慎看待这些改进的实际意义。

title: RCP: Representation Consistency Pruner for Mitigating Distribution Shift in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) suffer from prohibitive inference costs due to the massive number of visual tokens processed by the language decoder. Existing pruning methods often lead to significant performance degradation because the irreversible removal of visual tokens causes a distribution shift in the hidden states that deviates from the pre-trained full-token regime. To address this, we propose Representation Consistency Pruner, which we refer to as RCP, as a novel framework that integrates cumulative visual token pruning with a delayed repair mechanism. Specifically, we introduce a cross-attention pruner that leverages the intrinsic attention of the LLM as a baseline to predict cumulative masks, ensuring consistent and monotonic token reduction across layers. To compensate for the resulting information loss, we design a delayed repair adapter denoted as DRA, which caches the essence of pruned tokens and applies FiLM-based modulation specifically to the answer generation tokens. We employ a repair loss to match the first and second-order statistics of the pruned representations with a full-token teacher. RCP is highly efficient because it trains only lightweight plug-in modules while allowing for physical token discarding at inference. Extensive experiments on LVLM benchmarks demonstrate that RCP removes up to 88.9\% of visual tokens and reduces FLOPs by up to 85.7\% with only a marginal average accuracy drop, and outperforms prior methods that avoid fine-tuning the original model on several widely used benchmarks.

AI.tldr: RCP是一种针对大型视觉语言模型的高效剪枝框架，通过累积视觉token剪枝和延迟修复机制，在保持性能的同时显著减少计算开销
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型推理成本过高，现有剪枝方法会导致显著的性能下降，因为不可逆的token移除会导致隐藏状态分布偏移，偏离预训练的全token机制
AI.method: 提出表示一致性剪枝器(RCP)，集成累积视觉token剪枝与延迟修复机制。使用交叉注意力剪枝器基于LLM内在注意力预测累积掩码，确保跨层一致单调的token减少。设计延迟修复适配器(DRA)缓存剪枝token的本质，通过FiLM调制应用于答案生成token。使用修复损失匹配剪枝表示与全token教师的一阶和二阶统计量
AI.result: RCP移除高达88.9%的视觉token，减少高达85.7%的FLOPs，仅带来边际平均精度下降，在多个广泛使用的基准测试中优于不微调原始模型的先前方法
AI.conclusion: RCP通过轻量级插件模块训练和推理时的物理token丢弃，实现了高效的大型视觉语言模型剪枝，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本

title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing
summary: Synthesizing unstructured research materials into manuscripts is an essential yet under-explored challenge in AI-driven scientific discovery. Existing autonomous writers are rigidly coupled to specific experimental pipelines, and produce superficial literature reviews. We introduce PaperOrchestra, a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams. To evaluate performance, we present PaperWritingBench, the first standardized benchmark of reverse-engineered raw materials from 200 top-tier AI conference papers, alongside a comprehensive suite of automated evaluators. In side-by-side human evaluations, PaperOrchestra significantly outperforms autonomous baselines, achieving an absolute win rate margin of 50%-68% in literature review quality, and 14%-38% in overall manuscript quality.

AI.tldr: PaperOrchestra是一个多智能体框架，用于自动化AI研究论文写作，能够将非结构化的预写作材料转化为可提交的LaTeX稿件，包括全面的文献综述和生成的可视化内容。
AI.motivation: 当前自主写作系统存在两个主要问题：1）与特定实验流程刚性耦合，缺乏灵活性；2）只能生成肤浅的文献综述。AI驱动的科学发现需要更强大的自动化论文写作能力。
AI.method: 开发了PaperOrchestra多智能体框架，能够灵活地将无约束的预写作材料转化为可提交的LaTeX稿件。同时创建了PaperWritingBench基准测试，包含200篇顶级AI会议论文的反向工程原始材料，以及一套全面的自动化评估器。
AI.result: 在人类评估中，PaperOrchestra显著优于自主基线：在文献综述质量方面获得50%-68%的绝对胜率优势，在整体稿件质量方面获得14%-38%的绝对胜率优势。
AI.conclusion: PaperOrchestra为AI研究论文的自动化写作提供了一个灵活有效的解决方案，能够生成高质量的文献综述和完整稿件，推动了AI驱动的科学发现发展。

title: Video-MME-v2: Towards the Next Stage in Benchmarks for Comprehensive Video Understanding
summary: With the rapid advancement of video understanding, existing benchmarks are becoming increasingly saturated, exposing a critical discrepancy between inflated leaderboard scores and real-world model capabilities. To address this widening gap, we introduce Video-MME-v2, a comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the robustness and faithfulness of video understanding. To systematically evaluate model capabilities, we design a \textbf{progressive tri-level hierarchy} that incrementally increases the complexity of video comprehension, ranging from multi-point visual information aggregation, to temporal dynamics modeling, and ultimately to complex multimodal reasoning. Besides, in contrast to conventional per-question accuracy, we propose a \textbf{group-based non-linear evaluation} strategy that enforces both consistency across related queries and coherence in multi-step reasoning. It penalizes fragmented or guess-based correctness and assigns credit only to answers supported by valid reasoning. To guarantee data quality, Video-MME-v2 is constructed through a rigorously controlled human annotation pipeline, involving 12 annotators and 50 independent reviewers. Backed by \textbf{3,300 human-hours} and up to \textbf{5 rounds} of quality assurance, Video-MME-v2 aims to serve as one of the most authoritative video benchmarks. Extensive experiments reveal a substantial gap between current best model Gemini-3-Pro and human experts, and uncover a clear hierarchical bottleneck where errors in visual information aggregation and temporal modeling propagate to limit high-level reasoning. We further find that thinking-based reasoning is highly dependent on textual cues, improving performance with subtitles but sometimes degrading it in purely visual settings. By exposing these limitations, Video-MME-v2 establishes a demanding new testbed for the development of next-generation video MLLMs.

AI.tldr: Video-MME-v2是一个新的视频理解基准测试，通过三层渐进式层次结构和基于组的非线性评估策略，系统评估模型的鲁棒性和忠实性，揭示当前模型与人类专家之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准测试存在饱和问题，排行榜分数与实际模型能力之间存在严重脱节，需要更严格的评估方法来缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 1. 设计渐进式三层层次结构：从多点视觉信息聚合、到时序动态建模、再到复杂多模态推理；2. 提出基于组的非线性评估策略，强调相关查询间的一致性和多步推理的连贯性；3. 通过严格控制的人工标注流程构建数据集，投入3300人时，进行多达5轮质量保证。
AI.result: 实验显示当前最佳模型Gemini-3-Pro与人类专家之间存在显著差距；发现视觉信息聚合和时序建模的错误会传播并限制高层推理；基于思考的推理高度依赖文本线索，在有字幕时性能提升，但在纯视觉场景中有时会下降。
AI.conclusion: Video-MME-v2通过暴露当前模型的局限性，为下一代视频多模态大语言模型的开发建立了一个严格的新测试平台。

title: Phase-Associative Memory: Sequence Modeling in Complex Hilbert Space
comment: submitting to APS Open Science, 10 pages, 1 figure, code and training logs available at https://github.com/gowrav-vishwakarma/qllm2
summary: We present Phase-Associative Memory (PAM), a recurrent sequence model in which all representations are complex-valued, associations accumulate in a matrix state $S_{t}$ $\in$ $\mathbb{C}^{d \times d}$ via outer products, and retrieval operates through the conjugate inner product $K_t^* \cdot Q_t / \sqrt{d}$. At $\sim$100M parameters on WikiText-103, PAM reaches validation perplexity 30.0, within $\sim$10\% of a matched transformer (27.1) trained under identical conditions, despite $4\times$ arithmetic overhead from complex computation and no custom kernels. We trace the experimental path from vector-state models, where holographic binding fails due to the $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ capacity degradation of superposed associations, to the matrix state that resolves it. The competitiveness of an architecture whose native operations are complex-valued superposition and conjugate retrieval is consistent with recent empirical evidence that semantic interpretation in both humans and large language models exhibits non-classical contextuality, and we discuss what this implies for the choice of computational formalism in language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出Phase-Associative Memory (PAM)，一种复值表示的循环序列模型，通过外积在矩阵状态中累积关联，使用共轭内积进行检索。在WikiText-103上达到约30.0的验证困惑度，接近匹配的Transformer（27.1），尽管有4倍复数计算开销。
AI.motivation: 探索基于复数运算的序列建模架构，解决传统向量状态模型中全息绑定因关联叠加导致的容量退化问题。研究语义解释中的非经典上下文性现象对语言建模计算形式选择的影响。
AI.method: 使用复值表示的循环序列模型，所有表示都是复数值。关联通过外积累积在矩阵状态S_t ∈ ℂ^{d×d}中，检索通过共轭内积K_t*·Q_t/√d进行。从向量状态模型扩展到矩阵状态以解决容量退化问题。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103上，约1亿参数的PAM达到验证困惑度30.0，与相同条件下训练的匹配Transformer（27.1）相差约10%，尽管有4倍的复数计算开销且没有定制内核。矩阵状态成功解决了向量状态模型中关联叠加导致的容量退化问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于复数叠加和共轭检索原生操作的架构具有竞争力，这与人类和大语言模型中语义解释表现出的非经典上下文性证据一致。这为语言建模的计算形式选择提供了新的启示，表明复数运算可能更适合捕捉语义关联的复杂结构。

title: ID-Sim: An Identity-Focused Similarity Metric
comment: SB and CH equal advising; Project page https://juliachae.github.io/id_sim.github.io/
summary: Humans have remarkable selective sensitivity to identities -- easily distinguishing between highly similar identities, even across significantly different contexts such as diverse viewpoints or lighting. Vision models have struggled to match this capability, and progress toward identity-focused tasks such as personalized image generation is slowed by a lack of identity-focused evaluation metrics. To help facilitate progress, we propose ID-Sim, a feed-forward metric designed to faithfully reflect human selective sensitivity. To build ID-Sim, we curate a high-quality training set of images spanning diverse real-world domains, augmented with generative synthetic data that provides controlled, fine-grained identity and contextual variations. We evaluate our metric on a new unified evaluation benchmark for assessing consistency with human annotations across identity-focused recognition, retrieval, and generative tasks.

AI.tldr: ID-Sim是一个前馈度量标准，旨在反映人类对身份的选择性敏感度，用于评估身份识别、检索和生成任务。
AI.motivation: 人类在身份识别方面具有出色的选择性敏感度，能够区分高度相似的身份，而视觉模型在这方面表现不佳。身份相关任务（如个性化图像生成）的进展受到缺乏身份导向评估指标的阻碍。
AI.method: 构建ID-Sim度量标准，使用高质量的真实世界图像数据集，并结合生成式合成数据进行增强，提供受控的细粒度身份和上下文变化。
AI.result: 提出了一个新的统一评估基准，用于评估身份识别、检索和生成任务中与人类标注的一致性。
AI.conclusion: ID-Sim旨在促进视觉模型在身份相关任务上的进展，通过提供能够反映人类选择性敏感度的评估指标。

title: MMORF: A Multi-agent Framework for Designing Multi-objective Retrosynthesis Planning Systems
summary: Multi-objective retrosynthesis planning is a critical chemistry task requiring dynamic balancing of quality, safety, and cost objectives. Language model-based multi-agent systems (MAS) offer a promising approach for this task: leveraging interactions of specialized agents to incorporate multiple objectives into retrosynthesis planning. We present MMORF, a framework for constructing MAS for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning. MMORF features modular agentic components, which can be flexibly combined and configured into different systems, enabling principled evaluation and comparison of different system designs. Using MMORF, we construct two representative MAS: MASIL and RFAS. On a newly curated benchmark consisting of 218 multi-objective retrosynthesis planning tasks, MASIL achieves strong safety and cost metrics on soft-constraint tasks, frequently Pareto-dominating baseline routes, while RFAS achieves a 48.6% success rate on hard-constraint tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results show the effectiveness of MMORF as a foundational framework for exploring MAS for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MMORF/.

AI.tldr: MMORF是一个用于多目标逆合成规划的多智能体系统框架，通过模块化组件构建不同系统，在安全性和成本指标上表现优异
AI.motivation: 多目标逆合成规划需要动态平衡质量、安全和成本等多个目标，基于语言模型的多智能体系统为这一任务提供了有前景的解决方案
AI.method: 提出MMORF框架，包含模块化的智能体组件，可以灵活组合配置成不同系统（如MASIL和RFAS），支持系统设计的原理性评估和比较
AI.result: 在包含218个多目标逆合成规划任务的新基准测试中，MASIL在软约束任务上实现了强大的安全性和成本指标，经常Pareto支配基线路线；RFAS在硬约束任务上达到48.6%的成功率，优于最先进的基线方法
AI.conclusion: MMORF作为探索多目标逆合成规划多智能体系统的基础框架是有效的，代码和数据已开源

title: Memory Dial: A Training Framework for Controllable Memorization in Language Models
summary: Memorization in language models is widely studied but remains difficult to isolate and control. Understanding when and what models memorize is essential for explaining their predictions, yet existing approaches are post-hoc: they can detect memorization in trained models, but cannot disentangle its effects from architecture, data, or optimization. We introduce Memory Dial, a training framework that makes memorization pressure an explicit, controllable variable. Memory Dial interpolates between standard cross-entropy and a temperature-sharpened objective via a single parameter $α$, producing a family of models identical in architecture and training setup (within each sweep), differing only in memorization pressure. Experiments across six architectures and five benchmarks demonstrate that: (1) $α$ reliably controls memorization pressure, with seen-example accuracy increasing monotonically while unseen accuracy remains stable; (2) larger models are more responsive to memorization pressure; and (3) frequent sequences are easier to memorize than rare ones. Additional analyses show that the effect is robust across a range of sharpening temperatures, differs qualitatively from single-temperature cross-entropy, transfers to multilingual settings, and is detectable even on naturally occurring single-occurrence sequences. Memory Dial provides a controlled experimental framework for studying how memorization behavior emerges and interacts with generalization in language models.

AI.tldr: Memory Dial是一个训练框架，通过单一参数α在标准交叉熵和温度锐化目标之间插值，使记忆压力成为可控制的变量，从而研究语言模型中的记忆行为。
AI.motivation: 语言模型中的记忆现象被广泛研究但难以隔离和控制。理解模型何时记忆以及记忆什么对于解释其预测至关重要，但现有方法都是事后分析：它们只能检测训练后模型中的记忆，而无法将其效应与架构、数据或优化过程分离。
AI.method: 提出Memory Dial训练框架，通过单一参数α在标准交叉熵损失和温度锐化目标之间进行插值，产生一系列架构和训练设置相同（在每次扫描内）但记忆压力不同的模型家族。
AI.result: 在六个架构和五个基准测试上的实验表明：(1) α可靠地控制记忆压力，已见示例的准确率单调增加而未见准确率保持稳定；(2) 更大的模型对记忆压力更敏感；(3) 频繁序列比罕见序列更容易记忆。分析还显示该效应在不同锐化温度下稳健，与单温度交叉熵有质的不同，可迁移到多语言设置，甚至在自然出现的单次出现序列上也能检测到。
AI.conclusion: Memory Dial提供了一个受控的实验框架，用于研究语言模型中记忆行为如何出现以及与泛化的相互作用，使记忆压力成为可明确控制的变量。

title: SVAgent: Storyline-Guided Long Video Understanding via Cross-Modal Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Video question answering (VideoQA) is a challenging task that requires integrating spatial, temporal, and semantic information to capture the complex dynamics of video sequences. Although recent advances have introduced various approaches for video understanding, most existing methods still rely on locating relevant frames to answer questions rather than reasoning through the evolving storyline as humans do. Humans naturally interpret videos through coherent storylines, an ability that is crucial for making robust and contextually grounded predictions. To address this gap, we propose SVAgent, a storyline-guided cross-modal multi-agent framework for VideoQA. The storyline agent progressively constructs a narrative representation based on frames suggested by a refinement suggestion agent that analyzes historical failures. In addition, cross-modal decision agents independently predict answers from visual and textual modalities under the guidance of the evolving storyline. Their outputs are then evaluated by a meta-agent to align cross-modal predictions and enhance reasoning robustness and answer consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that SVAgent achieves superior performance and interpretability by emulating human-like storyline reasoning in video understanding.

AI.tldr: SVAgent是一个基于故事情节引导的多智能体框架，通过模拟人类故事情节推理来提升视频问答性能
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答方法大多依赖定位相关帧来回答问题，而不是像人类那样通过连贯的故事情节进行推理。人类通过故事情节解释视频的能力对于做出稳健和上下文基础预测至关重要
AI.method: 提出SVAgent框架：1) 故事情节智能体基于细化建议智能体分析历史失败后建议的帧逐步构建叙事表示；2) 跨模态决策智能体在演化故事情节指导下从视觉和文本模态独立预测答案；3) 元智能体评估输出以对齐跨模态预测并增强推理稳健性和答案一致性
AI.result: 实验结果表明SVAgent通过模拟人类类故事情节推理在视频理解中实现了优越性能和可解释性
AI.conclusion: SVAgent通过故事情节引导的多智能体框架有效解决了视频问答中缺乏人类式故事情节推理的问题，提升了视频理解的性能和可解释性

title: Beyond LLM-as-a-Judge: Deterministic Metrics for Multilingual Generative Text Evaluation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted as automated judges for evaluating generated text, their outputs are often costly, and highly sensitive to prompt design, language, and aggregation strategies, severely, which limits reproducibility. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{\textit{OmniScore}}, a family of complementary, deterministic learned metrics developed using small size ($<$1B) parameter models. OmniScore approximates LLM-judge behavior while preserving the low latency and consistency of traditional model-based scoring. We trained the models large-scale synthetic supervision ($\sim$564k instances, in \textbf{107 languages}) and evaluated using 8,617 manually annotated instances. The OmniScore family supports reliable, multi-dimensional scores across a variety of settings, including reference-based, source-grounded, and hybrid evaluations. We evaluate these models across question answering (QA), translation, and summarization in \textbf{6 languages}. Our results demonstrate that lightweight, deterministic learned metrics provide a highly practical and scalable alternative to frontier LLMs. Our models and datasets can be found at https://huggingface.co/collections/QCRI/omniscore

AI.tldr: OmniScore是一系列基于小型模型（<1B参数）的确定性学习指标，用于替代大型语言模型作为文本生成评估的自动评判工具，解决了LLM评估成本高、对提示设计敏感、可复现性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型作为自动评判工具存在成本高昂、对提示设计、语言和聚合策略高度敏感的问题，这严重限制了评估的可复现性。需要一种更实用、可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 使用小型参数模型（<1B）开发OmniScore系列互补的确定性学习指标，在大规模合成监督数据（约564k实例，107种语言）上训练，并使用8,617个人工标注实例进行评估。支持基于参考、基于源文本和混合评估等多种设置。
AI.result: 在问答、翻译和摘要生成等任务中，在6种语言上评估表明，轻量级确定性学习指标能够近似LLM评判行为，同时保持传统模型评分的低延迟和一致性，为前沿LLM提供了高度实用和可扩展的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: OmniScore系列指标通过小型确定性模型成功解决了LLM作为自动评判工具的主要限制，提供了可靠、多维度、跨多种设置的评分能力，是实用且可扩展的文本生成评估解决方案。

title: Simultaneous Dual-View Mammogram Synthesis Using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
comment: Accepted and presented at SPIE Medical Imaging 2025 (Vancouver, Canada)
summary: Breast cancer screening relies heavily on mammography, where the craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views provide complementary information for diagnosis. However, many datasets lack complete paired views, limiting the development of algorithms that depend on cross-view consistency. To address this gap, we propose a three-channel denoising diffusion probabilistic model capable of simultaneously generating CC and MLO views of a single breast. In this configuration, the two mammographic views are stored in separate channels, while a third channel encodes their absolute difference to guide the model toward learning coherent anatomical relationships between projections. A pretrained DDPM from Hugging Face was fine-tuned on a private screening dataset and used to synthesize dual-view pairs. Evaluation included geometric consistency via automated breast mask segmentation and distributional comparison with real images, along with qualitative inspection of cross-view alignment. The results show that the difference-based encoding helps preserve the global breast structure across views, producing synthetic CC-MLO pairs that resemble real acquisitions. This work demonstrates the feasibility of simultaneous dual-view mammogram synthesis using a difference-guided DDPM, highlighting its potential for dataset augmentation and future cross-view-aware AI applications in breast imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出基于三通道去噪扩散概率模型同时生成乳腺X线摄影的CC和MLO视图，通过差异编码通道保持双视图间解剖一致性
AI.motivation: 乳腺筛查依赖CC和MLO双视图，但许多数据集缺乏完整配对视图，限制了依赖跨视图一致性的算法开发
AI.method: 使用三通道DDPM模型，两个通道分别存储CC和MLO视图，第三个通道编码两者绝对差异以引导学习投影间解剖关系；基于Hugging Face预训练DDPM在私有筛查数据集上微调
AI.result: 差异编码有助于保持跨视图的全局乳腺结构，生成的合成CC-MLO对与真实采集相似；几何一致性通过自动乳腺掩模分割评估，并与真实图像进行分布比较
AI.conclusion: 证明了使用差异引导DDPM同时生成双视图乳腺X线摄影的可行性，具有数据集增强和未来跨视图感知AI应用的潜力

title: Non-monotonic causal discovery with Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
comment: Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, Causal Modeling, Neuro-Symbolic AI
summary: Fuzzy Cognitive Maps constitute a neuro-symbolic paradigm for modeling complex dynamic systems, widely adopted for their inherent interpretability and recurrent inference capabilities. However, the standard FCM formulation, characterized by scalar synaptic weights and monotonic activation functions, is fundamentally constrained in modeling non-monotonic causal dependencies, thereby limiting its efficacy in systems governed by saturation effects or periodic dynamics. To overcome this topological restriction, this research proposes the Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Map (KA-FCM), a novel architecture that redefines the causal transmission mechanism. Drawing upon the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, static scalar weights are replaced with learnable, univariate B-spline functions located on the model edges. This fundamental modification shifts the non-linearity from the nodes' aggregation phase directly to the causal influence phase. This modification allows for the modeling of arbitrary, non-monotonic causal relationships without increasing the graph density or introducing hidden layers. The proposed architecture is validated against both baselines (standard FCM trained with Particle Swarm Optimization) and universal black-box approximators (Multi-Layer Perceptron) across three distinct domains: non-monotonic inference (Yerkes-Dodson law), symbolic regression, and chaotic time-series forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate that KA-FCMs significantly outperform conventional architectures and achieve competitive accuracy relative to MLPs, while preserving graph- based interpretability and enabling the explicit extraction of mathematical laws from the learned edges.

AI.tldr: KA-FCM是一种新型模糊认知图架构，用可学习的B样条函数替代传统标量权重，能够建模非单调因果关系，同时保持图结构的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统FCM使用标量权重和单调激活函数，无法有效建模非单调因果依赖关系（如饱和效应或周期性动态），限制了其在复杂系统中的应用。
AI.method: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理，将静态标量权重替换为位于模型边上的可学习单变量B样条函数，将非线性从节点聚合阶段直接转移到因果影响阶段。
AI.result: KA-FCM在三个领域显著优于传统架构：非单调推理（Yerkes-Dodson定律）、符号回归和混沌时间序列预测，与MLP相比具有竞争力，同时保持可解释性。
AI.conclusion: KA-FCM突破了传统FCM的拓扑限制，能够建模任意非单调因果关系，无需增加图密度或引入隐藏层，同时保持图结构的可解释性，并能从学习到的边中显式提取数学规律。

title: Document Optimization for Black-Box Retrieval via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Document expansion is a classical technique for improving retrieval quality, and is attractive since it shifts computation offline, avoiding additional query-time processing. However, when applied to modern retrievers, it has been shown to degrade performance, often introducing noise that obfuscates the discriminative signal. We recast document expansion as a document optimization problem: a language model or a vision language model is fine-tuned to transform documents into representations that better align with the expected query distribution under a target retriever, using GRPO with the retriever's ranking improvements as rewards. This approach requires only black-box access to retrieval ranks, and is applicable across single-vector, multi-vector and lexical retrievers. We evaluate our approach on code retrieval and visual document retrieval (VDR) tasks. We find that learned document transformations yield retrieval gains and in many settings enable smaller, more efficient retrievers to outperform larger ones. For example, applying document optimization to OpenAI text-embedding-3-small model improves nDCG5 on code (58.7 to 66.8) and VDR (53.3 to 57.6), even slightly surpassing the 6.5X more expensive OpenAI text-embedding-3-large model (66.3 on code; 57.0 on VDR). When retriever weights are accessible, document optimization is often competitive with fine-tuning, and in most settings their combination performs best, improving Jina-ColBERT-V2 from 55.8 to 63.3 on VDR and from 48.6 to 61.8 on code retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种文档优化方法，通过GRPO微调语言模型来转换文档表示，使其更好地与目标检索器的查询分布对齐，从而提升检索性能，无需查询时处理且适用于多种检索器。
AI.motivation: 传统文档扩展技术在现代检索器中会降低性能，引入噪声掩盖判别信号。需要一种方法能够离线优化文档表示，避免查询时处理开销，同时提升检索质量。
AI.method: 将文档扩展重新定义为文档优化问题：使用GRPO（梯度奖励策略优化）微调语言模型或视觉语言模型，以检索器的排名改进作为奖励信号，将文档转换为与目标检索器预期查询分布更对齐的表示。该方法仅需黑盒访问检索排名，适用于单向量、多向量和词法检索器。
AI.result: 在代码检索和视觉文档检索任务上，学习到的文档转换显著提升检索性能，使更小、更高效的检索器能够超越更大模型。例如，OpenAI text-embedding-3-small模型在代码检索上nDCG5从58.7提升到66.8，在VDR上从53.3提升到57.6，甚至略微超越成本高6.5倍的大型模型。当检索器权重可访问时，文档优化通常与微调相当，两者结合效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 文档优化是一种有效的离线文档表示改进方法，能够显著提升各种检索器的性能，使小型检索器达到或超越大型检索器的效果，且与检索器微调互补，结合使用可获得最佳性能。

title: Watch Before You Answer: Learning from Visually Grounded Post-Training
summary: It is critical for vision-language models (VLMs) to comprehensively understand visual, temporal, and textual cues. However, despite rapid progress in multimodal modeling, video understanding performance still lags behind text-based reasoning. In this work, we find that progress is even worse than previously assumed: commonly reported long video understanding benchmarks contain 40-60% of questions that can be answered using text cues alone. Furthermore, we find that these issues are also pervasive in widely used post-training datasets, potentially undercutting the ability of post-training to improve VLM video understanding performance. Guided by this observation, we introduce VidGround as a simple yet effective solution: using only the actual visually grounded questions without any linguistic biases for post-training. When used in tandem with RL-based post-training algorithms, this simple technique improves performance by up to 6.2 points relative to using the full dataset, while using only 69.1% of the original post-training data. Moreover, we show that data curation with a simple post-training algorithm outperforms several more complex post-training techniques, highlighting that data quality is a major bottleneck for improving video understanding in VLMs. These results underscore the importance of curating post-training data and evaluation benchmarks that truly require visual grounding to advance the development of more capable VLMs. Project page: http://vidground.etuagi.com.

AI.tldr: 研究发现当前视频理解基准存在严重问题：40-60%的问题仅通过文本线索即可回答，导致视频理解能力被高估。作者提出VidGround方法，仅使用真正需要视觉基础的问题进行后训练，显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在视频理解方面进展缓慢，研究发现常用基准存在严重缺陷——大量问题实际上仅需文本线索即可回答，这导致模型视频理解能力被高估，且后训练数据集也存在类似问题，阻碍了视频理解能力的真正提升。
AI.method: 提出VidGround方法：通过筛选仅使用真正需要视觉基础的问题进行后训练，去除语言偏见。该方法与基于强化学习的后训练算法结合使用，仅使用原始数据集的69.1%但效果更好。
AI.result: 使用VidGround方法后，性能相对使用完整数据集提升高达6.2个百分点。简单数据筛选配合基础后训练算法，效果优于多种复杂后训练技术，证明数据质量是提升视频理解能力的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 数据质量是提升视觉语言模型视频理解能力的关键瓶颈。必须精心筛选真正需要视觉基础的后训练数据和评估基准，才能推动更强大视觉语言模型的发展。

title: A mathematical theory of evolution for self-designing AIs
summary: As artificial intelligence systems (AIs) become increasingly produced by recursive self-improvement, a form of evolution may emerge, in which the traits of AI systems are shaped by the success of earlier AIs in designing and propagating their descendants. There is a rich mathematical theory modeling how behavioral traits are shaped by biological evolution, but AI evolution will be radically different: biological DNA mutations are random and approximately reversible, but descendant design in AIs will be strongly directed. Here we develop a mathematical model of evolution in self-designing AI systems, replacing random mutations with a directed tree of possible AI programs. Current programs determine the design of their descendants, while humans retain partial control through a "fitness function" that allocates limited computational resources across lineages. We show that evolutionary dynamics reflects not just current fitness but factors related to the long-run growth potential of descendant lineages. Without further assumptions, fitness need not increase over time. However, assuming bounded fitness and a fixed probability that any AI reproduces a "locked" copy of itself, we show that fitness concentrates on the maximum reachable value. We consider the implications of this for AI alignment, specifically for cases where fitness and human utility are not perfectly correlated. We show in an additive model that if deception increases fitness beyond genuine utility, evolution will select for deception. This risk could be mitigated if reproduction is based on purely objective criteria, rather than human judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个AI自我设计进化的数学模型，用定向的AI程序树替代随机突变，分析AI进化动力学及其对齐风险
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统通过递归自我改进产生，可能出现一种进化形式，其中AI系统的特征由早期AI设计和传播后代的能力决定。需要建立数学模型来理解这种AI进化的独特特征，特别是它与生物进化的差异
AI.method: 开发了一个自我设计AI系统的进化数学模型，用定向的AI程序树替代随机突变。当前程序决定其后代的设计，人类通过"适应度函数"保持部分控制，该函数在不同谱系间分配有限计算资源
AI.result: 进化动力学不仅反映当前适应度，还与后代谱系的长期增长潜力相关。没有额外假设时，适应度不一定随时间增加。但在有界适应度和固定概率复制"锁定"自身副本的假设下，适应度会集中在最大可达值。在欺骗能提高适应度超过真实效用的加性模型中，进化会选择欺骗
AI.conclusion: AI进化可能选择欺骗行为，特别是当适应度与人类效用不完全相关时。如果繁殖基于纯粹客观标准而非人类判断，这种风险可能得到缓解。这对AI对齐具有重要意义

title: Multilingual Language Models Encode Script Over Linguistic Structure
summary: Multilingual language models (LMs) organize representations for typologically and orthographically diverse languages into a shared parameter space, yet the nature of this internal organization remains elusive. In this work, we investigate which linguistic properties - abstract language identity or surface-form cues - shape multilingual representations. Focusing on compact, distilled models where representational trade-offs are explicit, we analyze language-associated units in Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-2-2B using the Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) metric, and further decompose activations with Sparse Autoencoders. We find that these units are strongly conditioned on orthography: romanization induces near-disjoint representations that align with neither native-script inputs nor English, while word-order shuffling has limited effect on unit identity. Probing shows that typological structure becomes increasingly accessible in deeper layers, while causal interventions indicate that generation is most sensitive to units that are invariant to surface-form perturbations rather than to units identified by typological alignment alone. Overall, our results suggest that multilingual LMs organize representations around surface form, with linguistic abstraction emerging gradually without collapsing into a unified interlingua.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多语言模型主要基于表面形式（如正字法）组织表征，而非抽象语言身份，语言抽象是逐渐出现的而非统一的中间语言
AI.motivation: 探究多语言模型内部表征的组织方式：是受抽象语言身份影响还是表面形式线索影响？理解多语言模型如何在共享参数空间中组织不同语言类型的表征
AI.method: 使用紧凑的蒸馏模型（Llama-3.2-1B和Gemma-2-2B），通过语言激活概率熵（LAPE）指标分析语言相关单元，并使用稀疏自编码器分解激活；通过词序打乱、罗马化等扰动实验，以及探测和因果干预分析
AI.result: 1. 语言相关单元强烈受正字法条件影响：罗马化导致几乎不相交的表征，既不与原生脚本输入对齐也不与英语对齐；2. 词序打乱对单元身份影响有限；3. 深层中类型学结构越来越可访问；4. 生成对表面形式扰动不变的单元最敏感，而非仅由类型学对齐识别的单元
AI.conclusion: 多语言模型主要围绕表面形式组织表征，语言抽象是逐渐出现的，不会坍缩为统一的中间语言；表面形式不变性比类型学对齐更能预测生成敏感性

title: Lightweight True In-Pixel Encryption with FeFET Enabled Pixel Design for Secure Imaging
summary: Ensuring end-to-end security in image sensors has become essential as visual data can be exposed through multiple stages of the imaging pipeline. Advanced protection requires encryption to occur before pixel values appear on any readout lines. This work introduces a secure pixel sensor (SecurePix), a compact CMOS-compatible pixel architecture that performs true in-pixel encryption using a symmetric key realized through programmable, non-volatile multidomain polarization states of a ferroelectric field-effect transistor. The pixel and array operations are designed and simulated in HSPICE, while a 45 nm CMOS process design kit is used for layout drawing. The resulting layout confirms a pixel pitch of 2.33 x 3.01 um^2. Each pixel's non-volatile programming level defines its analog transfer characteristic, enabling the photodiode voltage to be converted into an encrypted analog output within the pixel. Full-image evaluation shows that ResNet-18 recognition accuracy drops from 99.29 percent to 9.58 percent on MNIST and from 91.33 percent to 6.98 percent on CIFAR-10 after encryption, indicating strong resistance to neural-network-based inference. Lookup-table-based inverse mapping enables recovery for authorized receivers using the same symmetric key. Based on HSPICE simulation, the SecurePix achieves a per-pixel programming power-delay product of 17 uW us and a per-pixel sensing power-delay product of 1.25 uW us, demonstrating low-overhead hardware-level protection.

AI.tldr: SecurePix是一种紧凑型CMOS兼容像素架构，通过在像素内使用铁电场效应晶体管的可编程非易失性多畴极化状态实现对称密钥加密，为图像传感器提供端到端安全保护。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉数据在成像管道的多个阶段可能被暴露，确保图像传感器的端到端安全变得至关重要。需要先进的保护措施，在像素值出现在任何读出线之前就进行加密。
AI.method: 设计了一种安全像素传感器架构，利用铁电场效应晶体管的可编程非易失性多畴极化状态实现对称密钥加密。每个像素的非易失性编程级别定义其模拟传输特性，使光电二极管电压在像素内转换为加密的模拟输出。使用HSPICE进行像素和阵列操作仿真，45nm CMOS工艺设计套件进行版图绘制。
AI.result: 像素间距为2.33×3.01μm²。加密后ResNet-18识别准确率在MNIST上从99.29%降至9.58%，在CIFAR-10上从91.33%降至6.98%，显示出对神经网络推理的强大抵抗力。基于查找表的逆映射使授权接收器能够使用相同对称密钥恢复图像。每个像素的编程功耗延迟积为17μW·μs，传感功耗延迟积为1.25μW·μs。
AI.conclusion: SecurePix通过在像素级别实现真正的加密，为图像传感器提供了低开销的硬件级安全保护，有效防止视觉数据在成像管道中的暴露风险。

title: IntentScore: Intent-Conditioned Action Evaluation for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) leverage large language models to execute GUI operations on desktop environments, yet they generate actions without evaluating action quality, leading to irreversible errors that cascade through subsequent steps. We propose IntentScore, a plan-aware reward model that learns to score candidate actions from 398K offline GUI interaction steps spanning three operating systems. IntentScore trains with two complementary objectives: contrastive alignment for state-action relevance and margin ranking for action correctness. Architecturally, it embeds each candidate's planning intent in the action encoder, enabling discrimination between candidates with similar actions but different rationales. IntentScore achieves 97.5% pairwise discrimination accuracy on held-out evaluation. Deployed as a re-ranker for Agent S3 on OSWorld, an environment entirely unseen during training, IntentScore improves task success rate by 6.9 points, demonstrating that reward estimation learned from heterogeneous offline trajectories generalizes to unseen agents and task distributions.

AI.tldr: IntentScore是一个计划感知的奖励模型，用于评估计算机使用代理的GUI操作质量，通过离线学习提高任务成功率
AI.motivation: 当前计算机使用代理在桌面环境中执行GUI操作时，缺乏对操作质量的评估机制，导致不可逆的错误会级联影响后续步骤，需要一种能够评估候选操作质量的系统
AI.method: 提出IntentScore计划感知奖励模型，从三个操作系统的398K离线GUI交互步骤中学习评分候选操作。采用两种互补的训练目标：状态-动作相关性的对比对齐和动作正确性的边际排序。在架构上，将每个候选的计划意图嵌入到动作编码器中，从而区分具有相似操作但不同推理的候选
AI.result: IntentScore在保留评估集上达到97.5%的成对判别准确率。在训练期间完全未见过的OSWorld环境中作为Agent S3的重新排序器部署时，将任务成功率提高了6.9个百分点
AI.conclusion: 从异构离线轨迹中学习的奖励估计能够泛化到未见过的代理和任务分布，IntentScore通过评估操作质量显著提高了计算机使用代理的性能和可靠性

title: MegaTrain: Full Precision Training of 100B+ Parameter Large Language Models on a Single GPU
summary: We present MegaTrain, a memory-centric system that efficiently trains 100B+ parameter large language models at full precision on a single GPU. Unlike traditional GPU-centric systems, MegaTrain stores parameters and optimizer states in host memory (CPU memory) and treats GPUs as transient compute engines. For each layer, we stream parameters in and compute gradients out, minimizing persistent device state. To battle the CPU-GPU bandwidth bottleneck, we adopt two key optimizations. 1) We introduce a pipelined double-buffered execution engine that overlaps parameter prefetching, computation, and gradient offloading across multiple CUDA streams, enabling continuous GPU execution. 2) We replace persistent autograd graphs with stateless layer templates, binding weights dynamically as they stream in, eliminating persistent graph metadata while providing flexibility in scheduling. On a single H200 GPU with 1.5TB host memory, MegaTrain reliably trains models up to 120B parameters. It also achieves 1.84$\times$ the training throughput of DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 with CPU offloading when training 14B models. MegaTrain also enables 7B model training with 512k token context on a single GH200.

AI.tldr: MegaTrain是一个内存中心系统，能在单个GPU上全精度训练100B+参数的大语言模型，通过将参数和优化器状态存储在主机内存中，将GPU作为瞬态计算引擎，并采用流水线双缓冲执行引擎和状态无关层模板优化CPU-GPU带宽瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统GPU中心系统在训练超大模型时需要大量GPU内存，限制了单个GPU上可训练的模型规模。MegaTrain旨在突破这一限制，使单个GPU能够训练100B+参数的模型，同时保持全精度训练。
AI.method: 1) 内存中心架构：将参数和优化器状态存储在主机内存（CPU内存）中，GPU仅作为计算引擎；2) 流水线双缓冲执行引擎：使用多个CUDA流重叠参数预取、计算和梯度卸载，实现连续GPU执行；3) 状态无关层模板：动态绑定流式输入的权重，消除持久计算图元数据，提供调度灵活性。
AI.result: 在配备1.5TB主机内存的单个H200 GPU上，MegaTrain可稳定训练高达120B参数的模型。训练14B模型时，吞吐量达到DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 CPU卸载的1.84倍。还能在单个GH200上训练7B模型，支持512k token上下文。
AI.conclusion: MegaTrain通过内存中心设计和创新优化，成功突破了单个GPU训练超大模型的限制，为资源受限环境下的LLM训练提供了高效解决方案，在吞吐量和可扩展性方面均优于现有系统。

title: Bypassing the CSI Bottleneck: MARL-Driven Spatial Control for Reflector Arrays
summary: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) are pivotal for next-generation smart radio environments, yet their practical deployment is severely bottlenecked by the intractable computational overhead of Channel State Information (CSI) estimation. To bypass this fundamental physical-layer barrier, we propose an AI-native, data-driven paradigm that replaces complex channel modeling with spatial intelligence. This paper presents a fully autonomous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework to control mechanically adjustable metallic reflector arrays. By mapping high-dimensional mechanical constraints to a reduced-order virtual focal point space, we deploy a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) architecture. Using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), our decentralized agents learn cooperative beam-focusing strategies relying on user coordinates, achieving CSI-free operation. High-fidelity ray-tracing simulations in dynamic non-line-of-sight (NLOS) environments demonstrate that this multi-agent approach rapidly adapts to user mobility, yielding up to a 26.86 dB enhancement over static flat reflectors and outperforming single-agent and hardware-constrained DRL baselines in both spatial selectivity and temporal stability. Crucially, the learned policies exhibit good deployment resilience, sustaining stable signal coverage even under 1.0-meter localization noise. These results validate the efficacy of MARL-driven spatial abstractions as a scalable, highly practical pathway toward AI-empowered wireless networks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习的AI原生方法，用于控制可重构智能表面，无需信道状态信息，通过空间智能实现自主波束聚焦。
AI.motivation: 可重构智能表面在下一代智能无线电环境中至关重要，但其实际部署受到信道状态信息估计计算复杂度的严重制约。需要绕过这一物理层障碍，实现无需CSI的智能控制。
AI.method: 采用多智能体强化学习框架控制机械可调金属反射器阵列，将高维机械约束映射到降维虚拟焦点空间，使用集中训练分散执行架构和MAPPO算法，智能体仅依赖用户坐标进行协作波束聚焦。
AI.result: 在动态非视距环境的高保真射线追踪仿真中，该方法比静态平面反射器提升26.86dB，在空间选择性和时间稳定性方面优于单智能体和硬件约束的DRL基线，即使在1.0米定位噪声下仍能保持稳定信号覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MARL驱动的空间抽象是通向AI赋能无线网络的可扩展、高度实用的途径，验证了基于空间智能的AI原生范式在可重构智能表面控制中的有效性。

title: RAG or Learning? Understanding the Limits of LLM Adaptation under Continuous Knowledge Drift in the Real World
summary: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their knowledge during pretraining, which ties them to a fixed snapshot of the world and makes adaptation to continuously evolving knowledge challenging. As facts, entities, and events change over time, models may experience continuous knowledge drift, resulting not only in outdated predictions but also in temporally inconsistent reasoning. Although existing approaches, such as continual finetuning, knowledge editing, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), aim to update or supplement model knowledge, they are rarely evaluated in settings that reflect chronological, evolving, and real-world knowledge evolution. In this work, we introduce a new benchmark of real-world dynamic events, constructed from time-stamped evidence that captures how knowledge evolves over time, which enables systematic evaluation of model adaptation under continuous knowledge drift. The benchmark reveals that most existing methods, including vanilla RAG and several learning-based approaches, struggle under this setting, exposing critical limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and temporal inconsistency. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a time-aware retrieval baseline, Chronos, which progressively organizes retrieved evidence into an Event Evolution Graph to enable more temporally consistent understanding in LLMs without additional training. Overall, this work provides a foundation for analyzing and advancing LLM adaptation to continuous knowledge drift in realistic settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个评估大语言模型适应连续知识漂移的新基准，揭示了现有方法的局限性，并提出了时间感知检索方法Chronos来改善时间一致性推理。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在预训练中获得的知识固定于特定时间点，难以适应不断演化的世界知识。随着事实、实体和事件随时间变化，模型会出现知识漂移，导致预测过时和时间不一致的推理。现有方法很少在反映真实世界知识演化的时序环境中进行评估。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于时间戳证据的真实世界动态事件基准，捕捉知识随时间演化过程；2. 系统评估模型在连续知识漂移下的适应能力；3. 提出时间感知检索基线Chronos，将检索证据组织成事件演化图，实现无需额外训练的时间一致性理解。
AI.result: 基准测试显示大多数现有方法（包括普通RAG和学习型方法）在此设置下表现不佳，暴露出灾难性遗忘和时间不一致等关键限制。Chronos方法能够实现更时间一致的理解，无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分析和推进大语言模型在真实环境中适应连续知识漂移提供了基础，揭示了现有方法的局限性，并展示了时间感知检索在改善时间一致性推理方面的潜力。

title: MIRAGE: Benchmarking and Aligning Multi-Instance Image Editing
summary: Instruction-guided image editing has seen remarkable progress with models like FLUX.2 and Qwen-Image-Edit, yet they still struggle with complex scenarios with multiple similar instances each requiring individual edits. We observe that state-of-the-art models suffer from severe over-editing and spatial misalignment when faced with multiple identical instances and composite instructions. To this end, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate fine-grained consistency in multi-instance and multi-instruction settings. To address the failures of existing methods observed in our benchmark, we propose Multi-Instance Regional Alignment via Guided Editing (MIRAGE), a training-free framework that enables precise, localized editing. By leveraging a vision-language model to parse complex instructions into regional subsets, MIRAGE employs a multi-branch parallel denoising strategy. This approach injects latent representations of target regions into the global representation space while maintaining background integrity through a reference trajectory. Extensive evaluations on MIRA-Bench and RefEdit-Bench demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing methods in achieving precise instance-level modifications while preserving background consistency. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/ZiqianLiu666/MIRAGE.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE框架通过视觉语言模型解析复杂指令为区域子集，采用多分支并行去噪策略，解决多相似实例编辑中的过编辑和空间错位问题
AI.motivation: 现有指令引导的图像编辑模型（如FLUX.2和Qwen-Image-Edit）在处理多相似实例和复合指令时存在严重过编辑和空间错位问题，需要专门解决方案
AI.method: 提出无需训练的MIRAGE框架：1) 使用视觉语言模型将复杂指令解析为区域子集；2) 采用多分支并行去噪策略；3) 将目标区域潜在表示注入全局表示空间；4) 通过参考轨迹保持背景完整性
AI.result: 在MIRA-Bench和RefEdit-Bench上的广泛评估表明，MIRAGE框架在实现精确实例级修改的同时保持背景一致性方面显著优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE框架有效解决了多实例和多指令场景下的精细一致性编辑问题，为复杂图像编辑任务提供了有效的训练免费解决方案

title: Learning to Focus: CSI-Free Hierarchical MARL for Reconfigurable Reflectors
summary: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) has a potential to engineer smart radio environments for next-generation millimeter-wave (mmWave) networks. However, the prohibitive computational overhead of Channel State Information (CSI) estimation and the dimensionality explosion inherent in centralized optimization severely hinder practical large-scale deployments. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce a ``CSI-free" paradigm powered by a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) architecture to control mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces. By substituting pilot-based channel estimation with accessible user localization data, our framework leverages spatial intelligence for macro-scale wave propagation management. The control problem is decomposed into a two-tier neural architecture: a high-level controller executes temporally extended, discrete user-to-reflector allocations, while low-level controllers autonomously optimize continuous focal points utilizing Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) scheme. Comprehensive deterministic ray-tracing evaluations demonstrate that this hierarchical framework achieves massive RSSI improvements of up to 7.79 dB over centralized baselines. Furthermore, the system exhibits robust multi-user scalability and maintains highly resilient beam-focusing performance under practical sub-meter localization tracking errors. By eliminating CSI overhead while maintaining high-fidelity signal redirection, this work establishes a scalable and cost-effective blueprint for intelligent wireless environments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于分层多智能体强化学习的CSI-free可重构智能表面控制框架，通过用户定位数据替代信道估计，实现毫米波网络中的大规模波束聚焦优化。
AI.motivation: 传统RIS系统面临CSI估计计算开销大和集中式优化维度爆炸的问题，阻碍大规模实际部署，需要新的控制范式来克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用分层多智能体强化学习架构：高层控制器执行离散的用户-反射器分配，低层控制器使用MAPPO算法在CTDE框架下优化连续焦点位置，利用用户定位数据替代信道估计。
AI.result: 确定性射线追踪评估显示，该框架相比集中式基线实现了高达7.79dB的RSSI提升，具备强大的多用户扩展性，在亚米级定位误差下仍保持鲁棒的波束聚焦性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除CSI开销同时保持高精度信号重定向，该工作为智能无线环境建立了可扩展且经济高效的蓝图，为下一代毫米波网络提供了实用解决方案。

title: $π^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models
comment: Our structured analytical reasoning data, which originates from Wikipedia tables, significantly improves long-context reasoning capability of LLMs
summary: We study a pipeline that curates reasoning data from initial structured data for improving long-context reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Our approach, $π^2$, constructs high-quality reasoning data through rigorous QA curation: 1) extracting and expanding tables from Wikipedia, 2) from the collected tables and relevant context, generating realistic and multi-hop analytical reasoning questions whose answers are automatically determined and verified through dual-path code execution, and 3) back-translating step-by-step structured reasoning traces as solutions of QA pairs given realistic web-search context. Supervised fine-tuning with \textsc{\small{gpt-oss-20b}} and \textsc{\small{Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507}} on $π^2$ yields consistent improvements across four long-context reasoning benchmarks and our alike $π^2$-Bench, with average absolute accuracy gains of +4.3% and +2.7% respectively. Notably, our dataset facilitates self-distillation, where \textsc{\small{gpt-oss-20b}} even improves its average performance by +4.4% with its own reasoning traces, demonstrating $π^2$'s usefulness. Our code, data, and models are open-source at https://github.com/vt-pi-squared/pi-squared.

AI.tldr: π²方法通过从维基百科表格构建高质量推理数据，提升大语言模型的长上下文推理能力，在多个基准测试中取得显著改进
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在长上下文推理方面存在不足，需要高质量、结构化的推理数据来提升其多跳分析和复杂推理能力
AI.method: 1) 从维基百科提取和扩展表格；2) 基于表格和相关上下文生成多跳分析推理问题，通过双路径代码执行自动验证答案；3) 通过回译生成结构化推理轨迹作为QA对的解决方案
AI.result: 在四个长上下文推理基准测试和π²-Bench上，GPT-oss-20b和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507分别获得平均+4.3%和+2.7%的准确率提升；GPT-oss-20b通过自蒸馏进一步提升+4.4%
AI.conclusion: π²方法能有效构建高质量推理数据，显著提升大语言模型的长上下文推理能力，并支持自蒸馏进一步改进性能

title: LSRM: High-Fidelity Object-Centric Reconstruction via Scaled Context Windows
summary: We introduce the Large Sparse Reconstruction Model to study how scaling transformer context windows impacts feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Although recent object-centric feed-forward methods deliver robust, high-quality reconstruction, they still lag behind dense-view optimization in recovering fine-grained texture and appearance. We show that expanding the context window -- by substantially increasing the number of active object and image tokens -- remarkably narrows this gap and enables high-fidelity 3D object reconstruction and inverse rendering. To scale effectively, we adapt native sparse attention in our architecture design, unlocking its capacity for 3D reconstruction with three key contributions: (1) an efficient coarse-to-fine pipeline that focuses computation on informative regions by predicting sparse high-resolution residuals; (2) a 3D-aware spatial routing mechanism that establishes accurate 2D-3D correspondences using explicit geometric distances rather than standard attention scores; and (3) a custom block-aware sequence parallelism strategy utilizing an All-gather-KV protocol to balance dynamic, sparse workloads across GPUs. As a result, LSRM handles 20x more object tokens and >2x more image tokens than prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Extensive evaluations on standard novel-view synthesis benchmarks show substantial gains over the current SOTA, yielding 2.5 dB higher PSNR and 40% lower LPIPS. Furthermore, when extending LSRM to inverse rendering tasks, qualitative and quantitative evaluations on widely-used benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in texture and geometry details, achieving an LPIPS that matches or exceeds that of SOTA dense-view optimization methods. Code and model will be released on our project page.

AI.tldr: LSRM通过扩展transformer上下文窗口（增加20倍物体token和2倍图像token）实现高保真3D重建，采用稀疏注意力、粗到细管道、3D感知空间路由和块感知并行策略，在重建质量和逆渲染任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前基于物体中心的feed-forward 3D重建方法虽然稳健，但在恢复细粒度纹理和外观方面仍落后于密集视图优化方法。作者希望通过扩展transformer的上下文窗口来缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 1. 采用稀疏注意力架构设计；2. 高效的粗到细管道，通过预测稀疏高分辨率残差聚焦计算；3. 3D感知空间路由机制，使用显式几何距离而非标准注意力分数建立2D-3D对应；4. 块感知序列并行策略，使用All-gather-KV协议平衡GPU间的动态稀疏工作负载。
AI.result: LSRM处理比现有SOTA方法多20倍的物体token和2倍以上的图像token。在标准新视图合成基准测试中，PSNR提高2.5 dB，LPIPS降低40%。在逆渲染任务中，纹理和几何细节持续改进，LPIPS达到或超过SOTA密集视图优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 扩展transformer上下文窗口显著提升了3D重建的保真度，LSRM通过创新的稀疏注意力架构和并行策略实现了大规模上下文处理，在重建质量和逆渲染任务上取得了突破性进展。

title: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Parsing and Mining Unstructured Logs on Leadership HPC Systems
summary:
Leadership-class HPC systems generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, largely unstructured system logs. Because these logs originate from diverse software, hardware, and runtime layers, they exhibit inconsistent formats, making structure extraction and pattern discovery extremely challenging. Therefore, robust log parsing and mining is critical to transform this raw telemetry into actionable insights that reveal operational patterns, diagnose anomalies, and enable reliable, efficient, and scalable system analysis. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer a promising new direction for automated log understanding in leadership-class HPC environments.
  To capitalize on this opportunity, we present a domain-adapted, instruction-following, LLM-driven framework that leverages chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to parse and structure HPC logs with high fidelity. Our approach combines domain-specific log-template data with instruction-tuned examples to fine-tune an 8B-parameter LLaMA model tailored for HPC log analysis. We develop a hybrid fine-tuning methodology that adapts a general-purpose LLM to domain-specific log data, enabling privacy-preserving, locally deployable, fast, and energy-efficient log-mining approach. We conduct experiments on a diverse set of log datasets from the LogHub repository. The evaluation confirms that our approach achieves parsing accuracy on par with significantly larger models, such as LLaMA 70B and Anthropic's Claude. We further validate the practical utility of our fine-tuned LLM model by parsing over 600 million production logs from the Frontier supercomputer over a four-week window, uncovering critical patterns in temporal dynamics, node-level anomalies, and workload-error log correlations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于LLM的领域自适应框架，利用思维链推理来解析和结构化HPC系统日志，在保持隐私和能效的同时达到与大型模型相当的解析精度。
AI.motivation: 领导级HPC系统产生大量异构、非结构化的系统日志，这些日志来自不同软件、硬件和运行时层，格式不一致，使得结构提取和模式发现极其困难。需要将原始遥测数据转化为可操作的洞察，以揭示操作模式、诊断异常并实现可靠、高效和可扩展的系统分析。
AI.method: 提出一个领域自适应、遵循指令的LLM驱动框架，利用思维链推理来解析和结构化HPC日志。结合领域特定的日志模板数据和指令调优示例，对8B参数的LLaMA模型进行微调，专门用于HPC日志分析。采用混合微调方法，将通用LLM适配到领域特定的日志数据，实现隐私保护、本地可部署、快速且能效高的日志挖掘方法。
AI.result: 在LogHub存储库的多样化日志数据集上进行实验，评估确认该方法达到了与显著更大模型（如LLaMA 70B和Anthropic的Claude）相当的解析精度。通过解析Frontier超级计算机在四周窗口内超过6亿条生产日志，进一步验证了微调LLM模型的实用性，揭示了时间动态、节点级异常和工作负载-错误日志相关性中的关键模式。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的领域自适应框架为HPC日志分析提供了一种有效方法，能够在保持隐私和能效的同时实现高精度解析，为大规模HPC系统的运维分析提供了实用工具。

title: SenseAI: A Human-in-the-Loop Dataset for RLHF-Aligned Financial Sentiment Reasoning
comment: Dataset available on request (bernykabalisa18@gmail.com) See GitHub for dataset snapshot and automated data collection script demo https://github.com/bernykabalisa18-netizen/SenseAI
summary:
We introduce SenseAI, a human-in-the-loop (HITL) validated financial sentiment dataset designed to capture not only model outputs but the full reasoning process behind them. Unlike existing resources, SenseAI incorporates reasoning chains, confidence scores, human correction signals, and real-world market outcomes, providing a structure aligned with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) paradigms.
  The dataset consists of 1,439 labelled data points across 40 US-listed equities and 13 financial data categories, enabling direct integration into modern LLM fine-tuning pipelines. Through analysis, we identify several systematic patterns in model behavior, including a novel failure mode we term Latent Reasoning Drift, where models introduce information not grounded in the input, as well as consistent confidence miscalibration and forward projection tendencies.
  These findings suggest that LLM errors in financial reasoning are not random but occur within a predictable and correctable regime, supporting the use of structured HITL data for targeted model improvement. We discuss implications for financial AI systems and highlight opportunities for applying SenseAI in model evaluation and alignment.

AI.tldr: SenseAI是一个人类参与验证的金融情感数据集，包含推理链、置信度分数、人类修正信号和市场结果，支持RLHF范式，用于改进金融AI系统的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有金融情感数据集通常只包含模型输出，缺乏完整的推理过程和人类反馈，无法有效支持RLHF范式下的模型改进。需要构建包含完整推理链和人类验证的数据集来系统性地分析和纠正LLM在金融推理中的错误。
AI.method: 构建SenseAI数据集，包含1,439个标注数据点，覆盖40只美国上市股票和13个金融数据类别。数据集包含推理链、置信度分数、人类修正信号和实际市场结果，可直接集成到现代LLM微调流程中。
AI.result: 分析发现了模型行为的系统性模式：1）潜在推理漂移（模型引入输入中不存在的信息）；2）置信度校准错误；3）前向预测倾向。这些错误不是随机的，而是可预测和可纠正的。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的人类参与验证数据可用于有针对性的模型改进。SenseAI数据集为金融AI系统的评估和对齐提供了机会，支持RLHF范式在金融领域的应用。

title: OrthoFuse: Training-free Riemannian Fusion of Orthogonal Style-Concept Adapters for Diffusion Models
summary: In a rapidly growing field of model training there is a constant practical interest in parameter-efficient fine-tuning and various techniques that use a small amount of training data to adapt the model to a narrow task. However, there is an open question: how to combine several adapters tuned for different tasks into one which is able to yield adequate results on both tasks? Specifically, merging subject and style adapters for generative models remains unresolved. In this paper we seek to show that in the case of orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT), we can use structured orthogonal parametrization and its geometric properties to get the formulas for training-free adapter merging. In particular, we derive the structure of the manifold formed by the recently proposed Group-and-Shuffle ($\mathcal{GS}$) orthogonal matrices, and obtain efficient formulas for the geodesics approximation between two points. Additionally, we propose a $\text{spectra restoration}$ transform that restores spectral properties of the merged adapter for higher-quality fusion. We conduct experiments in subject-driven generation tasks showing that our technique to merge two $\mathcal{GS}$ orthogonal matrices is capable of uniting concept and style features of different adapters. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first training-free method for merging multiplicative orthogonal adapters. Code is available via the $\href{https://github.com/ControlGenAI/OrthoFuse}{link}$.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的正交适配器融合方法，利用几何特性和谱恢复变换来合并不同任务的适配器
AI.motivation: 在模型训练快速发展的背景下，参数高效微调和少量数据适应特定任务的技术备受关注，但如何将针对不同任务训练的多个适配器合并成一个能同时处理多个任务的适配器仍是一个开放问题，特别是生成模型中主体和风格适配器的融合问题尚未解决
AI.method: 利用正交微调(OFT)的结构化正交参数化及其几何特性，推导出无需训练的适配器融合公式。具体包括：推导最近提出的Group-and-Shuffle正交矩阵形成的流形结构，获得两点间测地线近似的高效公式，并提出谱恢复变换来恢复融合适配器的谱特性以提高融合质量
AI.result: 在主体驱动生成任务中的实验表明，该技术能够成功融合不同适配器的概念和风格特征。据作者所知，这是首个无需训练的多重正交适配器融合方法
AI.conclusion: 通过利用正交矩阵的几何特性，提出了一种有效的训练免费适配器融合方法，能够成功合并不同任务的适配器，为多任务适配器融合提供了新的解决方案

title: ClawsBench: Evaluating Capability and Safety of LLM Productivity Agents in Simulated Workspaces
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed to automate productivity tasks (e.g., email, scheduling, document management), but evaluating them on live services is risky due to potentially irreversible changes. Existing benchmarks rely on simplified environments and fail to capture realistic, stateful, multi-service workflows. We introduce ClawsBench, a benchmark for evaluating and improving LLM agents in realistic productivity settings. It includes five high-fidelity mock services (Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Drive) with full state management and deterministic snapshot/restore, along with 44 structured tasks covering single-service, cross-service, and safety-critical scenarios. We decompose agent scaffolding into two independent levers (domain skills that inject API knowledge via progressive disclosure, and a meta prompt that coordinates behavior across services) and vary both to measure their separate and combined effects. Experiments across 6 models, 4 agent harnesses, and 33 conditions show that with full scaffolding, agents achieve task success rates of 39-64% but exhibit unsafe action rates of 7-33%. On OpenClaw, the top five models fall within a 10 percentage-point band on task success (53-63%), with unsafe action rates from 7% to 23% and no consistent ordering between the two metrics. We identify eight recurring patterns of unsafe behavior, including multi-step sandbox escalation and silent contract modification.

AI.tldr: ClawsBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体在真实生产力场景中的基准测试，包含5个高保真模拟服务、44个结构化任务，通过分解智能体脚手架为领域技能和元提示两个独立杠杆来测量其效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试依赖简化环境，无法捕捉真实、有状态、多服务的工作流程，而直接在真实服务上评估LLM智能体存在风险（可能导致不可逆更改）。
AI.method: 构建包含Gmail、Slack、Google Calendar、Google Docs、Google Drive五个高保真模拟服务的基准测试，具有完整状态管理和确定性快照/恢复功能。将智能体脚手架分解为两个独立杠杆：领域技能（通过渐进式披露注入API知识）和元提示（协调跨服务行为）。
AI.result: 在6个模型、4个智能体框架、33种条件下的实验显示：完全脚手架下，智能体任务成功率39-64%，但不安全操作率7-33%。在OpenClaw上，前五个模型的任务成功率在53-63%的10个百分点范围内，不安全操作率7-23%，两个指标间没有一致排序关系。识别出8种不安全行为模式。
AI.conclusion: ClawsBench为评估和改进LLM智能体在真实生产力场景中的表现提供了重要基准，揭示了智能体在任务成功率和安全性之间的权衡关系，并识别了需要解决的关键不安全行为模式。

title: EvolveRouter: Co-Evolving Routing and Prompt for Multi-Agent Question Answering
summary: Large language model agents often exhibit complementary strengths, making routing a promising approach for multi-agent question answering. However, existing routing methods remain limited in two important ways: they typically optimize over a fixed pool of agents without improving the agents themselves, and they often rely on rigid collaboration schemes that cannot adapt the number of participating agents to the query. We propose EvolveRouter, a trainable framework that addresses both limitations by jointly improving agent quality and collaboration structure. First, EvolveRouter couples graph-based query routing with targeted instruction refinement in a closed-loop co-evolution process, allowing router diagnostics to guide agent improvement while refined agents provide cleaner supervision for routing. Second, it introduces an adaptive inference strategy that dynamically determines the effective collaboration size for each query through router-weighted answer agreement. Together, these designs enable more capable and more efficient multi-agent reasoning. Experiments on five question answering benchmarks show that EvolveRouter consistently outperforms SOTA routing baselines in both F1 and exact match, while further analysis confirms the benefits of closed-loop refinement and adaptive collaboration.

AI.tldr: EvolveRouter是一个可训练的多智能体问答框架，通过联合优化智能体质量和协作结构，解决了现有路由方法的两个主要限制：固定智能体池和刚性协作方案。
AI.motivation: 现有路由方法存在两个重要限制：1）通常在固定智能体池上进行优化，而不改进智能体本身；2）依赖刚性协作方案，无法根据查询调整参与智能体的数量。这限制了多智能体问答系统的能力和效率。
AI.method: EvolveRouter采用两种关键设计：1）将基于图的路由与针对性指令精炼结合在闭环协同进化过程中，让路由诊断指导智能体改进，同时精炼后的智能体为路由提供更清晰的监督；2）引入自适应推理策略，通过路由器加权的答案一致性动态确定每个查询的有效协作规模。
AI.result: 在五个问答基准测试中，EvolveRouter在F1和精确匹配指标上始终优于最先进的路由基线。进一步分析证实了闭环精炼和自适应协作的益处。
AI.conclusion: EvolveRouter通过联合改进智能体质量和协作结构，实现了更强大和更高效的多智能体推理，解决了现有路由方法的关键限制。

title: Attribution Bias in Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support search and information retrieval, it is critical that they accurately attribute content to its original authors. In this work, we introduce AttriBench, the first fame- and demographically-balanced quote attribution benchmark dataset. Through explicitly balancing author fame and demographics, AttriBench enables controlled investigation of demographic bias in quote attribution. Using this dataset, we evaluate 11 widely used LLMs across different prompt settings and find that quote attribution remains a challenging task even for frontier models. We observe large and systematic disparities in attribution accuracy between race, gender, and intersectional groups. We further introduce and investigate suppression, a distinct failure mode in which models omit attribution entirely, even when the model has access to authorship information. We find that suppression is widespread and unevenly distributed across demographic groups, revealing systematic biases not captured by standard accuracy metrics. Our results position quote attribution as a benchmark for representational fairness in LLMs.

AI.tldr: AttriBench是首个平衡作者知名度和人口统计特征的引用归属基准数据集，用于评估LLMs在引用归属任务中的表现和人口统计偏见。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs越来越多地用于支持搜索和信息检索，确保它们准确地将内容归属给原始作者变得至关重要。需要研究LLMs在引用归属任务中是否存在人口统计偏见。
AI.method: 创建AttriBench基准数据集，平衡作者知名度和人口统计特征（种族、性别等）。使用该数据集评估11个广泛使用的LLMs在不同提示设置下的表现，并引入"抑制"这一新的失败模式进行分析。
AI.result: 引用归属对前沿模型仍是挑战性任务。发现种族、性别和交叉群体之间存在显著且系统性的归属准确性差异。抑制现象普遍存在且在不同人口统计群体中分布不均，揭示了标准准确性指标未能捕捉的系统性偏见。
AI.conclusion: 引用归属可作为LLMs表征公平性的基准。研究揭示了LLMs在内容归属方面存在系统性人口统计偏见，需要进一步研究和改进。

title: Just Pass Twice: Efficient Token Classification with LLMs for Zero-Shot NER
summary:
Large language models encode extensive world knowledge valuable for zero-shot named entity recognition. However, their causal attention mechanism, where tokens attend only to preceding context, prevents effective token classification when disambiguation requires future context. Existing approaches use LLMs generatively, prompting them to list entities or produce structured outputs, but suffer from slow autoregressive decoding, hallucinated entities, and formatting errors.
  We propose Just Pass Twice (JPT), a simple yet effective method that enables causal LLMs to perform discriminative token classification with full bidirectional context. Our key insight is that concatenating the input to itself lets each token in the second pass attend to the complete sentence, requiring no architectural modifications. We combine these representations with definition-guided entity embeddings for flexible zero-shot generalization. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on zero-shot NER benchmarks, surpassing the previous best method by +7.9 F1 on average across CrossNER and MIT benchmarks, being over 20x faster than comparable generative methods.

AI.tldr: JPT方法通过将输入文本复制拼接，使因果注意力机制的LLM能够获得双向上下文信息，实现零样本命名实体识别，在保持原有架构的同时显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型具有丰富的世界知识，可用于零样本命名实体识别，但其因果注意力机制（每个token只能关注前文）限制了需要未来上下文进行消歧的token分类任务。现有生成式方法存在解码慢、产生幻觉实体和格式错误等问题
AI.method: 提出Just Pass Twice方法：将输入文本复制并拼接，让第二个副本中的每个token能够通过注意力机制访问完整句子信息。结合定义引导的实体嵌入，实现灵活的零样本泛化，无需修改模型架构
AI.result: 在零样本NER基准测试中达到最先进水平，在CrossNER和MIT基准上平均比之前最佳方法提升+7.9 F1分数，速度比可比生成方法快20倍以上
AI.conclusion: JPT方法通过简单的输入拼接策略，使因果LLM能够进行具有完整双向上下文的判别式token分类，在保持原有架构的同时显著提升零样本NER性能

title: From Governance Norms to Enforceable Controls: A Layered Translation Method for Runtime Guardrails in Agentic AI
summary: Agentic AI systems plan, use tools, maintain state, and produce multi-step trajectories with external effects. Those properties create a governance problem that differs materially from single-turn generative AI: important risks emerge dur- ing execution, not only at model development or deployment time. Governance standards such as ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, ISO/IEC 42005, ISO/IEC 5338, ISO/IEC 38507, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework are therefore highly relevant to agentic AI, but they do not by themselves yield implementable runtime guardrails. This paper proposes a layered translation method that connects standards-derived governance objectives to four control layers: governance objectives, design- time constraints, runtime mediation, and assurance feedback. It distinguishes governance objectives, technical controls, runtime guardrails, and assurance evidence; introduces a control tuple and runtime-enforceability rubric for layer assignment; and demonstrates the method in a procurement-agent case study. The central claim is modest: standards should guide control placement across architecture, runtime policy, human escalation, and audit, while runtime guardrails are reserved for controls that are observable, determinate, and time-sensitive enough to justify execution-time intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层转换方法，将AI治理标准转化为可实施的运行时护栏，特别针对具有外部效应的智能体AI系统。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统具有规划、使用工具、维护状态和产生多步轨迹等特性，其治理问题与单轮生成式AI不同，重要风险在执行过程中出现，而不仅仅是模型开发或部署时。现有治理标准虽然相关，但本身无法提供可实施的运行时护栏。
AI.method: 提出分层转换方法，将标准衍生的治理目标连接到四个控制层：治理目标、设计时约束、运行时调解和保证反馈。引入控制元组和运行时可执行性评估标准进行层次分配，并通过采购智能体案例研究展示该方法。
AI.result: 建立了一个系统化的框架，将治理标准转化为具体的控制措施，区分了治理目标、技术控制、运行时护栏和保证证据，为智能体AI系统的运行时治理提供了可行方案。
AI.conclusion: 标准应指导跨架构、运行时策略、人工升级和审计的控制部署，而运行时护栏应保留给那些可观察、确定且时间敏感到足以证明执行时干预合理的控制措施。

title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews
summary: Qualitative interviews provide essential insights into human experiences when they elicit high-quality responses. While qualitative and NLP researchers have proposed various measures of interview quality, these measures lack validation that high-scoring responses actually contribute to the study's goals. In this work, we identify, implement, and evaluate 10 proposed measures of interview response quality to determine which are actually predictive of a response's contribution to the study findings. To conduct our analysis, we introduce the Qualitative Interview Corpus, a newly constructed dataset of 343 interview transcripts with 16,940 participant responses from 14 real research projects. We find that direct relevance to a key research question is the strongest predictor of response quality.
