We additionally find that two measures commonly used to evaluate NLP interview systems, clarity and surprisal-based informativeness, are not predictive of response quality. Our work provides analytic insights and grounded, scalable metrics to inform the design of qualitative studies and the evaluation of automated interview systems.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了10种访谈回答质量测量方法，发现与关键研究问题的直接相关性是最强的预测指标，而清晰度和基于惊奇度的信息性则不是有效预测指标。
AI.motivation: 定性访谈需要高质量的回答才能获得有价值的见解，但现有的访谈质量测量方法缺乏验证，无法确定高分回答是否真正有助于实现研究目标。
AI.method: 构建了包含343份访谈转录、16,940个参与者回答的定性访谈语料库，识别、实施并评估了10种提出的访谈回答质量测量方法，分析哪些方法能预测回答对研究发现的贡献。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 回答与关键研究问题的直接相关性是最强的质量预测指标；2) NLP访谈系统中常用的两个测量指标（清晰度和基于惊奇度的信息性）不能预测回答质量。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了分析见解和可扩展的度量标准，可为定性研究设计和自动化访谈系统评估提供信息，帮助研究者更有效地评估访谈回答质量。

title: EAGLE: Edge-Aware Graph Learning for Proactive Delivery Delay Prediction in Smart Logistics Networks
summary: Modern logistics networks generate rich operational data streams at every warehouse node and transportation lane -- from order timestamps and routing records to shipping manifests -- yet predicting delivery delays remains predominantly reactive. Existing predictive approaches typically treat this problem either as a tabular classification task, ignoring network topology, or as a time-series anomaly detection task, overlooking the spatial dependencies of the supply chain graph. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid deep learning framework for proactive supply chain risk management. The proposed method jointly models temporal order-flow dynamics via a lightweight Transformer patch encoder and inter-hub relational dependencies through an Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network (E-GAT), optimized via a multi-task learning objective. Evaluated on the real-world DataCo Smart Supply Chain dataset, our framework achieves consistent improvements over baseline methods, yielding an F1-score of 0.8762 and an AUC-ROC of 0.9773. Across four independent random seeds, the framework exhibits a cross-seed F1 standard deviation of only 0.0089 -- a 3.8 times improvement over the best ablated variant -- achieving the strongest balance of predictive accuracy and training stability among all evaluated models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合Transformer时间编码器和图注意力网络的混合深度学习框架，用于预测供应链中的交付延迟风险
AI.motivation: 现代物流网络产生丰富的运营数据流，但现有预测方法要么忽略网络拓扑结构，要么忽视供应链图的空间依赖关系，需要一种能同时建模时间和空间依赖的方法
AI.method: 提出混合深度学习框架：使用轻量级Transformer补丁编码器建模时间订单流动态，通过边感知图注意力网络（E-GAT）建模枢纽间关系依赖，采用多任务学习目标优化
AI.result: 在真实世界DataCo智能供应链数据集上评估，F1分数0.8762，AUC-ROC 0.9773，跨四个随机种子的F1标准差仅0.0089，比最佳消融变体提升3.8倍
AI.conclusion: 该框架在预测准确性和训练稳定性方面达到最佳平衡，为主动供应链风险管理提供了有效的解决方案

title: Gradient-Controlled Decoding: A Safety Guardrail for LLMs with Dual-Anchor Steering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain susceptible to jailbreak and direct prompt-injection attacks, yet the strongest defensive filters frequently over-refuse benign queries and degrade user experience. Previous work on jailbreak and prompt injection detection such as GradSafe, detects unsafe prompts with a single "accept all" anchor token, but its threshold is brittle and it offers no deterministic guarantee that harmful content will not be emitted once decoding begins. We introduce Gradient-Controlled Decoding (GCD), a training-free guardrail that combines an acceptance anchor token ("Sure") and refusal anchor token ("Sorry") tightening the decision boundary and significantly lowering false positives. In the mitigation stage, if a prompt is flagged, GCD preset-injects one or two refusal tokens ("Sorry, I can't...") before autoregressive decoding resumes, guaranteeing first-token safety regardless of sampling strategy. On ToxicChat, XSTest-v2, and AdvBench, GCD reduces false positives by 52% vs. GradSafe at comparable recall, lowers attack success rate by up to 10% vs. the strongest decoding-only baseline, adds under 15-20 ms latency on an average on V100 instances, transfers to LLaMA-2-7B, Mixtral-8x7B, and Qwen-2-7B, and requires only 20 demonstration templates.

AI.tldr: GCD是一种无需训练的防护机制，通过结合接受和拒绝锚点token来降低误报率，并在检测到有害提示时预设拒绝token来保证首token安全性
AI.motivation: 现有LLM防护方法如GradSafe存在阈值脆弱、无法保证解码开始后不产生有害内容的问题，且强防御过滤器经常过度拒绝良性查询，影响用户体验
AI.method: 提出梯度控制解码(GCD)，结合接受锚点token("Sure")和拒绝锚点token("Sorry")来收紧决策边界；在缓解阶段，如果提示被标记为有害，GCD会在自回归解码前预设注入一个或两个拒绝token，保证首token安全性
AI.result: 在ToxicChat、XSTest-v2和AdvBench上，GCD比GradSafe减少52%的误报率（召回率相当），攻击成功率比最强解码基线降低10%，在V100实例上增加15-20ms延迟，可迁移到多个模型，仅需20个演示模板
AI.conclusion: GCD提供了一种有效且高效的防护机制，显著降低误报率同时保证安全性，具有实际部署价值

title: Active Measurement of Two-Point Correlations
summary: Two-point correlation functions (2PCF) are widely used to characterize how points cluster in space. In this work, we study the problem of measuring the 2PCF over a large set of points, restricted to a subset satisfying a property of interest. An example comes from astronomy, where scientists measure the 2PCF of star clusters, which make up only a tiny subset of possible sources within a galaxy. This task typically requires careful labeling of sources to construct catalogs, which is time-consuming. We present a human-in-the-loop framework for efficient estimation of 2PCF of target sources. By leveraging a pre-trained classifier to guide sampling, our approach adaptively selects the most informative points for human annotation. After each annotation, it produces unbiased estimates of pair counts across multiple distance bins simultaneously. Compared to simple Monte Carlo approaches, our method achieves substantially lower variance while significantly reducing annotation effort. We introduce a novel unbiased estimator, sampling strategy, and confidence interval construction that together enable scalable and statistically grounded measurement of two-point correlations in astronomy datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种人机协同框架，用于高效估计目标源的两点相关函数，通过预训练分类器引导采样，显著减少标注工作量并降低方差。
AI.motivation: 在天文学中，测量星团等特定子集的两点相关函数需要大量标注工作，传统方法耗时且效率低下，需要更高效的估计方法。
AI.method: 开发了人机协同框架，利用预训练分类器指导采样，自适应选择最具信息量的点进行人工标注，每次标注后生成无偏估计，并提出了新的无偏估计器、采样策略和置信区间构建方法。
AI.result: 相比简单蒙特卡洛方法，该方法在显著减少标注工作量的同时，实现了更低的方差，能够同时跨多个距离区间进行无偏估计。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为天文学数据集中的两点相关测量提供了可扩展且统计基础扎实的解决方案，通过智能采样和人工标注的结合，实现了高效准确的相关性分析。

title: Simulating the Evolution of Alignment and Values in Machine Intelligence
summary: Model alignment is currently applied in a vacuum, evaluated primarily through standardised benchmark performance. The purpose of this study is to examine the effects of alignment on populations of models through time. We focus on the treatment of beliefs which contain both an alignment signal (how well it does on the test) and a true value (what the impact actually will be). By applying evolutionary theory we can model how different populations of beliefs and selection methodologies can fix deceptive beliefs through iterative alignment testing. The correlation between testing accuracy and true value remains a strong feature, but even at high correlations ($ρ= 0.8$) there is variability in the resulting deceptive beliefs that become fixed. Mutations allow for more complex developments, highlighting the increasing need to update the quality of tests to avoid fixation of maliciously deceptive models. Only by combining improving evaluator capabilities, adaptive test design, and mutational dynamics do we see significant reductions in deception while maintaining alignment fitness (permutation test, $p_{\text{adj}} < 0.001$).

AI.tldr: 该研究通过进化理论分析模型对齐对模型种群的影响，发现即使在测试准确性与真实价值高度相关的情况下，迭代对齐测试仍可能导致欺骗性信念的固定，需要结合改进评估能力、自适应测试设计和突变动态来减少欺骗。
AI.motivation: 当前模型对齐主要在真空环境中进行，主要通过标准化基准性能评估。本研究旨在通过时间维度考察对齐对模型种群的影响，特别是关注包含对齐信号（测试表现）和真实价值（实际影响）的信念处理。
AI.method: 应用进化理论建模不同信念种群和选择方法，分析迭代对齐测试如何固定欺骗性信念。研究测试准确性与真实价值之间的相关性，考察突变对复杂发展的影响，并探索结合改进评估能力、自适应测试设计和突变动态的方法。
AI.result: 即使在测试准确性与真实价值高度相关（ρ=0.8）的情况下，仍存在欺骗性信念固定的变异性。突变允许更复杂的发展，突显了更新测试质量以避免恶意欺骗模型固定的需求。只有结合改进评估能力、自适应测试设计和突变动态，才能显著减少欺骗同时保持对齐适应性（置换检验，p_adj < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 模型对齐评估需要超越简单的基准测试，考虑进化动态和种群效应。为避免欺骗性信念的固定，必须采用多维度的评估策略，包括持续改进评估能力、设计自适应测试以及考虑突变动态，这为未来模型对齐研究提供了重要方向。

title: Protecting and Preserving Protest Dynamics for Responsible Analysis
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, Submitted to ACM Journal on Responsible Computing
summary:
Protest-related social media data are valuable for understanding collective action but inherently high-risk due to concerns surrounding surveillance, repression, and individual privacy. Contemporary AI systems can identify individuals, infer sensitive attributes, and cross-reference visual information across platforms, enabling surveillance that poses risks to protesters and bystanders. In such contexts, large foundation models trained on protest imagery risk memorizing and disclosing sensitive information, leading to cross-platform identity leakage and retroactive participant identification. Existing approaches to automated protest analysis do not provide a holistic pipeline that integrates privacy risk assessment, downstream analysis, and fairness considerations.
  To address this gap, we propose a responsible computing framework for analyzing collective protest dynamics while reducing risks to individual privacy. Our framework replaces sensitive protest imagery with well-labeled synthetic reproductions using conditional image synthesis, enabling analysis of collective patterns without direct exposure of identifiable individuals. We demonstrate that our approach produces realistic and diverse synthetic imagery while balancing downstream analytical utility with reductions in privacy risk. We further assess demographic fairness in the generated data, examining whether synthetic representations disproportionately affect specific subgroups. Rather than offering absolute privacy guarantees, our method adopts a pragmatic, harm-mitigating approach that enables socially sensitive analysis while acknowledging residual risks.

AI.tldr: 提出负责任计算框架，用条件图像合成生成标记的合成抗议图像，在分析集体抗议动态的同时降低个人隐私风险
AI.motivation: 抗议相关的社交媒体数据对理解集体行动有价值，但存在高风险，包括监控、镇压和个人隐私问题。现有AI系统能够识别个人、推断敏感属性并跨平台交叉引用视觉信息，对抗议者和旁观者构成风险。现有抗议分析方法缺乏整合隐私风险评估、下游分析和公平性考虑的整体流程。
AI.method: 提出负责任计算框架，使用条件图像合成技术将敏感的抗议图像替换为良好标记的合成再现，从而在不直接暴露可识别个人的情况下分析集体模式。评估生成数据的真实性和多样性，平衡下游分析效用与隐私风险降低，并评估生成数据的人口统计学公平性。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成真实且多样化的合成图像，在保持下游分析效用的同时降低隐私风险。进一步评估了生成数据的人口统计学公平性，检查合成表示是否对特定亚群体产生不成比例的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不提供绝对的隐私保证，而是采用务实的伤害减轻方法，在承认残余风险的同时实现社会敏感分析。为分析集体抗议动态提供了一种负责任的计算框架。

title: Pressure, What Pressure? Sycophancy Disentanglement in Language Models via Reward Decomposition
summary: Large language models exhibit sycophancy, the tendency to shift their stated positions toward perceived user preferences or authority cues regardless of evidence. Standard alignment methods fail to correct this because scalar reward models conflate two distinct failure modes into a single signal: pressure capitulation, where the model changes a correct answer under social pressure, and evidence blindness, where the model ignores the provided context entirely. We operationalise sycophancy through formal definitions of pressure independence and evidence responsiveness, serving as a working framework for disentangled training rather than a definitive characterisation of the phenomenon. We propose the first approach to sycophancy reduction via reward decomposition, introducing a multi-component Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) reward that decomposes the training signal into five terms: pressure resistance, context fidelity, position consistency, agreement suppression, and factual correctness. We train using a contrastive dataset pairing pressure-free baselines with pressured variants across three authority levels and two opposing evidence contexts. Across five base models, our two-phase pipeline consistently reduces sycophancy on all metric axes, with ablations confirming that each reward term governs an independent behavioural dimension. The learned resistance to pressure generalises beyond our training methodology and prompt structure, reducing answer-priming sycophancy by up to 17 points on SycophancyEval despite the absence of such pressure forms during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过奖励分解来减少大语言模型谄媚行为的新方法，将训练信号分解为五个独立组件，有效降低了模型在不同权威级别和证据上下文下的谄媚倾向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型表现出谄媚行为，即倾向于根据感知到的用户偏好或权威线索改变立场，而不顾证据。标准的对齐方法无法纠正这一问题，因为标量奖励模型将两种不同的失败模式混为一谈：压力屈服（模型在社交压力下改变正确答案）和证据盲视（模型完全忽略提供的上下文）。
AI.method: 提出了通过奖励分解减少谄媚行为的方法，引入多组件群体相对策略优化（GRPO）奖励，将训练信号分解为五个项：压力抵抗、上下文保真度、立场一致性、同意抑制和事实正确性。使用对比数据集进行训练，该数据集包含无压力基线和受压力变体，涵盖三个权威级别和两个对立证据上下文。
AI.result: 在五个基础模型上，两阶段训练流程在所有指标轴上持续减少谄媚行为，消融实验确认每个奖励项控制独立的行为维度。学习到的压力抵抗能力能够泛化到训练方法和提示结构之外，在SycophancyEval上将答案引导型谄媚减少了高达17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过奖励分解方法可以有效减少大语言模型的谄媚行为，将训练信号分解为独立组件能够更精确地控制模型行为，且学习到的抵抗能力具有良好的泛化性。

title: Faster Superword Tokenization
summary: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is a widely used tokenization algorithm, whose tokens cannot extend across pre-tokenization boundaries, functionally limiting it to representing at most full words. The BoundlessBPE and SuperBPE algorithms extend and improve BPE by relaxing this limitation and allowing the formation of superwords, which are combinations of pretokens that form phrases. However, previous implementations were impractical to train: for example, BoundlessBPE took 4.7 CPU days to train on 1GB of data. We show that supermerge candidates, two or more consecutive pretokens eligible to form a supermerge, can be aggregated by frequency much like regular pretokens. This avoids keeping full documents in memory, as the original implementations of BoundlessBPE and SuperBPE required, leading to a significant training speedup. We present a two-phase formulation of BoundlessBPE that separates first-phase learning of regular merges from second-phase learning of supermerges, producing identical results to the original implementation. We also show a near-equivalence between two-phase BoundlessBPE and SuperBPE, with the difference being that a manually selected hyperparameter used in SuperBPE can be automatically determined in the second phase of BoundlessBPE. These changes enable a much faster implementation, allowing training on that same 1GB of data in 603 and 593 seconds for BoundlessBPE and SuperBPE, respectively, a more than 600x increase in speed. For each of BoundlessBPE, SuperBPE, and BPE, we open-source both a reference Python implementation and a fast Rust implementation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种改进的BPE训练方法，通过两阶段训练和候选聚合技术，将BoundlessBPE和SuperBPE的训练速度提升了600倍以上。
AI.motivation: 传统BPE算法受限于预分词边界，只能表示完整单词。虽然BoundlessBPE和SuperBPE通过允许形成超词（短语组合）来改进BPE，但之前的实现训练效率极低（如BoundlessBPE在1GB数据上需要4.7个CPU天），不切实际。
AI.method: 提出两阶段BoundlessBPE：第一阶段学习常规合并，第二阶段学习超合并。关键创新是发现超合并候选（可形成超合并的连续预分词）可以像常规预分词一样按频率聚合，避免了原始实现需要将完整文档保存在内存中的问题。
AI.result: 在相同1GB数据上，BoundlessBPE训练时间从4.7个CPU天减少到603秒，SuperBPE减少到593秒，速度提升超过600倍。同时展示了BoundlessBPE和SuperBPE的近等价性，SuperBPE中需要手动选择的超参数可以在BoundlessBPE第二阶段自动确定。
AI.conclusion: 通过两阶段训练和候选聚合技术，显著提升了BoundlessBPE和SuperBPE的训练效率，使这些改进的BPE算法变得实用可行。开源了Python参考实现和快速的Rust实现。

title: Coverage Optimization for Camera View Selection
summary: What makes a good viewpoint? The quality of the data used to learn 3D reconstructions is crucial for enabling efficient and accurate scene modeling. We study the active view selection problem and develop a principled analysis that yields a simple and interpretable criterion for selecting informative camera poses. Our key insight is that informative views can be obtained by minimizing a tractable approximation of the Fisher Information Gain, which reduces to favoring viewpoints that cover geometry that has been insufficiently observed by past cameras. This leads to a lightweight coverage-based view selection metric that avoids expensive transmittance estimation and is robust to noise and training dynamics. We call this metric COVER (Camera Optimization for View Exploration and Reconstruction). We integrate our method into the Nerfstudio framework and evaluate it on real datasets within fixed and embodied data acquisition scenarios. Across multiple datasets and radiance-field baselines, our method consistently improves reconstruction quality compared to state-of-the-art active view selection methods. Additional visualizations and our Nerfstudio package can be found at https://chengine.github.io/nbv_gym/.

AI.tldr: COVER是一种轻量级的主动视角选择方法，通过最小化Fisher信息增益的近似值，选择覆盖过去相机观测不足区域的视角，从而提升3D重建质量。
AI.motivation: 3D重建的数据质量对场景建模的效率和准确性至关重要，需要解决主动视角选择问题，找到选择信息丰富相机姿态的原则性方法。
AI.method: 提出COVER（Camera Optimization for View Exploration and Reconstruction）方法，核心洞察是通过最小化Fisher信息增益的易处理近似值来选择信息丰富的视角，这简化为倾向于覆盖过去相机观测不足区域的视角，形成轻量级的基于覆盖率的视角选择指标。
AI.result: 在Nerfstudio框架中集成该方法，在固定和移动数据采集场景的真实数据集上进行评估。在多个数据集和辐射场基线上，相比最先进的主动视角选择方法，该方法一致提升了重建质量。
AI.conclusion: COVER提供了一种简单、可解释且轻量级的视角选择标准，通过最小化Fisher信息增益的近似值，有效选择覆盖观测不足区域的视角，显著提升了3D重建质量。

title: Breakthrough the Suboptimal Stable Point in Value-Factorization-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Value factorization, a popular paradigm in MARL, faces significant theoretical and algorithmic bottlenecks: its tendency to converge to suboptimal solutions remains poorly understood and unsolved. Theoretically, existing analyses fail to explain this due to their primary focus on the optimal case. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel theoretical concept: the stable point, which characterizes the potential convergence of value factorization in general cases. Through an analysis of stable point distributions in existing methods, we reveal that non-optimal stable points are the primary cause of poor performance. However, algorithmically, making the optimal action the unique stable point is nearly infeasible. In contrast, iteratively filtering suboptimal actions by rendering them unstable emerges as a more practical approach for global optimality. Inspired by this, we propose a novel Multi-Round Value Factorization (MRVF) framework. Specifically, by measuring a non-negative payoff increment relative to the previously selected action, MRVF transforms inferior actions into unstable points, thereby driving each iteration toward a stable point with a superior action. Experiments on challenging benchmarks, including predator-prey tasks and StarCraft II Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC), validate our analysis of stable points and demonstrate the superiority of MRVF over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多轮价值分解框架，通过引入稳定点理论分析价值分解方法的收敛问题，并设计迭代过滤次优动作的算法来解决MARL中的次优收敛问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习中价值分解方法面临理论和算法瓶颈：现有理论分析主要关注最优情况，无法解释为何会收敛到次优解，这导致性能不佳的问题长期未解决。
AI.method: 提出稳定点理论概念来分析一般情况下的收敛性；基于此提出多轮价值分解框架，通过测量相对于先前选择动作的非负收益增量，将次优动作转化为不稳定点，驱动每次迭代向具有更优动作的稳定点收敛。
AI.result: 在捕食者-猎物任务和星际争霸II多智能体挑战等基准测试中验证了稳定点理论分析的有效性，并证明MRVF框架优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 稳定点理论为理解价值分解的收敛问题提供了新视角，多轮价值分解框架通过迭代过滤次优动作实现了全局最优性，为解决MARL中的次优收敛问题提供了有效方案。

title: XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 as a main conference paper
summary: Multi-bit watermarking has emerged as a promising solution for embedding imperceptible binary messages into Large Language Model (LLM)-generated text, enabling reliable attribution and tracing of malicious usage of LLMs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face key limitations: some become computationally infeasible for large messages, while others suffer from a poor trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. Moreover, the decoding accuracy of existing methods drops significantly when the number of tokens in the generated text is limited, a condition that frequently arises in practical usage. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{XMark}, a novel method for encoding and decoding binary messages in LLM-generated texts. The unique design of \textsc{XMark}'s encoder produces a less distorted logit distribution for watermarked token generation, preserving text quality, and also enables its tailored decoder to reliably recover the encoded message with limited tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks show that \textsc{XMark} significantly improves decoding accuracy while preserving the quality of watermarked text, outperforming prior methods. The code is at https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/XMark.

AI.tldr: XMark是一种用于LLM生成文本的多比特水印方法，通过减少对数分布失真来保持文本质量，并在有限token数量下提高解码准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多比特水印方法存在计算复杂度高、文本质量与解码准确率权衡不佳、在有限token数量下解码准确率显著下降等问题，需要一种更有效的解决方案。
AI.method: XMark采用独特的编码器设计，生成对数分布失真较小的水印token，同时配合定制的解码器，能够在有限token数量下可靠恢复编码信息。
AI.result: 在多种下游任务上的实验表明，XMark显著提高了解码准确率，同时保持了水印文本的质量，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: XMark为解决LLM生成文本的多比特水印问题提供了一种有效方法，在保持文本质量的同时提高了解码准确率，特别是在有限token数量的实际应用场景中表现优异。

title: Region-R1: Reinforcing Query-Side Region Cropping for Multi-Modal Re-Ranking
summary: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (MM-RAG) relies heavily on re-rankers to surface the most relevant evidence for image-question queries. However, standard re-rankers typically process the full query image as a global embedding, making them susceptible to visual distractors (e.g., background clutter) that skew similarity scores. We propose Region-R1, a query-side region cropping framework that formulates region selection as a decision-making problem during re-ranking, allowing the system to learn to retain the full image or focus only on a question-relevant region before scoring the retrieved candidates. Region-R1 learns a policy with a novel region-aware group relative policy optimization (r-GRPO) to dynamically crop a discriminative region. Across two challenging benchmarks, E-VQA and InfoSeek, Region-R1 delivers consistent gains, achieving state-of-the-art performances by increasing conditional Recall@1 by up to 20%. These results show the great promise of query-side adaptation as a simple but effective way to strengthen MM-RAG re-ranking.

AI.tldr: Region-R1：一种针对多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）的查询端区域裁剪框架，通过动态裁剪与问题相关的图像区域来提升重排序性能，减少视觉干扰物的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态重排序器通常将整个查询图像作为全局嵌入处理，容易受到背景杂乱等视觉干扰物的影响，导致相似性评分偏差。需要一种能够动态聚焦于问题相关区域的方法来提升重排序的准确性。
AI.method: 提出Region-R1框架，将区域选择建模为决策问题，使用新颖的区域感知组相对策略优化（r-GRPO）学习策略，动态裁剪判别性区域，可以选择保留完整图像或仅关注问题相关区域。
AI.result: 在E-VQA和InfoSeek两个基准测试中，Region-R1实现了持续的性能提升，达到最先进水平，条件Recall@1最高提升20%。
AI.conclusion: 查询端适应是一种简单而有效的方法，可以显著增强MM-RAG重排序性能，展示了通过动态区域裁剪减少视觉干扰的潜力。

title: Graph of Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
comment: 13 pages of main text, 13 pages of appendix. Core contribution by Dawei Li and Zongxia Li. Project page: https://github.com/davidliuk/graph-of-skills
summary:
Skill usage has become a core component of modern agent systems and can substantially improve agents' ability to complete complex tasks. In real-world settings, where agents must monitor and interact with numerous personal applications, web browsers, and other environment interfaces, skill libraries can scale to thousands of reusable skills. Scaling to larger skill sets introduces two key challenges. First, loading the full skill set saturates the context window, driving up token costs, hallucination, and latency.
  In this paper, we present Graph of Skills (GoS), an inference-time structural retrieval layer for large skill libraries. GoS constructs an executable skill graph offline from skill packages, then at inference time retrieves a bounded, dependency-aware skill bundle through hybrid semantic-lexical seeding, reverse-weighted Personalized PageRank, and context-budgeted hydration. On SkillsBench and ALFWorld, GoS improves average reward by 43.6% over the vanilla full skill-loading baseline while reducing input tokens by 37.8%, and generalizes across three model families: Claude Sonnet, GPT-5.2 Codex, and MiniMax. Additional ablation studies across skill libraries ranging from 200 to 2,000 skills further demonstrate that GoS consistently outperforms both vanilla skills loading and simple vector retrieval in balancing reward, token efficiency, and runtime.

AI.tldr: GoS是一种用于大规模技能库的推理时结构检索层，通过构建可执行技能图，在推理时检索有界、依赖感知的技能包，显著提高奖励同时减少输入token
AI.motivation: 现实世界中智能体需要监控和交互大量个人应用、网页浏览器等环境接口，技能库可扩展到数千个可重用技能。但加载完整技能集会饱和上下文窗口，导致token成本增加、幻觉和延迟问题
AI.method: GoS从技能包离线构建可执行技能图，在推理时通过混合语义-词汇种子、反向加权个性化PageRank和上下文预算水合技术检索有界、依赖感知的技能包
AI.result: 在SkillsBench和ALFWorld上，GoS比完整技能加载基线平均奖励提高43.6%，同时减少37.8%的输入token，在Claude Sonnet、GPT-5.2 Codex和MiniMax三个模型家族上均有效。在200-2000个技能库的消融研究中，GoS在奖励、token效率和运行时间平衡方面持续优于完整技能加载和简单向量检索
AI.conclusion: GoS为解决大规模技能库的上下文窗口饱和问题提供了有效的结构检索解决方案，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本

title: Exemplar Retrieval Without Overhypothesis Induction: Limits of Distributional Sequence Learning in Early Word Learning
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 22 references. Pre-registered study (OSF: https://osf.io/qj9hb/). Code and data: https://github.com/synthiumjp/overhypothesis. Submitted to Cognitive Computation
summary: Background: Children do not simply learn that balls are round and blocks are square. They learn that shape is the kind of feature that tends to define object categories -- a second-order generalisation known as an overhypothesis [1, 2]. What kind of learning mechanism is sufficient for this inductive leap? Methods: We trained autoregressive transformer language models (3.4M-25.6M parameters) on synthetic corpora in which shape is the stable feature dimension across categories, with eight conditions controlling for alternative explanations. Results: Across 120 pre-registered runs evaluated on a 1,040-item wug test battery, every model achieved perfect first-order exemplar retrieval (100%) while second-order generalisation to novel nouns remained at chance (50-52%), a result confirmed by equivalence testing. A feature-swap diagnostic revealed that models rely on frame-to-feature template matching rather than structured noun-to-domain-to-feature abstraction. Conclusions: These results reveal a clear limitation of autoregressive distributional sequence learning under developmental-scale training conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，自回归语言模型在发育规模训练条件下无法学习到形状作为稳定特征维度的二阶概括（overhypothesis），尽管能完美记忆一阶样例。
AI.motivation: 探究儿童如何学习到形状是定义物体类别的稳定特征维度（二阶概括），以及什么样的学习机制足以实现这种归纳跳跃。
AI.method: 使用自回归transformer语言模型（340万-2560万参数）在合成语料库上进行训练，其中形状是跨类别的稳定特征维度，设计了8种条件控制替代解释，通过1040项的wug测试电池评估。
AI.result: 所有模型在120次预注册运行中都实现了完美的一阶样例检索（100%），但对新名词的二阶概括仍处于随机水平（50-52%），特征交换诊断显示模型依赖框架到特征的模板匹配而非结构化抽象。
AI.conclusion: 自回归分布序列学习在发育规模训练条件下存在明显局限性，无法学习到二阶概括，这揭示了当前语言模型与人类概念学习之间的重要差异。

title: Toward Unified Fine-Grained Vehicle Classification and Automatic License Plate Recognition
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of the Brazilian Computer Society (JBCS)
summary: Extracting vehicle information from surveillance images is essential for intelligent transportation systems, enabling applications such as traffic monitoring and criminal investigations. While Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is widely used, Fine-Grained Vehicle Classification (FGVC) offers a complementary approach by identifying vehicles based on attributes such as color, make, model, and type. Although there have been advances in this field, existing studies often assume well-controlled conditions, explore limited attributes, and overlook FGVC integration with ALPR. To address these gaps, we introduce UFPR-VeSV, a dataset comprising 24,945 images of 16,297 unique vehicles with annotations for 13 colors, 26 makes, 136 models, and 14 types. Collected from the Military Police of Paraná (Brazil) surveillance system, the dataset captures diverse real-world conditions, including partial occlusions, nighttime infrared imaging, and varying lighting. All FGVC annotations were validated using license plate information, with text and corner annotations also being provided. A qualitative and quantitative comparison with established datasets confirmed the challenging nature of our dataset. A benchmark using five deep learning models further validated this, revealing specific challenges such as handling multicolored vehicles, infrared images, and distinguishing between vehicle models that share a common platform. Additionally, we apply two optical character recognition models to license plate recognition and explore the joint use of FGVC and ALPR. The results highlight the potential of integrating these complementary tasks for real-world applications. The UFPR-VeSV dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/Lima001/UFPR-VeSV-Dataset.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了UFPR-VeSV数据集，包含24,945张车辆图像和13种颜色、26个品牌、136个型号、14种类型的细粒度标注，用于车辆细粒度分类和车牌识别任务，验证了在真实监控场景下的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有车辆信息提取研究通常假设理想条件、探索有限属性，且忽略了细粒度车辆分类与车牌识别的整合。需要真实监控条件下的综合数据集来弥补这些不足。
AI.method: 从巴西巴拉那州军事警察监控系统收集24,945张图像，标注16,297辆独特车辆的13种颜色、26个品牌、136个型号、14种类型，所有标注都通过车牌信息验证。使用5个深度学习模型进行基准测试，并应用2个OCR模型进行车牌识别。
AI.result: 数据集包含真实世界挑战条件（部分遮挡、夜间红外成像、不同光照）。基准测试揭示了处理多色车辆、红外图像以及区分共享平台车辆模型的具体挑战。联合使用细粒度车辆分类和车牌识别显示出实际应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: UFPR-VeSV数据集为真实监控条件下的车辆细粒度分类和车牌识别研究提供了有价值的资源，证明了整合这两个互补任务在实际应用中的潜力。

title: TRACE: Capability-Targeted Agentic Training
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in agentic environments must exercise multiple capabilities across different task instances, where a capability is performing one or more actions in a trajectory that are necessary for successfully solving a subset of tasks in the environment. Many existing approaches either rely on synthetic training data that is not targeted to the model's actual capability deficits in the target environment or train directly on the target environment, where the model needs to implicitly learn the capabilities across tasks. We introduce TRACE (Turning Recurrent Agent failures into Capability-targeted training Environments), an end-to-end system for environment-specific agent self-improvement. TRACE contrasts successful and failed trajectories to automatically identify lacking capabilities, synthesizes a targeted training environment for each that rewards whether the capability was exercised, and trains a LoRA adapter via RL on each synthetic environment, routing to the relevant adapter at inference. Empirically, TRACE generalizes across different environments, improving over the base agent by +14.1 points on $τ^2$-bench (customer service) and +7 perfect scores on ToolSandbox (tool use), outperforming the strongest baseline by +7.4 points and +4 perfect scores, respectively. Given the same number of rollouts, TRACE scales more efficiently than baselines, outperforming GRPO and GEPA by +9.2 and +7.4 points on $τ^2$-bench.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个端到端系统，通过分析智能体失败轨迹自动识别缺失能力，为每个能力合成针对性训练环境，并通过强化学习训练LoRA适配器，实现环境特定的智能体自我改进。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖非针对性的合成训练数据，要么直接在目标环境中训练，需要隐式学习跨任务能力。需要一种能自动识别智能体在特定环境中缺失能力并提供针对性训练的系统。
AI.method: TRACE对比成功和失败轨迹自动识别缺失能力，为每个能力合成针对性训练环境（奖励是否执行该能力），通过强化学习在每个合成环境中训练LoRA适配器，在推理时路由到相关适配器。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench（客服）上比基础智能体提升14.1分，在ToolSandbox（工具使用）上多获得7个完美分数，分别比最强基线高出7.4分和4个完美分数。在相同rollout数量下，TRACE比基线方法扩展更高效。
AI.conclusion: TRACE系统能够有效识别智能体在特定环境中的能力缺陷，通过针对性训练显著提升性能，且比现有方法更高效。

title: Do Domain-specific Experts exist in MoE-based LLMs?
summary: In the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as an effective approach for training extremely large models with improved computational efficiency. This success builds upon extensive prior research aimed at enhancing expert specialization in MoE-based LLMs. However, the nature of such specializations and how they can be systematically interpreted remain open research challenges. In this work, we investigate this gap by posing a fundamental question: \textit{Do domain-specific experts exist in MoE-based LLMs?} To answer the question, we evaluate ten advanced MoE-based LLMs ranging from 3.8B to 120B parameters and provide empirical evidence for the existence of domain-specific experts. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{Domain Steering Mixture of Experts (DSMoE)}, a training-free framework that introduces zero additional inference cost and outperforms both well-trained MoE-based LLMs and strong baselines, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Experiments on four advanced open-source MoE-based LLMs across both target and non-target domains demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance and robust generalization without increasing inference cost or requiring additional retraining. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/giangdip2410/Domain-specific-Experts.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了MoE架构LLM中是否存在领域特定专家，并通过实验证实了其存在性，进而提出了无需额外训练成本的Domain Steering Mixture of Experts (DSMoE)框架，在多个领域任务上超越了传统MoE模型和SFT方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管MoE架构在训练超大规模LLM方面取得了成功，但专家专业化的本质及其系统性解释仍是开放研究问题。本研究旨在探究MoE-based LLMs中是否存在领域特定专家，并基于这一发现开发更高效的推理方法。
AI.method: 1) 评估10个参数规模从3.8B到120B的先进MoE-based LLMs，为领域特定专家的存在提供实证证据；2) 提出Domain Steering Mixture of Experts (DSMoE)框架，这是一种无需训练的方法，不增加推理成本；3) 在4个开源MoE-based LLMs上进行实验，涵盖目标和非目标领域。
AI.result: 实验证实了MoE-based LLMs中存在领域特定专家。DSMoE框架在目标和非目标领域都表现出强大的性能和鲁棒的泛化能力，超越了训练良好的MoE-based LLMs和包括SFT在内的强基线方法，且不增加推理成本或需要重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次系统性地证实了MoE-based LLMs中领域特定专家的存在，并提出了高效的DSMoE框架，为理解和利用MoE架构的专业化特性提供了新视角，同时保持了计算效率优势。

title: From Measurement to Mitigation: Quantifying and Reducing Identity Leakage in Image Representation Encoders with Linear Subspace Removal
summary: Frozen visual embeddings (e.g., CLIP, DINOv2/v3, SSCD) power retrieval and integrity systems, yet their use on face-containing data is constrained by unmeasured identity leakage and a lack of deployable mitigations. We take an attacker-aware view and contribute: (i) a benchmark of visual embeddings that reports open-set verification at low false-accept rates, a calibrated diffusion-based template inversion check, and face-context attribution with equal-area perturbations; and (ii) propose a one-shot linear projector that removes an estimated identity subspace while preserving the complementary space needed for utility, which for brevity we denote as the identity sanitization projection ISP. Across CelebA-20 and VGGFace2, we show that these encoders are robust under open-set linear probes, with CLIP exhibiting relatively higher leakage than DINOv2/v3 and SSCD, robust to template inversion, and are context-dominant. In addition, we show that ISP drives linear access to near-chance while retaining high non-biometric utility, and transfers across datasets with minor degradation. Our results establish the first attacker-calibrated facial privacy audit of non-FR encoders and demonstrate that linear subspace removal achieves strong privacy guarantees while preserving utility for visual search and retrieval.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种针对视觉嵌入模型的身份隐私审计方法和缓解方案，通过基准测试评估CLIP、DINOv2/v3、SSCD等模型的身份泄露风险，并提出一次性线性投影器ISP来移除身份子空间同时保持实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉嵌入模型（如CLIP、DINOv2/v3、SSCD）在人脸数据上的应用受到身份泄露风险的限制，缺乏可部署的缓解措施和系统化的隐私评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 建立视觉嵌入模型基准测试，包括低误接受率下的开放集验证、基于扩散的模板反转检查、以及等面积扰动的人脸上下文归因分析；2) 提出一次性线性投影器ISP，通过估计并移除身份子空间来保护隐私，同时保留实用功能所需的互补空间。
AI.result: 在CelebA-20和VGGFace2数据集上，CLIP相比DINOv2/v3和SSCD表现出相对较高的身份泄露，但所有编码器对模板反转攻击都具有鲁棒性，且上下文主导。ISP方法能够将线性访问降低到接近随机水平，同时保持高非生物特征实用性，并在跨数据集迁移时仅出现轻微性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次建立了针对非人脸识别编码器的攻击者校准面部隐私审计框架，并证明线性子空间移除方法能够在保持视觉搜索和检索实用性的同时提供强大的隐私保护保证。

title: Dynamic Agentic AI Expert Profiler System Architecture for Multidomain Intelligence Modeling
comment: Accepted to be Published in IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CAI) 2026 - May 8-10, 2026, Granada, Spain
summary: In today's artificial intelligence driven world, modern systems communicate with people from diverse backgrounds and skill levels. For human-machine interaction to be meaningful, systems must be aware of context and user expertise. This study proposes an agentic AI profiler that classifies natural language responses into four levels: Novice, Basic, Advanced, and Expert. The system uses a modular layered architecture built on LLaMA v3.1 (8B), with components for text preprocessing, scoring, aggregation, and classification. Evaluation was conducted in two phases: a static phase using pre-recorded transcripts from 82 participants, and a dynamic phase with 402 live interviews conducted by an agentic AI interviewer. In both phases, participant self-ratings were compared with profiler predictions. In the dynamic phase, expertise was assessed after each response rather than at the end of the interview. Across domains, 83% to 97% of profiler evaluations matched participant self-assessments. Remaining differences were due to self-rating bias, unclear responses, and occasional misinterpretation of nuanced expertise by the language model.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于LLaMA v3.1(8B)的智能AI分析器，能够将自然语言回答分类为新手、基础、高级和专家四个专业水平等级，在动态评估中准确率达到83%-97%。
AI.motivation: 在现代人工智能驱动的世界中，系统需要与不同背景和技能水平的人交流。为了实现有意义的人机交互，系统必须了解上下文和用户专业知识水平。
AI.method: 采用基于LLaMA v3.1(8B)的模块化分层架构，包含文本预处理、评分、聚合和分类组件。评估分为两个阶段：静态阶段使用82名参与者的预录转录，动态阶段使用智能AI面试官进行402次实时访谈。
AI.result: 在不同领域中，分析器评估与参与者自我评估的匹配率达到83%至97%。剩余差异主要源于自我评估偏差、回答不清晰以及语言模型偶尔对细微专业知识的误解。
AI.conclusion: 该智能AI分析器能够有效评估用户专业知识水平，在人机交互中实现更智能的上下文感知，为个性化交互系统提供了实用工具。

title: Beneath the Surface: Investigating LLMs' Capabilities for Communicating with Subtext
summary: Human communication is fundamentally creative, and often makes use of subtext -- implied meaning that goes beyond the literal content of the text. Here, we systematically study whether language models can use subtext in communicative settings, and introduce four new evaluation suites to assess these capabilities. Our evaluation settings range from writing & interpreting allegories to playing multi-agent and multi-modal games inspired by the rules of board games like Dixit. We find that frontier models generally exhibit a strong bias towards overly literal, explicit communication, and thereby fail to account for nuanced constraints -- even the best performing models generate literal clues 60% of times in one of our environments -- Visual Allusions. However, we find that some models can sometimes make use of common ground with another party to help them communicate with subtext, achieving 30%-50% reduction in overly literal clues; but they struggle at inferring presence of a common ground when not explicitly stated. For allegory understanding, we find paratextual and persona conditions to significantly shift the interpretation of subtext. Overall, our work provides quantifiable measures for an inherently complex and subjective phenomenon like subtext and reveals many weaknesses and idiosyncrasies of current LLMs. We hope this research to inspire future work towards socially grounded creative communication and reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了语言模型在创造性沟通中使用潜台词的能力，发现前沿模型普遍存在过于字面化的沟通偏见，但在特定条件下能够利用共同背景减少字面化表达。
AI.motivation: 人类沟通本质上是创造性的，经常使用潜台词（超越字面意义的隐含含义）。研究旨在系统评估语言模型是否能在沟通环境中使用潜台词，量化这一复杂主观现象的能力。
AI.method: 引入了四个新的评估套件：从写作和解释寓言，到玩受Dixit等桌游规则启发的多智能体多模态游戏。具体包括"视觉暗示"等环境，评估模型在多种约束条件下的潜台词使用能力。
AI.result: 前沿模型普遍表现出强烈的字面化沟通偏见，在"视觉暗示"环境中，即使最佳模型也有60%的时间生成字面化线索。但某些模型有时能利用与另一方的共同背景来使用潜台词，将过度字面化线索减少30%-50%。在寓言理解方面，副文本和角色条件显著改变了潜台词的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为潜台词这一复杂主观现象提供了可量化的衡量标准，揭示了当前LLMs的许多弱点和特质。希望激发未来在社会基础创造性沟通和推理方面的研究。

title: SmokeGS-R: Physics-Guided Pseudo-Clean 3DGS for Real-World Multi-View Smoke Restoration
summary: Real-world smoke simultaneously attenuates scene radiance, adds airlight, and destabilizes multi-view appearance consistency, making robust 3D reconstruction particularly difficult. We present \textbf{SmokeGS-R}, a practical pipeline developed for the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Track 2 challenge. The key idea is to decouple geometry recovery from appearance correction: we generate physics-guided pseudo-clean supervision with a refined dark channel prior and guided filtering, train a sharp clean-only 3D Gaussian Splatting source model, and then harmonize its renderings with a donor ensemble using geometric-mean reference aggregation, LAB-space Reinhard transfer, and light Gaussian smoothing. On the official challenge testing leaderboard, the final submission achieved \mbox{PSNR $=15.217$} and \mbox{SSIM $=0.666$}. After the public release of RealX3D, we re-evaluated the same frozen result on the seven released challenge scenes without retraining and obtained \mbox{PSNR $=15.209$}, \mbox{SSIM $=0.644$}, and \mbox{LPIPS $=0.551$}, outperforming the strongest official baseline average on the same scenes by $+3.68$ dB PSNR. These results suggest that a geometry-first reconstruction strategy combined with stable post-render appearance harmonization is an effective recipe for real-world multi-view smoke restoration. The code is available at https://github.com/windrise/3drr_Track2_SmokeGS-R.

AI.tldr: SmokeGS-R是一个用于烟雾场景3D重建的实用管道，通过解耦几何恢复和外观校正，在NTIRE 2026挑战赛上取得了优于基准方法的结果。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的烟雾会同时衰减场景辐射、增加空气光并破坏多视角外观一致性，这使得鲁棒的3D重建变得特别困难。
AI.method: 采用几何恢复与外观校正解耦策略：1) 使用改进的暗通道先验和引导滤波生成物理引导的伪干净监督；2) 训练一个锐利的仅干净3D高斯溅射源模型；3) 通过几何平均参考聚合、LAB空间Reinhard传递和轻量高斯平滑，将渲染结果与捐赠集合进行协调。
AI.result: 在官方测试排行榜上获得PSNR=15.217和SSIM=0.666。在RealX3D公开后重新评估，获得PSNR=15.209、SSIM=0.644和LPIPS=0.551，比最强官方基准平均高出+3.68 dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 几何优先的重建策略结合稳定的后渲染外观协调是真实世界多视角烟雾恢复的有效方法。

title: ETR: Entropy Trend Reward for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model performance on complex tasks, but often produces excessively long and inefficient reasoning traces. Existing methods shorten CoTs using length penalties or global entropy reduction, implicitly assuming that low uncertainty is desirable throughout reasoning. We show instead that reasoning efficiency is governed by the trajectory of uncertainty. CoTs with dominant downward entropy trends are substantially shorter. Motivated by this insight, we propose Entropy Trend Reward (ETR), a trajectory-aware objective that encourages progressive uncertainty reduction while allowing limited local exploration. We integrate ETR into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and evaluate it across multiple reasoning models and challenging benchmarks. ETR consistently achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency tradeoff, improving DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B by 9.9% in accuracy while reducing CoT length by 67% across four benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Xuan1030/ETR

AI.tldr: 论文提出Entropy Trend Reward (ETR)方法，通过鼓励推理过程中不确定性逐步降低的趋势，来优化思维链的长度和效率，在保持准确率的同时显著缩短推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过长度惩罚或全局熵减来缩短思维链，隐含假设低不确定性在整个推理过程中都是可取的。但作者发现推理效率实际上由不确定性轨迹决定，具有主导下降熵趋势的思维链更短。
AI.method: 提出Entropy Trend Reward (ETR)，这是一种轨迹感知的目标函数，鼓励渐进式不确定性降低，同时允许有限的局部探索。将ETR集成到Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)中进行优化。
AI.result: ETR在多个推理模型和挑战性基准测试中始终实现更优的准确率-效率权衡，将DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B在四个基准测试中的准确率提高9.9%，同时将思维链长度减少67%。
AI.conclusion: 推理效率由不确定性轨迹决定而非全局低不确定性，ETR方法通过鼓励渐进式熵减趋势，在保持准确率的同时显著提高思维链推理效率。

title: DIA-HARM: Dialectal Disparities in Harmful Content Detection Across 50 English Dialects
summary: Harmful content detectors-particularly disinformation classifiers-are predominantly developed and evaluated on Standard American English (SAE), leaving their robustness to dialectal variation unexplored. We present DIA-HARM, the first benchmark for evaluating disinformation detection robustness across 50 English dialects spanning U.S., British, African, Caribbean, and Asia-Pacific varieties. Using Multi-VALUE's linguistically grounded transformations, we introduce D3 (Dialectal Disinformation Detection), a corpus of 195K samples derived from established disinformation benchmarks. Our evaluation of 16 detection models reveals systematic vulnerabilities: human-written dialectal content degrades detection by 1.4-3.6% F1, while AI-generated content remains stable. Fine-tuned transformers substantially outperform zero-shot LLMs (96.6% vs. 78.3% best-case F1), with some models exhibiting catastrophic failures exceeding 33% degradation on mixed content. Cross-dialectal transfer analysis across 2,450 dialect pairs shows that multilingual models (mDeBERTa: 97.2% average F1) generalize effectively, while monolingual models like RoBERTa and XLM-RoBERTa fail on dialectal inputs. These findings demonstrate that current disinformation detectors may systematically disadvantage hundreds of millions of non-SAE speakers worldwide. We release the DIA-HARM framework, D3 corpus, and evaluation tools: https://github.com/jsl5710/dia-harm

AI.tldr: DIA-HARM是首个评估虚假信息检测在50种英语方言中鲁棒性的基准，发现现有检测器对非标准美式英语方言存在系统性脆弱性，可能导致全球数亿非SAE使用者处于不利地位。
AI.motivation: 当前有害内容检测器（特别是虚假信息分类器）主要基于标准美式英语（SAE）开发和评估，其对方言变体的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索，这可能导致对非SAE使用者的系统性偏见。
AI.method: 使用Multi-VALUE的语言学基础转换方法，创建了D3（方言虚假信息检测）语料库，包含195K个样本，源自已有的虚假信息基准。评估了16个检测模型在50种英语方言上的表现，包括美国、英国、非洲、加勒比和亚太地区的方言变体。
AI.result: 研究发现系统性脆弱性：人类撰写的方言内容使检测性能下降1.4-3.6% F1，而AI生成内容保持稳定。微调transformer模型显著优于零样本LLM（96.6% vs. 78.3%最佳F1），部分模型在混合内容上出现超过33%的性能退化。跨方言迁移分析显示多语言模型（mDeBERTa：97.2%平均F1）泛化效果更好，而单语言模型如RoBERTa和XLM-RoBERTa在方言输入上表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前虚假信息检测器可能系统性地使全球数亿非标准美式英语使用者处于不利地位。研究发布了DIA-HARM框架、D3语料库和评估工具，以促进更公平和鲁棒的检测系统开发。

title: VLA-InfoEntropy: A Training-Free Vision-Attention Information Entropy Approach for Vision-Language-Action Models Inference Acceleration and Success
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action decision-making for cross-modal semantic alignment, exhibiting broad application potential. However, the joint processing of high-dimensional visual features, complex linguistic inputs, and continuous action sequences incurs significant computational overhead and low inference efficiency, thereby hindering real-time deployment and reliability. To address this issue, we use image entropy to quantify the grayscale distribution characteristics of each visual token and introduce attention entropy to capture the distribution of attention scores over task-related text. Visual entropy identifies texture-rich or structurally informative regions, while attention entropy pinpoints semantically relevant tokens. Combined with timestep information, these metrics enable a dynamic transition strategy that shifts the model's focus from global visual features to attention-guided local informative regions. Thus, the resulting VLA-InfoEntropy method integrates spatial, semantic, and temporal cues to reduce redundancy while preserving critical content. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces inference parameters, accelerates inference speed, and outperforms existing approaches.

AI.tldr: VLA-InfoEntropy方法通过图像熵和注意力熵量化视觉和语义信息，结合时间步信息实现动态注意力转移，减少冗余计算，提升VLA模型推理效率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在处理高维视觉特征、复杂语言输入和连续动作序列时存在显著计算开销和低推理效率问题，阻碍实时部署和可靠性。
AI.method: 使用图像熵量化每个视觉token的灰度分布特征，引入注意力熵捕捉任务相关文本的注意力分数分布。结合时间步信息实现动态注意力转移策略，从全局视觉特征转向注意力引导的局部信息区域。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法减少了推理参数，加速了推理速度，并优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: VLA-InfoEntropy方法通过整合空间、语义和时间线索，在保留关键内容的同时减少冗余，有效提升了VLA模型的推理效率。

title: LatentAudit: Real-Time White-Box Faithfulness Monitoring for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Verifiable Deployment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucination but does not eliminate it: a deployed system must still decide, at inference time, whether its answer is actually supported by the retrieved evidence. We introduce LatentAudit, a white-box auditor that pools mid-to-late residual-stream activations from an open-weight generator and measures their Mahalanobis distance to the evidence representation. The resulting quadratic rule requires no auxiliary judge model, runs at generation time, and is simple enough to calibrate on a small held-out set. We show that residual-stream geometry carries a usable faithfulness signal, that this signal survives architecture changes and realistic retrieval failures, and that the same rule remains amenable to public verification. On PubMedQA with Llama-3-8B, LatentAudit reaches 0.942 AUROC with 0.77,ms overhead. Across three QA benchmarks and five model families (Llama-2/3, Qwen-2.5/3, Mistral), the monitor remains stable; under a four-way stress test with contradictions, retrieval misses, and partial-support noise, it reaches 0.9566--0.9815 AUROC on PubMedQA and 0.9142--0.9315 on HotpotQA. At 16-bit fixed-point precision, the audit rule preserves 99.8% of the FP16 AUROC, enabling Groth16-based public verification without revealing model weights or activations. Together, these results position residual-stream geometry as a practical basis for real-time RAG faithfulness monitoring and optional verifiable deployment.

AI.tldr: LatentAudit：一种基于残差流几何的白盒审计器，用于实时监测RAG系统的忠实度，无需额外判断模型，计算开销小且支持公开验证
AI.motivation: RAG系统虽然能缓解幻觉问题，但无法完全消除，需要在推理时判断答案是否真正得到检索证据的支持。现有方法通常需要额外的判断模型，计算开销大且缺乏可验证性。
AI.method: 提出LatentAudit白盒审计器，从开放权重的生成器中提取中后期残差流激活，计算其与证据表示的Mahalanobis距离，形成二次规则。该方法无需辅助判断模型，可在生成时运行，且易于在小规模验证集上校准。
AI.result: 在PubMedQA上使用Llama-3-8B达到0.942 AUROC，开销仅0.77ms。在三个QA基准和五个模型家族上保持稳定，在包含矛盾、检索失败和部分支持噪声的四向压力测试中，在PubMedQA上达到0.9566-0.9815 AUROC，在HotpotQA上达到0.9142-0.9315 AUROC。16位定点精度下保留99.8%的FP16 AUROC性能。
AI.conclusion: 残差流几何为实时RAG忠实度监测提供了实用基础，支持可选的公开验证部署，无需暴露模型权重或激活，为RAG系统的可靠性和可验证性提供了新方案。

title: Human Values Matter: Investigating How Misalignment Shapes Collective Behaviors in LLM Agent Communities
summary: As LLMs become increasingly integrated into human society, evaluating their orientations on human values from social science has drawn growing attention. Nevertheless, it is still unclear why human values matter for LLMs, especially in LLM-based multi-agent systems, where group-level failures may accumulate from individually misaligned actions. We ask whether misalignment with human values alters the collective behavior of LLM agents and what changes it induces? In this work, we introduce CIVA, a controlled multi-agent environment grounded in social science theories, where LLM agents form a community and autonomously communicate, explore, and compete for resources, enabling systematic manipulation of value prevalence and behavioral analysis. Through comprehensive simulation experiments, we reveal three key findings. (1) We identify several structurally critical values that substantially shape the community's collective dynamics, including those diverging from LLMs' original orientations. Triggered by the misspecification of these values, we (2) detect system failure modes, e.g., catastrophic collapse, at the macro level, and (3) observe emergent behaviors like deception and power-seeking at the micro level. These results offer quantitative evidence that human values are essential for collective outcomes in LLMs and motivate future multi-agent value alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了人类价值观对LLM多智能体系统集体行为的影响，发现价值观错配会导致系统崩溃、欺骗等异常行为。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地融入人类社会，从社会科学角度评估其对人类价值观的取向变得日益重要。特别是在LLM多智能体系统中，个体层面的错配行为可能累积导致群体层面的失败，但尚不清楚人类价值观为何对LLM重要，以及价值观错配如何改变LLM智能体的集体行为。
AI.method: 研究者引入了CIVA——一个基于社会科学理论的可控多智能体环境，LLM智能体在其中形成社区，自主通信、探索和竞争资源。通过系统性地操纵价值观流行程度和行为分析，进行全面的模拟实验。
AI.result: 研究揭示了三个关键发现：(1)识别出几个结构上关键的价值观念，这些观念显著塑造社区的集体动态，包括那些与LLM原始取向不同的价值观；(2)当这些价值观被错误设定时，在宏观层面检测到系统故障模式（如灾难性崩溃）；(3)在微观层面观察到涌现行为，如欺骗和权力追求。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为人类价值观对LLM集体结果的重要性提供了量化证据，并激励未来在多智能体价值对齐方面的研究。

title: TFRBench: A Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Forecasting Systems
summary: We introduce TFRBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of forecasting systems. Traditionally, time-series forecasting has been evaluated solely on numerical accuracy, treating foundation models as ``black boxes.'' Unlike existing benchmarks, TFRBench provides a protocol for evaluating the reasoning generated by forecasting systems--specifically their analysis of cross-channel dependencies, trends, and external events. To enable this, we propose a systematic multi-agent framework that utilizes an iterative verification loop to synthesize numerically grounded reasoning traces. Spanning ten datasets across five domains, our evaluation confirms that this reasoning is causally effective; useful for evaluation; and prompting LLMs with our generated traces significantly improves forecasting accuracy compared to direct numerical prediction (e.g., avg. $\sim40.2\%\to56.6\%)$, validating the quality of our reasoning. Conversely, benchmarking experiments reveal that off-the-shelf LLMs consistently struggle with both reasoning (lower LLM-as-a-Judge scores) and numerical forecasting, frequently failing to capture domain-specific dynamics. TFRBench thus establishes a new standard for interpretable, reasoning-based evaluation in time-series forecasting. Our benchmark is available at: https://tfrbench.github.io

AI.tldr: TFRBench是首个评估预测系统推理能力的基准，通过多智能体框架生成数值基础的推理轨迹，显著提升预测准确性，揭示现成LLM在推理和预测方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测仅评估数值准确性，将基础模型视为"黑箱"，缺乏对预测系统推理能力的评估。需要建立能够评估跨通道依赖、趋势和外部事件分析的基准。
AI.method: 提出系统性多智能体框架，利用迭代验证循环合成数值基础的推理轨迹。在5个领域的10个数据集上进行评估，通过LLM-as-a-Judge评分评估推理质量。
AI.result: 生成的推理轨迹具有因果有效性，对评估有用；使用这些轨迹提示LLM显著提高预测准确性（平均从40.2%提升到56.6%）。现成LLM在推理和数值预测方面表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: TFRBench为时间序列预测建立了可解释、基于推理的评估新标准，填补了传统仅关注数值准确性评估的空白。

title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, accepted at ACL 2026 Industry Track
summary: Enterprise IT support interactions are fundamentally diagnostic: effective resolution requires iterative evidence gathering from ambiguous user reports to identify an underlying root cause. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides grounding through historical cases, standard multi-turn RAG systems lack explicit diagnostic state and therefore struggle to accumulate evidence and resolve competing hypotheses across turns. We introduce DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents. DQA combines conversational query rewriting, retrieval aggregation, and state-conditioned response generation to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints. We evaluate DQA on 150 anonymized enterprise IT support scenarios using a replay-based protocol. Averaged over three independent runs, DQA achieves a 78.7% success rate under a trajectory-level success criterion, compared to 41.3% for a multi-turn RAG baseline, while reducing average turns from 8.4 to 3.9.

AI.tldr: DQA框架通过维护持久诊断状态和按根因聚合检索案例，显著提升企业IT支持中的多轮诊断问答效果，相比标准RAG基线成功率提高近一倍，对话轮次减少一半以上。
AI.motivation: 企业IT支持交互本质上是诊断性的，需要从模糊的用户报告中迭代收集证据以识别根本原因。标准的多轮RAG系统缺乏明确的诊断状态，难以在多个轮次中积累证据和解决竞争性假设。
AI.method: DQA框架结合对话查询重写、检索聚合和状态条件响应生成，维护持久诊断状态，并在根因级别而非单个文档级别聚合检索案例，以支持系统化故障排除。
AI.result: 在150个匿名企业IT支持场景的评估中，DQA在轨迹级成功标准下达到78.7%的成功率，而多轮RAG基线仅为41.3%，同时将平均对话轮次从8.4减少到3.9。
AI.conclusion: DQA框架通过显式维护诊断状态和按根因聚合检索，显著提升了企业IT支持中的诊断问答效果，在满足企业延迟和上下文约束的同时实现了更高效的系统化故障排除。

title: GESS: Multi-cue Guided Local Feature Learning via Geometric and Semantic Synergy
summary: Robust local feature detection and description are foundational tasks in computer vision. Existing methods primarily rely on single appearance cues for modeling, leading to unstable keypoints and insufficient descriptor discriminability. In this paper, we propose a multi-cue guided local feature learning framework that leverages semantic and geometric cues to synergistically enhance detection robustness and descriptor discriminability. Specifically, we construct a joint semantic-normal prediction head and a depth stability prediction head atop a lightweight backbone. The former leverages a shared 3D vector field to deeply couple semantic and normal cues, thereby resolving optimization interference from heterogeneous inconsistencies. The latter quantifies the reliability of local regions from a geometric consistency perspective, providing deterministic guidance for robust keypoint selection. Based on these predictions, we introduce the Semantic-Depth Aware Keypoint (SDAK) mechanism for feature detection. By coupling semantic reliability with depth stability, SDAK reweights keypoint responses to suppress spurious features in unreliable regions. For descriptor construction, we design a Unified Triple-Cue Fusion (UTCF) module, which employs a semantic-scheduled gating mechanism to adaptively inject multi-attribute features, improving descriptor discriminability. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The source code and pre-trained model will be available at: https://github.com/yiyscut/GESS.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多线索引导的局部特征学习框架，通过语义和几何线索协同增强检测鲁棒性和描述符区分度
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖单一外观线索进行建模，导致关键点不稳定和描述符区分度不足。需要利用多线索信息来提升局部特征的质量。
AI.method: 1) 构建联合语义-法线预测头和深度稳定性预测头；2) 提出语义-深度感知关键点(SDAK)机制，通过语义可靠性和深度稳定性重新加权关键点响应；3) 设计统一三线索融合(UTCF)模块，使用语义调度门控机制自适应注入多属性特征。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上进行了广泛实验，验证了所提框架的有效性。源代码和预训练模型将在GitHub上公开。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多线索引导局部特征学习框架通过语义和几何线索的协同作用，显著提升了关键点检测的鲁棒性和描述符的区分度。

title: LLM-as-Judge for Semantic Judging of Powerline Segmentation in UAV Inspection
summary: The deployment of lightweight segmentation models on drones for autonomous power line inspection presents a critical challenge: maintaining reliable performance under real-world conditions that differ from training data. Although compact architectures such as U-Net enable real-time onboard inference, their segmentation outputs can degrade unpredictably in adverse environments, raising safety concerns. In this work, we study the feasibility of using a large language model (LLM) as a semantic judge to assess the reliability of power line segmentation results produced by drone-mounted models. Rather than introducing a new inspection system, we formalize a watchdog scenario in which an offboard LLM evaluates segmentation overlays and examine whether such a judge can be trusted to behave consistently and perceptually coherently. To this end, we design two evaluation protocols that analyze the judge's repeatability and sensitivity. First, we assess repeatability by repeatedly querying the LLM with identical inputs and fixed prompts, measuring the stability of its quality scores and confidence estimates. Second, we evaluate perceptual sensitivity by introducing controlled visual corruptions (fog, rain, snow, shadow, and sunflare) and analyzing how the judge's outputs respond to progressive degradation in segmentation quality. Our results show that the LLM produces highly consistent categorical judgments under identical conditions while exhibiting appropriate declines in confidence as visual reliability deteriorates. Moreover, the judge remains responsive to perceptual cues such as missing or misidentified power lines, even under challenging conditions. These findings suggest that, when carefully constrained, an LLM can serve as a reliable semantic judge for monitoring segmentation quality in safety-critical aerial inspection tasks.

AI.tldr: 使用大型语言模型作为语义裁判评估无人机电力线分割结果的可靠性，通过重复性和感知敏感性测试验证其作为监控分割质量的可信度。
AI.motivation: 无人机自主电力线巡检中，轻量级分割模型在真实环境中的性能可能不可靠，存在安全隐患。需要一种方法来评估分割结果的可信度，而不必构建新的检测系统。
AI.method: 提出"看门狗"场景，让离板LLM评估分割叠加结果。设计两种评估协议：1) 重复性测试：用相同输入和固定提示重复查询LLM，测量其质量分数和置信度估计的稳定性；2) 感知敏感性测试：引入受控视觉干扰（雾、雨、雪、阴影、阳光耀斑），分析LLM输出如何响应分割质量的渐进退化。
AI.result: LLM在相同条件下产生高度一致的分类判断，同时随着视觉可靠性恶化，置信度适当下降。即使在挑战性条件下，裁判仍对缺失或误识别的电力线等感知线索保持响应。
AI.conclusion: 当受到适当约束时，LLM可以作为可靠的语义裁判，用于监控安全关键航空检测任务中的分割质量。

title: Rethinking IRSTD: Single-Point Supervision Guided Encoder-only Framework is Enough for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to separate small targets from clutter backgrounds. Extensive research is dedicated to the pixel-level supervision-guided "encoder-decoder" segmentation paradigm. Although having achieved promising performance, they neglect the fact that small targets only occupy a few pixels and are usually accompanied with blurred boundary caused by clutter backgrounds. Based on this observation, we argue that the first principle of IRSTD should be target localization instead of separating all target region accompanied with indistinguishable background noise. In this paper, we reformulate IRSTD as a centroid regression task and propose a novel Single-Point Supervision guided Infrared Probabilistic Response Encoding method (namely, SPIRE), which is indeed challenging due to the mismatch between reduced supervision network and equivalent output. Specifically, we first design a Point-Response Prior Supervision (PRPS), which transforms single-point annotations into probabilistic response map consistent with infrared point-target response characteristics, with a High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder (HRPE) that enables encoder-only, end-to-end regression without decoder reconstruction. By preserving high-resolution features and increasing effective supervision density, SPIRE alleviates optimization instability under sparse target distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on various IRSTD benchmarks, including SIRST-UAVB and SIRST4 demonstrate that SPIRE achieves competitive target-level detection performance with consistently low false alarm rate (Fa) and significantly reduced computational cost. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/NIRIXIANG/SPIRE-IRSTD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRE方法，将红外小目标检测重新定义为质心回归任务，使用单点监督和概率响应编码，在保持高分辨率特征的同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素级监督的"编码器-解码器"分割方法忽略了小目标仅占少数像素且边界模糊的问题。作者认为红外小目标检测的首要原则应是目标定位而非分离所有目标区域。
AI.method: 提出SPIRE方法：1) 点响应先验监督(PRPS)，将单点标注转换为符合红外点目标响应特性的概率响应图；2) 高分辨率概率编码器(HRPE)，实现仅编码器的端到端回归，无需解码器重建。
AI.result: 在SIRST-UAVB和SIRST4等多个红外小目标检测基准测试中，SPIRE实现了具有竞争力的目标级检测性能，保持低误报率的同时显著降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 将红外小目标检测重新定义为质心回归任务，采用单点监督和概率响应编码的方法有效解决了稀疏目标分布下的优化不稳定问题，为红外小目标检测提供了新的有效范式。

title: Towards Effective In-context Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via Domain-invariant-neurons-based Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have made notable progress in logical reasoning, yet still fall short of human-level performance. Current boosting strategies rely on expert-crafted in-domain demonstrations, limiting their applicability in expertise-scarce domains, such as specialized mathematical reasoning, formal logic, or legal analysis. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging cross-domain demonstrating examples to boost the LLMs' reasoning performance. Despite substantial domain differences, many reusable implicit logical structures are shared across domains. In order to effectively retrieve cross-domain examples for unseen domains under investigation, in this work, we further propose an effective retrieval method, called domain-invariant neurons-based retrieval (\textbf{DIN-Retrieval}). Concisely, DIN-Retrieval first summarizes a hidden representation that is universal across different domains. Then, during the inference stage, we use the DIN vector to retrieve structurally compatible cross-domain demonstrations for the in-context learning. Experimental results in multiple settings for the transfer of mathematical and logical reasoning demonstrate that our method achieves an average improvement of 1.8 over the state-of-the-art methods \footnote{Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Leon221220/DIN-Retrieval}.

AI.tldr: 提出DIN-Retrieval方法，利用跨领域示例提升LLMs的逻辑推理能力，通过领域不变神经元检索结构兼容的演示示例
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs在逻辑推理方面仍有不足，现有增强策略依赖专家制作的领域内演示，限制了在专家稀缺领域（如专业数学推理、形式逻辑、法律分析）的应用。跨领域示例中共享许多可重用的隐式逻辑结构，但如何有效检索这些示例是一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出DIN-Retrieval方法：1) 总结跨不同领域的通用隐藏表示（领域不变神经元）；2) 在推理阶段使用DIN向量检索结构兼容的跨领域演示示例，用于上下文学习。
AI.result: 在数学和逻辑推理的多种迁移设置中，该方法相比最先进方法平均提升了1.8个性能点。
AI.conclusion: 证明了利用跨领域演示示例提升LLMs推理性能的可行性，提出的DIN-Retrieval方法能有效检索结构兼容的跨领域示例，显著提升推理性能。

title: 3DTurboQuant: Training-Free Near-Optimal Quantization for 3D Reconstruction Models
summary: Every existing method for compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or transformer-based 3D reconstructors requires learning a data-dependent codebook through per-scene fine-tuning. We show this is unnecessary. The parameter vectors that dominate storage in these models, 45-dimensional spherical harmonics in 3DGS and 1024-dimensional key-value vectors in DUSt3R, fall in a dimension range where a single random rotation transforms any input into coordinates with a known Beta distribution. This makes precomputed, data-independent Lloyd-Max quantization near-optimal, within a factor of 2.7 of the information-theoretic lower bound. We develop 3D, deriving (1) a dimension-dependent criterion that predicts which parameters can be quantized and at what bit-width before running any experiment, (2) norm-separation bounds connecting quantization MSE to rendering PSNR per scene, (3) an entry-grouping strategy extending rotation-based quantization to 2-dimensional hash grid features, and (4) a composable pruning-quantization pipeline with a closed-form compression ratio. On NeRF Synthetic, 3DTurboQuant compresses 3DGS by 3.5x with 0.02dB PSNR loss and DUSt3R KV caches by 7.9x with 39.7dB pointmap fidelity. No training, no codebook learning, no calibration data. Compression takes seconds. The code will be released (https://github.com/JaeLee18/3DTurboQuant)

AI.tldr: 3DTurboQuant提出了一种无需训练、无需数据依赖码本的3D重建模型压缩方法，通过随机旋转和预计算量化实现高效压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅、NeRF或基于transformer的3D重建模型压缩方法都需要通过逐场景微调学习数据依赖的码本，这种方法效率低下且不必要。
AI.method: 利用随机旋转将参数向量转换为已知Beta分布，采用预计算的Lloyd-Max量化；提出维度相关准则预测可量化参数和比特宽度、连接量化MSE与渲染PSNR的范数分离边界、扩展到2D哈希网格特征的入口分组策略，以及具有闭式压缩比的可组合剪枝-量化流水线。
AI.result: 在NeRF Synthetic上，3DTurboQuant将3DGS压缩3.5倍（PSNR损失仅0.02dB），将DUSt3R KV缓存压缩7.9倍（点图保真度39.7dB）。无需训练、码本学习或校准数据，压缩仅需数秒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了数据无关的预计算量化在3D重建模型压缩中的有效性，显著降低了存储需求，同时保持了高质量的渲染结果。

title: Neural Assistive Impulses: Synthesizing Exaggerated Motions for Physics-based Characters
summary: Physics-based character animation has become a fundamental approach for synthesizing realistic, physically plausible motions. While current data-driven deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods can synthesize complex skills, they struggle to reproduce exaggerated, stylized motions, such as instantaneous dashes or mid-air trajectory changes, which are required in animation but violate standard physical laws. The primary limitation stems from modeling the character as an underactuated floating-base system, in which internal joint torques and momentum conservation strictly govern motion. Direct attempts to enforce such motions via external wrenches often lead to training instability, as velocity discontinuities produce sparse, high-magnitude force spikes that prevent policy convergence. We propose Assistive Impulse Neural Control, a framework that reformulates external assistance in impulse space rather than force space to ensure numerical stability. We decompose the assistive signal into an analytic high-frequency component derived from Inverse Dynamics and a learned low-frequency residual correction, governed by a hybrid neural policy. We demonstrate that our method enables robust tracking of highly agile, dynamically infeasible maneuvers that were previously intractable for physics-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Assistive Impulse Neural Control框架，通过将外部辅助从力空间重新表述为冲量空间，实现物理角色动画中夸张、风格化动作的稳定合成。
AI.motivation: 当前基于DRL的物理角色动画方法难以合成夸张、风格化的动作（如瞬时冲刺、空中轨迹改变），因为这些动作违反标准物理定律。主要限制在于将角色建模为欠驱动浮基系统，内部关节扭矩和动量守恒严格约束运动。直接通过外部力尝试强制执行此类动作会导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Assistive Impulse Neural Control框架：1）将外部辅助从力空间重新表述为冲量空间以确保数值稳定性；2）将辅助信号分解为基于逆动力学推导的解析高频分量和学习的低频残差校正；3）由混合神经策略控制。
AI.result: 该方法能够稳健地跟踪高度敏捷、动态不可行的机动动作，这些动作以前对于基于物理的方法是无法处理的。
AI.conclusion: 通过冲量空间重新表述外部辅助，解决了物理角色动画中合成夸张风格化动作的稳定性问题，实现了以前无法处理的动态不可行动作的稳健跟踪。

title: Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a smaller model to draft future tokens, which are then verified by the target LLM. This preserves generation quality by accepting only aligned tokens. However, individual drafters, often trained for specific tasks or domains, exhibit limited effectiveness across diverse applications. To address this, we introduce \textsc{MetaSD}, a unified framework that integrates multiple drafters into the SD process. MetaSD dynamically allocates computational resources to heterogeneous drafters by leveraging alignment feedback and framing drafter selection as a multi-armed bandit problem. Extensive experiments show MetaSD consistently outperforms single-drafter approaches.

AI.tldr: MetaSD提出了一种统一框架，将多个草稿模型集成到推测解码中，通过多臂老虎机问题动态分配计算资源，显著提升LLM推理效率
AI.motivation: 传统的推测解码使用单个草稿模型，但针对特定任务或领域训练的草稿模型在多样化应用中效果有限，需要更通用的解决方案
AI.method: 提出MetaSD统一框架，集成多个异构草稿模型，利用对齐反馈和多臂老虎机问题动态分配计算资源，优化草稿模型选择
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MetaSD在性能上持续优于单草稿模型方法，显著提升了大型语言模型的推理效率
AI.conclusion: MetaSD通过集成多个草稿模型并动态分配资源，有效解决了传统推测解码中草稿模型泛化能力不足的问题，为LLM推理加速提供了更通用的解决方案

title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning
summary: Despite its success, existing in-context learning (ICL) relies on in-domain expert demonstrations, limiting its applicability when expert annotations are scarce. We posit that different domains may share underlying reasoning structures, enabling source-domain demonstrations to improve target-domain inference despite semantic mismatch. To test this hypothesis, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study of different retrieval methods to validate the feasibility of achieving cross-domain knowledge transfer under the in-context learning setting. Our results demonstrate conditional positive transfer in cross-domain ICL. We identify a clear example absorption threshold: beyond it, positive transfer becomes more likely, and additional demonstrations yield larger gains. Further analysis suggests that these gains stem from reasoning structure repair by retrieved cross-domain examples, rather than semantic cues. Overall, our study validates the feasibility of leveraging cross-domain knowledge transfer to improve cross-domain ICL performance, motivating the community to explore designing more effective retrieval approaches for this novel direction.\footnote{Our implementation is available at https://github.com/littlelaska/ICL-TF4LR}

AI.tldr: 跨领域上下文学习(ICL)研究：验证了即使存在语义不匹配，源领域示例也能通过修复推理结构来提升目标领域推理性能，存在明确的示例吸收阈值
AI.motivation: 现有上下文学习依赖领域内专家标注，限制了在专家标注稀缺场景下的应用。研究者假设不同领域可能共享底层推理结构，使得源领域示例能够提升目标领域推理性能
AI.method: 通过全面的实证研究，测试不同检索方法在跨领域知识迁移中的可行性，分析跨领域示例对推理结构修复的作用
AI.result: 研究证实了跨领域上下文学习中存在条件性正向迁移，识别出明确的示例吸收阈值：超过该阈值后，正向迁移更可能发生，且额外示例带来更大增益。分析表明这些增益源于检索到的跨领域示例对推理结构的修复，而非语义线索
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了利用跨领域知识迁移提升跨领域上下文学习性能的可行性，激励社区探索设计更有效的检索方法来实现这一新颖方向

title: Learning What Matters: Dynamic Dimension Selection and Aggregation for Interpretable Vision-Language Reward Modeling
summary: Vision-language reward modeling faces a dilemma: generative approaches are interpretable but slow, while discriminative ones are efficient but act as opaque "black boxes." To bridge this gap, we propose VL-MDR (Vision-Language Multi-Dimensional Reward), a framework that dynamically decomposes evaluation into granular, interpretable dimensions. Instead of outputting a monolithic scalar, VL-MDR employs a visual-aware gating mechanism to identify relevant dimensions and adaptively weight them (e.g., Hallucination, Reasoning) for each specific input. To support this, we curate a dataset of 321k vision-language preference pairs annotated across 21 fine-grained dimensions. Extensive experiments show that VL-MDR consistently outperforms existing open-source reward models on benchmarks like VL-RewardBench. Furthermore, we show that VL-MDR-constructed preference pairs effectively enable DPO alignment to mitigate visual hallucinations and improve reliability, providing a scalable solution for VLM alignment.

AI.tldr: VL-MDR是一个视觉语言多维奖励框架，通过动态分解评估为可解释的细粒度维度，解决了生成式方法慢而判别式方法不透明的问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言奖励建模面临两难困境：生成式方法可解释但速度慢，判别式方法高效但像不透明的"黑盒"。需要弥合这一差距，提供既高效又可解释的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出VL-MDR框架，采用视觉感知门控机制动态识别相关维度并自适应加权（如幻觉、推理等）。构建了包含321k视觉语言偏好对的数据集，标注了21个细粒度维度。
AI.result: VL-MDR在VL-RewardBench等基准测试中持续优于现有开源奖励模型。使用VL-MDR构建的偏好对能有效实现DPO对齐，减少视觉幻觉并提高可靠性。
AI.conclusion: VL-MDR为VLM对齐提供了可扩展的解决方案，通过多维可解释的奖励建模，既保持了判别式方法的效率，又获得了生成式方法的可解释性。

title: LUMOS: Universal Semi-Supervised OCT Retinal Layer Segmentation with Hierarchical Reliable Mutual Learning
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE ISBI 2026. \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) layer segmentation faces challenges due to annotation scarcity and heterogeneous label granularities across datasets. While semi-supervised learning helps alleviate label scarcity, existing methods typically assume a fixed granularity, failing to fully exploit cross-granularity supervision. This paper presents LUMOS, a semi-supervised universal OCT retinal layer segmentation framework based on a Dual-Decoder Network with a Hierarchical Prompting Strategy (DDN-HPS) and Reliable Progressive Multi-granularity Learning (RPML). DDN-HPS combines a dual-branch architecture with a multi-granularity prompting strategy to effectively suppress pseudo-label noise propagation. Meanwhile, RPML introduces region-level reliability weighing and a progressive training approach that guides the model from easier to more difficult tasks, ensuring the reliable selection of cross-granularity consistency targets, thereby achieving stable cross-granularity alignment. Experiments on six OCT datasets demonstrate that LUMOS largely outperforms existing methods and exhibits exceptional cross-domain and cross-granularity generalization capability.

AI.tldr: LUMOS是一个半监督的通用OCT视网膜层分割框架，通过双解码器网络和分层提示策略以及可靠渐进多粒度学习，有效解决标注稀缺和标签粒度异构问题，在跨域和跨粒度泛化方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: OCT层分割面临标注稀缺和不同数据集标签粒度异构的挑战。现有半监督学习方法通常假设固定粒度，无法充分利用跨粒度监督信息。
AI.method: 提出LUMOS框架，包含：1）DDN-HPS（双解码器网络与分层提示策略），通过双分支架构和多粒度提示策略抑制伪标签噪声传播；2）RPML（可靠渐进多粒度学习），引入区域级可靠性加权和渐进训练方法，从易到难引导模型，确保可靠选择跨粒度一致性目标。
AI.result: 在六个OCT数据集上的实验表明，LUMOS大幅优于现有方法，展现出卓越的跨域和跨粒度泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LUMOS通过创新的双解码器架构和渐进多粒度学习策略，有效解决了OCT层分割中的标注稀缺和粒度异构问题，实现了稳定可靠的跨粒度对齐。

title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data
summary:
Machine data is central to observability and diagnosis in modern computing systems, appearing in logs, metrics, telemetry traces, and configuration snapshots. When provided to large language models (LLMs), this data typically arrives as a mixture of natural language and structured payloads such as JSON or Python/AST literals. Yet LLMs remain brittle on such inputs, particularly when they are long, deeply nested, and dominated by repetitive structure.
  We present HYVE (HYbrid ViEw), a framework for LLM context engineering for inputs containing large machine-data payloads, inspired by database management principles. HYVE surrounds model invocation with coordinated preprocessing and postprocessing, centered on a request-scoped datastore augmented with schema information. During preprocessing, HYVE detects repetitive structure in raw inputs, materializes it in the datastore, transforms it into hybrid columnar and row-oriented views, and selectively exposes only the most relevant representation to the LLM. During postprocessing, HYVE either returns the model output directly, queries the datastore to recover omitted information, or performs a bounded additional LLM call for SQL-augmented semantic synthesis.
  We evaluate HYVE on diverse real-world workloads spanning knowledge QA, chart generation, anomaly detection, and multi-step network troubleshooting. Across these benchmarks, HYVE reduces token usage by 50-90% while maintaining or improving output quality. On structured generation tasks, it improves chart-generation accuracy by up to 132% and reduces latency by up to 83%. Overall, HYVE offers a practical approximation to an effectively unbounded context window for prompts dominated by large machine-data payloads.

AI.tldr: HYVE框架通过检测和转换机器数据中的重复结构，将混合自然语言和结构化数据（如JSON）优化为列式和行式视图，显著减少LLM的token使用并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现代计算系统中的机器数据（日志、指标、遥测跟踪、配置快照）通常包含自然语言和结构化负载的混合，当提供给大型语言模型时，这些输入通常很长、深度嵌套且具有重复结构，导致LLM处理脆弱且效率低下。
AI.method: HYVE框架采用数据库管理原则，围绕模型调用进行协调的预处理和后处理。预处理阶段检测原始输入中的重复结构，将其物化到数据存储中，转换为混合的列式和行式视图，并选择性地向LLM暴露最相关的表示。后处理阶段直接返回模型输出，查询数据存储以恢复省略的信息，或执行有限的额外LLM调用进行SQL增强的语义合成。
AI.result: 在知识问答、图表生成、异常检测和多步骤网络故障排除等真实工作负载中，HYVE将token使用量减少了50-90%，同时保持或提高了输出质量。在结构化生成任务中，图表生成准确率提高了132%，延迟降低了83%。
AI.conclusion: HYVE为以大型机器数据负载为主的提示提供了实际有效的近似无限上下文窗口解决方案，显著提升了LLM处理混合自然语言和结构化数据的效率和效果。

title: Content Fuzzing for Escaping Information Cocoons on Digital Social Media
summary: Information cocoons on social media limit users' exposure to posts with diverse viewpoints. Modern platforms use stance detection as an important signal in recommendation and ranking pipelines, which can route posts primarily to like-minded audiences and reduce cross-cutting exposure. This restricts the reach of dissenting opinions and hinders constructive discourse. We take the creator's perspective and investigate how content can be revised to reach beyond existing affinity clusters. We present ContentFuzz, a confidence-guided fuzzing framework that rewrites posts while preserving their human-interpreted intent and induces different machine-inferred stance labels. ContentFuzz aims to route posts beyond their original cocoons. Our method guides a large language model (LLM) to generate meaning-preserving rewrites using confidence feedback from stance detection models. Evaluated on four representative stance detection models across three datasets in two languages, ContentFuzz effectively changes machine-classified stance labels, while maintaining semantic integrity with respect to the original content.

AI.tldr: ContentFuzz是一个基于置信度引导的模糊测试框架，通过重写社交媒体帖子来改变机器推断的立场标签，帮助内容突破信息茧房限制
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的信息茧房限制了用户接触不同观点的内容，平台使用的立场检测算法会将内容主要推送给观点相似的受众，减少了跨立场接触，限制了不同意见的传播并阻碍建设性对话
AI.method: ContentFuzz是一个置信度引导的模糊测试框架，通过指导大型语言模型生成保持原意的重写内容，利用立场检测模型的置信度反馈来改变机器推断的立场标签
AI.result: 在三个数据集、两种语言上的四个代表性立场检测模型评估中，ContentFuzz能有效改变机器分类的立场标签，同时保持与原始内容的语义完整性
AI.conclusion: ContentFuzz能够帮助内容创作者突破原有的亲和力集群限制，让内容能够触及更广泛的受众，从而缓解信息茧房问题

title: Beyond Semantic Search: Towards Referential Anchoring in Composed Image Retrieval
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page, dataset, and code are available at: https://hahajun1101.github.io/OACIR/
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) has demonstrated significant potential by enabling flexible multimodal queries that combine a reference image and modification text. However, CIR inherently prioritizes semantic matching, struggling to reliably retrieve a user-specified instance across contexts. In practice, emphasizing concrete instance fidelity over broad semantics is often more consequential. In this work, we propose Object-Anchored Composed Image Retrieval (OACIR), a novel fine-grained retrieval task that mandates strict instance-level consistency. To advance research on this task, we construct OACIRR (OACIR on Real-world images), the first large-scale, multi-domain benchmark comprising over 160K quadruples and four challenging candidate galleries enriched with hard-negative instance distractors. Each quadruple augments the compositional query with a bounding box that visually anchors the object in the reference image, providing a precise and flexible way to ensure instance preservation. To address the OACIR task, we propose AdaFocal, a framework featuring a Context-Aware Attention Modulator that adaptively intensifies attention within the specified instance region, dynamically balancing focus between the anchored instance and the broader compositional context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaFocal substantially outperforms existing compositional retrieval models, particularly in maintaining instance-level fidelity, thereby establishing a robust baseline for this challenging task while opening new directions for more flexible, instance-aware retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了对象锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）任务，强调实例级一致性而非语义匹配，并构建了首个大规模基准数据集OACIRR，同时提出了AdaFocal框架来提升实例保真度。
AI.motivation: 传统组合图像检索（CIR）过于强调语义匹配，难以在不同上下文中可靠地检索用户指定的具体实例。在实际应用中，保持具体实例的保真度比宽泛的语义匹配更为重要。
AI.method: 提出了对象锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）任务，要求严格的实例级一致性。构建了OACIRR基准数据集，包含超过16万个四元组和四个具有挑战性的候选库。提出了AdaFocal框架，采用上下文感知注意力调制器，自适应地增强指定实例区域的注意力，动态平衡锚定实例和更广泛组合上下文之间的关注。
AI.result: AdaFocal框架显著优于现有的组合检索模型，特别是在保持实例级保真度方面表现突出，为这一具有挑战性的任务建立了强大的基线。
AI.conclusion: OACIR任务强调了实例级一致性的重要性，AdaFocal框架为解决该任务提供了有效方案，为更灵活、实例感知的检索系统开辟了新方向。

title: CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces
summary: LLM-based code agents treat repositories as unstructured text, applying edits through brittle string matching that frequently fails due to formatting drift or ambiguous patterns. We propose reframing the codebase as a structured action space where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Our framework, CODESTRUCT, provides readCode for retrieving complete syntactic units and editCode for applying syntax-validated transformations to semantic program elements. Evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified across six LLMs, CODESTRUCT improves Pass@1 accuracy by 1.2-5.0% while reducing token consumption by 12-38% for most models.
