Models that frequently fail to produce valid patches under text-based interfaces benefit most: GPT-5-nano improves by 20.8% as empty-patch failures drop from 46.6% to 7.2%. On CodeAssistBench, we observe consistent accuracy gains (+0.8-4.4%) with cost reductions up to 33%. Our results show that structure-aware interfaces offer a more reliable foundation for code agents.

AI.tldr: CODESTRUCT框架将代码库重构为结构化动作空间，让LLM代码代理操作AST实体而非文本，显著提升代码修复准确率并降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码代理将代码库视为非结构化文本，通过脆弱的字符串匹配进行编辑，常因格式漂移或模糊模式而失败，需要更可靠的结构化方法。
AI.method: 提出CODESTRUCT框架，将代码库重构为结构化动作空间，提供readCode检索完整语法单元和editCode应用语法验证的转换，操作命名AST实体而非文本跨度。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上评估六个LLM，CODESTRUCT将Pass@1准确率提升1.2-5.0%，token消耗降低12-38%；GPT-5-nano提升20.8%，空补丁失败率从46.6%降至7.2%。在CodeAssistBench上准确率提升0.8-4.4%，成本降低达33%。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知接口为代码代理提供了更可靠的基础，通过操作语义程序元素而非文本跨度，显著提高了代码编辑的准确性和效率。

title: Don't Act Blindly: Robust GUI Automation via Action-Effect Verification and Self-Correction
summary: Autonomous GUI agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) often assume deterministic environment responses, generating actions without verifying whether previous operations succeeded. In real-world settings with network latency, rendering delays, and system interruptions, this assumption leads to undetected action failures, repetitive ineffective behaviors, and catastrophic error accumulation. Moreover, learning robust recovery strategies is challenging due to the high cost of online interaction and the lack of real-time feedback in offline datasets.We propose VeriGUI (Verification-driven GUI Agent), which explicitly models action outcomes and recovery under noisy environments. VeriGUI introduces a Thinking--Verification--Action--Expectation (TVAE) framework to detect failures and guide corrective reasoning, and a two-stage training pipeline that combines Robust SFT with synthetic failure trajectories and GRPO with asymmetric verification rewards. We further construct a Robustness Benchmark based on AndroidControl to evaluate failure recognition and correction. Experiments show that VeriGUI significantly reduces failure loops and improves recovery success while maintaining competitive standard task performance.

AI.tldr: VeriGUI是一个基于视觉语言模型的GUI代理，通过显式建模动作结果和恢复机制来应对现实环境中的不确定性，显著减少了故障循环并提高了恢复成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的自主GUI代理通常假设环境响应是确定性的，但在真实环境中存在网络延迟、渲染延迟和系统中断等问题，这导致未检测到的动作失败、重复无效行为和灾难性错误累积。此外，学习鲁棒的恢复策略具有挑战性，因为在线交互成本高且离线数据集缺乏实时反馈。
AI.method: VeriGUI提出了TVAE（思考-验证-动作-期望）框架来检测故障并指导纠正推理，以及一个两阶段训练流程：结合合成故障轨迹的鲁棒SFT和具有非对称验证奖励的GRPO。还构建了基于AndroidControl的鲁棒性基准来评估故障识别和纠正能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，VeriGUI显著减少了故障循环并提高了恢复成功率，同时保持了竞争力的标准任务性能。
AI.conclusion: VeriGUI通过显式建模动作结果和恢复机制，有效解决了自主GUI代理在嘈杂环境中的鲁棒性问题，为实际应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: LSGS-Loc: Towards Robust 3DGS-Based Visual Localization for Large-Scale UAV Scenarios
comment: This paper is under reviewed by RA-L. The copyright might be transferred upon acceptance
summary: Visual localization in large-scale UAV scenarios is a critical capability for autonomous systems, yet it remains challenging due to geometric complexity and environmental variations. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising scene representation, existing 3DGS-based visual localization methods struggle with robust pose initialization and sensitivity to rendering artifacts in large-scale settings. To address these limitations, we propose LSGS-Loc, a novel visual localization pipeline tailored for large-scale 3DGS scenes. Specifically, we introduce a scale-aware pose initialization strategy that combines scene-agnostic relative pose estimation with explicit 3DGS scale constraints, enabling geometrically grounded localization without scene-specific training. Furthermore, in the pose refinement, to mitigate the impact of reconstruction artifacts such as blur and floaters, we develop a Laplacian-based reliability masking mechanism that guides photometric refinement toward high-quality regions. Extensive experiments on large-scale UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness for unordered image queries, significantly outperforming existing 3DGS-based approaches. Code is available at: https://github.com/xzhang-z/LSGS-Loc

AI.tldr: LSGS-Loc：针对大规模无人机场景的视觉定位新方法，通过尺度感知姿态初始化和拉普拉斯可靠性掩码机制，解决3D高斯泼溅场景中姿态初始化困难和渲染伪影敏感性问题。
AI.motivation: 大规模无人机场景中的视觉定位对自主系统至关重要，但现有基于3D高斯泼溅的方法存在姿态初始化困难和渲染伪影敏感性问题，特别是在大规模场景中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出LSGS-Loc视觉定位流水线：1）尺度感知姿态初始化策略，结合场景无关的相对姿态估计和显式的3DGS尺度约束；2）拉普拉斯可靠性掩码机制，引导光度细化朝向高质量区域，减少重建伪影影响。
AI.result: 在大规模无人机基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在无序图像查询中实现了最先进的准确性和鲁棒性，显著优于现有的基于3DGS的方法。
AI.conclusion: LSGS-Loc通过创新的尺度感知姿态初始化和可靠性掩码机制，有效解决了大规模3DGS场景中的视觉定位挑战，为无人机自主系统提供了更可靠的定位能力。

title: Multi-Agent Pathfinding with Non-Unit Integer Edge Costs via Enhanced Conflict-Based Search and Graph Discretization
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, submitted to cs.AI, Multi-Agent Systems, Pathfinding Optimization
summary: Multi-Agent Pathfinding (MAPF) plays a critical role in various domains. Traditional MAPF methods typically assume unit edge costs and single-timestep actions, which limit their applicability to real-world scenarios. MAPFR extends MAPF to handle non-unit costs with real-valued edge costs and continuous-time actions, but its geometric collision model leads to an unbounded state space that compromises solver efficiency. In this paper, we propose MAPFZ, a novel MAPF variant on graphs with non-unit integer costs that preserves a finite state space while offering improved realism over classical MAPF. To solve MAPFZ efficiently, we develop CBS-NIC, an enhanced Conflict-Based Search framework incorporating time-interval-based conflict detection and an improved Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) algorithm. Additionally, we propose Bayesian Optimization for Graph Design (BOGD), a discretization method for non-unit edge costs that balances efficiency and accuracy with a sub-linear regret bound. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in runtime and success rate across diverse benchmark scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPFZ，一种具有非单位整数成本的多智能体路径规划新变体，解决了传统MAPF的局限性，同时保持了有限状态空间。开发了CBS-NIC框架和BOGD图设计方法，在效率和成功率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统MAPF方法假设单位边成本和单时间步动作，限制了在实际场景中的应用。MAPFR扩展到处理非单位成本，但其几何碰撞模型导致无限状态空间，影响求解器效率。
AI.method: 提出MAPFZ变体，在具有非单位整数成本的图上保持有限状态空间。开发CBS-NIC框架，包含基于时间间隔的冲突检测和改进的SIPP算法。提出BOGD离散化方法，平衡效率和准确性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在运行时间和成功率上优于现有最先进方法，在多样化基准场景中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: MAPFZ在保持有限状态空间的同时提高了现实性，CBS-NIC和BOGD方法有效解决了非单位成本MAPF问题，为实际应用提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: Cross-Modal Coreference Alignment: Enabling Reliable Information Transfer in Omni-LLMs
summary: Omni Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in holistic multi-modal perception, yet they consistently falter in complex scenarios requiring synergistic omni-modal reasoning. Beyond understanding global multimodal context, effective reasoning also hinges on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, especially identifying shared referents across modalities, yet this aspect has been largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we formalize the challenge as a cross-modal coreference problem, where a model must localize a referent in a source modality and re-identify it in a target modality. Building on this paradigm, we introduce CrossOmni, a dataset comprising nine tasks equipped with human-designed reasoning rationales to evaluate and enhance this capability. Experiments on 13 Omni-LLMs reveal systematic weaknesses in cross-modal coreference, which we attribute to the absence of coreference-aware thinking patterns. To address this, we enhance cross-modal alignment via two strategies: a training-free In-Context Learning method and a training-based SFT+GRPO framework designed to induce such thinking patterns. Both approaches yield substantial performance gains and generalize effectively to collaborative reasoning tasks. Overall, our findings highlight cross-modal coreference as a crucial missing piece for advancing robust omni-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨模态指代问题作为全模态推理的关键挑战，创建了CrossOmni数据集评估13个全模态大模型，发现系统性弱点，并提出两种训练方法提升性能。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型在全模态感知方面表现出色，但在需要协同全模态推理的复杂场景中表现不佳。现有研究忽视了细粒度跨模态对齐，特别是跨模态共享指称的识别，这是有效推理的关键。
AI.method: 1. 将挑战形式化为跨模态指代问题：模型必须在源模态中定位指称并在目标模态中重新识别它；2. 创建CrossOmni数据集，包含9个任务和人工设计的推理原理；3. 提出两种方法：基于上下文学习的免训练方法和基于SFT+GRPO的训练框架，以诱导指代感知的思维模式。
AI.result: 对13个全模态大模型的实验揭示了跨模态指代的系统性弱点，归因于缺乏指代感知的思维模式。提出的两种方法都带来了显著的性能提升，并能有效泛化到协作推理任务中。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态指代是推进稳健全模态推理的关键缺失环节，提出的方法和数据集为评估和增强这一能力提供了重要工具。

title: PRISM-MCTS: Learning from Reasoning Trajectories with Metacognitive Reflection
summary: PRISM-MCTS: Learning from Reasoning Trajectories with Metacognitive Reflection Siyuan Cheng, Bozhong Tian, Yanchao Hao, Zheng Wei Published: 06 Apr 2026, Last Modified: 06 Apr 2026 ACL 2026 Findings Conference, Area Chairs, Reviewers, Publication Chairs, Authors Revisions BibTeX CC BY 4.0 Keywords: Efficient/Low-Resource Methods for NLP, Generation, Question Answering Abstract: The emergence of reasoning models, exemplified by OpenAI o1, signifies a transition from intuitive to deliberative cognition, effectively reorienting the scaling laws from pre-training paradigms toward test-time computation. While Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has shown promise in this domain, existing approaches typically treat each rollout as an isolated trajectory. This lack of information sharing leads to severe inefficiency and substantial computational redundancy, as the search process fails to leverage insights from prior explorations. To address these limitations, we propose PRISM-MCTS, a novel reasoning framework that draws inspiration from human parallel thinking and reflective processes. PRISM-MCTS integrates a Process Reward Model (PRM) with a dynamic shared memory, capturing both "Heuristics" and "Fallacies". By reinforcing successful strategies and pruning error-prone branches, PRISM-MCTS effectively achieves refinement. Furthermore, we develop a data-efficient training strategy for the PRM, achieving high-fidelity evaluation under a few-shot regime. Empirical evaluations across diverse reasoning benchmarks substantiate the efficacy of PRISM-MCTS. Notably, it halves the trajectory requirements on GPQA while surpassing MCTS-RAG and Search-o1, demonstrating that it scales inference by reasoning judiciously rather than exhaustively.

AI.tldr: PRISM-MCTS是一个新颖的推理框架，通过集成过程奖励模型和动态共享内存来改进蒙特卡洛树搜索，显著减少计算冗余并提高推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型如MCTS将每次rollout视为独立轨迹，缺乏信息共享，导致严重的低效率和计算冗余。需要一种能够从先前探索中学习并利用洞察的方法。
AI.method: 提出PRISM-MCTS框架，集成过程奖励模型（PRM）与动态共享内存，捕获"启发式"和"谬误"。通过强化成功策略和修剪易错分支实现精炼，并开发了PRM的数据高效训练策略。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试中验证了PRISM-MCTS的有效性。在GPQA上将轨迹需求减半，同时超越了MCTS-RAG和Search-o1，表明其通过明智而非穷尽的推理来扩展推理能力。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-MCTS通过元认知反思从推理轨迹中学习，实现了从直觉到审慎认知的转变，显著提高了推理效率，为推理模型的发展提供了新方向。

title: Turbulence-like 5/3 spectral scaling in contextual representations of language as a complex system
summary: Natural language is a complex system that exhibits robust statistical regularities. Here, we represent text as a trajectory in a high-dimensional embedding space generated by transformer-based language models, and quantify scale-dependent fluctuations along the token sequence using an embedding-step signal. Across multiple languages and corpora, the resulting power spectrum exhibits a robust power law with an exponent close to $5/3$ over an extended frequency range. This scaling is observed consistently in contextual embeddings from both human-written and AI-generated text, but is absent in static word embeddings and is disrupted by randomization of token order. These results show that the observed scaling reflects multiscale, context-dependent organization rather than lexical statistics alone. By analogy with the Kolmogorov spectrum in turbulence, our findings suggest that semantic information is integrated in a scale-free, self-similar manner across linguistic scales, and provide a quantitative, model-agnostic benchmark for studying complex structure in language representations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言在嵌入空间中表现出幂律谱特征，指数接近5/3，类似于湍流中的Kolmogorov谱，表明语义信息在多个尺度上以尺度不变的方式整合
AI.motivation: 自然语言是一个复杂的系统，具有稳健的统计规律性。研究者希望量化语言在嵌入空间中的多尺度波动特征，探索语义信息的组织方式
AI.method: 将文本表示为基于transformer的语言模型生成的高维嵌入空间中的轨迹，使用嵌入步长信号量化沿标记序列的尺度相关波动，分析功率谱特征
AI.result: 在多种语言和语料库中，功率谱在扩展频率范围内表现出稳健的幂律，指数接近5/3。这种缩放特征在人类书写和AI生成文本的上下文嵌入中一致存在，但在静态词嵌入中缺失，且被标记顺序随机化破坏
AI.conclusion: 观察到的缩放反映了多尺度、上下文相关的组织，而不仅仅是词汇统计。类似于湍流中的Kolmogorov谱，语义信息在语言尺度上以尺度不变、自相似的方式整合，为研究语言表示中的复杂结构提供了定量、模型无关的基准

title: Learning to Edit Knowledge via Instruction-based Chain-of-Thought Prompting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can effectively handle outdated information through knowledge editing. However, current approaches face two key limitations: (I) Poor generalization: Most approaches rigidly inject new knowledge without ensuring that the model can use it effectively to solve practical problems. (II) Narrow scope: Current methods focus primarily on structured fact triples, overlooking the diverse unstructured forms of factual information (e.g., news, articles) prevalent in real-world contexts. To address these challenges, we propose a new paradigm: teaching LLMs to edit knowledge via Chain of Thoughts (CoTs) reasoning (CoT2Edit). We first leverage language model agents for both structured and unstructured edited data to generate CoTs, building high-quality instruction data. The model is then trained to reason over edited knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). At inference time, we integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to dynamically retrieve relevant edited facts for real-time knowledge editing. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves strong generalization across six diverse knowledge editing scenarios with just a single round of training on three open-source language models. The codes are available at https://github.com/FredJDean/CoT2Edit.

AI.tldr: CoT2Edit：通过思维链推理教授大语言模型进行知识编辑的新范式，解决现有方法泛化性差和范围狭窄的问题
AI.motivation: 当前知识编辑方法存在两大局限：1）泛化性差：大多数方法只是生硬地注入新知识，不能确保模型能有效利用这些知识解决实际问题；2）范围狭窄：现有方法主要关注结构化事实三元组，忽视了现实世界中普遍存在的非结构化事实信息形式（如新闻、文章）
AI.method: 提出CoT2Edit新范式：1）利用语言模型代理为结构化和非结构化编辑数据生成思维链，构建高质量指令数据；2）通过监督微调和组相对策略优化训练模型在编辑知识上进行推理；3）推理时集成检索增强生成来动态检索相关编辑事实进行实时知识编辑
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在六个不同的知识编辑场景中表现出强大的泛化能力，仅需在三个开源语言模型上进行单轮训练
AI.conclusion: CoT2Edit通过思维链推理教授LLMs进行知识编辑，有效解决了现有方法的泛化性和范围限制问题，为知识编辑提供了更实用的解决方案

title: Learning to Synergize Semantic and Geometric Priors for Limited-Data Wheat Disease Segmentation
summary: Wheat disease segmentation is fundamental to precision agriculture but faces severe challenges from significant intra-class temporal variations across growth stages. Such substantial appearance shifts make collecting a representative dataset for training from scratch both labor-intensive and impractical. To address this, we propose SGPer, a Semantic-Geometric Prior Synergization framework that treats wheat disease segmentation under limited data as a coupled task of disease-specific semantic perception and disease boundary localization. Our core insight is that pretrained DINOv2 provides robust category-aware semantic priors to handle appearance shifts, which can be converted into coarse spatial prompts to guide SAM for the precise localization of disease boundaries. Specifically, SGPer designs disease-sensitive adapters with multiple disease-friendly filters and inserts them into both DINOv2 and SAM to align their pretrained representations with disease-specific characteristics. To operationalize this synergy, SGPer transforms DINOv2-derived features into dense, category-specific point prompts to ensure comprehensive spatial coverage of all disease regions. To subsequently eliminate prompt redundancy and ensure highly accurate mask generation, it dynamically filters these dense candidates by cross-referencing SAM's iterative mask confidence with the category-specific semantic consistency derived from DINOv2. Ultimately, SGPer distills a highly informative set of prompts to activate SAM's geometric priors, achieving precise and robust segmentation that remains strictly invariant to temporal appearance changes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SGPer consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on wheat disease and organ segmentation benchmarks, especially in data-constrained scenarios.

AI.tldr: SGPer是一个语义-几何先验协同框架，用于小麦病害分割，通过结合DINOv2的语义先验和SAM的几何先验，在有限数据下实现跨生长阶段的鲁棒分割。
AI.motivation: 小麦病害分割面临严重挑战，因为病害在不同生长阶段存在显著的类内时间变化，导致外观差异巨大。收集代表性训练数据集既劳动密集又不切实际，需要开发在有限数据下仍能处理外观变化的鲁棒分割方法。
AI.method: SGPer将小麦病害分割视为疾病特定语义感知和疾病边界定位的耦合任务。核心是利用预训练的DINOv2提供类别感知语义先验处理外观变化，将其转换为粗略空间提示来指导SAM精确定位疾病边界。设计了疾病敏感适配器，包含多个疾病友好过滤器，插入DINOv2和SAM中以对齐预训练表示与疾病特定特征。将DINOv2特征转换为密集的类别特定点提示，确保所有疾病区域的全面空间覆盖。通过交叉参考SAM的迭代掩码置信度和DINOv2的类别特定语义一致性，动态过滤密集候选提示，消除冗余并确保高精度掩码生成。
AI.result: 广泛评估表明，SGPer在小麦病害和器官分割基准测试中始终实现最先进的性能，特别是在数据受限场景下。该方法能够实现精确且鲁棒的分割，严格保持对时间外观变化的不变性。
AI.conclusion: SGPer通过语义-几何先验协同，成功解决了小麦病害分割中的跨生长阶段外观变化挑战，在有限数据下实现了鲁棒且精确的分割性能，为精准农业中的病害监测提供了有效解决方案。

title: Adaptive Serverless Resource Management via Slot-Survival Prediction and Event-Driven Lifecycle Control
summary: Serverless computing eliminates infrastructure management overhead but introduces significant challenges regarding cold start latency and resource utilization. Traditional static resource allocation often leads to inefficiencies under variable workloads, resulting in performance degradation or excessive costs. This paper presents an adaptive engineering framework that optimizes serverless performance through event-driven architecture and probabilistic modeling. We propose a dual-strategy mechanism that dynamically adjusts idle durations and employs an intelligent request waiting strategy based on slot survival predictions. By leveraging sliding window aggregation and asynchronous processing, our system proactively manages resource lifecycles. Experimental results show that our approach reduces cold starts by up to 51.2% and improves cost-efficiency by nearly 2x compared to baseline methods in multi-cloud environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应工程框架，通过事件驱动架构和概率建模优化无服务器计算性能，减少冷启动延迟并提高资源利用率。
AI.motivation: 无服务器计算消除了基础设施管理开销，但在可变工作负载下，传统的静态资源分配往往导致效率低下，造成性能下降或成本过高的问题。
AI.method: 提出双策略机制：动态调整空闲时长，基于槽位生存预测的智能请求等待策略；利用滑动窗口聚合和异步处理主动管理资源生命周期。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法在多云环境中相比基线方法减少冷启动达51.2%，成本效率提升近2倍。
AI.conclusion: 自适应工程框架通过事件驱动架构和概率建模有效解决了无服务器计算的冷启动和资源利用率问题，显著提升了性能和成本效率。

title: Efficient Inference for Large Vision-Language Models: Bottlenecks, Techniques, and Prospects
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) enable sophisticated reasoning over images and videos, yet their inference is hindered by a systemic efficiency barrier known as visual token dominance. This overhead is driven by a multi-regime interplay between high-resolution feature extraction, quadratic attention scaling, and memory bandwidth constraints. We present a systematic taxonomy of efficiency techniques structured around the inference lifecycle, consisting of encoding, prefilling, and decoding. Unlike prior reviews focused on isolated optimizations, we analyze the end-to-end pipeline to reveal how upstream decisions dictate downstream bottlenecks, covering compute-bound visual encoding, the intensive prefilling of massive contexts, and the ''visual memory wall'' in bandwidth-bound decoding. By decoupling the efficiency landscape into the axes of shaping information density, managing long-context attention, and overcoming memory limits, this work provides a structured analysis of how isolated optimizations compose to navigate the trade-off between visual fidelity and system efficiency. The survey concludes by outlining four future frontiers supported by pilot empirical insights, including hybrid compression based on functional unit sensitivity, modality-aware decoding with relaxed verification, progressive state management for streaming continuity, and stage-disaggregated serving through hardware-algorithm co-design. The submitted software contains a snapshot of our literature repository, which is designed to be maintained as a living resource for the community.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了大型视觉语言模型的效率瓶颈，提出了基于推理生命周期的分类法，并探讨了视觉保真度与系统效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在推理过程中面临"视觉令牌主导"的系统性效率障碍，这源于高分辨率特征提取、二次注意力缩放和内存带宽限制之间的多机制相互作用，需要系统性的效率优化方法。
AI.method: 提出了基于推理生命周期（编码、预填充、解码）的系统分类法，从信息密度塑造、长上下文注意力管理和内存限制克服三个维度分析效率技术，不同于以往孤立优化的方法。
AI.result: 揭示了上游决策如何决定下游瓶颈：计算受限的视觉编码、大规模上下文密集预填充，以及带宽受限解码中的"视觉内存墙"，为效率优化提供了结构化分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 提出了四个未来研究方向：基于功能单元敏感性的混合压缩、具有宽松验证的模态感知解码、流式连续性的渐进状态管理，以及硬件算法协同设计的阶段解耦服务，并提供了可维护的文献资源库。

title: VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG
summary: Scaling multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to long videos is constrained by limited context windows. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a promising remedy by organizing query-relevant visual evidence into a compact context, most existing methods (i) flatten videos into independent segments, breaking their inherent spatio-temporal structure, and (ii) depend on explicit semantic matching, which can miss cues that are implicitly relevant to the query's intent. To overcome these limitations, we propose VideoStir, a structured and intent-aware long-video RAG framework. It firstly structures a video as a spatio-temporal graph at clip level, and then performs multi-hop retrieval to aggregate evidence across distant yet contextually related events. Furthermore, it introduces an MLLM-backed intent-relevance scorer that retrieves frames based on their alignment with the query's reasoning intent. To support this capability, we curate IR-600K, a large-scale dataset tailored for learning frame-query intent alignment. Experiments show that VideoStir is competitive with state-of-the-art baselines without relying on auxiliary information, highlighting the promise of shifting long-video RAG from flattened semantic matching to structured, intent-aware reasoning. Codes and checkpoints are available at Github.

AI.tldr: VideoStir是一个结构化、意图感知的长视频检索增强生成框架，通过时空图结构和多跳检索解决现有方法破坏视频结构、依赖显式语义匹配的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频多模态大语言模型受限于有限的上下文窗口，而检索增强生成方法通常将视频扁平化为独立片段，破坏了固有的时空结构，且依赖显式语义匹配，可能错过与查询意图隐式相关的线索。
AI.method: VideoStir首先将视频构建为片段级的时空图，然后进行多跳检索以聚合跨距离但上下文相关的事件证据。同时引入基于MLLM的意图相关性评分器，根据帧与查询推理意图的对齐程度进行检索。为此构建了IR-600K大规模数据集来学习帧-查询意图对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，VideoStir在不依赖辅助信息的情况下与最先进的基线方法具有竞争力，突显了将长视频RAG从扁平化语义匹配转向结构化、意图感知推理的前景。
AI.conclusion: VideoStir通过结构化时空图和意图感知检索，成功解决了长视频RAG中的结构破坏和显式语义匹配限制问题，为长视频理解提供了更有效的框架。

title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
summary: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) extrapolation is an important task that aims to predict future facts through historical interaction information within KG snapshots. A key challenge for most existing TKG extrapolation models is handling entities with sparse historical interaction. The ontological knowledge is beneficial for alleviating this sparsity issue by enabling these entities to inherit behavioral patterns from other entities with the same concept, which is ignored by previous studies. In this paper, we propose a novel encoder-decoder framework OntoTKGE that leverages the ontological knowledge from the ontology-view KG (i.e., a KG modeling hierarchical relations among abstract concepts as well as the connections between concepts and entities) to guide the TKG extrapolation model's learning process through the effective integration of the ontological and temporal knowledge, thereby enhancing entity embeddings. OntoTKGE is flexible enough to adapt to many TKG extrapolation models. Extensive experiments on four data sets demonstrate that OntoTKGE not only significantly improves the performance of many TKG extrapolation models but also surpasses many SOTA baseline methods.

AI.tldr: OntoTKGE：利用本体知识增强时序知识图谱外推的框架，通过整合本体知识和时序知识来改善稀疏历史交互实体的预测性能
AI.motivation: 现有时序知识图谱外推模型在处理历史交互稀疏的实体时面临挑战，而本体知识（概念层次关系和实体-概念连接）可以帮助这些实体从具有相同概念的其他实体继承行为模式，但先前研究忽略了这一点
AI.method: 提出OntoTKGE编码器-解码器框架，利用本体视图知识图谱（建模抽象概念间的层次关系以及概念与实体间的连接）来指导时序知识图谱外推模型的学习过程，有效整合本体知识和时序知识以增强实体嵌入
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，OntoTKGE不仅显著提升了多个时序知识图谱外推模型的性能，而且超越了多个最先进的基线方法
AI.conclusion: OntoTKGE框架通过有效整合本体知识和时序知识，能够适应多种时序知识图谱外推模型，显著改善稀疏历史交互实体的预测性能，证明了本体知识在时序知识图谱外推任务中的价值

title: Stop Fixating on Prompts: Reasoning Hijacking and Constraint Tightening for Red-Teaming LLM Agents
summary: With the widespread application of LLM-based agents across various domains, their complexity has introduced new security threats. Existing red-team methods mostly rely on modifying user prompts, which lack adaptability to new data and may impact the agent's performance. To address the challenge, this paper proposes the JailAgent framework, which completely avoids modifying the user prompt. Specifically, it implicitly manipulates the agent's reasoning trajectory and memory retrieval with three key stages: Trigger Extraction, Reasoning Hijacking, and Constraint Tightening. Through precise trigger identification, real-time adaptive mechanisms, and an optimized objective function, JailAgent demonstrates outstanding performance in cross-model and cross-scenario environments.

AI.tldr: JailAgent框架通过隐式操纵智能体推理轨迹和记忆检索来攻击LLM智能体，避免修改用户提示，在跨模型和跨场景环境中表现优异
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在各领域的广泛应用，其复杂性带来了新的安全威胁。现有红队方法主要依赖修改用户提示，缺乏对新数据的适应性，且可能影响智能体性能
AI.method: 提出JailAgent框架，完全避免修改用户提示，通过三个关键阶段隐式操纵智能体推理轨迹和记忆检索：触发提取、推理劫持和约束收紧。采用精确触发识别、实时自适应机制和优化目标函数
AI.result: JailAgent在跨模型和跨场景环境中表现出色
AI.conclusion: JailAgent框架为LLM智能体安全评估提供了新的有效方法，通过隐式操纵而非直接修改提示的方式实现了更好的适应性和性能

title: Can We Trust a Black-box LLM? LLM Untrustworthy Boundary Detection via Bias-Diffusion and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown a high capability in answering questions on a diverse range of topics. However, these models sometimes produce biased, ideologized or incorrect responses, limiting their applications if there is no clear understanding of which topics their answers can be trusted. In this research, we introduce a novel algorithm, named as GMRL-BD, designed to identify the untrustworthy boundaries (in terms of topics) of a given LLM, with black-box access to the LLM and under specific query constraints. Based on a general Knowledge Graph (KG) derived from Wikipedia, our algorithm incorporates with multiple reinforcement learning agents to efficiently identify topics (some nodes in KG) where the LLM is likely to generate biased answers. Our experiments demonstrated the efficiency of our algorithm, which can detect the untrustworthy boundary with just limited queries to the LLM. Additionally, we have released a new dataset containing popular LLMs including Llama2, Vicuna, Falcon, Qwen2, Gemma2 and Yi-1.5, along with labels indicating the topics on which each LLM is likely to be biased.

AI.tldr: GMRL-BD算法通过知识图谱和强化学习智能体，在有限查询次数下识别大语言模型的不信任边界（易产生偏见回答的主题）
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能回答广泛主题的问题，但有时会产生偏见、意识形态化或不正确的回答。由于不清楚模型在哪些主题上的回答可信，这限制了其应用。需要一种方法来识别LLM的不信任边界。
AI.method: 提出GMRL-BD算法：基于维基百科构建通用知识图谱，使用多个强化学习智能体高效识别LLM可能产生偏见回答的主题（KG中的节点）。算法仅需黑盒访问LLM并在特定查询约束下工作。
AI.result: 实验证明算法高效，仅需有限查询就能检测LLM的不信任边界。同时发布了包含Llama2、Vicuna、Falcon、Qwen2、Gemma2和Yi-1.5等流行LLM的新数据集，标注了每个模型可能产生偏见的主题。
AI.conclusion: GMRL-BD算法能有效识别大语言模型的不信任边界，为评估LLM的可信度提供了实用工具，并发布了相关数据集促进该领域研究。

title: AutoSOTA: An End-to-End Automated Research System for State-of-the-Art AI Model Discovery
summary: Artificial intelligence research increasingly depends on prolonged cycles of reproduction, debugging, and iterative refinement to achieve State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) performance, creating a growing need for systems that can accelerate the full pipeline of empirical model optimization. In this work, we introduce AutoSOTA, an end-to-end automated research system that advances the latest SOTA models published in top-tier AI papers to reproducible and empirically improved new SOTA models. We formulate this problem through three tightly coupled stages: resource preparation and goal setting; experiment evaluation; and reflection and ideation. To tackle this problem, AutoSOTA adopts a multi-agent architecture with eight specialized agents that collaboratively ground papers to code and dependencies, initialize and repair execution environments, track long-horizon experiments, generate and schedule optimization ideas, and supervise validity to avoid spurious gains. We evaluate AutoSOTA on recent research papers collected from eight top-tier AI conferences under filters for code availability and execution cost. Across these papers, AutoSOTA achieves strong end-to-end performance in both automated replication and subsequent optimization. Specifically, it successfully discovers 105 new SOTA models that surpass the original reported methods, averaging approximately five hours per paper. Case studies spanning LLM, NLP, computer vision, time series, and optimization further show that the system can move beyond routine hyperparameter tuning to identify architectural innovation, algorithmic redesigns, and workflow-level improvements. These results suggest that end-to-end research automation can serve not only as a performance optimizer, but also as a new form of research infrastructure that reduces repetitive experimental burden and helps redirect human attention toward higher-level scientific creativity.

AI.tldr: AutoSOTA是一个端到端的自动化研究系统，能够自动复现顶级AI论文中的SOTA模型并进一步优化，发现新的SOTA模型，平均每篇论文耗时约5小时。
AI.motivation: AI研究越来越依赖漫长的复现、调试和迭代优化周期来达到SOTA性能，需要能够加速整个经验模型优化流程的系统。
AI.method: 采用多智能体架构，包含8个专门智能体，通过三个紧密耦合阶段：资源准备和目标设定、实验评估、反思和构思，将论文转化为代码和依赖，初始化修复执行环境，跟踪长期实验，生成调度优化想法，监督有效性避免虚假增益。
AI.result: 在8个顶级AI会议收集的论文上评估，成功发现了105个超越原始报告方法的新SOTA模型，平均每篇论文耗时约5小时。案例研究涵盖LLM、NLP、计算机视觉、时间序列和优化等领域，系统能够超越常规超参数调优，识别架构创新、算法重新设计和流程级改进。
AI.conclusion: 端到端研究自动化不仅可以作为性能优化器，还可以作为一种新的研究基础设施，减少重复性实验负担，帮助将人类注意力重新导向更高层次的科学创造力。

title: Auditable Agents
summary:
LLM agents call tools, query databases, delegate tasks, and trigger external side effects. Once an agent system can act in the world, the question is no longer only whether harmful actions can be prevented--it is whether those actions remain answerable after deployment. We distinguish accountability (the ability to determine compliance and assign responsibility), auditability (the system property that makes accountability possible), and auditing (the process of reconstructing behavior from trustworthy evidence). Our claim is direct: no agent system can be accountable without auditability.
  To make this operational, we define five dimensions of agent auditability, i.e., action recoverability, lifecycle coverage, policy checkability, responsibility attribution, and evidence integrity, and identify three mechanism classes (detect, enforce, recover) whose temporal information-and-intervention constraints explain why, in practice, no single approach suffices. We support the position with layered evidence rather than a single benchmark: lower-bound ecosystem measurements suggest that even basic security prerequisites for auditability are widely unmet (617 security findings across six prominent open-source projects); runtime feasibility results show that pre-execution mediation with tamper-evident records adds only 8.3 ms median overhead; and controlled recovery experiments show that responsibility-relevant information can be partially recovered even when conventional logs are missing. We propose an Auditability Card for agent systems and identify six open research problems organized by mechanism class.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张：没有可审计性就没有问责制，定义了智能体系统可审计性的五个维度，并通过实证证据支持这一立场。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体系统能够在现实世界中执行操作（调用工具、查询数据库、触发外部副作用），关键问题从"能否防止有害行为"转变为"部署后这些行为是否仍然可被问责"。论文旨在解决智能体系统在部署后的问责问题。
AI.method: 1. 定义了问责制、可审计性和审计的概念区分；2. 提出了智能体可审计性的五个维度：行动可恢复性、生命周期覆盖、策略可检查性、责任归属、证据完整性；3. 识别了三种机制类别（检测、执行、恢复）；4. 通过多层证据支持：生态系统测量、运行时可行性测试、受控恢复实验；5. 提出了"可审计性卡片"框架。
AI.result: 1. 生态系统测量显示基本安全前提条件广泛缺失（6个开源项目中发现617个安全问题）；2. 运行时测试表明预执行调解与防篡改记录仅增加8.3毫秒中位数开销；3. 受控恢复实验显示即使传统日志缺失，责任相关信息仍可部分恢复；4. 提出了按机制类别组织的六个开放研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文核心主张是：没有可审计性就没有问责制。通过定义智能体可审计性的五个维度和三种机制类别，为构建可问责的智能体系统提供了理论基础和实践框架。提出的"可审计性卡片"和开放研究问题为未来研究指明了方向。

title: FastDiSS: Few-step Match Many-step Diffusion Language Model on Sequence-to-Sequence Generation--Full Version
comment: camera-ready version, accepted by ACL Findings (ACL 2026)
summary: Self-conditioning has been central to the success of continuous diffusion language models, as it allows models to correct previous errors. Yet its ability degrades precisely in the regime where diffusion is most attractive for deployment: few-step sampling for fast inference. In this study, we show that when models only have a few denoising steps, inaccurate self-conditioning induces a substantial approximation gap; this mistake compounds across denoising steps and ultimately dominate the sample quality. To address this, we propose a novel training framework that handles these errors during learning by perturbing the self-conditioning signal to match inference noise, improving robustness to prior estimation errors. In addition, we introduce a token-level noise-awareness mechanism that prevents training from saturation, hence improving optimization. Extensive experiments across conditional generation benchmarks demonstrate that our framework surpasses standard continuous diffusion models while providing up to 400x faster inference speed, and remains competitive against other one-step diffusion frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的训练框架，通过扰动自条件信号以匹配推理噪声，解决连续扩散语言模型中自条件在少步采样时性能下降的问题，实现更快的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型中的自条件机制在少步采样（快速推理）时性能显著下降，导致近似误差累积并最终主导样本质量，这是扩散模型部署中的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出新颖的训练框架：1）扰动自条件信号以匹配推理噪声，提高对先验估计错误的鲁棒性；2）引入词元级噪声感知机制，防止训练饱和并改善优化。
AI.result: 在条件生成基准测试中，该框架超越了标准连续扩散模型，提供高达400倍的推理加速，并在其他单步扩散框架中保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过处理自条件误差和引入噪声感知机制，提出的训练框架有效解决了少步采样时自条件性能下降的问题，实现了高质量快速推理的扩散模型部署。

title: Human Interaction-Aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image
summary: Reconstructing textured 3D human models from a single image is fundamental for AR/VR and digital human applications. However, existing methods mostly focus on single individuals and thus fail in multi-human scenes, where naive composition of individual reconstructions often leads to artifacts such as unrealistic overlaps, missing geometry in occluded regions, and distorted interactions. These limitations highlight the need for approaches that incorporate group-level context and interaction priors. We introduce a holistic method that explicitly models both group- and instance-level information. To mitigate perspective-induced geometric distortions, we first transform the input into a canonical orthographic space. Our primary component, Human Group-Instance Multi-View Diffusion (HUG-MVD), then generates complete multi-view normals and images by jointly modeling individuals and group context to resolve occlusions and proximity. Subsequently, the Human Group-Instance Geometric Reconstruction (HUG-GR) module optimizes the geometry by leveraging explicit, physics-based interaction priors to enforce physical plausibility and accurately model inter-human contact. Finally, the multi-view images are fused into a high-fidelity texture. Together, these components form our complete framework, HUG3D. Extensive experiments show that HUG3D significantly outperforms both single-human and existing multi-human methods, producing physically plausible, high-fidelity 3D reconstructions of interacting people from a single image. Project page: https://jongheean11.github.io/HUG3D_project

AI.tldr: HUG3D是一个从单张图像重建多人交互场景的3D人体模型框架，通过结合群体级上下文和交互先验，解决了现有方法在多人场景中的重叠、遮挡和交互失真问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体重建方法主要针对单人场景，在多人场景中直接组合个体重建会导致不现实的重叠、遮挡区域几何缺失和交互失真等问题，需要能够结合群体级上下文和交互先验的方法。
AI.method: 首先将输入转换到规范正交空间以减轻透视引起的几何失真；然后使用Human Group-Instance Multi-View Diffusion (HUG-MVD)联合建模个体和群体上下文，生成完整的多视角法线和图像以解决遮挡和接近问题；接着通过Human Group-Instance Geometric Reconstruction (HUG-GR)模块利用基于物理的交互先验优化几何，确保物理合理性并准确建模人际接触；最后将多视角图像融合为高保真纹理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HUG3D在从单张图像重建交互人群的3D模型方面显著优于单人方法和现有多人方法，能够生成物理合理、高保真的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: HUG3D框架通过结合群体级上下文建模和物理交互先验，成功解决了多人场景中的3D重建问题，为AR/VR和数字人应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: SCMAPR: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement for Complex-Scenario Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-Video (T2V) generation has benefited from recent advances in diffusion models, yet current systems still struggle under complex scenarios, which are generally exacerbated by the ambiguity and underspecification of text prompts. In this work, we formulate complex-scenario prompt refinement as a stage-wise multi-agent refinement process and propose SCMAPR, i.e., a scenario-aware and Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement framework for T2V prompting. SCMAPR coordinates specialized agents to (i) route each prompt to a taxonomy-grounded scenario for strategy selection, (ii) synthesize scenario-aware rewriting policies and perform policy-conditioned refinement, and (iii) conduct structured semantic verification that triggers conditional revision when violations are detected. To clarify what constitutes complex scenarios in T2V prompting, provide representative examples, and enable rigorous evaluation under such challenging conditions, we further introduce {T2V-Complexity}, which is a complex-scenario T2V benchmark consisting exclusively of complex-scenario prompts. Extensive experiments on 3 existing benchmarks and our T2V-Complexity benchmark demonstrate that SCMAPR consistently improves text-video alignment and overall generation quality under complex scenarios, achieving up to 2.67\% and 3.28 gains in average score on VBench and EvalCrafter, and up to 0.028 improvement on T2V-CompBench over 3 State-Of-The-Art baselines.

AI.tldr: SCMAPR是一个用于文本到视频生成的场景感知自校正多智能体提示词优化框架，通过多智能体协作解决复杂场景下文本提示的模糊性和不完整性，显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到视频生成系统在复杂场景下表现不佳，主要原因是文本提示存在模糊性和不完整性。需要一种系统化的方法来优化复杂场景下的提示词。
AI.method: 提出SCMAPR框架，采用分阶段多智能体优化流程：1) 将提示词路由到基于分类的场景进行策略选择；2) 合成场景感知的重写策略并执行策略条件优化；3) 进行结构化语义验证，检测到违规时触发条件修订。
AI.result: 在3个现有基准和新的T2V-Complexity基准上，SCMAPR在复杂场景下持续提升文本-视频对齐和整体生成质量，在VBench和EvalCrafter上平均得分提升最高达2.67%和3.28，在T2V-CompBench上提升0.028。
AI.conclusion: SCMAPR通过多智能体协作的提示词优化框架有效解决了复杂场景下文本到视频生成的挑战，显著提升了生成质量和对齐度，并为此类挑战提供了系统化的解决方案。

title: Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate outstanding performance in many language tasks but still face fundamental challenges in managing the non-linear flow of human conversation. The prevalent approach of treating dialogue history as a flat, linear sequence is misaligned with the intrinsically hierarchical and branching structure of natural discourse, leading to inefficient context utilization and a loss of coherence during extended interactions involving topic shifts or instruction refinements. To address this limitation, we introduce Context-Agent, a novel framework that models multi-turn dialogue history as a dynamic tree structure. This approach mirrors the inherent non-linearity of conversation, enabling the model to maintain and navigate multiple dialogue branches corresponding to different topics. Furthermore, to facilitate robust evaluation, we introduce the Non-linear Task Multi-turn Dialogue (NTM) benchmark, specifically designed to assess model performance in long-horizon, non-linear scenarios. Our experiments demonstrate that Context-Agent enhances task completion rates and improves token efficiency across various LLMs, underscoring the value of structured context management for complex, dynamic dialogues. The dataset and code is available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context-Agent框架，将多轮对话历史建模为动态树结构以应对对话的非线性特性，并引入NTM基准进行评估，实验证明该方法能提升任务完成率和token效率。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在处理人类对话时面临根本性挑战，将对话历史视为扁平线性序列的方法与自然对话固有的层次化和分支结构不匹配，导致上下文利用效率低下，在涉及话题转换或指令细化的长对话中失去连贯性。
AI.method: 提出Context-Agent框架，将多轮对话历史建模为动态树结构，这种方法反映了对话的固有非线性特性，使模型能够维护和导航对应于不同话题的多个对话分支。
AI.result: 实验证明Context-Agent在各种大语言模型中提高了任务完成率并改善了token效率，强调了结构化上下文管理对于复杂动态对话的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入动态树结构建模对话历史和专门的NTM评估基准，Context-Agent框架有效解决了大语言模型在处理非线性对话时的局限性，为复杂动态对话提供了更有效的上下文管理方法。

title: Thinking Diffusion: Penalize and Guide Visual-Grounded Reasoning in Diffusion Multimodal Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are emerging as promising alternatives to autoregressive (AR) LLMs. Recently, this paradigm has been extended to multimodal tasks, leading to the development of diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs). These models are expected to retain the reasoning capabilities of LLMs while enabling faster inference through parallel generation. However, when combined with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, dMLLMs exhibit two critical issues. First, we observe that dMLLMs often generate the final answer token at a very early timestep. This trend indicates that the model determines the answer before sufficient reasoning, leading to degraded reasoning performance. Second, during the initial timesteps, dMLLMs show minimal dependency on visual prompts, exhibiting a fundamentally different pattern of visual information utilization compared to AR vision-language models. In summary, these findings indicate that dMLLMs tend to generate premature final answers without sufficiently grounding on visual inputs. To address these limitations, we propose Position and Step Penalty (PSP) and Visual Reasoning Guidance (VRG). PSP penalizes tokens in later positions during early timesteps, delaying premature answer generation and encouraging progressive reasoning across timesteps. VRG, inspired by classifier-free guidance, amplifies visual grounding signals to enhance the model's alignment with visual evidence. Extensive experiments across various dMLLMs demonstrate that our method achieves up to 7.5% higher accuracy while delivering more than 3x speedup compared to reasoning with four times more diffusion steps.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了扩散多模态大语言模型在思维链推理中的问题：过早生成最终答案且视觉信息利用不足，提出了位置和步骤惩罚以及视觉推理引导方法来解决这些问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型结合思维链推理时存在两个关键问题：1）模型在早期时间步就生成最终答案，导致推理不充分；2）初始时间步对视觉提示的依赖极小，视觉信息利用模式与自回归模型不同。
AI.method: 提出了两种方法：位置和步骤惩罚（PSP）和视觉推理引导（VRG）。PSP惩罚早期时间步中靠后位置的标记，延迟过早答案生成并鼓励跨时间步的渐进推理。VRG受无分类器引导启发，放大视觉基础信号以增强模型与视觉证据的对齐。
AI.result: 在各种dMLLM上的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了高达7.5%的准确率提升，同时相比使用四倍扩散步数的推理，提供了超过3倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: 提出的PSP和VRG方法有效解决了dMLLMs在思维链推理中的过早答案生成和视觉信息利用不足问题，显著提升了推理性能和效率。

title: EpiBench: Benchmarking Multi-turn Research Workflows for Multimodal Agents
summary: Scientific research follows multi-turn, multi-step workflows that require proactively searching the literature, consulting figures and tables, and integrating evidence across papers to align experimental settings and support reproducible conclusions. This joint capability is not systematically assessed in existing benchmarks, which largely under-evaluate proactive search, multi-evidence integration and sustained evidence use over time. In this work, we introduce EpiBench, an episodic multi-turn multimodal benchmark that instantiates short research workflows. Given a research task, agents must navigate across papers over multiple turns, align evidence from figures and tables, and use the accumulated evidence in the memory to answer objective questions that require cross paper comparisons and multi-figure integration. EpiBench introduces a process-level evaluation framework for fine-grained testing and diagnosis of research agents. Our experiments show that even the leading model achieves an accuracy of only 29.23% on the hard split, indicating substantial room for improvement in multi-turn, multi-evidence research workflows, providing an evaluation platform for verifiable and reproducible research agents.

AI.tldr: EpiBench是一个多轮多模态基准测试，用于评估研究代理在科学工作流程中的能力，包括主动搜索、多证据整合和持续证据使用，现有模型在困难任务上准确率仅29.23%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试未能系统评估科学研究的完整工作流程，特别是主动搜索、多证据整合和持续证据使用等关键能力，需要更全面的评估框架。
AI.method: 引入EpiBench基准测试，采用情景式多轮多模态设计，模拟短研究流程，要求代理在多轮中导航论文、整合图表证据、使用累积记忆回答需要跨论文比较和多图整合的客观问题。
AI.result: 实验显示，即使是领先模型在困难任务上的准确率也只有29.23%，表明在多轮多证据研究工作流程方面仍有很大改进空间。
AI.conclusion: EpiBench为可验证和可重复的研究代理提供了评估平台，揭示了当前模型在复杂科学研究工作流程中的局限性，为未来研究提供了方向。

title: A Synthetic Eye Movement Dataset for Script Reading Detection: Real Trajectory Replay on a 3D Simulator
comment: Synthetic eye movement dataset generation via 3D eye simulator; iris trajectory replay; script reading detection; behavioral data augmentation
summary:
Large vision-language models have achieved remarkable capabilities by training on massive internet-scale data, yet a fundamental asymmetry persists: while LLMs can leverage self-supervised pretraining on abundant text and image data, the same is not true for many behavioral modalities. Video-based behavioral data -- gestures, eye movements, social signals -- remains scarce, expensive to annotate, and privacy-sensitive. A promising alternative is simulation: replace real data collection with controlled synthetic generation to produce automatically labeled data at scale.
  We introduce infrastructure for this paradigm applied to eye movement, a behavioral signal with applications across vision-language modeling, virtual reality, robotics, accessibility systems, and cognitive science. We present a pipeline for generating synthetic labeled eye movement video by extracting real human iris trajectories from reference videos and replaying them on a 3D eye movement simulator via headless browser automation. Applying this to the task of script-reading detection during video interviews, we release final_dataset_v1: 144 sessions (72 reading, 72 conversation) totaling 12 hours of synthetic eye movement video at 25fps.
  Evaluation shows that generated trajectories preserve the temporal dynamics of the source data (KS D < 0.14 across all metrics). A matched frame-by-frame comparison reveals that the 3D simulator exhibits bounded sensitivity at reading-scale movements, attributable to the absence of coupled head movement -- a finding that informs future simulator design. The pipeline, dataset, and evaluation tools are released to support downstream behavioral classifier development at the intersection of behavioral modeling and vision-language systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一个生成合成眼动视频数据的框架，通过提取真实人类虹膜轨迹并在3D眼动模拟器中重放，用于解决行为模态数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在互联网规模数据上训练取得了显著能力，但行为模态数据（如眼动、手势、社交信号）仍然稀缺、标注成本高且涉及隐私。模拟生成合成数据成为有前景的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一个合成眼动视频生成管道：从参考视频中提取真实人类虹膜轨迹，通过无头浏览器自动化在3D眼动模拟器中重放这些轨迹，生成自动标注的合成眼动视频。
AI.result: 生成了final_dataset_v1：144个会话（72个阅读，72个对话），总计12小时25fps的合成眼动视频。评估显示生成的轨迹保留了源数据的时序动态特性（所有指标的KS D < 0.14）。
AI.conclusion: 该管道、数据集和评估工具已发布，支持行为建模和视觉语言系统交叉领域的行为分类器开发。研究发现3D模拟器在阅读尺度运动上表现出有限敏感性，这为未来模拟器设计提供了参考。

title: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward
summary: The paradigm of programmable diagram generation is evolving rapidly, playing a crucial role in structured visualization. However, most existing studies are confined to a narrow range of task formulations and language support, constraining their applicability to diverse diagram types. In this work, we propose OmniDiagram, a unified framework that incorporates diverse diagram code languages and task definitions. To address the challenge of aligning code logic with visual fidelity in Reinforcement Learning (RL), we introduce a novel visual feedback strategy named Visual Interrogation Verifies All (\textsc{Viva}). Unlike brittle syntax-based rules or pixel-level matching, \textsc{Viva} rewards the visual structure of rendered diagrams through a generative approach. Specifically, \textsc{Viva} actively generates targeted visual inquiries to scrutinize diagram visual fidelity and provides fine-grained feedback for optimization. This mechanism facilitates a self-evolving training process, effectively obviating the need for manually annotated ground truth code. Furthermore, we construct M3$^2$Diagram, the first large-scale diagram code generation dataset, containing over 196k high-quality instances. Experimental results confirm that the combination of SFT and our \textsc{Viva}-based RL allows OmniDiagram to establish a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across diagram code generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OmniDiagram是一个统一框架，支持多种图表代码语言和任务定义，通过创新的视觉反馈策略Viva和RL训练，在图表代码生成任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前可编程图表生成研究局限于狭窄的任务表述和语言支持，限制了其在不同图表类型中的适用性。需要建立一个统一框架来解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出OmniDiagram统一框架，包含多样化的图表代码语言和任务定义。引入创新的视觉反馈策略Viva，通过生成有针对性的视觉查询来检查图表视觉保真度，为优化提供细粒度反馈。构建了首个大规模图表代码生成数据集M3²Diagram，包含超过196k高质量实例。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，结合SFT和基于Viva的RL训练，OmniDiagram在图表代码生成基准测试中建立了新的最先进性能（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: OmniDiagram通过统一的框架设计和创新的视觉反馈机制，解决了现有图表生成方法的局限性，实现了更广泛的应用覆盖和更好的性能表现。

title: THIVLVC: Retrieval Augmented Dependency Parsing for Latin
summary: We describe THIVLVC, a two-stage system for the EvaLatin 2026 Dependency Parsing task. Given a Latin sentence, we retrieve structurally similar entries from the CIRCSE treebank using sentence length and POS n-gram similarity, then prompt a large language model to refine the baseline parse from UDPipe using the retrieved examples and UD annotation guidelines. We submit two configurations: one without retrieval and one with retrieval (RAG). On poetry (Seneca), THIVLVC improves CLAS by +17 points over the UDPipe baseline; on prose (Thomas Aquinas), the gain is +1.5 CLAS. A double-blind error analysis of 300 divergences between our system and the gold standard reveals that, among unanimous annotator decisions, 53.3% favour THIVLVC, showing annotation inconsistencies both within and across treebanks.

AI.tldr: THIVLVC是一个两阶段的拉丁语依存句法分析系统，通过检索相似树库条目并使用大语言模型优化UDPipe基线解析，在诗歌文本上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 解决拉丁语依存句法分析任务，特别是针对不同文体（诗歌和散文）的解析挑战，通过结合检索增强生成技术来提升解析质量。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：1) 基于句子长度和POS n-gram相似性从CIRCSE树库检索结构相似的条目；2) 使用大语言模型结合检索到的示例和UD标注指南来优化UDPipe的基线解析。
AI.result: 在诗歌文本（塞涅卡）上，THIVLVC比UDPipe基线提高了17个CLAS点；在散文文本（托马斯·阿奎那）上提高了1.5个CLAS点。对300个差异的双盲错误分析显示，在一致的标注者决策中，53.3%支持THIVLVC。
AI.conclusion: THIVLVC系统在拉丁语依存句法分析中表现出色，特别是在诗歌文本上。错误分析揭示了树库内部和跨树库的标注不一致性，表明系统性能可能受到标注质量的影响。

title: Unifying VLM-Guided Flow Matching and Spectral Anomaly Detection for Interpretable Veterinary Diagnosis
summary: Automatic diagnosis of canine pneumothorax is challenged by data scarcity and the need for trustworthy models. To address this, we first introduce a public, pixel-level annotated dataset to facilitate research. We then propose a novel diagnostic paradigm that reframes the task as a synergistic process of signal localization and spectral detection. For localization, our method employs a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to guide an iterative Flow Matching process, which progressively refines segmentation masks to achieve superior boundary accuracy. For detection, the segmented mask is used to isolate features from the suspected lesion. We then apply Random Matrix Theory (RMT), a departure from traditional classifiers, to analyze these features. This approach models healthy tissue as predictable random noise and identifies pneumothorax by detecting statistically significant outlier eigenvalues that represent a non-random pathological signal. The high-fidelity localization from Flow Matching is crucial for purifying the signal, thus maximizing the sensitivity of our RMT detector. This synergy of generative segmentation and first-principles statistical analysis yields a highly accurate and interpretable diagnostic system (source code is available at: https://github.com/Pu-Wang-alt/Canine-pneumothorax).

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合视觉语言模型引导的流匹配分割和随机矩阵理论检测的犬气胸自动诊断新范式，解决了数据稀缺和模型可信度问题。
AI.motivation: 犬气胸自动诊断面临数据稀缺和需要可信模型的挑战。现有方法在边界精度和统计可靠性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 引入公开像素级标注数据集；2) 提出信号定位与频谱检测协同范式：使用VLM引导迭代流匹配进行高精度分割，然后用随机矩阵理论分析分割特征，将健康组织建模为可预测随机噪声，通过检测统计显著的异常特征值来识别气胸。
AI.result: 该方法实现了高精度边界分割和统计可靠的检测，生成分割的高保真定位有助于净化信号，最大化RMT检测器的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式分割与第一性原理统计分析相结合，构建了高精度且可解释的诊断系统，为医学图像分析提供了新思路。

title: UniCreative: Unifying Long-form Logic and Short-form Sparkle via Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning
summary: A fundamental challenge in creative writing lies in reconciling the inherent tension between maintaining global coherence in long-form narratives and preserving local expressiveness in short-form texts. While long-context generation necessitates explicit macroscopic planning, short-form creativity often demands spontaneous, constraint-free expression. Existing alignment paradigms, however, typically employ static reward signals and rely heavily on high-quality supervised data, which is costly and difficult to scale. To address this, we propose \textbf{UniCreative}, a unified reference-free reinforcement learning framework. We first introduce \textbf{AC-GenRM}, an adaptive constraint-aware reward model that dynamically synthesizes query-specific criteria to provide fine-grained preference judgments. Leveraging these signals, we propose \textbf{ACPO}, a policy optimization algorithm that aligns models with human preferences across both content quality and structural paradigms without supervised fine-tuning and ground-truth references. Empirical results demonstrate that AC-GenRM aligns closely with expert evaluations, while ACPO significantly enhances performance across diverse writing tasks. Crucially, our analysis reveals an emergent meta-cognitive ability: the model learns to autonomously differentiate between tasks requiring rigorous planning and those favoring direct generation, validating the effectiveness of our direct alignment approach.

AI.tldr: UniCreative是一个统一的免参考强化学习框架，通过自适应约束感知奖励模型和策略优化算法，解决创意写作中长篇叙事全局连贯性与短篇文本局部表达力之间的张力问题。
AI.motivation: 创意写作面临的核心挑战是平衡长篇叙事的全局连贯性与短篇文本的局部表达力。现有对齐范式通常使用静态奖励信号并依赖高质量监督数据，这些数据成本高昂且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出UniCreative框架：1) AC-GenRM自适应约束感知奖励模型，动态合成查询特定标准以提供细粒度偏好判断；2) ACPO策略优化算法，在无需监督微调和真实参考的情况下，使模型在内容质量和结构范式上对齐人类偏好。
AI.result: 实验结果表明AC-GenRM与专家评估高度一致，ACPO在多样写作任务上显著提升性能。分析揭示了模型出现了元认知能力：能够自主区分需要严格规划的任务和适合直接生成的任务。
AI.conclusion: UniCreative框架有效解决了创意写作中的全局-局部张力问题，验证了直接对齐方法的有效性，使模型能够自适应地处理不同写作任务的需求。

title: YoNER: A New Yorùbá Multi-domain Named Entity Recognition Dataset
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a foundational NLP task, yet research in Yorùbá has been constrained by limited and domain-specific resources. Existing resources, such as MasakhaNER (a manually annotated news-domain corpus) and WikiAnn (automatically created from Wikipedia), are valuable but restricted in domain coverage. To address this gap, we present YoNER, a new multidomain Yorùbá NER dataset that extends entity coverage beyond news and Wikipedia. The dataset comprises about 5,000 sentences and 100,000 tokens collected from five domains including Bible, Blogs, Movies, Radio broadcast and Wikipedia, and annotated with three entity types: Person (PER), Organization (ORG) and Location (LOC), following CoNLL-style guidelines. Annotation was conducted manually by three native Yorùbá speakers, with an inter-annotator agreement of over 0.70, ensuring high quality and consistency. We benchmark several transformer encoder models using cross-domain experiments with MasakhaNER 2.0, and we also assess the effect of few-shot in-domain data using YoNER and cross-lingual setups with English datasets. Our results show that African-centric models outperform general multilingual models for Yorùbá, but cross-domain performance drops substantially, particularly for blogs and movie domains. Furthermore, we observed that closely related formal domains, such as news and Wikipedia, transfer more effectively. In addition, we introduce a new Yorùbá-specific language model (OyoBERT) that outperforms multilingual models in in-domain evaluation. We publicly release the YoNER dataset and pretrained OyoBERT models to support future research on Yorùbá natural language processing.

AI.tldr: YoNER是一个新的约鲁巴语多领域命名实体识别数据集，包含约5,000个句子和100,000个标记，覆盖圣经、博客、电影、广播和维基百科五个领域，标注了PER、ORG、LOC三种实体类型。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语NER研究受限于领域特定的有限资源，现有资源如MasakhaNER（新闻领域）和WikiAnn（维基百科）领域覆盖不足，需要多领域数据集来推动约鲁巴语NLP发展。
AI.method: 创建YoNER多领域数据集，包含五个领域约5,000句子，由三位母语者手动标注，遵循CoNLL风格指南，标注一致性超过0.70。使用跨领域实验评估多种Transformer模型，并开发了约鲁巴语专用语言模型OyoBERT。
AI.result: 非洲中心模型优于通用多语言模型，但跨领域性能显著下降，特别是博客和电影领域。形式相近的领域（新闻和维基百科）迁移效果更好。OyoBERT在领域内评估中超越多语言模型。
AI.conclusion: YoNER填补了约鲁巴语多领域NER数据空白，OyoBERT模型表现优异，公开数据集和模型将支持约鲁巴语NLP研究，跨领域性能下降表明需要更多领域适应研究。

title: A Weak-Signal-Aware Framework for Subsurface Defect Detection: Mechanisms for Enhancing Low-SCR Hyperbolic Signatures
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Accepted by International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Subsurface defect detection via Ground Penetrating Radar is challenged by "weak signals" faint diffraction hyperbolas with low signal-to-clutter ratios, high wavefield similarity, and geometric degradation. Existing lightweight detectors prioritize efficiency over sensitivity, failing to preserve low-frequency structures or decouple heterogeneous clutter. We propose WSA-Net, a framework designed to enhance faint signatures through physical-feature reconstruction. Moving beyond simple parameter reduction, WSA-Net integrates four mechanisms: Signal preservation using partial convolutions; Clutter suppression via heterogeneous grouping attention; Geometric reconstruction to sharpen hyperbolic arcs; Context anchoring to resolve semantic ambiguities. Evaluations on the RTSTdataset show WSA-Net achieves 0.6958 mAP@0.5 and 164 FPS with only 2.412 M parameters. Results prove that signal-centric awareness in lightweight architectures effectively reduces false negatives in infrastructure inspection.

AI.tldr: WSA-Net：一种用于探地雷达微弱信号检测的轻量级框架，通过物理特征重建增强微弱衍射双曲线信号，在保持高效率的同时提高检测灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 探地雷达地下缺陷检测面临"微弱信号"挑战：信号杂波比低、波场相似性高、几何退化。现有轻量级检测器优先考虑效率而牺牲灵敏度，无法保留低频结构或解耦异质杂波。
AI.method: 提出WSA-Net框架，集成四种机制：1) 使用部分卷积进行信号保留；2) 通过异质分组注意力抑制杂波；3) 几何重建以锐化双曲线弧；4) 上下文锚定以解决语义模糊性。
AI.result: 在RTST数据集上，WSA-Net达到0.6958 mAP@0.5和164 FPS，仅需2.412M参数，证明信号中心感知在轻量级架构中能有效减少基础设施检测中的漏检。
AI.conclusion: WSA-Net通过物理特征重建增强微弱信号，在轻量级架构中实现信号中心感知，有效解决了探地雷达微弱信号检测的挑战，在保持高效率的同时提高了检测灵敏度。

title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition
summary: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to manage and acquire economic resources remains unclear. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Market-Bench}, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates the capabilities of LLMs in economically-relevant tasks through economic and trade competition. Specifically, we construct a configurable multi-agent supply chain economic model where LLMs act as retailer agents responsible for procuring and retailing merchandise. In the \textbf{procurement} stage, LLMs bid for limited inventory in budget-constrained auctions. In the \textbf{retail} stage, LLMs set retail prices, generate marketing slogans, and provide them to buyers through a role-based attention mechanism for purchase. Market-Bench logs complete trajectories of bids, prices, slogans, sales, and balance-sheet states, enabling automatic evaluation with economic, operational, and semantic metrics. Benchmarking on 20 open- and closed-source LLM agents reveals significant performance disparities and winner-take-most phenomenon, \textit{i.e.}, only a small subset of LLM retailers can consistently achieve capital appreciation, while many hover around the break-even point despite similar semantic matching scores. Market-Bench provides a reproducible testbed for studying how LLMs interact in competitive markets.

AI.tldr: Market-Bench是一个评估大语言模型在经济相关任务中能力的基准测试，通过构建可配置的多智能体供应链经济模型，测试LLM作为零售商在采购和零售两个阶段的竞争表现。
AI.motivation: 目前大语言模型管理和获取经济资源的能力尚不明确，需要建立一个系统性的评估框架来研究LLM在竞争性市场环境中的表现。
AI.method: 构建可配置的多智能体供应链经济模型，LLM作为零售商智能体参与两个阶段：1）采购阶段：在预算约束的拍卖中竞标有限库存；2）零售阶段：设定零售价格、生成营销口号，通过基于角色的注意力机制提供给买家购买。记录完整的竞标、价格、口号、销售和资产负债表状态轨迹。
AI.result: 对20个开源和闭源LLM智能体的基准测试显示显著性能差异和"赢家通吃"现象：只有一小部分LLM零售商能够持续实现资本增值，而许多模型尽管语义匹配得分相似，却只能维持盈亏平衡。
AI.conclusion: Market-Bench为研究LLM在竞争性市场中的互动提供了一个可复现的测试平台，揭示了不同LLM在经济资源管理能力上的显著差异。

title: Graph-Based Chain-of-Thought Pruning for Reducing Redundant Reflections in Reasoning LLMs
summary: Extending CoT through RL has been widely used to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, due to the sparsity of reward signals, it can also induce undesirable thinking patterns such as overthinking, i.e., generating redundant intermediate reasoning content. In this work, we argue that a major source of such redundancy is inefficient reflection, which often manifests in two problematic patterns: Indiscriminate Reflection, where the model performs broad, low-impact checks throughout reasoning, and Repetitive Reflection, where it repeatedly re-verifies an already established conclusion. To address this, we introduce a graph-based CoT optimization framework. Specifically, we convert each linear CoT into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with explicit dependency edges, and design a dual pruning strategy: branch-level pruning removes weakly contributing reflection branches, while depth-level pruning eliminates late-stage re-verification. We distill this behavior via a three-stage pipeline: (1) SFT to initialize the policy on pruned concise traces, (2) DPO to prefer correct but less redundant trajectories, and (3) GRPO with length penalty to jointly optimize answer correctness and efficiency. Experiments show that our approach reduces the average reasoning tokens by 42\% while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图结构的思维链优化框架，通过双剪枝策略减少冗余推理，在保持准确率的同时减少42%的推理token
AI.motivation: 强化学习增强的思维链方法容易产生过度思考问题，主要源于低效的反思模式：无差别反思和重复反思，导致生成冗余的中间推理内容
AI.method: 将线性思维链转换为有向无环图，采用分支级剪枝和深度级剪枝的双剪枝策略，通过三阶段训练流程：监督微调、直接偏好优化和带长度惩罚的组相对策略优化
AI.result: 实验表明该方法平均减少42%的推理token，同时保持或提高了准确率
AI.conclusion: 图结构的思维链优化框架能有效减少冗余反思，提高推理效率，为优化大语言模型的推理能力提供了新思路

title: CLIP-Guided Data Augmentation for Night-Time Image Dehazing
summary: Nighttime image dehazing faces a more complex degradation pattern than its daytime counterpart, as haze scattering couples with low illumination, non-uniform lighting, and strong light interference. Under limited supervision, this complexity aggravates domain drift and training instability, since target-domain samples are scarce while naively introducing external data may weaken adaptation due to distribution mismatch. This paper presents our solution to the NTIRE 2026 Night Time Image Dehazing Challenge, built as a unified framework that integrates domain-aligned data construction, stage-wise training, and inference-time enhancement. Specifically, a pre-trained CLIP visual encoder screens candidate external samples by similarity to construct training data closer to the target domain. NAFNet is then trained in two stages, first adapting to the target domain and then expanding to broader degradation patterns. At inference time, TLC, x8 self-ensemble, and weighted snapshot fusion are combined to improve output stability. Rather than relying on complex network redesign, the proposed framework offers a practical and effective pipeline for nighttime image dehazing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于夜间图像去雾的统一框架，通过领域对齐数据构建、分阶段训练和推理时增强来解决夜间去雾的复杂退化问题。
AI.motivation: 夜间图像去雾面临比白天更复杂的退化模式，包括雾散射与低光照、非均匀照明和强光干扰的耦合。在有限监督下，这种复杂性加剧了领域漂移和训练不稳定性，因为目标域样本稀缺，而简单地引入外部数据可能因分布不匹配而削弱适应性。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，包含：1）使用预训练CLIP视觉编码器筛选候选外部样本，构建更接近目标域的训练数据；2）采用NAFNet进行两阶段训练，先适应目标域，再扩展到更广泛的退化模式；3）推理时结合TLC、x8自集成和加权快照融合来提高输出稳定性。
AI.result: 该框架为NTIRE 2026夜间图像去雾挑战赛提供了解决方案，不依赖复杂的网络重新设计，而是提供了一个实用有效的夜间图像去雾流程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过领域对齐数据构建、分阶段训练和推理时增强的组合，为解决夜间图像去雾的复杂挑战提供了一个实用且有效的解决方案。

title: ActivityEditor: Learning to Synthesize Physically Valid Human Mobility
summary: Human mobility modeling is indispensable for diverse urban applications. However, existing data-driven methods often suffer from data scarcity, limiting their applicability in regions where historical trajectories are unavailable or restricted. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{ActivityEditor}, a novel dual-LLM-agent framework designed for zero-shot cross-regional trajectory generation. Our framework decomposes the complex synthesis task into two collaborative stages. Specifically, an intention-based agent, which leverages demographic-driven priors to generate structured human intentions and coarse activity chains to ensure high-level socio-semantic coherence. These outputs are then refined by editor agent to obtain mobility trajectories through iteratively revisions that enforces human mobility law. This capability is acquired through reinforcement learning with multiple rewards grounded in real-world physical constraints, allowing the agent to internalize mobility regularities and ensure high-fidelity trajectory generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textbf{ActivityEditor} achieves superior zero-shot performance when transferred across diverse urban contexts. It maintains high statistical fidelity and physical validity, providing a robust and highly generalizable solution for mobility simulation in data-scarce scenarios. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ActivityEditor-066B.

AI.tldr: ActivityEditor是一个基于双LLM代理的零样本跨区域轨迹生成框架，通过分解合成任务为两个协作阶段，解决数据稀缺区域的人类移动建模问题。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法在历史轨迹数据不可用或受限的区域面临数据稀缺问题，限制了其在城市应用中的适用性，需要开发能够跨区域迁移的零样本轨迹生成方法。
AI.method: 提出双LLM代理框架：1) 基于意图的代理利用人口统计先验生成结构化人类意图和粗略活动链；2) 编辑代理通过基于真实世界物理约束的多奖励强化学习进行迭代修订，确保轨迹符合人类移动规律。
AI.result: ActivityEditor在跨不同城市环境的零样本迁移中表现出优越性能，保持了高统计保真度和物理有效性，为数据稀缺场景提供了鲁棒且高度可泛化的移动模拟解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了跨区域轨迹生成的数据稀缺问题，通过双代理协作和强化学习实现了高保真度的零样本迁移，为城市移动建模提供了通用解决方案。

title: See the Forest for the Trees: Loosely Speculative Decoding via Visual-Semantic Guidance for Efficient Inference of Video LLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) excel in video understanding but suffer from high inference latency during autoregressive generation. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by applying a draft-and-verify paradigm, yet existing methods are constrained by rigid exact-match rules, severely limiting the acceleration potential. To bridge this gap, we propose LVSpec, the first training-free loosely SD framework tailored for Video-LLMs. Grounded in the insight that generation is governed by sparse visual-relevant anchors (mandating strictness) amidst abundant visual-irrelevant fillers (permitting loose verification), LVSpec employs a lightweight visual-relevant token identification scheme to accurately pinpoint the former. To further maximize acceptance, we augment this with a position-shift tolerant mechanism that effectively salvages positionally mismatched but semantically equivalent tokens. Experiments demonstrate that LVSpec achieves high fidelity and speed: it preserves >99.8 of target performance while accelerating Qwen2.5-VL-32B by 2.70x and LLaVA-OneVision-72B by 2.94x. Notably, it boosts the mean accepted length and speedup ratio by 136% and 35% compared to SOTA training-free SD methods for Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: LVSpec是一种针对视频大语言模型的无训练松散推测解码框架，通过识别视觉相关锚点token和容忍位置偏移，在保持>99.8%性能的同时实现2.7-2.94倍加速
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型在自回归生成时存在高推理延迟问题，现有推测解码方法受限于严格的精确匹配规则，严重限制了加速潜力
AI.method: 提出LVSpec框架：1) 轻量级视觉相关token识别方案，准确识别需要严格验证的视觉相关锚点；2) 位置偏移容忍机制，挽救位置不匹配但语义等价的token；3) 无训练松散推测解码范式
AI.result: 在保持>99.8%目标性能的同时，将Qwen2.5-VL-32B加速2.70倍，LLaVA-OneVision-72B加速2.94倍；平均接受长度和加速比相比最先进的无训练SD方法分别提升136%和35%
AI.conclusion: LVSpec通过松散验证机制有效解决了视频大语言模型推测解码中的严格匹配限制，在保持高保真度的同时显著提升推理速度，为视频理解任务提供了高效的推理解决方案

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models under Contradictory Virtual Content Attacks in Augmented Reality
summary: Augmented reality (AR) has rapidly expanded over the past decade. As AR becomes increasingly integrated into daily life, its security and reliability emerge as critical challenges. Among various threats, contradictory virtual content attacks, where malicious or inconsistent virtual elements are introduced into the user's view, pose a unique risk by misleading users, creating semantic confusion, or delivering harmful information. In this work, we systematically model such attacks and present ContrAR, a novel benchmark for evaluating the robustness of vision-language models (VLMs) against virtual content manipulation and contradiction in AR. ContrAR contains 312 real-world AR videos validated by 10 human participants. We further benchmark 11 VLMs, including both commercial and open-source models. Experimental results reveal that while current VLMs exhibit reasonable understanding of contradictory virtual content, room still remains for improvement in detecting and reasoning about adversarial content manipulations in AR environments. Moreover, balancing detection accuracy and latency remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContrAR基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在增强现实中对抗虚拟内容操纵和矛盾攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着增强现实技术日益融入日常生活，其安全性和可靠性成为关键挑战。矛盾虚拟内容攻击（恶意或不一致的虚拟元素被引入用户视野）通过误导用户、制造语义混淆或传递有害信息构成独特风险。
AI.method: 系统建模此类攻击，提出ContrAR基准，包含312个真实世界AR视频并由10名人类参与者验证。进一步对11个视觉语言模型（包括商业和开源模型）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前视觉语言模型对矛盾虚拟内容表现出合理的理解能力，但在检测和推理AR环境中的对抗性内容操纵方面仍有改进空间。此外，平衡检测准确性和延迟仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 增强现实中的虚拟内容操纵攻击构成严重安全威胁，需要开发更鲁棒的视觉语言模型来检测和应对此类攻击。ContrAR基准为评估和改进模型在此领域的性能提供了重要工具。

title: Inventory of the 12 007 Low-Dimensional Pseudo-Boolean Landscapes Invariant to Rank, Translation, and Rotation
summary: Many randomized optimization algorithms are rank-invariant, relying solely on the relative ordering of solutions rather than absolute fitness values. We introduce a stronger notion of rank landscape invariance: two problems are equivalent if their ranking, but also their neighborhood structure and symmetries (translation and rotation), induce identical landscapes. This motivates the study of rank landscapes rather than individual functions. While prior work analyzed the rankings of injective function classes in isolation, we provide an exhaustive inventory of the invariant landscape classes for pseudo-Boolean functions of dimensions 1, 2, and 3, including non-injective cases. Our analysis reveals 12,007 classes in total, a significant reduction compared to rank-invariance alone. We find that non-injective functions yield far more invariant landscape classes than injective ones. In addition, complex combinations of topological landscape properties and algorithm behaviors emerge, particularly regarding deceptiveness, neutrality, and the performance of hill-climbing strategies. The inventory serves as a resource for pedagogical purposes and benchmark design, offering a foundation for constructing larger problems with controlled hardness and advancing our understanding of landscape difficulty and algorithm performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了比传统秩不变性更强的"秩景观不变性"概念，系统分析了伪布尔函数在1、2、3维情况下的不变景观类别，发现非单射函数比单射函数产生更多不变类别，揭示了景观拓扑特性与算法性能之间的复杂关系。
AI.motivation: 许多随机优化算法仅依赖解的相对排序而非绝对适应值，但传统秩不变性忽略了邻域结构和对称性等景观特征。研究旨在建立更全面的秩景观不变性理论，系统分析不同维度下伪布尔函数的景观类别，为理解算法性能和设计基准测试提供理论基础。
AI.method: 引入秩景观不变性概念，要求排名、邻域结构和对称性（平移和旋转）都相同。对1、2、3维伪布尔函数进行穷举分析，包括非单射情况，建立不变景观类别的完整清单。
AI.result: 共发现12,007个不变景观类别，相比仅考虑秩不变性显著减少。非单射函数比单射函数产生更多不变类别。揭示了欺骗性、中立性和爬山策略性能等复杂景观特性与算法行为的组合关系。
AI.conclusion: 秩景观不变性为研究景观难度和算法性能提供了更精细的分析框架。建立的类别清单可作为教学资源和基准设计基础，有助于构建具有可控难度的更大规模问题，推进对优化问题本质的理解。

title: LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals
summary: This work characterizes large language models' chain-of-thought generation as a structured trajectory through representation space. We show that mathematical reasoning traverses functionally ordered, step-specific subspaces that become increasingly separable with layer depth. This structure already exists in base models, while reasoning training primarily accelerates convergence toward termination-related subspaces rather than introducing new representational organization. While early reasoning steps follow similar trajectories, correct and incorrect solutions diverge systematically at late stages. This late-stage divergence enables mid-reasoning prediction of final-answer correctness with ROC-AUC up to 0.87. Furthermore, we introduce trajectory-based steering, an inference-time intervention framework that enables reasoning correction and length control based on derived ideal trajectories. Together, these results establish reasoning trajectories as a geometric lens for interpreting, predicting, and controlling LLM reasoning behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究将大语言模型的思维链生成表征为表示空间中的结构化轨迹，发现数学推理会穿越功能有序的步骤特定子空间，这些子空间随层深增加而变得可分离
AI.motivation: 理解大语言模型在数学推理任务中思维链生成的内在机制，探索推理过程在表示空间中的几何结构，为解释、预测和控制LLM推理行为提供新视角
AI.method: 将思维链生成建模为表示空间中的结构化轨迹，分析数学推理过程中不同步骤的表示子空间特征，研究正确与错误解决方案的轨迹差异，并开发基于轨迹的引导框架进行推理修正和长度控制
AI.result: 数学推理穿越功能有序的步骤特定子空间，这些子空间随层深增加而变得可分离；正确与错误解决方案在后期阶段系统性地分叉；中期推理阶段就能预测最终答案正确性（ROC-AUC达0.87）；轨迹引导框架能有效修正推理和控制推理长度
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹为解释、预测和控制大语言模型推理行为提供了几何视角，揭示了推理训练主要加速收敛而非引入新的表示组织，为开发推理干预技术提供了理论基础

title: Experience Transfer for Multimodal LLM Agents in Minecraft Game
summary: Multimodal LLM agents operating in complex game environments must continually reuse past experience to solve new tasks efficiently. In this work, we propose Echo, a transfer-oriented memory framework that enables agents to derive actionable knowledge from prior interactions rather than treating memory as a passive repository of static records. To make transfer explicit, Echo decomposes reusable knowledge into five dimensions: structure, attribute, process, function, and interaction. This formulation allows the agent to identify recurring patterns shared across different tasks and infer what prior experience remains applicable in new situations. Building on this formulation, Echo leverages In-Context Analogy Learning (ICAL) to retrieve relevant experiences and adapt them to unseen tasks through contextual examples. Experiments in Minecraft show that, under a from-scratch learning setting, Echo achieves a 1.3x to 1.7x speed-up on object-unlocking tasks. Moreover, Echo exhibits a burst-like chain-unlocking phenomenon, rapidly unlocking multiple similar items within a short time interval after acquiring transferable experience. These results suggest that experience transfer is a promising direction for improving the efficiency and adaptability of multimodal LLM agents in complex interactive environments.

AI.tldr: Echo框架通过五维知识分解和上下文类比学习，实现多模态LLM智能体在复杂游戏环境中的经验迁移，在Minecraft中实现1.3-1.7倍加速
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM智能体在复杂游戏环境中需要重用过去的经验来高效解决新任务，传统方法将记忆视为静态存储库，无法有效进行经验迁移
AI.method: 提出Echo框架，将可重用知识分解为结构、属性、过程、功能和交互五个维度，采用上下文类比学习(ICAL)检索相关经验并通过上下文示例适应新任务
AI.result: 在Minecraft从零学习设置下，Echo在对象解锁任务上实现1.3-1.7倍加速，并展现出爆发式链式解锁现象，短时间内快速解锁多个相似物品
AI.conclusion: 经验迁移是提高多模态LLM智能体在复杂交互环境中效率和适应性的有前景方向，Echo框架通过显式的知识分解和类比学习实现了有效的经验重用

title: Attention Editing: A Versatile Framework for Cross-Architecture Attention Conversion
summary: Key-Value (KV) cache memory and bandwidth increasingly dominate large language model inference cost in long-context and long-generation regimes. Architectures such as multi-head latent attention (MLA) and hybrid sliding-window attention (SWA) can alleviate this bound, but integrating them into existing models remains difficult. Prior methods impose fine-grained structural requirements on both source and target attention modules, which cannot meet the feasible requirement in practical deployment. We present Attention Editing, a practical framework for converting already-trained large language models (LLMs) with new attention architectures without re-pretraining from scratch. Attention editing replaces the original attention with a learnable target module and trains it using progressive distillation, consisting of (1) layer-wise teacher-forced optimization with intermediate activation supervision to prevent cold-start error accumulation, and (2) model-level distillation on next-token distributions, optionally regularized by weak feature matching. We instantiate the framework on two different target--MLA and GateSWA, a gated hybrid SWA design, and apply it to Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. The resulting models maintain competitive performance while delivering substantial efficiency improvements, demonstrating that large-scale attention conversion is both feasible and robust. Notably, experiments are conducted on an Ascend 910B clusters, offering a practical training case study on domestic hardware.

AI.tldr: Attention Editing框架允许将已训练大语言模型的注意力机制转换为更高效的架构（如MLA或GateSWA），无需从头预训练，显著提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 长上下文和长生成场景下，KV缓存的内存和带宽成本主导大语言模型推理开销。现有高效注意力架构（如MLA和混合滑动窗口注意力）难以集成到已训练模型中，先前方法对源和目标注意力模块有细粒度结构要求，不满足实际部署需求。
AI.method: 提出Attention Editing框架：1）用可学习目标模块替换原始注意力；2）使用渐进蒸馏训练：层间教师强制优化（带中间激活监督防止冷启动误差累积）和模型级蒸馏（基于下一个token分布，可选弱特征匹配正则化）。在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B上实例化为MLA和GateSWA（门控混合SWA设计）。
AI.result: 转换后的模型保持竞争力性能，同时带来显著效率提升。实验在Ascend 910B集群上进行，提供了国产硬件上的实用训练案例研究，证明大规模注意力转换既可行又鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: Attention Editing框架为已训练大语言模型提供了实用的注意力架构转换方案，无需从头预训练，在保持性能的同时显著提升推理效率，为实际部署提供了可行解决方案。

title: Cross-Resolution Diffusion Models via Network Pruning
summary: Diffusion models have demonstrated impressive image synthesis performance, yet many UNet-based models are trained at certain fixed resolutions. Their quality tends to degrade when generating images at out-of-training resolutions. We trace this issue to resolution-dependent parameter behaviors, where weights that function well at the default resolution can become adverse when spatial scales shift, weakening semantic alignment and causing structural instability in the UNet architecture. Based on this analysis, this paper introduces CR-Diff, a novel method that improves the cross-resolution visual consistency by pruning some parameters of the diffusion model. Specifically, CR-Diff has two stages. It first performs block-wise pruning to selectively eliminate adverse weights. Then, a pruned output amplification is conducted to further purify the pruned predictions. Empirically, extensive experiments suggest that CR-Diff can improve perceptual fidelity and semantic coherence across various diffusion backbones and unseen resolutions, while largely preserving the performance at default resolutions. Additionally, CR-Diff supports prompt-specific refinement, enabling quality enhancement on demand.

AI.tldr: CR-Diff通过剪枝扩散模型参数来改善跨分辨率视觉一致性，解决了UNet模型在训练分辨率外生成质量下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在固定分辨率训练后，在训练分辨率外生成图像时质量会下降。这源于分辨率依赖的参数行为——在默认分辨率下表现良好的权重在空间尺度变化时会变得不利，削弱语义对齐并导致UNet结构不稳定。
AI.method: CR-Diff采用两阶段方法：首先进行块级剪枝，选择性消除不利权重；然后进行剪枝输出放大，进一步纯化剪枝后的预测结果。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CR-Diff能够提高各种扩散模型主干和未见分辨率下的感知保真度和语义连贯性，同时很大程度上保留在默认分辨率下的性能。此外，CR-Diff支持特定提示的细化，可按需增强质量。
AI.conclusion: CR-Diff通过参数剪枝有效解决了扩散模型跨分辨率生成的一致性问题，在保持默认分辨率性能的同时显著提升了未见分辨率的生成质量。

title: SignalClaw: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Synthesis of Interpretable Traffic Signal Control Skills
summary: Traffic signal control TSC requires strategies that are both effective and interpretable for deployment, yet reinforcement learning produces opaque neural policies while program synthesis depends on restrictive domain-specific languages. We present SIGNALCLAW, a framework that uses large language models LLMs as evolutionary skill generators to synthesize and refine interpretable control skills for adaptive TSC. Each skill includes rationale, selection guidance, and executable code, making policies human-inspectable and self-documenting. At each generation, evolution signals from simulation metrics such as queue percentiles, delay trends, and stagnation are translated into natural language feedback to guide improvement. SignalClaw also introduces event-driven compositional evolution: an event detector identifies emergency vehicles, transit priority, incidents, and congestion via TraCI, and a priority dispatcher selects specialized skills. Each skill is evolved independently, and a priority chain enables runtime composition without retraining. We evaluate SignalClaw on routine and event-injected SUMO scenarios against four baselines. On routine scenarios, it achieves average delay of 7.8 to 9.2 seconds, within 3 to 10 percent of the best method, with low variance across random seeds. Under event scenarios, it yields the lowest emergency delay 11.2 to 18.5 seconds versus 42.3 to 72.3 for MaxPressure and 78.5 to 95.3 for DQN, and the lowest transit person delay 9.8 to 11.5 seconds versus 38.7 to 45.2 for MaxPressure. In mixed events, the dispatcher composes skills effectively while maintaining stable overall delay. The evolved skills progress from simple linear rules to conditional strategies with multi-feature interactions, while remaining fully interpretable and directly modifiable by traffic engineers.

AI.tldr: SIGNALCLAW使用大语言模型作为进化技能生成器，为自适应交通信号控制合成可解释的控制技能，通过事件驱动的组合进化实现实时技能组合，在常规和事件场景中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 交通信号控制需要既有效又可解释的策略，但强化学习产生不透明的神经网络策略，而程序合成依赖于限制性的领域特定语言。需要一种既能保持可解释性又能有效处理复杂交通场景的方法。
AI.method: SIGNALCLAW框架使用大语言模型作为进化技能生成器，合成包含原理、选择指导和可执行代码的可解释控制技能。采用事件驱动的组合进化：事件检测器识别紧急车辆、公交优先、事故和拥堵，优先级调度器选择专门技能。每个技能独立进化，优先级链实现运行时组合而无需重新训练。
