AI.result: 在常规场景中，平均延迟为7.8-9.2秒，与最佳方法相差3-10%，随机种子间方差低。在事件场景中，紧急延迟最低（11.2-18.5秒 vs MaxPressure的42.3-72.3秒和DQN的78.5-95.3秒），公交人员延迟最低（9.8-11.5秒 vs MaxPressure的38.7-45.2秒）。混合事件中调度器能有效组合技能并保持总体延迟稳定。
AI.conclusion: SIGNALCLAW成功合成了从简单线性规则到具有多特征交互的条件策略的可解释技能，保持完全可解释性且交通工程师可直接修改，为交通信号控制提供了有效且可解释的解决方案。

title: Prior-guided Fusion of Multimodal Features for Change Detection from Optical-SAR Images
summary: Multimodal change detection (MMCD) identifies changed areas in multimodal remote sensing (RS) data, demonstrating significant application value in land use monitoring, disaster assessment, and urban sustainable development. However, literature MMCD approaches exhibit limitations in cross-modal interaction and exploiting modality-specific characteristics. This leads to insufficient modeling of fine-grained change information, thus hindering the precise detection of semantic changes in multimodal data. To address the above problems, we propose STSF-Net, a framework designed for MMCD between optical and SAR images. STSF-Net jointly models modality-specific and spatio-temporal common features to enhance change representations. Specifically, modality-specific features are exploited to capture genuine semantic change signals, while spatio-temporal common features are embedded to suppress pseudo-changes caused by differences in imaging mechanisms. Furthermore, we introduce an optical and SAR feature fusion strategy that adaptively adjusts feature importance based on semantic priors obtained from pre-trained foundational models, enabling semantic-guided adaptive fusion of multi-modal information. In addition, we introduce the Delta-SN6 dataset, the first openly-accessible multiclass MMCD benchmark consisting of very-high-resolution (VHR) fully polarimetric SAR and optical images. Experimental results on Delta-SN6, BRIGHT, and Wuhan-Het datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 3.21%, 1.08%, and 1.32% in mIoU, respectively. The associated code and Delta-SN6 dataset will be released at: https://github.com/liuxuanguang/STSF-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出STSF-Net用于光学与SAR图像的多模态变化检测，通过联合建模模态特定特征和时空共同特征来增强变化表示，并引入语义引导的自适应融合策略，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态变化检测方法在跨模态交互和利用模态特定特征方面存在局限，导致对细粒度变化信息建模不足，阻碍了多模态数据中语义变化的精确检测。
AI.method: 提出STSF-Net框架，联合建模模态特定特征和时空共同特征；引入光学和SAR特征融合策略，基于预训练基础模型获得的语义先验自适应调整特征重要性；创建Delta-SN6数据集作为首个公开可用的多类多模态变化检测基准。
AI.result: 在Delta-SN6、BRIGHT和Wuhan-Het数据集上，STSF-Net在mIoU指标上分别比现有最佳方法提升3.21%、1.08%和1.32%。
AI.conclusion: STSF-Net通过有效建模模态特定特征和时空共同特征，结合语义引导的自适应融合策略，显著提升了多模态变化检测的性能，为解决光学与SAR图像变化检测问题提供了有效方案。

title: A canonical generalization of OBDD
summary: We introduce Tree Decision Diagrams (TDD) as a model for Boolean functions that generalizes OBDD. They can be seen as a restriction of structured d-DNNF; that is, d-DNNF that respect a vtree $T$. We show that TDDs enjoy the same tractability properties as OBDD, such as model counting, enumeration, conditioning, and apply, and are more succinct. In particular, we show that CNF formulas of treewidth $k$ can be represented by TDDs of FPT size, which is known to be impossible for OBDD. We study the complexity of compiling CNF formulas into deterministic TDDs via bottom-up compilation and relate the complexity of this approach with the notion of factor width introduced by Bova and Szeider.

AI.tldr: TDD是布尔函数的新模型，比OBDD更通用但保持相同可处理性，能更紧凑地表示树宽受限的CNF公式
AI.motivation: OBDD虽然具有多项式时间的模型计数、枚举等可处理性，但表达能力有限，无法紧凑表示树宽受限的CNF公式。需要一种既保持OBDD可处理性又更强大的表示模型
AI.method: 提出Tree Decision Diagrams (TDD)作为布尔函数模型，它是结构化d-DNNF的限制形式，尊重vtree T。研究自底向上编译CNF公式为确定性TDD的复杂度，并与Bova和Szeider提出的因子宽度概念关联
AI.result: TDD保持OBDD的所有可处理性（模型计数、枚举、条件化、应用），但更紧凑。特别地，树宽为k的CNF公式可以用FPT大小的TDD表示，而这对OBDD是不可能的
AI.conclusion: TDD是OBDD的有力推广，在保持相同可处理性的同时显著增强了表达能力，为处理树宽受限的CNF公式提供了新工具

title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement
summary: We present a neurosymbolic approach, i.e., combining symbolic and subsymbolic artificial intelligence, to validating offer documents in regulated public institutions. We employ a language model to extract information and then aggregate with an LTN (Logic Tensor Network) to make an auditable decision. In regulated public institutions, decisions must be made in a manner that is both factually correct and legally verifiable. Our neurosymbolic approach allows existing domain-specific knowledge to be linked to the semantic text understanding of language models. The decisions resulting from our pipeline can be justified by predicate values, rule truth values, and corresponding text passages, which enables rule checking based on a real corpus of offer documents. Our experiments on a real corpus show that the proposed pipeline achieves performance comparable to existing models, while its key advantage lies in its interpretability, modular predicate extraction, and explicit support for XAI (Explainable AI).

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经符号方法，结合符号与亚符号人工智能，用于验证受监管公共机构的报价文件，通过语言模型提取信息并用逻辑张量网络进行可审计决策。
AI.motivation: 在受监管的公共机构中，决策必须既事实正确又法律可验证，需要将领域特定知识与语言模型的语义理解相结合，实现可解释的决策过程。
AI.method: 使用语言模型提取信息，然后通过逻辑张量网络（LTN）进行聚合，形成可审计的决策。该方法将领域知识与语言模型的语义理解相连接，决策可通过谓词值、规则真值和相应文本段落进行验证。
AI.result: 在真实报价文件语料库上的实验表明，该管道性能与现有模型相当，主要优势在于其可解释性、模块化谓词提取以及对可解释人工智能的明确支持。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法为受监管环境中的文档验证提供了可解释、可审计的解决方案，将语言模型的语义理解与符号推理相结合，实现了事实正确性和法律可验证性的平衡。

title: Controlling Distributional Bias in Multi-Round LLM Generation via KL-Optimized Fine-Tuning
summary: While the real world is inherently stochastic, Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly evaluated on single-round inference against fixed ground truths. In this work, we shift the lens to distribution alignment: assessing whether LLMs, when prompted repeatedly, can generate outputs that adhere to a desired target distribution, e.g. reflecting real-world statistics or a uniform distribution. We formulate distribution alignment using the attributes of gender, race, and sentiment within occupational contexts. Our empirical analysis reveals that off-the-shelf LLMs and standard alignment techniques, including prompt engineering and Direct Preference Optimization, fail to reliably control output distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel fine-tuning framework that couples Steering Token Calibration with Semantic Alignment. We introduce a hybrid objective function combining Kullback-Leibler divergence to anchor the probability mass of latent steering tokens and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization to bind these tokens to semantically consistent responses. Experiments across six diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baselines, achieving precise distributional control in attribute generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的微调框架，通过结合引导令牌校准和语义对齐，使大型语言模型能够生成符合目标分布的输出，解决了现有方法在分布对齐任务上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现实世界本质上是随机的，但当前大型语言模型主要针对单轮推理和固定真实值进行评估。本文旨在评估LLM在重复提示下是否能生成符合期望目标分布的输出，如反映真实世界统计或均匀分布。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的微调框架，结合引导令牌校准与语义对齐。引入混合目标函数：使用KL散度锚定潜在引导令牌的概率质量，并使用Kahneman-Tversky优化将这些令牌绑定到语义一致的响应。
AI.result: 在六个不同数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于基线模型，在属性生成任务中实现了精确的分布控制。
AI.conclusion: 现成的LLM和标准对齐技术（包括提示工程和直接偏好优化）无法可靠地控制输出分布。提出的框架通过引导令牌校准和语义对齐，成功实现了对LLM输出分布的精确控制。

title: Evaluation Before Generation: A Paradigm for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
summary: The missing modality problem poses a fundamental challenge in multimodal sentiment analysis, significantly degrading model accuracy and generalization in real world scenarios. Existing approaches primarily improve robustness through prompt learning and pre trained models. However, two limitations remain. First, the necessity of generating missing modalities lacks rigorous evaluation. Second, the structural dependencies among multimodal prompts and their global coherence are insufficiently explored. To address these issues, a Prompt based Missing Modality Adaptation framework is proposed. A Missing Modality Evaluator is introduced at the input stage to dynamically assess the importance of missing modalities using pretrained models and pseudo labels, thereby avoiding low quality data imputation. Building on this, a Modality invariant Prompt Disentanglement module decomposes shared prompts into modality specific private prompts to capture intrinsic local correlations and improve representation quality. In addition, a Dynamic Prompt Weighting module computes mutual information based weights from cross attention outputs to adaptively suppress interference from missing modalities. To enhance global consistency, a Multi level Prompt Dynamic Connection module integrates shared prompts with self attention outputs through residual connections, leveraging global prompt priors to strengthen key guidance features. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, including CMU MOSI, CMU MOSEI, and CH SIMS, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves state of the art performance and stable results under diverse missing modality settings. The implementation is available at https://github.com/rongfei-chen/ProMMA

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt-based Missing Modality Adaptation框架，通过缺失模态评估器、模态不变提示解缠、动态提示加权和多级提示动态连接模块，解决多模态情感分析中的模态缺失问题，在三个公开基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中模态缺失问题严重降低模型准确性和泛化能力。现有方法主要通过提示学习和预训练模型提高鲁棒性，但存在两个局限：1) 缺失模态生成缺乏严格评估；2) 多模态提示间的结构依赖性和全局一致性探索不足。
AI.method: 提出ProMMA框架：1) 缺失模态评估器在输入阶段动态评估缺失模态重要性，避免低质量数据填补；2) 模态不变提示解缠模块将共享提示分解为模态特定私有提示，捕捉内在局部相关性；3) 动态提示加权模块基于互信息权重自适应抑制缺失模态干扰；4) 多级提示动态连接模块通过残差连接整合共享提示与自注意力输出，增强全局一致性。
AI.result: 在CMU MOSI、CMU MOSEI和CH-SIMS三个公开基准上的大量实验表明，该框架在不同缺失模态设置下实现了最先进的性能和稳定结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出的ProMMA框架有效解决了多模态情感分析中的模态缺失问题，通过动态评估、提示解缠、自适应加权和全局连接机制，显著提升了模型在真实场景中的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: COSMO-Agent: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration
summary: Iterative industrial design-simulation optimization is bottlenecked by the CAD-CAE semantic gap: translating simulation feedback into valid geometric edits under diverse, coupled constraints. To fill this gap, we propose COSMO-Agent (Closed-loop Optimization, Simulation, and Modeling Orchestration), a tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) framework that teaches LLMs to complete the closed-loop CAD-CAE process. Specifically, we cast CAD generation, CAE solving, result parsing, and geometry revision as an interactive RL environment, where an LLM learns to orchestrate external tools and revise parametric geometries until constraints are satisfied. To make this learning stable and industrially usable, we design a multi-constraint reward that jointly encourages feasibility, toolchain robustness, and structured output validity. In addition, we contribute an industry-aligned dataset that covers 25 component categories with executable CAD-CAE tasks to support realistic training and evaluation. Experiments show that COSMO-Agent training substantially improves small open-source LLMs for constraint-driven design, exceeding large open-source and strong closed-source models in feasibility, efficiency, and stability.

AI.tldr: COSMO-Agent是一个基于工具增强强化学习的框架，通过教导LLM完成闭环CAD-CAE流程来弥合工业设计与仿真之间的语义鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 工业设计-仿真迭代优化受限于CAD-CAE语义鸿沟：将仿真反馈转化为符合多种耦合约束的有效几何编辑。现有方法难以自动完成这一闭环过程。
AI.method: 将CAD生成、CAE求解、结果解析和几何修订构建为交互式RL环境，让LLM学习协调外部工具并修订参数化几何直到满足约束。设计了多约束奖励函数，同时鼓励可行性、工具链鲁棒性和结构化输出有效性。
AI.result: COSMO-Agent训练显著提升了小型开源LLM在约束驱动设计方面的能力，在可行性、效率和稳定性方面超越了大型开源模型和强大的闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: COSMO-Agent框架成功弥合了CAD-CAE语义鸿沟，通过工具增强的RL方法使LLM能够自主完成工业设计优化闭环，为实际工业应用提供了可行解决方案。

title: Identifying Influential N-grams in Confidence Calibration via Regression Analysis
summary: While large language models (LLMs) improve performance by explicit reasoning, their responses are often overconfident, even though they include linguistic expressions demonstrating uncertainty. In this work, we identify what linguistic expressions are related to confidence by applying the regression method. Specifically, we predict confidence of those linguistic expressions in the reasoning parts of LLMs as the dependent variables and analyze the relationship between a specific $n$-gram and confidence. Across multiple models and QA benchmarks, we show that LLMs remain overconfident when reasoning is involved and attribute this behavior to specific linguistic information. Interestingly, several of the extracted expressions coincide with cue phrases intentionally inserted on test-time scaling to improve reasoning performance. Through our test on causality and verification that the extracted linguistic information truly affects confidence, we reveal that confidence calibration is possible by simply suppressing those overconfident expressions without drops in performance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在推理过程中存在过度自信问题，通过回归分析识别出与置信度相关的特定语言表达，并发现可以通过抑制这些过度自信表达来实现置信度校准而不影响性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理过程中常常表现出过度自信，即使它们的回答中包含表示不确定性的语言表达。本研究旨在识别哪些语言表达与模型的置信度相关，并理解这种过度自信行为的根源。
AI.method: 采用回归分析方法，将语言模型推理部分中特定n-gram的置信度作为因变量，分析特定语言表达与置信度之间的关系。研究在多个模型和问答基准上进行，并通过因果性测试验证提取的语言信息是否真正影响置信度。
AI.result: 研究发现大语言模型在涉及推理时仍然保持过度自信，并将这种行为归因于特定的语言信息。有趣的是，一些提取的表达与测试时扩展中故意插入的提示短语重合，这些短语原本是为了提高推理性能。通过抑制这些过度自信的表达，可以在不降低性能的情况下实现置信度校准。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过简单地抑制那些过度自信的语言表达，可以实现大语言模型的置信度校准，同时保持性能不变。这一发现为改进语言模型的可靠性提供了新的途径。

title: Physics-Aligned Spectral Mamba: Decoupling Semantics and Dynamics for Few-Shot Hyperspectral Target Detection
summary: Meta-learning facilitates few-shot hyperspectral target detection (HTD), but adapting deep backbones remains challenging. Full-parameter fine-tuning is inefficient and prone to overfitting, and existing methods largely ignore the frequency-domain structure and spectral band continuity of hyperspectral data, limiting spectral adaptation and cross-domain generalization.To address these challenges, we propose SpecMamba, a parameter-efficient and frequency-aware framework that decouples stable semantic representation from agile spectral adaptation. Specifically, we introduce a Discrete Cosine Transform Mamba Adapter (DCTMA) on top of frozen Transformer representations. By projecting spectral features into the frequency domain via DCT and leveraging Mamba's linear-complexity state-space recursion, DCTMA explicitly captures global spectral dependencies and band continuity while avoiding the redundancy of full fine-tuning. Furthermore, to address prototype drift caused by limited sample sizes, we design a Prior-Guided Tri-Encoder (PGTE) that allows laboratory spectral priors to guide the optimization of the learnable adapter without disrupting the stable semantic feature space. Finally, a Self-Supervised Pseudo-Label Mapping (SSPLM) strategy is developed for test-time adaptation, enabling efficient decision boundary refinement through uncertainty-aware sampling and dual-path consistency constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that SpecMamba consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in detection accuracy and cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: SpecMamba：一种参数高效、频率感知的元学习框架，用于少样本高光谱目标检测，通过解耦稳定语义表示和灵活光谱适应，在多个数据集上实现最先进的检测精度和跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前元学习方法在高光谱目标检测中存在两个主要问题：1）全参数微调效率低下且容易过拟合；2）现有方法忽略了高光谱数据的频域结构和光谱带连续性，限制了光谱适应和跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出SpecMamba框架，包含三个核心组件：1）离散余弦变换Mamba适配器（DCTMA），通过DCT将光谱特征投影到频域，利用Mamba的线性复杂度状态空间递归捕获全局光谱依赖性和带连续性；2）先验引导三编码器（PGTE），利用实验室光谱先验指导可学习适配器的优化；3）自监督伪标签映射（SSPLM），通过不确定性感知采样和双路径一致性约束实现测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在多个公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，SpecMamba在检测精度和跨域泛化方面持续优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: SpecMamba通过参数高效的频域适应策略，成功解决了少样本高光谱目标检测中的过拟合和泛化问题，为高光谱分析提供了有效的元学习解决方案。

title: ResearchEVO: An End-to-End Framework for Automated Scientific Discovery and Documentation
summary: An important recurring pattern in scientific breakthroughs is a two-stage process: an initial phase of undirected experimentation that yields an unexpected finding, followed by a retrospective phase that explains why the finding works and situates it within existing theory. We present ResearchEVO, an end-to-end framework that computationally instantiates this discover-then-explain paradigm. The Evolution Phase employs LLM-guided bi-dimensional co-evolution -- simultaneously optimizing both algorithmic logic and overall architecture -- to search the space of code implementations purely by fitness, without requiring any understanding of the solutions it produces. The Writing Phase then takes the best-performing algorithm and autonomously generates a complete, publication-ready research paper through sentence-level retrieval-augmented generation with explicit anti-hallucination verification and automated experiment design. To our knowledge, ResearchEVO is the first system to cover this full pipeline end to end: no prior work jointly performs principled algorithm evolution and literature-grounded scientific documentation. We validate the framework on two cross-disciplinary scientific problems -- Quantum Error Correction using real Google quantum hardware data, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks -- where the Evolution Phase discovered human-interpretable algorithmic mechanisms that had not been previously proposed in the respective domain literatures. In both cases, the Writing Phase autonomously produced compilable LaTeX manuscripts that correctly grounded these blind discoveries in existing theory via RAG, with zero fabricated citations.

AI.tldr: ResearchEVO是一个端到端框架，通过LLM引导的双维协同进化（算法逻辑和架构）进行无指导探索，然后通过检索增强生成自动撰写完整的研究论文，实现"先发现后解释"的科研范式。
AI.motivation: 科学突破通常遵循"先实验发现后理论解释"的两阶段模式，但现有系统无法完整覆盖这一流程。研究旨在开发一个能够自动实现从算法发现到论文撰写的完整科研管道。
AI.method: 1. 进化阶段：使用LLM引导的双维协同进化，同时优化算法逻辑和整体架构，仅基于适应度搜索代码实现空间；2. 撰写阶段：通过句子级检索增强生成，结合显式反幻觉验证和自动实验设计，生成可发表的完整研究论文。
AI.result: 在量子纠错（使用Google量子硬件数据）和物理信息神经网络两个跨学科问题上，进化阶段发现了领域文献中未提出的人类可解释算法机制，撰写阶段生成了可编译的LaTeX稿件，通过RAG正确地将这些发现与现有理论关联，且无伪造引用。
AI.conclusion: ResearchEVO是首个覆盖从算法进化到科学文档生成完整管道的系统，成功实现了"先发现后解释"的科研范式，为自动化科学研究提供了新途径。

title: PhageBench: Can LLMs Understand Raw Bacteriophage Genomes?
summary: Bacteriophages, often referred to as the dark matter of the biosphere, play a critical role in regulating microbial ecosystems and in antibiotic alternatives. Thus, accurate interpretation of their genomes holds significant scientific and practical value. While general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at understanding biological texts, their ability to directly interpret raw nucleotide sequences and perform biological reasoning remains underexplored. To address this, we introduce PhageBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate phage genome understanding by mirroring the workflow of bioinformatics experts. The dataset contains 5,600 high-quality samples covering five core tasks across three stages: Screening, Quality Control, and Phenotype Annotation. Our evaluation of eight LLMs reveals that general-purpose reasoning models significantly outperform random baselines in phage contig identification and host prediction, demonstrating promising potential for genomic understanding. However, they exhibit significant limitations in complex reasoning tasks involving long-range dependencies and fine-grained functional localization. These findings highlight the necessity of developing next-generation models with enhanced reasoning capabilities for biological sequences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了PhageBench基准测试，用于评估大语言模型对噬菌体基因组的理解能力，发现通用推理模型在噬菌体基因组识别和宿主预测方面表现良好，但在复杂推理任务中存在局限。
AI.motivation: 噬菌体作为生物圈的"暗物质"，在调节微生物生态系统和抗生素替代方面具有关键作用。虽然通用大语言模型在理解生物文本方面表现出色，但其直接解释原始核苷酸序列和进行生物推理的能力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 研究人员引入了PhageBench基准测试，这是首个专门评估噬菌体基因组理解的基准。数据集包含5,600个高质量样本，涵盖筛选、质量控制和表型注释三个阶段的五个核心任务。评估了八个大语言模型。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，通用推理模型在噬菌体contig识别和宿主预测方面显著优于随机基线，显示出基因组理解的潜力。但在涉及长距离依赖和细粒度功能定位的复杂推理任务中存在显著局限性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了开发具有增强推理能力的下一代模型对于生物序列分析的必要性。PhageBench为评估和改进大语言模型在基因组理解方面的能力提供了重要基准。

title: High-Resolution Single-Shot Polarimetric Imaging Made Easy
summary: Polarization-based vision has gained increasing attention for providing richer physical cues beyond RGB images. While achieving single-shot capture is highly desirable for practical applications, existing Division-of-Focal-Plane (DoFP) sensors inherently suffer from reduced spatial resolution and artifacts due to their spatial multiplexing mechanism. To overcome these limitations without sacrificing the snapshot capability, we propose EasyPolar, a multi-view polarimetric imaging framework. Our system is grounded in the physical insight that three independent intensity measurements are sufficient to fully characterize linear polarization. Guided by this, we design a triple-camera setup consisting of three synchronized RGB cameras that capture one unpolarized view and two polarized views with distinct orientations. Building upon this hardware design, we further propose a confidence-guided polarization reconstruction network to address the potential misalignment in multi-view fusion. The network performs multi-modal feature fusion under a confidence-aware physical guidance mechanism, which effectively suppresses warping-induced artifacts and enforces explicit geometric constraints on the solution space. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves high-quality results and benefits various downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: EasyPolar：一种多视角偏振成像框架，使用三个同步RGB相机（一个无偏振和两个不同方向的偏振视图）实现单次拍摄的高质量偏振成像，避免传统DoFP传感器的分辨率损失和伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 基于偏振的视觉能提供超越RGB图像的丰富物理线索，但现有的分焦平面(DoFP)传感器由于空间复用机制导致空间分辨率降低和伪影问题。需要在保持单次拍摄能力的同时克服这些限制。
AI.method: 1. 基于物理洞察：三个独立的强度测量足以完全表征线性偏振；2. 硬件设计：三相机系统（三个同步RGB相机，分别捕获无偏振视图和两个不同方向的偏振视图）；3. 算法：置信度引导的偏振重建网络，通过置信感知物理引导机制进行多模态特征融合，抑制扭曲伪影并在解空间上施加显式几何约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该方法能实现高质量结果，并有益于各种下游任务。
AI.conclusion: EasyPolar框架通过多视角偏振成像解决了传统DoFP传感器的局限性，在保持单次拍摄能力的同时实现了高质量的偏振重建，为实际应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Label Effects: Shared Heuristic Reliance in Trust Assessment by Humans and LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators (LLM-as-a-Judge). This work challenges its reliability by showing that trust judgments by LLMs are biased by disclosed source labels. Using a counterfactual design, we find that both humans and LLM judges assign higher trust to information labeled as human-authored than to the same content labeled as AI-generated. Eye-tracking data reveal that humans rely heavily on source labels as heuristic cues for judgments. We analyze LLM internal states during judgment. Across label conditions, models allocate denser attention to the label region than the content region, and this label dominance is stronger under Human labels than AI labels, consistent with the human gaze patterns. Besides, decision uncertainty measured by logits is higher under AI labels than Human labels. These results indicate that the source label is a salient heuristic cue for both humans and LLMs. It raises validity concerns for label-sensitive LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, and we cautiously raise that aligning models with human preferences may propagate human heuristic reliance into models, motivating debiased evaluation and alignment.

AI.tldr: 研究发现人类和LLM评估者在判断信息可信度时都受到来源标签的偏见影响，将标注为"人类创作"的内容评为比相同内容标注为"AI生成"时更高的可信度
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被用作自动化评估者（LLM-as-a-Judge），本研究旨在挑战其可靠性，探究来源标签是否会导致评估偏见
AI.method: 采用反事实设计，比较相同内容在不同来源标签（人类创作 vs AI生成）下的可信度评估；使用眼动追踪分析人类评估者的注意力模式；分析LLM在评估过程中的内部状态，包括注意力分配和决策不确定性
AI.result: 人类和LLM评估者都对标注为人类创作的内容给予更高信任度；眼动数据显示人类严重依赖来源标签作为启发式线索；LLM内部状态分析显示模型在不同标签条件下对标签区域的注意力密度高于内容区域，且这种标签主导效应在人类标签条件下更强；AI标签条件下的决策不确定性高于人类标签条件
AI.conclusion: 来源标签是人类和LLM评估者的显著启发式线索，这对标签敏感的LLM-as-a-Judge评估的有效性提出了质疑，表明将模型与人类偏好对齐可能会将人类的启发式依赖传播到模型中，需要去偏评估和对齐方法

title: What Models Know, How Well They Know It: Knowledge-Weighted Fine-Tuning for Learning When to Say "I Don't Know"
summary: While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across diverse user queries, they still suffer from hallucinations, often arising from knowledge misalignment between pre-training and fine-tuning. To address this misalignment, we reliably estimate a fine-grained, instance-level knowledge score via multi-sampled inference. Using the knowledge score, we scale the learning signal according to the model's existing knowledge, while encouraging explicit "I don't know" responses for out-of-scope queries. Experimental results show that this approach allows the model to explicitly express uncertainty when it lacks knowledge, while maintaining accuracy on questions it can answer. Furthermore, we propose evaluation metrics for uncertainty, showing that accurate discrimination between known and unknown instances consistently improves performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过多采样推理估计细粒度实例级知识分数，根据模型已有知识调整学习信号，鼓励对超出范围的问题明确回答"我不知道"，从而减少幻觉并提高不确定性表达
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能力强大，但仍存在幻觉问题，这主要源于预训练和微调之间的知识不对齐。需要解决这种不对齐，让模型能够明确表达不确定性
AI.method: 通过多采样推理可靠地估计细粒度的实例级知识分数，根据模型已有知识调整学习信号，鼓励对超出范围的问题明确回答"我不知道"
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法使模型在缺乏知识时能够明确表达不确定性，同时保持对能够回答问题的准确性。提出的不确定性评估指标显示，准确区分已知和未知实例能持续提升性能
AI.conclusion: 通过知识分数调整学习信号的方法有效减少了幻觉问题，使模型能够更好地表达不确定性，在已知和未知问题之间实现更好的平衡

title: WRF4CIR: Weight-Regularized Fine-Tuning Network for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) task aims to retrieve target images based on reference images and modification texts. Current CIR methods primarily rely on fine-tuning vision-language pre-trained models. However, we find that these approaches commonly suffer from severe overfitting, posing challenges for CIR with limited triplet data. To better understand this issue, we present a systematic study of overfitting in VLP-based CIR, revealing a significant and previously overlooked generalization gap across different models and datasets. Motivated by these findings, we introduce WRF4CIR, a Weight-Regularized Fine-tuning network for CIR. Specifically, during the fine-tuning process, we apply adversarial perturbations to the model weights for regularization, where these perturbations are generated in the opposite direction of gradient descent. Intuitively, WRF4CIR increases the difficulty of fitting the training data, which helps mitigate overfitting in CIR under limited triplet supervision. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that WRF4CIR significantly narrows the generalization gap and achieves substantial improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WRF4CIR方法，通过权重正则化微调解决基于视觉语言预训练模型的组合图像检索中的过拟合问题，显著缩小泛化差距。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视觉语言预训练模型的组合图像检索方法普遍存在严重过拟合问题，特别是在有限的三元组数据下，这限制了CIR的性能。作者通过系统研究发现不同模型和数据集之间存在显著的泛化差距。
AI.method: 提出WRF4CIR（Weight-Regularized Fine-tuning network for CIR），在微调过程中对模型权重施加对抗性扰动进行正则化。这些扰动在梯度下降的相反方向生成，增加训练数据拟合难度，从而缓解有限三元组监督下的过拟合。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，WRF4CIR显著缩小了泛化差距，相比现有方法取得了实质性改进。
AI.conclusion: WRF4CIR通过权重正则化微调有效解决了CIR中的过拟合问题，提高了模型在有限数据下的泛化能力，为基于视觉语言预训练模型的组合图像检索提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: Beyond Behavior: Why AI Evaluation Needs a Cognitive Revolution
summary: In 1950, Alan Turing proposed replacing the question "Can machines think?" with a behavioral test: if a machine's outputs are indistinguishable from those of a thinking being, the question of whether it truly thinks can be set aside. This paper argues that Turing's move was not only a pragmatic simplification but also an epistemological commitment, a decision about what kind of evidence counts as relevant to intelligence attribution, and that this commitment has quietly constrained AI research for seven decades. We trace how Turing's behavioral epistemology became embedded in the field's evaluative infrastructure, rendering unaskable a class of questions about process, mechanism, and internal organization that cognitive psychology, neuroscience, and related disciplines learned to ask. We draw a structural parallel to the behaviorist-to-cognitivist transition in psychology: just as psychology's commitment to studying only observable behavior prevented it from asking productive questions about internal mental processes until that commitment was abandoned, AI's commitment to behavioral evaluation prevents it from distinguishing between systems that achieve identical outputs through fundamentally different computational processes, a distinction on which intelligence attribution depends. We argue that the field requires an epistemological transition comparable to the cognitive revolution: not an abandonment of behavioral evidence, but a recognition that behavioral evidence alone is insufficient for the construct claims the field wishes to make. We articulate what a post-behaviorist epistemology for AI would involve and identify the specific questions it would make askable that the field currently has no way to ask.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为图灵的行为主义测试不仅是一种实用简化，更是一种认识论承诺，这种承诺限制了AI研究70年，使其无法探究智能的内部过程和机制，需要类似心理学从行为主义到认知主义的认识论转变。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在揭示图灵测试背后的认识论承诺如何长期约束AI研究，使其无法探究智能的内部机制和计算过程，从而限制了该领域的理论发展。
AI.method: 通过历史分析追溯图灵行为主义认识论在AI评估体系中的嵌入过程，并与心理学从行为主义到认知主义的转变进行结构类比，提出AI需要类似的认识论转型。
AI.result: 识别出AI领域因行为主义认识论而无法提出的关键问题类别，特别是关于过程、机制和内部组织的问题，这些是区分不同计算过程实现相同输出的智能系统的核心。
AI.conclusion: AI需要从行为主义认识论转向后行为主义认识论，不是完全抛弃行为证据，而是认识到仅凭行为证据不足以支持该领域想要做出的建构性主张，从而开启对智能内部机制的研究。

title: Purify-then-Align: Towards Robust Human Sensing under Modality Missing with Knowledge Distillation from Noisy Multimodal Teacher
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026 Workshop On Any-to-Any Multimodal Learning
summary: Robust multimodal human sensing must overcome the critical challenge of missing modalities. Two principal barriers are the Representation Gap between heterogeneous data and the Contamination Effect from low-quality modalities. These barriers are causally linked, as the corruption introduced by contamination fundamentally impedes the reduction of representation disparities. In this paper, we propose PTA, a novel "Purify-then-Align" framework that solves this causal dependency through a synergistic integration of meta-learning and knowledge diffusion. To purify the knowledge source, PTA first employs a meta-learning-driven weighting mechanism that dynamically learns to down-weight the influence of noisy, low-contributing modalities. Subsequently, to align different modalities, PTA introduces a diffusion-based knowledge distillation paradigm in which an information-rich clean teacher, formed from this purified consensus, refines the features of each student modality. The ultimate payoff of this "Purify-then-Align" strategy is the creation of exceptionally powerful single-modality encoders imbued with cross-modal knowledge. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale MM-Fi and XRF55 datasets, under pronounced Representation Gap and Contamination Effect, demonstrate that PTA achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly improves the robustness of single-modality models in diverse missing-modality scenarios.

AI.tldr: PTA提出"净化-对齐"框架，通过元学习降噪和扩散知识蒸馏解决多模态缺失问题，提升单模态编码器性能
AI.motivation: 多模态感知面临缺失模态的挑战，主要障碍是异构数据间的表示差距和低质量模态的污染效应，这些障碍存在因果关联
AI.method: 提出PTA框架：1) 元学习驱动的权重机制动态降低噪声模态影响；2) 扩散知识蒸馏范式，用净化后的教师模型精炼各学生模态特征
AI.result: 在MM-Fi和XRF55数据集上，在显著表示差距和污染效应下，PTA达到最先进性能，显著提升单模态模型在多种缺失模态场景中的鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: PTA的"净化-对齐"策略通过协同整合元学习和知识扩散，有效解决多模态缺失问题，创建了具有跨模态知识的强大单模态编码器

title: PECKER: A Precisely Efficient Critical Knowledge Erasure Recipe For Machine Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) has become a critical technique for GenAI models' safe and compliant operation. While existing MU methods are effective, most impose prohibitive training time and computational overhead. Our analysis suggests the root cause lies in poorly directed gradient updates, which reduce training efficiency and destabilize convergence. To mitigate these issues, we propose PECKER, an efficient MU approach that matches or outperforms prevailing methods. Within a distillation framework, PECKER introduces a saliency mask to prioritize updates to parameters that contribute most to forgetting the targeted data, thereby reducing unnecessary gradient computation and shortening overall training time without sacrificing unlearning efficacy. Our method generates samples that unlearn related class or concept more quickly, while closely aligning with the true image distribution on CIFAR-10 and STL-10 datasets, achieving shorter training times for both class forgetting and concept forgetting.

AI.tldr: PECKER是一种高效的机器遗忘方法，通过引入显著性掩码优先更新对遗忘目标数据贡献最大的参数，减少不必要的梯度计算，缩短训练时间，同时保持遗忘效果。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法虽然有效，但训练时间和计算开销过高。分析发现根本原因在于梯度更新方向不佳，降低了训练效率并导致收敛不稳定。
AI.method: 在蒸馏框架中引入显著性掩码，优先更新对遗忘目标数据贡献最大的参数，减少不必要的梯度计算，缩短总体训练时间而不牺牲遗忘效果。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和STL-10数据集上，PECKER能够更快地生成遗忘相关类别或概念的样本，同时与真实图像分布紧密对齐，在类别遗忘和概念遗忘任务上都实现了更短的训练时间。
AI.conclusion: PECKER是一种高效的机器遗忘方法，能够匹配或超越现有方法，通过优化梯度更新方向显著减少训练时间和计算开销，同时保持遗忘效果。

title: CLEAR: Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Alignment via Reverse-training
summary: Existing multilingual embedding models often encounter challenges in cross-lingual scenarios due to imbalanced linguistic resources and less consideration of cross-lingual alignment during training. Although standardized contrastive learning approaches for cross-lingual adaptation are widely adopted, they may struggle to capture fundamental alignment between languages and degrade performance in well-aligned languages such as English. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Retrieval via Reverse-training (CLEAR), a novel loss function utilizing a reverse training scheme to improve retrieval performance across diverse cross-lingual retrieval scenarios. CLEAR leverages an English passage as a bridge to strengthen alignments between the target language and English, ensuring robust performance in the cross-lingual retrieval task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR achieves notable improvements in cross-lingual scenarios, with gains up to 15%, particularly in low-resource languages, while minimizing performance degradation in English. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CLEAR offers promising effectiveness even in multilingual training, suggesting its potential for broad application and scalability. We release the code at https://github.com/dltmddbs100/CLEAR.

AI.tldr: CLEAR提出了一种新的损失函数，通过反向训练方案增强跨语言检索性能，特别是在低资源语言上提升显著，同时最小化英语性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言嵌入模型面临语言资源不平衡和跨语言对齐考虑不足的问题，标准对比学习方法难以捕捉语言间基本对齐，且在英语等对齐良好的语言上性能下降。
AI.method: 提出CLEAR损失函数，采用反向训练方案，利用英语段落作为桥梁，增强目标语言与英语之间的对齐，确保跨语言检索任务的鲁棒性能。
AI.result: CLEAR在跨语言场景中取得显著改进，提升高达15%，特别是在低资源语言上表现突出，同时最小化英语性能下降。在多语言训练中也显示出良好效果。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR是一种有效的跨语言检索增强方法，具有广泛的应用潜力和可扩展性，特别是在处理语言资源不平衡和跨语言对齐问题上表现出色。

title: BPC-Net: Annotation-Free Skin Lesion Segmentation via Boundary Probability Calibration
summary: Annotation-free skin lesion segmentation is attractive for low-resource dermoscopic deployment. However, its performance remains constrained by three coupled challenges: noisy pseudo-label supervision, unstable transfer under limited target-domain data, and boundary probability under-confidence. Most existing annotation-free methods primarily focus on pseudo-label denoising. In contrast, the effect of compressed boundary probabilities on final mask quality has received less explicit attention, although it directly affects contour completeness and cannot be adequately corrected by global threshold adjustment alone. To address this issue, we propose BPC-Net, a boundary probability calibration framework for annotation-free skin lesion segmentation. The core of the framework is Gaussian Probability Smoothing (GPS), which performs localized probability-space calibration before thresholding to recover under-confident lesion boundaries without inducing indiscriminate foreground expansion. To support this calibration under noisy pseudo-supervision and cross-domain transfer, we further incorporate two auxiliary designs: a feature-decoupled decoder that separately handles context suppression, detail recovery, and boundary refinement, and an interaction-branch adaptation strategy that updates only the pseudo-label interaction branch while preserving the deployed image-only segmentation path. Under a strictly annotation-free protocol, no manual masks are used during training or target-domain adaptation, and validation labels, when available, are used only for final operating-point selection. Experiments on ISIC-2017, ISIC-2018, and PH2 show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art performance among published unsupervised methods, reaching a macro-average Dice coefficient and Jaccard index of 85.80\% and 76.97\%, respectively, while approaching supervised reference performance on PH2.

AI.tldr: BPC-Net：一种用于无标注皮肤病变分割的边界概率校准框架，通过高斯概率平滑解决边界概率不足信问题，在无标注条件下达到接近监督方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 无标注皮肤病变分割面临三个耦合挑战：噪声伪标签监督、有限目标域数据下的不稳定迁移、边界概率不足信。现有方法主要关注伪标签去噪，而压缩边界概率对最终掩码质量的影响未得到充分关注，这直接影响轮廓完整性且无法通过全局阈值调整充分校正。
AI.method: 提出BPC-Net框架，核心是高斯概率平滑(GPS)，在阈值化前进行局部概率空间校准以恢复不足信的病变边界。辅助设计包括：特征解耦解码器（分别处理上下文抑制、细节恢复和边界细化）和交互分支适应策略（仅更新伪标签交互分支，保留部署的图像分割路径）。
AI.result: 在ISIC-2017、ISIC-2018和PH2数据集上，该框架在已发表的无监督方法中达到最先进性能，宏观平均Dice系数和Jaccard指数分别为85.80%和76.97%，在PH2上接近监督参考性能。
AI.conclusion: BPC-Net通过边界概率校准有效解决了无标注皮肤病变分割中的边界不足信问题，在严格无标注协议下实现了接近监督方法的性能，为低资源皮肤镜部署提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: CuraLight: Debate-Guided Data Curation for LLM-Centered Traffic Signal Control
summary:
Traffic signal control (TSC) is a core component of intelligent transportation systems (ITS), aiming to reduce congestion, emissions, and travel time. Recent approaches based on reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) have improved adaptivity, but still suffer from limited interpretability, insufficient interaction data, and weak generalization to heterogeneous intersections.
  This paper proposes CuraLight, an LLM-centered framework where an RL agent assists the fine-tuning of an LLM-based traffic signal controller. The RL agent explores traffic environments and generates high-quality interaction trajectories, which are converted into prompt-response pairs for imitation fine-tuning. A multi-LLM ensemble deliberation system further evaluates candidate signal timing actions through structured debate, providing preference-aware supervision signals for training.
  Experiments conducted in SUMO across heterogeneous real-world networks from Jinan, Hangzhou, and Yizhuang demonstrate that CuraLight consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing average travel time by 5.34 percent, average queue length by 5.14 percent, and average waiting time by 7.02 percent. The results highlight the effectiveness of combining RL-assisted exploration with deliberation-based data curation for scalable and interpretable traffic signal control.

AI.tldr: CuraLight是一个基于大语言模型的交通信号控制框架，通过强化学习辅助探索生成高质量交互轨迹，结合多LLM集成审议系统评估候选信号配时，在异构交叉口场景中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习和大型语言模型的交通信号控制方法存在可解释性有限、交互数据不足以及对异构交叉口泛化能力弱的问题，需要一种更有效的方法来提升交通信号控制的适应性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出CuraLight框架：1）使用强化学习代理探索交通环境并生成高质量交互轨迹；2）将轨迹转换为提示-响应对进行模仿微调；3）建立多LLM集成审议系统，通过结构化辩论评估候选信号配时动作，提供偏好感知的监督信号用于训练。
AI.result: 在SUMO仿真平台上对济南、杭州、亦庄等真实世界异构网络进行实验，CuraLight持续优于最先进的基线方法，平均旅行时间减少5.34%，平均队列长度减少5.14%，平均等待时间减少7.02%。
AI.conclusion: 结合强化学习辅助探索和基于审议的数据筛选方法，能够实现可扩展且可解释的交通信号控制，为智能交通系统提供了有效的解决方案。

title: ID-Selection: Importance-Diversity Based Visual Token Selection for Efficient LVLM Inference
summary: Recent advances have explored visual token pruning to accelerate the inference of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, existing methods often struggle to balance token importance and diversity: importance-based methods tend to retain redundant tokens, whereas diversity-based methods may overlook informative ones. This trade-off becomes especially problematic under high reduction ratios, where preserving only a small subset of visual tokens is critical. To address this issue, we propose ID-Selection, a simple yet effective token selection strategy for efficient LVLM inference. The key idea is to couple importance estimation with diversity-aware iterative selection: each token is first assigned an importance score, after which high-scoring tokens are selected one by one while the scores of similar tokens are progressively suppressed. In this way, ID-Selection preserves informative tokens while reducing redundancy in a unified selection process. Extensive experiments across 5 LVLM backbones and 16 main benchmarks demonstrate that ID-Selection consistently achieves superior performance and efficiency, especially under extreme pruning ratios. For example, on LLaVA-1.5-7B, ID-Selection prunes 97.2% of visual tokens, retaining only 16 tokens, while reducing inference FLOPs by over 97% and preserving 91.8% of the original performance, all without additional training.

AI.tldr: ID-Selection是一种用于大型视觉语言模型的高效视觉token选择策略，通过结合重要性估计和多样性感知的迭代选择，在保持信息性token的同时减少冗余，特别适用于高剪枝比例场景。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法难以平衡重要性和多样性：基于重要性的方法倾向于保留冗余token，而基于多样性的方法可能忽略信息性token。这种权衡在高剪枝比例下尤为关键，需要保留少量视觉token时问题更加突出。
AI.method: ID-Selection采用重要性估计与多样性感知迭代选择相结合的策略：首先为每个token分配重要性分数，然后逐个选择高分token，同时逐步抑制相似token的分数，从而在统一的选择过程中既保留信息性token又减少冗余。
AI.result: 在5个LVLM主干网络和16个主要基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ID-Selection始终实现优越的性能和效率，特别是在极端剪枝比例下。例如在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，剪枝97.2%的视觉token（仅保留16个token），推理FLOPs减少超过97%，同时保持91.8%的原始性能，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: ID-Selection是一种简单而有效的token选择策略，能够平衡重要性和多样性，显著加速大型视觉语言模型的推理，特别是在高剪枝比例下表现优异，为高效LVLM推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: LUDOBENCH: Evaluating LLM Behavioural Decision-Making Through Spot-Based Board Game Scenarios in Ludo
summary: We introduce LudoBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM strategic reasoning in Ludo, a stochastic multi-agent board game whose dice mechanics, piece capture, safe-square navigation, and home-path progression introduce meaningful planning complexity. LudoBench comprises 480 handcrafted spot scenarios across 12 behaviorally distinct decision categories, each isolating a specific strategic choice. We additionally contribute a fully functional 4-player Ludo simulator supporting Random, Heuristic, Game-Theory, and LLM agents. The game-theory agent uses Expectiminimax search with depth-limited lookahead to provide a principled strategic ceiling beyond greedy heuristics. Evaluating six models spanning four model families, we find that all models agree with the game-theory baseline only 40-46% of the time. Models split into distinct behavioral archetypes: finishers that complete pieces but neglect development, and builders that develop but never finish. Each archetype captures only half of the game theory strategy. Models also display measurable behavioral shifts under history-conditioned grudge framing on identical board states, revealing prompt-sensitivity as a key vulnerability. LudoBench provides a lightweight and interpretable framework for benchmarking LLM strategic reasoning under uncertainty. All code, the spot dataset (480 entries) and model outputs are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LudoBench-5CBF/

AI.tldr: LudoBench是一个用于评估LLM在Ludo游戏中战略推理能力的基准，包含480个手工制作的场景和4玩家模拟器，发现LLM与博弈论基准的一致性仅为40-46%，并表现出两种不同的行为模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估基准在战略推理方面存在不足，特别是在具有随机性、多智能体交互和复杂规划需求的场景中。Ludo游戏因其骰子机制、棋子捕获、安全方格导航和归家路径等特性，为评估LLM的战略推理能力提供了理想的测试平台。
AI.method:
1. 创建LudoBench基准：包含480个手工制作的特定场景，涵盖12个行为不同的决策类别，每个类别隔离特定的战略选择。
2. 开发4玩家Ludo模拟器：支持随机、启发式、博弈论和LLM智能体。
3. 博弈论智能体使用Expectiminimax搜索和深度受限的前瞻来提供超越贪婪启发式的战略基准。
4. 评估六个模型（涵盖四个模型系列），分析它们与博弈论基准的一致性。
AI.result:
1. 所有模型与博弈论基准的一致性仅为40-46%。
2. 模型分为两种不同的行为原型：完成者（专注于完成棋子但忽视发展）和建设者（专注于发展但从不完成），每种原型只捕捉到博弈论策略的一半。
3. 在历史条件怨恨框架下，模型在相同棋盘状态下表现出可测量的行为转变，揭示了提示敏感性是关键弱点。
AI.conclusion: LudoBench提供了一个轻量级且可解释的框架，用于在不确定性下对LLM的战略推理进行基准测试。研究结果表明当前LLM在复杂战略推理方面存在显著局限性，特别是在处理随机性和多智能体交互时。提示敏感性是LLM战略决策的关键脆弱点。

title: AgentGL: Towards Agentic Graph Learning with LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on agentic capabilities-iterative retrieval, tool use, and decision-making-to overcome the limits of static, parametric knowledge. Yet existing agentic frameworks treat external information as unstructured text and fail to leverage the topological dependencies inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we introduce Agentic Graph Learning (AGL), a paradigm that reframes graph learning as an interleaved process of topology-aware navigation and LLM-based inference. Specifically, we propose AgentGL, the first reinforcement learning (RL)-driven framework for AGL. AgentGL equips an LLM agent with graph-native tools for multi-scale exploration, regulates tool usage via search-constrained thinking to balance accuracy and efficiency, and employs a graph-conditioned curriculum RL strategy to stabilize long-horizon policy learning without step-wise supervision. Across diverse Text-Attributed Graph (TAG) benchmarks and multiple LLM backbones, AgentGL substantially outperforms strong GraphLLMs and GraphRAG baselines, achieving absolute improvements of up to 17.5% in node classification and 28.4% in link prediction. These results demonstrate that AGL is a promising frontier for enabling LLMs to autonomously navigate and reason over complex relational environments. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sunyuanfu/AgentGL.

AI.tldr: AgentGL是一个基于强化学习的图学习框架，通过拓扑感知导航和LLM推理相结合，显著提升图结构数据上的节点分类和链接预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架将外部信息视为非结构化文本，未能充分利用现实世界数据中固有的拓扑依赖关系，限制了LLM在复杂关系环境中的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Graph Learning (AGL)范式，将图学习重新定义为拓扑感知导航和LLM推理的交错过程。具体实现AgentGL框架：1) 为LLM智能体配备多尺度探索的图原生工具；2) 通过搜索约束思维调节工具使用以平衡准确性和效率；3) 采用图条件课程强化学习策略稳定长时程策略学习。
AI.result: 在多样化的文本属性图基准测试和多个LLM骨干网络上，AgentGL显著优于现有GraphLLMs和GraphRAG基线，在节点分类上绝对提升高达17.5%，在链接预测上提升28.4%。
AI.conclusion: AGL是一个有前景的前沿方向，能够使LLM在复杂关系环境中自主导航和推理，代码已公开。

title: Evaluation of Randomization through Style Transfer for Enhanced Domain Generalization
summary: Deep learning models for computer vision often suffer from poor generalization when deployed in real-world settings, especially when trained on synthetic data due to the well-known Sim2Real gap. Despite the growing popularity of style transfer as a data augmentation strategy for domain generalization, the literature contains unresolved contradictions regarding three key design axes: the diversity of the style pool, the role of texture complexity, and the choice of style source. We present a systematic empirical study that isolates and evaluates each of these factors for driving scene understanding, resolving inconsistencies in prior work. Our findings show that (i) expanding the style pool yields larger gains than repeated augmentation with few styles, (ii) texture complexity has no significant effect when the pool is sufficiently large, and (iii) diverse artistic styles outperform domain-aligned alternatives. Guided by these insights, we derive StyleMixDG (Style-Mixing for Domain Generalization), a lightweight, model-agnostic augmentation recipe that requires no architectural modifications or additional losses. Evaluated on the GTAV $\rightarrow$ {BDD100k, Cityscapes, Mapillary Vistas} benchmark, StyleMixDG demonstrates consistent improvements over strong baselines, confirming that the empirically identified design principles translate into practical gains. The code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统实证研究解决了风格迁移数据增强中的三个关键设计矛盾，提出了StyleMixDG方法，在GTAV到真实世界数据集迁移中取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉深度学习模型在从合成数据迁移到真实世界时存在Sim2Real差距，风格迁移作为数据增强策略在文献中存在三个未解决的设计矛盾：风格池多样性、纹理复杂度作用和风格源选择。
AI.method: 进行系统实证研究，隔离并评估三个关键因素，基于研究结果提出StyleMixDG方法——一种轻量级、模型无关的数据增强方案，无需架构修改或额外损失函数。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1)扩大风格池比重复使用少量风格带来更大收益；(2)当风格池足够大时，纹理复杂度无显著影响；(3)多样艺术风格优于领域对齐替代方案。StyleMixDG在GTAV→{BDD100k, Cityscapes, Mapillary Vistas}基准测试中持续超越强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统实证研究解决了风格迁移数据增强中的设计矛盾，提出的StyleMixDG方法将实证发现的设计原则转化为实际性能提升，为领域泛化提供了有效的轻量级解决方案。

title: QA-MoE: Towards a Continuous Reliability Spectrum with Quality-Aware Mixture of Experts for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to infer human sentiment from textual, acoustic, and visual signals. In real-world scenarios, however, multimodal inputs are often compromised by dynamic noise or modality missingness. Existing methods typically treat these imperfections as discrete cases or assume fixed corruption ratios, which limits their adaptability to continuously varying reliability conditions. To address this, we first introduce a Continuous Reliability Spectrum to unify missingness and quality degradation into a single framework. Building on this, we propose QA-MoE, a Quality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts framework that quantifies modality reliability via self-supervised aleatoric uncertainty. This mechanism explicitly guides expert routing, enabling the model to suppress error propagation from unreliable signals while preserving task-relevant information. Extensive experiments indicate that QA-MoE achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across diverse degradation scenarios and exhibits a promising One-Checkpoint-for-All property in practice.

AI.tldr: QA-MoE：一种基于质量感知专家混合框架的多模态情感分析方法，通过自监督偶然不确定性量化模态可靠性，统一处理模态缺失和质量退化问题
AI.motivation: 现实场景中多模态输入常受动态噪声或模态缺失影响，现有方法通常将这些缺陷视为离散情况或假设固定损坏比例，限制了其对连续变化可靠性条件的适应性
AI.method: 提出连续可靠性谱概念，将缺失和质量退化统一到单一框架；设计QA-MoE质量感知专家混合框架，通过自监督偶然不确定性量化模态可靠性，明确指导专家路由，抑制不可靠信号的错误传播
AI.result: QA-MoE在各种退化场景中取得竞争性或最先进的性能，并在实践中展现出有前景的"一个检查点适用所有"特性
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过连续可靠性谱和QA-MoE框架有效解决了多模态情感分析中动态噪声和模态缺失问题，为实际应用提供了更灵活可靠的解决方案

title: Can Large Language Models Reinvent Foundational Algorithms?
summary: LLMs have shown strong potential to advance scientific discovery. Whether they possess the capacity for foundational innovation, however, remains an open question. In this work, we focus on a prerequisite for foundational innovation: can LLMs reinvent foundational algorithms in computer science? Our \textit{Unlearn-and-Reinvent} pipeline applies LLM unlearning to remove a specific foundational algorithm, such as Dijkstra's or Euclid's algorithm, from an LLM's pretrained knowledge, and then tests whether the model can reinvent it in a controlled environment. To enable effective unlearning, we adopt a GRPO-based, on-policy unlearning method. Across 10 target algorithms, 3 strong open-weight models, and 3 hint levels, our experiments demonstrate that (1) the strongest model Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 successfully reinvents 50% of the algorithms with no hint, 70% at hint level 1, and 90% at hint level 2; (2) a few high-level hints can enhance the reinvention success rate, but even step-by-step hints fail for those complicated algorithms; and (3) test-time reinforcement learning enables successful reinvention for the Strassen algorithm at hint level 2. Through analyses of output trajectories and ablation studies, we find that generative verifier in the reinvention phase plays a critical role in sustaining models' reasoning strength, helping to avoid the ``thought collapse'' phenomenon. These findings offer insights into both the potential and current limits of LLMs' innovative thinking.

AI.tldr: LLMs能否重新发明计算机科学基础算法？研究通过"遗忘-再发明"管道测试LLMs的创新思维能力，发现最强模型能在不同提示级别下重新发明50%-90%的基础算法。
AI.motivation: 探索LLMs是否具备基础创新能力，特别是能否重新发明计算机科学中的基础算法，这是评估LLMs创新潜力的关键前提。
AI.method: 采用"遗忘-再发明"管道：首先使用基于GRPO的策略性遗忘方法从LLMs中移除特定基础算法知识，然后在受控环境中测试模型能否重新发明这些算法。实验覆盖10种目标算法、3个强开源模型和3个提示级别。
AI.result: 最强模型Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507在无提示情况下成功重新发明50%的算法，一级提示下达到70%，二级提示下达到90%。高级提示能提高成功率，但逐步提示对复杂算法无效。测试时强化学习使Strassen算法在二级提示下成功重新发明。
AI.conclusion: LLMs具备重新发明基础算法的潜力，生成验证器在再发明阶段对维持推理能力、避免"思维崩溃"现象起关键作用。研究揭示了LLMs创新思维的潜力和当前局限。

title: LoRM: Learning the Language of Rotating Machinery for Self-Supervised Condition Monitoring
summary: We present LoRM (Language of Rotating Machinery), a self-supervised framework for multi-modal rotating-machinery signal understanding and real-time condition monitoring. LoRM is built on the idea that rotating-machinery signals can be viewed as a machine language: local signals can be tokenised into discrete symbolic units, and their future evolution can be predicted from observed multi-sensor context. Unlike conventional signal-processing methods that rely on hand-crafted transforms and features, LoRM reformulates multi-modal sensor data as a token-based sequence-prediction problem. For each data window, the observed context segment is retained in continuous form, while the future target segment of each sensing channel is quantised into a discrete token. Then, efficient knowledge transfer is achieved by partially fine-tuning a general-purpose pre-trained language model on industrial signals, avoiding the need to train a large model from scratch. Finally, condition monitoring is performed by tracking token-prediction errors as a health indicator, where increasing errors indicate degradation. In-situ tool condition monitoring (TCM) experiments demonstrate stable real-time tracking and strong cross-tool generalisation, showing that LoRM provides a practical bridge between language modelling and industrial signal analysis. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Q159753258/LormPHM.

AI.tldr: LoRM是一个自监督框架，将旋转机械信号视为机器语言，通过token化处理和语言模型预测实现实时状态监测
AI.motivation: 传统信号处理方法依赖手工设计的变换和特征，而LoRM旨在通过语言建模方法实现多模态旋转机械信号的理解和实时状态监测
AI.method: 将多模态传感器数据重构为基于token的序列预测问题：保留连续形式的观测上下文段，将未来目标段量化为离散token，然后对预训练语言模型进行部分微调
AI.result: 原位刀具状态监测实验展示了稳定的实时跟踪和强大的跨刀具泛化能力，表明LoRM在语言建模和工业信号分析之间建立了实用桥梁
AI.conclusion: LoRM为旋转机械信号理解提供了一种新颖的自监督框架，通过将信号视为机器语言并利用预训练语言模型，实现了有效的实时状态监测和跨工具泛化

title: FunRec: Reconstructing Functional 3D Scenes from Egocentric Interaction Videos
summary: We present FunRec, a method for reconstructing functional 3D digital twins of indoor scenes directly from egocentric RGB-D interaction videos. Unlike existing methods on articulated reconstruction, which rely on controlled setups, multi-state captures, or CAD priors, FunRec operates directly on in-the-wild human interaction sequences to recover interactable 3D scenes. It automatically discovers articulated parts, estimates their kinematic parameters, tracks their 3D motion, and reconstructs static and moving geometry in canonical space, yielding simulation-compatible meshes. Across new real and simulated benchmarks, FunRec surpasses prior work by a large margin, achieving up to +50 mIoU improvement in part segmentation, 5-10 times lower articulation and pose errors, and significantly higher reconstruction accuracy. We further demonstrate applications on URDF/USD export for simulation, hand-guided affordance mapping and robot-scene interaction.

AI.tldr: FunRec是一种从第一人称RGB-D交互视频中重建室内场景功能3D数字孪生的方法，能够自动发现关节部件、估计运动学参数并重建可交互的3D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有关节重建方法依赖受控设置、多状态捕捉或CAD先验，无法直接从真实世界的人类交互序列中恢复可交互的3D场景。
AI.method: FunRec直接从第一人称RGB-D交互视频中操作，自动发现关节部件，估计其运动学参数，跟踪3D运动，并在规范空间中重建静态和动态几何体，生成模拟兼容的网格。
AI.result: 在新真实和模拟基准测试中，FunRec大幅超越先前工作：部件分割mIoU提升高达+50，关节和姿态误差降低5-10倍，重建精度显著提高。
AI.conclusion: FunRec能够从真实世界交互视频中重建功能完整的3D数字孪生，支持URDF/USD导出用于模拟、手动引导的可用性映射和机器人-场景交互等应用。

title: Emergent social transmission of model-based representations without inference
summary: How do people acquire rich, flexible knowledge about their environment from others despite limited cognitive capacity? Humans are often thought to rely on computationally costly mentalizing, such as inferring others' beliefs. In contrast, cultural evolution emphasizes that behavioral transmission can be supported by simple social cues. Using reinforcement learning simulations, we show how minimal social learning can indirectly transmit higher-level representations. We simulate a naïve agent searching for rewards in a reconfigurable environment, learning either alone or by observing an expert - crucially, without inferring mental states. Instead, the learner heuristically selects actions or boosts value representations based on observed actions. Our results demonstrate that these cues bias the learner's experience, causing its representation to converge toward the expert's. Model-based learners benefit most from social exposure, showing faster learning and more expert-like representations. These findings show how cultural transmission can arise from simple, non-mentalizing processes exploiting asocial learning mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 通过强化学习模拟证明，即使没有复杂的心理推断，简单的社会学习线索也能间接传递高级认知表征，支持文化传播的简单机制解释。
AI.motivation: 探讨人类如何在有限认知能力下通过社会互动获得丰富的环境知识，挑战传统认为需要复杂心理推断（如推断他人信念）的观点，探索文化进化理论中简单社会线索支持行为传递的可能性。
AI.method: 使用强化学习模拟，比较个体单独学习与观察专家学习两种情境。学习者不推断心理状态，而是基于观察到的专家行为，通过启发式选择行动或增强价值表征来学习。模拟在可重构环境中进行，学习者寻找奖励。
AI.result: 简单的社会线索（观察专家行为）能够偏置学习者的经验，使其表征逐渐收敛到专家的表征。基于模型的学习者从社会暴露中获益最大，表现出更快的学习速度和更接近专家的表征。
AI.conclusion: 文化传播可以通过简单的、非心理推断的过程实现，这些过程利用了个体学习机制，表明复杂知识的传递不一定需要复杂的认知计算。

title: Understanding Performance Gap Between Parallel and Sequential Sampling in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable performance on challenging questions, such as math and coding. However, to obtain a high quality solution, one may need to sample more than once. In principal, there are two sampling strategies that can be composed to form more complex processes: sequential sampling and parallel sampling. In this paper, we first compare these two approaches with rigor, and observe, aligned with previous works, that parallel sampling seems to outperform sequential sampling even though the latter should have more representation power. To understand the underline reasons, we make three hypothesis on the reason behind this behavior: (i) parallel sampling outperforms due to the aggregator operator; (ii) sequential sampling is harmed by needing to use longer contexts; (iii) sequential sampling leads to less exploration due to conditioning on previous answers. The empirical evidence on various model families and sizes (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1 distilled models, Gemini 2.5) and question domains (math and coding) suggests that the aggregation and context length do not seem to be the main culprit behind the performance gap. In contrast, the lack of exploration seems to play a considerably larger role, and we argue that this is one main cause for the performance gap.

AI.tldr: 并行采样在大型推理模型中表现优于顺序采样，主要原因是顺序采样缺乏探索性而非聚合操作或上下文长度问题
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在数学和编程等挑战性问题中表现出色，但需要多次采样才能获得高质量解决方案。目前有两种主要采样策略：顺序采样和并行采样。虽然顺序采样理论上具有更强的表示能力，但实践中并行采样表现更好，本文旨在探究这一现象背后的原因。
AI.method: 首先对顺序采样和并行采样进行严格比较，然后提出三个假设解释性能差异：1) 并行采样因聚合操作而表现更好；2) 顺序采样因需要更长上下文而受损；3) 顺序采样因条件依赖先前答案导致探索不足。通过在不同模型家族和规模（Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1蒸馏模型、Gemini 2.5）以及问题领域（数学和编程）上进行实证研究来验证这些假设。
AI.result: 实证证据表明，聚合操作和上下文长度并不是性能差距的主要原因。相反，探索不足似乎在性能差距中起着相当大的作用，这是顺序采样表现不如并行采样的主要原因。
AI.conclusion: 顺序采样与并行采样的性能差距主要源于探索不足，而非聚合操作或上下文长度问题。这一发现对大型推理模型的采样策略设计具有重要指导意义。

title: DetailVerifyBench: A Benchmark for Dense Hallucination Localization in Long Image Captions
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. The dataset and code are available at https://zyx-hhnkh.github.io/DetailVerifyBench/
summary: Accurately detecting and localizing hallucinations is a critical task for ensuring high reliability of image captions. In the era of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), captions have evolved from brief sentences into comprehensive narratives, often spanning hundreds of words. This shift exponentially increases the challenge: models must now pinpoint specific erroneous spans or words within extensive contexts, rather than merely flag response-level inconsistencies. However, existing benchmarks lack the fine granularity and domain diversity required to evaluate this capability. To bridge this gap, we introduce DetailVerifyBench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 1,000 high-quality images across five distinct domains. With an average caption length of over 200 words and dense, token-level annotations of multiple hallucination types, it stands as the most challenging benchmark for precise hallucination localization in the field of long image captioning to date. Our benchmark is available at https://zyx-hhnkh.github.io/DetailVerifyBench/.

AI.tldr: DetailVerifyBench是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在长图像描述中精确检测和定位幻觉的基准测试，包含1000张高质量图像、五个不同领域，平均描述长度超过200词，提供密集的token级幻觉标注。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态大语言模型的发展，图像描述从简短句子演变为包含数百词的全面叙述，这使得精确检测和定位幻觉变得极其困难。现有基准测试缺乏评估这种能力的细粒度标注和领域多样性，因此需要一个新的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究者构建了DetailVerifyBench基准测试，包含1000张高质量图像，覆盖五个不同领域。每个图像都配有平均超过200词的长描述，并提供密集的token级幻觉标注，涵盖多种幻觉类型。
AI.result: DetailVerifyBench是目前长图像描述领域中用于精确幻觉定位的最具挑战性的基准测试，提供了细粒度的评估框架，可用于评估模型在长文本中定位特定错误词汇或片段的能力。
AI.conclusion: DetailVerifyBench填补了现有基准测试在细粒度幻觉检测和定位方面的不足，为评估多模态大语言模型在长图像描述中的可靠性提供了重要工具，有助于推动更可靠的图像描述系统的发展。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex interactive decision-making tasks. However, existing LLM agents typically rely on increasingly long interaction histories, resulting in high computational cost and limited scalability. In this paper, we propose STEP-HRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that enables step-level learning by conditioning only on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories. STEP-HRL structures tasks hierarchically, using completed subtasks to represent global progress of overall task. By introducing a local progress module, it also iteratively and selectively summarizes interaction history within each subtask to produce a compact summary of local progress. Together, these components yield augmented step-level transitions for both high-level and low-level policies. Experimental results on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld benchmarks consistently demonstrate that STEP-HRL substantially outperforms baselines in terms of performance and generalization while reducing token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/STEP-HRL.

AI.tldr: STEP-HRL是一个分层强化学习框架，通过仅基于单步转移而非完整交互历史进行步级学习，解决了LLM智能体计算成本高和可扩展性有限的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体通常依赖越来越长的交互历史，导致计算成本高且可扩展性有限，需要更高效的决策框架。
AI.method: 提出STEP-HRL分层强化学习框架，通过层次化任务结构、使用完成的子任务表示全局进度，并引入局部进度模块迭代总结子任务内的交互历史，生成紧凑的局部进度摘要。
AI.result: 在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld基准测试中，STEP-HRL在性能和泛化能力方面显著优于基线方法，同时减少了token使用量。
AI.conclusion: STEP-HRL通过步级学习和层次化结构有效解决了LLM智能体的计算效率和可扩展性问题，为复杂交互决策任务提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: Mechanistic Circuit-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world dynamic environments raises the challenge of updating their pre-trained knowledge. While existing knowledge editing methods can reliably patch isolated facts, they frequently suffer from a "Reasoning Gap", where the model recalls the edited fact but fails to utilize it in multi-step reasoning chains. To bridge this gap, we introduce MCircKE (\underline{M}echanistic \underline{Circ}uit-based \underline{K}nowledge \underline{E}diting), a novel framework that enables a precise "map-and-adapt" editing procedure. MCircKE first identifies the causal circuits responsible for a specific reasoning task, capturing both the storage of the fact and the routing of its logical consequences. It then surgically update parameters exclusively within this mapped circuit. Extensive experiments on the MQuAKE-3K benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for multi-hop reasoning in knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: MCircKE是一种基于机制电路的知识编辑框架，通过"映射-适应"方法解决大语言模型在多步推理中的"推理鸿沟"问题
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法虽然能可靠地修补孤立事实，但在多步推理链中经常出现"推理鸿沟"问题，即模型能回忆起编辑的事实但无法在推理链中有效利用它
AI.method: MCircKE首先识别负责特定推理任务的因果电路，捕捉事实存储及其逻辑后果的路由，然后仅在该映射电路内进行精确的参数更新
AI.result: 在MQuAKE-3K基准测试上的广泛实验证明了该方法在多跳推理知识编辑中的有效性
AI.conclusion: MCircKE通过机制电路方法成功解决了大语言模型知识编辑中的推理鸿沟问题，实现了更精确的多步推理知识更新

title: A Unified Foundation Model for All-in-One Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Image Restoration and Fusion with Language Prompting
summary: Remote sensing imagery suffers from clouds, haze, noise, resolution limits, and sensor heterogeneity. Existing restoration and fusion approaches train separate models per degradation type. In this work, we present Language-conditioned Large-scale Remote Sensing restoration model (LLaRS), the first unified foundation model for multi-modal and multi-task remote sensing low-level vision. LLaRS employs Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport to align heterogeneous bands into semantically matched slots, routes features through three complementary mixture-of-experts layers (convolutional experts for spatial patterns, channel-mixing experts for spectral fidelity, and attention experts with low-rank adapters for global context), and stabilizes joint training via step-level dynamic weight adjustment. To train LLaRS, we construct LLaRS1M, a million-scale multi-task dataset spanning eleven restoration and enhancement tasks, integrating real paired observations and controlled synthetic degradations with diverse natural language prompts. Experiments show LLaRS consistently outperforms seven competitive models, and parameter-efficient finetuning experiments demonstrate strong transfer capability and adaptation efficiency on unseen data. Repo: https://github.com/yc-cui/LLaRS

AI.tldr: LLaRS是首个统一的多模态多任务遥感低层视觉基础模型，通过Sinkhorn-Knopp最优传输对齐异质波段，采用三专家层混合架构，在百万级多任务数据集上训练，在11个修复增强任务中超越7个竞争模型。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像存在云、雾、噪声、分辨率限制和传感器异质性等多种退化问题，现有方法通常为每种退化类型训练单独模型，缺乏统一的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用Sinkhorn-Knopp最优传输将异质波段对齐到语义匹配的槽位；2) 通过三个互补的专家层路由特征：卷积专家处理空间模式、通道混合专家保证光谱保真度、带低秩适配器的注意力专家处理全局上下文；3) 采用步级动态权重调整稳定联合训练。
AI.result: 在LLaRS1M百万级多任务数据集上训练，涵盖11个修复增强任务。实验表明LLaRS在多个任务中一致优于7个竞争模型，参数高效微调实验展示了在未见数据上的强大迁移能力和适应效率。
AI.conclusion: LLaRS是首个统一的遥感低层视觉基础模型，通过创新的对齐机制和专家混合架构，实现了多模态多任务的统一处理，在多种修复增强任务中表现出优越性能。

title: Reciprocal Trust and Distrust in Artificial Intelligence Systems: The Hard Problem of Regulation
summary: Policy makers, scientists, and the public are increasingly confronted with thorny questions about the regulation of artificial intelligence (AI) systems. A key common thread concerns whether AI can be trusted and the factors that can make it more trustworthy in front of stakeholders and users. This is indeed crucial, as the trustworthiness of AI systems is fundamental for both democratic governance and for the development and deployment of AI. This article advances the discussion by arguing that AI systems should also be recognized, as least to some extent, as artifacts capable of exercising a form of agency, thereby enabling them to engage in relationships of trust or distrust with humans. It further examines the implications of these reciprocal trust dynamics for regulators tasked with overseeing AI systems. The article concludes by identifying key tensions and unresolved dilemmas that these dynamics pose for the future of AI regulation and governance.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨AI系统的信任问题，提出应将AI视为具有某种程度能动性的实体，能够与人类建立信任关系，并分析这对监管的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统日益普及，政策制定者、科学家和公众面临如何监管AI的棘手问题。核心问题在于AI是否可信以及如何使其更可信，这对民主治理和AI发展部署至关重要。
AI.method: 通过论证AI系统应被视为具有某种能动性的实体，能够与人类建立相互信任或不信任的关系，并分析这种双向信任动态对监管者的影响。
AI.result: 提出AI系统应被认可为具有某种程度能动性的实体，能够参与信任关系，这对监管框架提出了新的挑战和要求。
AI.conclusion: 识别了这些信任动态为AI监管和治理未来带来的关键紧张关系和未解决困境，为后续研究提供了方向。

title: FRENCH-YMCA: A FRENCH Corpus meeting the language needs of Youth, froM Children to Adolescents
summary: In this paper, we introduce the French-YMCA corpus, a new linguistic resource specifically tailored for children and adolescents. The motivation for building this corpus is clear: children have unique language requirements, as their language skills are in constant evolution and differ from those of adults. With an extensive collection of 39,200 text files, the French-YMCA corpus encompasses a total of 22,471,898 words. It distinguishes itself through its diverse sources, consistent grammar and spelling, and the commitment to providing open online accessibility for all. Such corpus can serve as the foundation for training language models that understand and anticipate youth's language, thereby enhancing the quality of digital interactions and ensuring that responses and suggestions are age-appropriate and adapted to the comprehension level of users of this age.

AI.tldr: 介绍了专门为儿童和青少年设计的法语语料库French-YMCA，包含39,200个文本文件和22,471,898个单词，旨在训练能理解青少年语言的语言模型。
AI.motivation: 儿童和青少年的语言需求独特，他们的语言技能在不断演变且与成人不同，需要专门的语言资源来支持针对这一群体的语言技术发展。
AI.method: 构建了包含39,200个文本文件、总计22,471,898个单词的法语语料库，特点是来源多样、语法和拼写一致，并承诺提供开放的在线访问。
AI.result: 创建了French-YMCA语料库，这是一个专门为儿童和青少年设计的大规模法语语言资源，具有多样性、一致性和可访问性等特点。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库可以作为训练理解青少年语言的语言模型的基础，从而提高数字交互质量，确保回应和建议适合年龄并适应用户的理解水平。

title: SGANet: Semantic and Geometric Alignment for Multimodal Multi-view Anomaly Detection
summary: Multi-view anomaly detection aims to identify surface defects on complex objects using observations captured from multiple viewpoints. However, existing unsupervised methods often suffer from feature inconsistency arising from viewpoint variations and modality discrepancies. To address these challenges, we propose a Semantic and Geometric Alignment Network (SGANet), a unified framework for multimodal multi-view anomaly detection that effectively combines semantic and geometric alignment to learn physically coherent feature representations across viewpoints and modalities. SGANet consists of three key components. The Selective Cross-view Feature Refinement Module (SCFRM) selectively aggregates informative patch features from adjacent views to enhance cross-view feature interaction. The Semantic-Structural Patch Alignment (SSPA) enforces semantic alignment across modalities while maintaining structural consistency under viewpoint transformations. The Multi-View Geometric Alignment (MVGA) further aligns geometrically corresponding patches across viewpoints. By jointly modeling feature interaction, semantic and structural consistency, and global geometric correspondence, SGANet effectively enhances anomaly detection performance in multimodal multi-view settings. Extensive experiments on the SiM3D and Eyecandies datasets demonstrate that SGANet achieves state-of-the-art performance in both anomaly detection and localization, validating its effectiveness in realistic industrial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出SGANet框架，通过语义和几何对齐解决多视角异常检测中的特征不一致问题，在SiM3D和Eyecandies数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督多视角异常检测方法存在视角变化和模态差异导致的特征不一致问题，需要一种能够学习跨视角和跨模态物理一致特征表示的框架。
AI.method: 提出语义和几何对齐网络（SGANet），包含三个核心组件：选择性跨视角特征细化模块（SCFRM）聚合相邻视角信息；语义-结构块对齐（SSPA）实现跨模态语义对齐并保持结构一致性；多视角几何对齐（MVGA）对齐几何对应块。
AI.result: 在SiM3D和Eyecandies数据集上的实验表明，SGANet在异常检测和定位方面均达到最先进性能，验证了其在真实工业场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SGANet通过联合建模特征交互、语义结构一致性和全局几何对应，有效提升了多模态多视角异常检测性能，为解决工业表面缺陷检测中的挑战提供了有效方案。

authors: Gerrit J. J. van den Burg
title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Code generation with large language models often relies on multi-stage human-in-the-loop refinement, which is effective but very costly - particularly in domains such as frontend web development where the solution quality depends on rendered visual output. We present a fully automated critic-in-the-loop framework in which a vision-language model serves as a visual critic that provides structured feedback on rendered webpages to guide iterative refinement of generated code. Across real-world user requests from the WebDev Arena dataset, this approach yields consistent improvements in solution quality, achieving up to 17.8% increase in performance over three refinement cycles. Next, we investigate parameter-efficient fine-tuning using LoRA to understand whether the improvements provided by the critic can be internalized by the code-generating LLM. Fine-tuning achieves 25% of the gains from the best critic-in-the-loop solution without a significant increase in token counts. Our findings indicate that automated, VLM-based critique of frontend code generation leads to significantly higher quality solutions than can be achieved through a single LLM inference pass, and highlight the importance of iterative refinement for the complex visual outputs associated with web development.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉语言模型的自动批评循环框架，通过视觉反馈迭代优化前端代码生成，相比单次推理提升17.8%性能，微调可内化25%的改进效果。
AI.motivation: 前端网页开发中，代码生成质量依赖渲染的视觉输出，传统多阶段人工循环方法成本高昂。需要自动化方法替代人工反馈，提升代码生成质量。
AI.method: 1) 提出完全自动化的批评循环框架，使用视觉语言模型作为视觉批评器，对渲染的网页提供结构化反馈；2) 采用LoRA进行参数高效微调，研究批评器提供的改进能否被代码生成LLM内化。
AI.result: 1) 在WebDev Arena数据集上，该方法经过三个细化周期实现17.8%的性能提升；2) 微调实现了最佳批评循环解决方案25%的增益，且没有显著增加token数量。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的自动化前端代码生成批评能显著提升解决方案质量，超越单次LLM推理；迭代细化对网页开发等复杂视觉输出至关重要；微调可部分内化批评器的改进效果。

title: FrontierFinance: A Long-Horizon Computer-Use Benchmark of Real-World Financial Tasks
summary: As concerns surrounding AI-driven labor displacement intensify in knowledge-intensive sectors, existing benchmarks fail to measure performance on tasks that define practical professional expertise. Finance, in particular, has been identified as a domain with high AI exposure risk, yet lacks robust benchmarks to track real-world developments. This gap is compounded by the absence of clear accountability mechanisms in current Large Language Model (LLM) deployments. To address this, we introduce FrontierFinance, a long-horizon benchmark of 25 complex financial modeling tasks across five core finance models, requiring an average of over 18 hours of skilled human labor per task to complete. Developed with financial professionals, the benchmark reflects industry-standard financial modeling workflows and is paired with detailed rubrics for structured evaluation. We engage human experts to define the tasks, create rubrics, grade LLMs, and perform the tasks themselves as human baselines. We demonstrate that our human experts both receive higher scores on average, and are more likely to provide client-ready outputs than current state-of-the-art systems.

AI.tldr: FrontierFinance是一个长期视野的金融建模基准测试，包含25个复杂金融建模任务，需要平均超过18小时专业人力完成，用于评估LLM在专业金融领域的实际能力。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在知识密集型行业（特别是金融领域）存在劳动力替代风险，但现有基准测试无法衡量实际专业任务的表现，且缺乏明确的问责机制。
AI.method: 与金融专业人士合作开发了包含5个核心金融模型的25个复杂任务基准，采用行业标准工作流程，并制定了详细的评分标准。聘请人类专家定义任务、创建评分标准、评估LLM，并作为人类基准执行任务。
AI.result: 人类专家在平均得分上更高，且比当前最先进的系统更有可能提供客户就绪的输出结果。
AI.conclusion: FrontierFinance填补了金融领域AI评估的空白，为跟踪实际发展提供了稳健的基准，并揭示了当前LLM在复杂专业任务上的局限性。

title: Deep Researcher Agent: An Autonomous Framework for 24/7 Deep Learning Experimentation with Zero-Cost Monitoring
summary: We present \textbf{Deep Researcher Agent}, an open-source framework that enables large language model (LLM) agents to autonomously conduct deep learning experiments around the clock. Unlike existing AI research assistants that focus on paper writing or code generation, our system addresses the full experiment lifecycle: hypothesis formation, code implementation, training execution, result analysis, and iterative refinement. The framework introduces three key innovations: (1) \textbf{Zero-Cost Monitoring} -- a monitoring paradigm that incurs zero LLM API costs during model training by relying solely on process-level checks and log file reads; (2) \textbf{Two-Tier Constant-Size Memory} -- a memory architecture capped at $\sim$5K characters regardless of runtime duration, preventing the unbounded context growth that plagues long-running agents; and (3) \textbf{Minimal-Toolset Leader-Worker Architecture} -- a multi-agent design where each worker agent is equipped with only 3--5 tools, reducing per-call token overhead by up to 73\%. In sustained deployments spanning 30+ days, the framework autonomously completed 500+ experiment cycles across four concurrent research projects, achieving a 52\% improvement over baseline metrics in one project through 200+ automated experiments -- all at an average LLM cost of \$0.08 per 24-hour cycle. Code is available at https://github.com/Xiangyue-Zhang/auto-deep-researcher-24x7.

AI.tldr: Deep Researcher Agent是一个开源框架，让LLM代理能够7x24小时自主进行深度学习实验，覆盖完整实验生命周期，通过零成本监控、恒定大小内存和最小工具集架构实现高效自动化研究。
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究助手主要关注论文写作或代码生成，缺乏对完整实验生命周期的支持。需要开发一个能够自主进行深度学习实验的框架，解决实验设计、执行、分析和迭代的全流程自动化问题。
AI.method: 提出三个关键技术：1) 零成本监控 - 仅依赖进程级检查和日志文件读取，训练期间零LLM API成本；2) 两层恒定大小内存 - 内存上限约5K字符，防止长运行代理的上下文无限增长；3) 最小工具集领导者-工作者架构 - 每个工作者代理仅配备3-5个工具，减少每次调用的token开销。
AI.result: 在30多天的持续部署中，框架在四个并行研究项目中自主完成了500多个实验周期，其中一个项目通过200多个自动化实验实现了52%的基线指标改进，平均每24小时周期的LLM成本仅为0.08美元。
AI.conclusion: Deep Researcher Agent框架成功实现了深度学习实验的完全自主化，通过创新的架构设计显著降低了运行成本，同时保持了高效的实验迭代能力，为自动化AI研究提供了实用解决方案。

title: "I See What You Did There": Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?
summary: Puns are a common form of rhetorical wordplay that exploits polysemy and phonetic similarity to create humor. In multimodal puns, visual and textual elements synergize to ground the literal sense and evoke the figurative meaning simultaneously. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely used in multimodal understanding and generation, their ability to understand puns has not been systematically studied due to a scarcity of rigorous benchmarks. To address this, we first propose a multimodal pun generation pipeline. We then introduce MultiPun, a dataset comprising diverse types of puns alongside adversarial non-pun distractors. Our evaluation reveals that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from these distractors. Moreover, we propose both prompt-level and model-level strategies to enhance pun comprehension, with an average improvement of 16.5% in F1 scores. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing future VLMs that master the subtleties of human-like humor via cross-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了视觉语言模型理解多模态双关语的能力，提出了MultiPun数据集和评估方法，发现现有模型难以区分真正双关语与对抗性干扰项，并提出改进策略使F1分数平均提升16.5%。
AI.motivation: 双关语是一种利用多义性和语音相似性创造幽默的修辞手法。在多模态双关语中，视觉和文本元素协同作用，同时表达字面意义和比喻意义。虽然视觉语言模型广泛用于多模态理解和生成，但由于缺乏严格的基准测试，它们理解双关语的能力尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 首先提出了多模态双关语生成流程，然后引入了MultiPun数据集，包含多种类型的双关语以及对抗性非双关干扰项。评估了现有模型区分真正双关语与干扰项的能力，并提出了提示级和模型级策略来增强双关语理解。
AI.result: 评估显示大多数模型难以区分真正的双关语与对抗性干扰项。提出的改进策略使F1分数平均提升了16.5%，为开发未来能够通过跨模态推理掌握人类幽默微妙之处的视觉语言模型提供了有价值的见解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了视觉语言模型理解多模态双关语能力的评估空白，提出的数据集和改进策略为开发更擅长理解人类幽默的AI模型奠定了基础，有助于推动视觉语言模型在跨模态推理和人类幽默理解方面的发展。

title: PanopticQuery: Unified Query-Time Reasoning for 4D Scenes
summary: Understanding dynamic 4D environments through natural language queries requires not only accurate scene reconstruction but also robust semantic grounding across space, time, and viewpoints. While recent methods using neural representations have advanced 4D reconstruction, they remain limited in contextual reasoning, especially for complex semantics such as interactions, temporal actions, and spatial relations. A key challenge lies in transforming noisy, view-dependent predictions into globally consistent 4D interpretations. We introduce PanopticQuery, a framework for unified query-time reasoning in 4D scenes. Our approach builds on 4D Gaussian Splatting for high-fidelity dynamic reconstruction and introduces a multi-view semantic consensus mechanism that grounds natural language queries by aggregating 2D semantic predictions across multiple views and time frames. This process filters inconsistent outputs, enforces geometric consistency, and lifts 2D semantics into structured 4D groundings via neural field optimization. To support evaluation, we present Panoptic-L4D, a new benchmark for language-based querying in dynamic scenes. Experiments demonstrate that PanopticQuery sets a new state of the art on complex language queries, effectively handling attributes, actions, spatial relationships, and multi-object interactions. A video demonstration is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: PanopticQuery：基于4D高斯泼溅的动态场景重建框架，通过多视角语义共识机制实现自然语言查询的时空语义理解
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经表示的4D重建方法在上下文推理方面存在局限，特别是对于交互、时序动作和空间关系等复杂语义的理解不足。关键挑战在于如何将噪声的、视角依赖的预测转化为全局一致的4D解释。
AI.method: 基于4D高斯泼溅进行高保真动态重建，引入多视角语义共识机制，通过聚合多个视角和时间帧的2D语义预测来锚定自然语言查询，过滤不一致输出，强制几何一致性，并通过神经场优化将2D语义提升为结构化的4D锚定。
AI.result: 在复杂语言查询上达到新的最先进水平，有效处理属性、动作、空间关系和多对象交互。提出了新的基准测试Panoptic-L4D用于动态场景的语言查询评估。
AI.conclusion: PanopticQuery框架通过统一查询时推理实现了4D场景的语义理解，为动态环境中的自然语言查询提供了有效的解决方案。

title: When Do We Need LLMs? A Diagnostic for Language-Driven Bandits
comment: ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI Advances in Finance
summary: We study Contextual Multi-Armed Bandits (CMABs) for non-episodic sequential decision making problems where the context includes both textual and numerical information (e.g., recommendation systems, dynamic portfolio adjustments, offer selection; all frequent problems in finance). While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to these settings, utilizing LLMs for reasoning at every decision step is computationally expensive and uncertainty estimates are difficult to obtain. To address this, we introduce LLMP-UCB, a bandit algorithm that derives uncertainty estimates from LLMs via repeated inference. However, our experiments demonstrate that lightweight numerical bandits operating on text embeddings (dense or Matryoshka) match or exceed the accuracy of LLM-based solutions at a fraction of their cost. We further show that embedding dimensionality is a practical lever on the exploration-exploitation balance, enabling cost--performance tradeoffs without prompt complexity.
