Finally, to guide practitioners, we propose a geometric diagnostic based on the arms' embedding to decide when to use LLM-driven reasoning versus a lightweight numerical bandit. Our results provide a principled deployment framework for cost-effective, uncertainty-aware decision systems with broad applicability across AI use cases in financial services.

AI.tldr: 研究结合文本和数值信息的上下文多臂老虎机问题，提出LLMP-UCB算法但发现轻量级数值老虎机在嵌入空间表现更优，提供成本-性能权衡框架
AI.motivation: 解决金融领域推荐系统、动态投资组合调整等非情景序列决策问题中，上下文包含文本和数值信息的情况。虽然大语言模型（LLMs）被广泛应用，但每次决策都使用LLM推理计算成本高且难以获得不确定性估计
AI.method: 提出LLMP-UCB算法，通过重复推理从LLMs获得不确定性估计。同时探索轻量级数值老虎机在文本嵌入（密集或Matryoshka嵌入）上的应用，发现嵌入维度可作为探索-利用平衡的实际调节杠杆
AI.result: 实验表明，基于文本嵌入的轻量级数值老虎机在成本仅为LLM方案一小部分的情况下，匹配或超过LLM解决方案的准确性。嵌入维度可实现成本-性能权衡而无需提示复杂性
AI.conclusion: 提出基于臂嵌入的几何诊断方法，指导实践者何时使用LLM驱动推理与轻量级数值老虎机。为金融服务中的AI应用提供成本有效、不确定性感知的决策系统部署框架

title: BOSCH: Black-Box Binary Optimization for Short-Context Attention-Head Selection in LLMs
summary: Post-training hybridization of large language models (LLMs) often replaces quadratic self-attention with sliding-window attention (SWA) to reduce KV cache usage and improve latency. Existing hybridization schemes are typically defined either at the layer level (e.g., interleaving) or at the head level via static rankings from local to global. Layer-level schemes ignore that local and global dependencies are routed through heads within the same layer, while static head-level rankings suffer from entanglement: a head's local/global behavior can change after hybridization. We propose BOSCH, Black-box Binary Optimization for Short-context Head Selection, a training-free method that formulates the problem as a Large Neighborhood Search and decomposes it into three subproblems: (i) layer-importance detection via small-budget black-box probes, (ii) adaptive per-layer SWA-ratio assignment based on these sensitivities, and (iii) grouped head-level optimization within ratio buckets. Extensive experiments on 4 LLMs ranging from 1.7B to 30B parameters, across 4 SWA ratios, show that BOSCH consistently outperforms layer-level heuristics and 6 strong static head-level methods, with larger gains at higher SWA ratios. Under continual pretraining, BOSCH recover original long-context performance faster and to a higher level. Analysis of the selected heads reveals substantial turnover for BOSCH across different SWA ratios, underscoring the importance of performing head-level selection for each target ratio rather than relying on fixed locality rankings.

AI.tldr: BOSCH是一种无需训练的黑盒二元优化方法，用于在大型语言模型后训练混合中优化滑动窗口注意力头的选择，通过分层重要性检测和自适应SWA比例分配来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练混合方法存在局限性：层级方案忽略了同一层内不同注意力头可能处理局部和全局依赖关系；静态头级排名存在纠缠问题，即头的局部/全局行为在混合后会发生变化。需要一种训练自由的方法来优化注意力头选择。
AI.method: BOSCH将问题建模为大邻域搜索，分解为三个子问题：1) 通过小预算黑盒探测进行层重要性检测；2) 基于这些敏感性进行自适应每层SWA比例分配；3) 在比例桶内进行分组头级优化。
AI.result: 在4个参数规模从1.7B到30B的LLM上，跨越4种SWA比例的实验表明，BOSCH始终优于层级启发式方法和6种强静态头级方法，在更高SWA比例下增益更大。在持续预训练中，BOSCH能更快、更高水平地恢复原始长上下文性能。
AI.conclusion: BOSCH通过训练自由的黑盒优化方法有效解决了LLM后训练混合中的注意力头选择问题，分析显示不同SWA比例下选择的头有显著变化，强调了针对每个目标比例进行头级选择的重要性，而非依赖固定的局部性排名。

title: JTON: A Token-Efficient JSON Superset with Zen Grid Tabular Encoding for Large Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code and test suite available at https://github.com/gowthamkumar-nandakishore/JTON
summary: When LLMs process structured data, the serialization format directly affects cost and context utilization. Standard JSON wastes tokens repeating key names in every row of a tabular array--overhead that scales linearly with row count. This paper presents JTON (JSON Tabular Object Notation), a strict JSON superset whose main idea, Zen Grid, factors column headers into a single row and encodes values with semicolons, preserving JSON's type system while cutting redundancy. Across seven real-world domains, Zen Grid reduces token counts by 15-60% versus JSON compact (28.5% average; 32% with bare_strings). Comprehension tests on 10 LLMs show a net +0.3 pp accuracy gain over JSON: four models improve, three hold steady, and three dip slightly. Generation tests on 12 LLMs yield 100% syntactic validity in both few-shot and zero-shot settings. A Rust/PyO3 reference implementation adds SIMD-accelerated parsing at 1.4x the speed of Python's json module. Code, a 683-vector test suite, and all experimental data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: JTON是一种JSON超集格式，通过Zen Grid技术将表格数据的列头提取到单行并用分号分隔值，显著减少序列化时的token数量，同时保持JSON类型系统。
AI.motivation: LLM处理结构化数据时，标准JSON格式在表格数组中会重复键名，导致token浪费和上下文利用率低下，这种开销随行数线性增长。
AI.method: 提出JTON格式，核心是Zen Grid技术：将列头提取到单行，用分号分隔值，保持JSON类型系统，减少冗余。
AI.result: 在7个真实领域减少15-60%的token数（平均28.5%）；10个LLM理解测试显示准确率平均+0.3pp；12个LLM生成测试在few-shot和zero-shot下均100%语法有效；Rust/PyO3实现解析速度比Python json模块快1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: JTON通过Zen Grid技术有效减少LLM处理结构化数据时的token开销，提高上下文利用率，同时保持向后兼容性和性能优势。

title: FinReporting: An Agentic Workflow for Localized Reporting of Cross-Jurisdiction Financial Disclosures
summary: Financial reporting systems increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to extract and summarize corporate disclosures. However, most assume a single-market setting and do not address structural differences across jurisdictions. Variations in accounting taxonomies, tagging infrastructures (e.g., XBRL vs. PDF), and aggregation conventions make cross-jurisdiction reporting a semantic alignment and verification challenge. We present FinReporting, an agentic workflow for localized cross-jurisdiction financial reporting. The system builds a unified canonical ontology over Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow, and decomposes reporting into auditable stages including filing acquisition, extraction, canonical mapping, and anomaly logging. Rather than using LLMs as free-form generators, FinReporting deploys them as constrained verifiers under explicit decision rules and evidence grounding. Evaluated on annual filings from the US, Japan, and China, the system improves consistency and reliability under heterogeneous reporting regimes. We release an interactive demo supporting cross-market inspection and structured export of localized financial statements. Our demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/BoomQ/FinReporting-Demo . The video describing our system is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f65jdEL31Kk

AI.tldr: FinReporting是一个用于跨司法管辖区财务报告的代理工作流系统，通过构建统一规范本体和分阶段处理流程，在异构报告制度下提高财务数据提取的一致性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前财务报告系统大多假设单一市场环境，未能解决不同司法管辖区之间的结构性差异。会计分类法、标记基础设施（如XBRL与PDF）和汇总惯例的差异使得跨司法管辖区报告成为语义对齐和验证的挑战。
AI.method: 系统构建了涵盖利润表、资产负债表和现金流量表的统一规范本体，将报告分解为可审计的阶段：文件获取、提取、规范映射和异常记录。系统将LLM作为受约束的验证器而非自由形式生成器，在明确的决策规则和证据基础上运行。
AI.result: 在美国、日本和中国年度申报文件的评估中，系统在异构报告制度下提高了财务报告的一致性和可靠性。系统发布了支持跨市场检查和本地化财务报表结构化导出的交互式演示。
AI.conclusion: FinReporting通过代理工作流和规范本体方法，有效解决了跨司法管辖区财务报告中的语义对齐和验证挑战，为处理异构财务报告制度提供了可靠的技术方案。

title: Joint Knowledge Base Completion and Question Answering by Combining Large Language Models and Small Language Models
summary: Knowledge Bases (KBs) play a key role in various applications. As two representative KB-related tasks, knowledge base completion (KBC) and knowledge base question answering (KBQA) are closely related and inherently complementary with each other. Thus, it will be beneficial to solve the task of joint KBC and KBQA to make them reinforce each other. However, existing studies usually rely on the small language model (SLM) to enhance them jointly, and the large language model (LLM)'s strong reasoning ability is ignored. In this paper, by combining the strengths of the LLM with the SLM, we propose a novel framework JCQL, which can make these two tasks enhance each other in an iterative manner. To make KBC enhance KBQA, we augment the LLM agent-based KBQA model's reasoning paths by incorporating an SLM-trained KBC model as an action of the agent, alleviating the LLM's hallucination and high computational costs issue in KBQA. To make KBQA enhance KBC, we incrementally fine-tune the KBC model by leveraging KBQA's reasoning paths as its supplementary training data, improving the ability of the SLM in KBC. Extensive experiments over two public benchmark data sets demonstrate that JCQL surpasses all baselines for both KBC and KBQA tasks.

AI.tldr: JCQL框架结合大语言模型和小语言模型，通过迭代方式让知识库补全和知识库问答相互增强，提升两个任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 知识库补全和知识库问答是密切相关且互补的任务，现有研究通常依赖小语言模型进行联合增强，忽略了大语言模型的强大推理能力。需要结合两者的优势，让这两个任务相互促进。
AI.method: 提出JCQL框架：1) 用SLM训练的KBC模型作为LLM智能体的动作，增强KBQA的推理路径，缓解LLM的幻觉和高计算成本问题；2) 利用KBQA的推理路径作为补充训练数据，增量微调KBC模型，提升SLM在KBC中的能力。两个任务以迭代方式相互增强。
AI.result: 在两个公共基准数据集上的大量实验表明，JCQL在KBC和KBQA两个任务上都超越了所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: JCQL框架成功结合了LLM和SLM的优势，通过迭代增强机制让知识库补全和知识库问答相互促进，在两个任务上都取得了显著性能提升。

title: The Model Agreed, But Didn't Learn: Diagnosing Surface Compliance in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) internalize vast world knowledge as parametric memory, yet inevitably inherit the staleness and errors of their source corpora. Consequently, ensuring the reliability and malleability of these internal representations is imperative for trustworthy real-world deployment. Knowledge editing offers a pivotal paradigm for surgically modifying memory without retraining. However, while recent editors demonstrate high success rates on standard benchmarks, it remains questionable whether current evaluation frameworks that rely on assessing output under specific prompting conditions can reliably authenticate genuine memory modification. In this work, we introduce a simple diagnostic framework that subjects models to discriminative self-assessment under in-context learning (ICL) settings that better reflect real-world application environments, specifically designed to scrutinize the subtle behavioral nuances induced by memory modifications. This probing reveals a pervasive phenomenon of Surface Compliance, where editors achieve high benchmark scores by merely mimicking target outputs without structurally overwriting internal beliefs. Moreover, we find that recursive modifications accumulate representational residues, triggering cognitive instability and permanently diminishing the reversibility of the model's memory state. These insights underscore the risks of current editing paradigms and highlight the pivotal role of robust memory modification in building trustworthy, long-term sustainable LLM systems. Code is available at https://github.com/XiaojieGu/SA-MCQ.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了当前知识编辑方法存在表面遵从现象，编辑后的模型只是在特定提示下模仿目标输出，而非真正修改内部记忆结构，且递归编辑会积累残留表示，导致认知不稳定和不可逆性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型内部存储了海量世界知识作为参数化记忆，但不可避免地继承了源语料库的陈旧性和错误。为确保这些内部表示的可信度和可塑性，知识编辑成为关键范式。然而，当前评估框架主要依赖特定提示条件下的输出评估，难以可靠验证真正的记忆修改是否发生。
AI.method: 引入一个简单的诊断框架，通过上下文学习（ICL）设置下的判别性自我评估来测试模型，这种设置更好地反映了实际应用环境。该框架专门设计用于审视记忆修改引发的微妙行为变化。
AI.result: 诊断揭示了普遍存在的"表面遵从"现象：编辑方法在基准测试中获得高分，但只是模仿目标输出，并未结构性覆盖内部信念。此外，递归修改会积累表示残留，引发认知不稳定，并永久降低模型记忆状态的可逆性。
AI.conclusion: 当前编辑范式存在风险，强调了稳健记忆修改在构建可信、长期可持续的LLM系统中的关键作用。研究结果呼吁开发更可靠的评估方法和编辑技术。

title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models based on flow matching -- such as pi0, pi0.5, and SmolVLA -- achieve state-of-the-art generalist robotic manipulation, yet their iterative denoising, typically 10 ODE steps, introduces substantial latency: on a modern GPU, denoising alone accounts for 80% of end-to-end inference time. Naively reducing the step count is unreliable, degrading success on most tasks due to the velocity field being uncalibrated for single-step jumps. We present SnapFlow, a plug-and-play self-distillation method that compresses multi-step denoising into a single forward pass (1-NFE) for flow-matching VLAs. SnapFlow mixes standard flow-matching samples with consistency samples whose targets are two-step Euler shortcut velocities computed from the model's own marginal velocity predictions, avoiding the trajectory drift caused by conditional velocities, as we analyze theoretically. A zero-initialized target-time embedding lets the network switch between local velocity estimation and global one-step generation within a single architecture. SnapFlow requires no external teacher, no architecture changes, and trains in ~12h on a single GPU. We validate on two VLA architectures spanning a 6x parameter range, with identical hyperparameters: on pi0.5 (3B) across four LIBERO suites (40 tasks, 400 episodes), SnapFlow achieves 98.75% average success -- matching the 10-step teacher at 97.75% and slightly exceeding it -- with 9.6x denoising speedup and end-to-end latency reduced from 274ms to 83ms; on SmolVLA (500M), it reduces MSE by 8.3% with 3.56x end-to-end acceleration. An action-step sweep on long-horizon tasks reveals that SnapFlow maintains its advantage across execution horizons, achieving 93% at n_act=5 where the baseline reaches only 90%. SnapFlow is orthogonal to layer-distillation and token-pruning approaches, enabling compositional speedups.

AI.tldr: SnapFlow是一种即插即用的自蒸馏方法，将基于流匹配的VLA模型的多步去噪压缩为单步前向传播，显著降低推理延迟，同时保持甚至提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的VLA模型（如pi0、pi0.5、SmolVLA）虽然实现了最先进的通用机器人操作，但其迭代去噪过程（通常10个ODE步骤）引入了显著延迟，去噪本身占端到端推理时间的80%。简单地减少步数会导致成功率下降，因为速度场未针对单步跳跃进行校准。
AI.method: SnapFlow通过自蒸馏方法将多步去噪压缩为单步前向传播。它混合标准流匹配样本与一致性样本，后者使用模型自身边缘速度预测计算的两步欧拉捷径速度作为目标，避免条件速度引起的轨迹漂移。通过零初始化目标时间嵌入，网络可以在单个架构内切换局部速度估计和全局单步生成。
AI.result: 在pi0.5（3B）模型上，SnapFlow在四个LIBERO套件（40个任务，400个episode）中达到98.75%的平均成功率，与10步教师模型的97.75%相当甚至略高，同时实现9.6倍去噪加速，端到端延迟从274ms降至83ms。在SmolVLA（500M）上，MSE降低8.3%，端到端加速3.56倍。在长时域任务中，SnapFlow在n_act=5时达到93%成功率，而基线仅90%。
AI.conclusion: SnapFlow是一种高效的自蒸馏方法，无需外部教师、无需架构修改，可在单GPU上12小时内训练完成，显著加速基于流匹配的VLA模型推理，同时保持或提升性能，且与层蒸馏和令牌剪枝方法正交，可实现组合加速。

title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced unified reasoning over text, images, and videos, but their inference is hindered by the rapid growth of key-value (KV) caches. Each visual input expands into thousands of tokens, causing caches to scale linearly with context length and remain resident in GPU memory throughout decoding, which leads to prohibitive memory overhead and latency even on high-end GPUs. A common solution is to compress caches under a fixed allocated budget at different granularities: token-level uniformly discards less important tokens, layer-level varies retention across layers, and head-level redistributes budgets across heads. Yet these approaches stop at allocation and overlook the heterogeneous behaviors of attention heads that require distinct compression strategies. We propose HybridKV, a hybrid KV cache compression framework that integrates complementary strategies in three stages: heads are first classified into static or dynamic types using text-centric attention; then a top-down budget allocation scheme hierarchically assigns KV budgets; finally, static heads are compressed by text-prior pruning and dynamic heads by chunk-wise retrieval. Experiments on 11 multimodal benchmarks with Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that HybridKV reduces KV cache memory by up to $7.9\times$ and achieves $1.52\times$ faster decoding, with almost no performance drop or even higher relative to the full-cache MLLM.

AI.tldr: HybridKV是一个混合KV缓存压缩框架，通过分层预算分配和针对不同类型注意力头的差异化压缩策略，显著减少多模态大语言模型的KV缓存内存占用并提升解码速度。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在处理视觉输入时，每个视觉输入会扩展为数千个token，导致KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长并持续占用GPU内存，造成过高的内存开销和解码延迟，即使在高性能GPU上也难以承受。
AI.method: HybridKV采用三阶段混合压缩框架：1) 使用文本中心注意力将注意力头分类为静态或动态类型；2) 采用自上而下的分层预算分配方案分配KV缓存预算；3) 对静态头使用文本优先剪枝压缩，对动态头使用分块检索压缩。
AI.result: 在11个多模态基准测试中使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型，HybridKV将KV缓存内存减少高达7.9倍，解码速度提升1.52倍，且性能几乎无下降甚至优于完整缓存模型。
AI.conclusion: HybridKV通过考虑注意力头的异构行为并采用差异化压缩策略，有效解决了多模态大语言模型中KV缓存的内存和延迟问题，为高效的多模态推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: Disentangling MLP Neuron Weights in Vocabulary Space
summary: Interpreting the information encoded in model weights remains a fundamental challenge in mechanistic interpretability. In this work, we introduce ROTATE (Rotation-Optimized Token Alignment in weighT spacE), a data-free method requiring no forward passes that disentangles MLP neurons directly in weight space. Our approach relies on a key statistical observation: neurons that encode coherent, monosemantic concepts exhibit high kurtosis when projected onto the model's vocabulary. By optimizing rotations of neuron weights to maximize their vocabulary-space kurtosis, our method recovers sparse, interpretable directions which we name vocabulary channels. Experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-2-2B-it demonstrate that ROTATE consistently recovers vocabulary channels that are faithful to the neuron's behavior. ablating individual channels selectively disables corresponding input activations or the promotion of specific concepts. Moreover, aggregating channel-level descriptions yields comprehensive neuron descriptions that outperform optimized activation-based baselines by 2-3x in head-to-head comparisons. By providing a data-free decomposition of neuron weights, ROTATE offers a scalable, fine-grained building block for interpreting LMs.

AI.tldr: ROTATE是一种无需数据、无需前向传播的权重空间方法，通过最大化词汇空间峰度来分离MLP神经元，恢复稀疏可解释的词汇通道。
AI.motivation: 模型权重中编码的信息解释仍然是机制可解释性领域的基本挑战，需要一种可扩展的、细粒度的构建块来理解语言模型。
AI.method: 基于关键统计观察：编码连贯、单语义概念的神经元在投影到模型词汇空间时表现出高峰度。通过优化神经元权重的旋转以最大化其词汇空间峰度，恢复稀疏可解释的词汇通道。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Gemma-2-2B-it上的实验表明，ROTATE一致地恢复与神经元行为一致的词汇通道。消融单个通道选择性地禁用相应的输入激活或促进特定概念。通道级描述聚合产生的神经元描述在头对头比较中优于基于激活的基线2-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过提供神经元权重的无数据分解，ROTATE为解释语言模型提供了一个可扩展、细粒度的构建块。

title: 3D Smoke Scene Reconstruction Guided by Vision Priors from Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes from smoke-degraded multi-view images is particularly difficult because smoke introduces strong scattering effects, view-dependent appearance changes, and severe degradation of cross-view consistency. To address these issues, we propose a framework that integrates visual priors with efficient 3D scene modeling. We employ Nano-Banana-Pro to enhance smoke-degraded images and provide clearer visual observations for reconstruction and develop Smoke-GS, a medium-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for smoke scene reconstruction and restoration-oriented novel view synthesis. Smoke-GS models the scene using explicit 3D Gaussians and introduces a lightweight view-dependent medium branch to capture direction-dependent appearance variations caused by smoke. Our method preserves the rendering efficiency of 3D Gaussian Splatting while improving robustness to smoke-induced degradation. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for generating consistent and visually clear novel views in challenging smoke environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一个结合视觉先验和高效3D场景建模的框架，用于烟雾退化多视角图像的3D场景重建，通过图像增强和烟雾感知的3D高斯泼溅方法解决烟雾环境下的重建挑战。
AI.motivation: 烟雾环境下的多视角图像重建面临三大挑战：强散射效应、视角依赖的外观变化、以及严重的跨视角一致性退化。传统方法难以有效处理这些烟雾引入的复杂退化问题。
AI.method: 1. 使用Nano-Banana-Pro增强烟雾退化图像，为重建提供更清晰的视觉观测；2. 开发Smoke-GS，一个烟雾感知的3D高斯泼溅框架，包含显式3D高斯建模和轻量级视角依赖介质分支，用于捕捉烟雾引起的方向依赖外观变化。
AI.result: 该方法在保持3D高斯泼溅渲染效率的同时，提高了对烟雾诱导退化的鲁棒性，能够在挑战性烟雾环境中生成一致且视觉清晰的新视角图像。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架通过结合图像增强和烟雾感知的3D高斯泼溅方法，有效解决了烟雾环境下3D场景重建的挑战，为烟雾场景的重建和修复导向的新视角合成提供了有效解决方案。

title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in simulating human behavior, yet existing agents often exhibit behavioral rigidity, a flaw frequently masked by the self-referential bias of current "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluations. By evaluating against empirical ground truth, we reveal a counter-intuitive phenomenon: increasing the intensity of prompt-driven reasoning does not enhance fidelity but rather exacerbates value polarization, collapsing population diversity. To address this, we propose the Context-Value-Action (CVA) architecture, grounded in the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) model and Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values. Unlike methods relying on self-verification, CVA decouples action generation from cognitive reasoning via a novel Value Verifier trained on authentic human data to explicitly model dynamic value activation. Experiments on CVABench, which comprises over 1.1 million real-world interaction traces, demonstrate that CVA significantly outperforms baselines. Our approach effectively mitigates polarization while offering superior behavioral fidelity and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVA架构，通过解耦行动生成与认知推理，使用基于真实人类数据的价值验证器来缓解LLM模拟人类行为时的价值极化问题，显著提升行为保真度和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM模拟人类行为存在行为僵化问题，且当前"LLM作为评判者"的评估存在自指偏差。研究发现增加提示驱动的推理强度不仅不会提高保真度，反而会加剧价值极化，导致群体多样性崩溃。
AI.method: 提出基于刺激-有机体-响应(S-O-R)模型和Schwartz基本人类价值理论的Context-Value-Action (CVA)架构。该方法通过训练在真实人类数据上的价值验证器，将行动生成与认知推理解耦，显式建模动态价值激活。
AI.result: 在包含超过110万真实世界交互轨迹的CVABench数据集上的实验表明，CVA显著优于基线方法，有效缓解了价值极化问题，同时提供了更优的行为保真度和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: CVA架构通过解耦行动生成与认知推理，并基于真实人类数据显式建模价值激活，能够有效缓解LLM模拟人类行为时的价值极化问题，提升模拟的保真度和可解释性。

title: BiMind: A Dual-Head Reasoning Model with Attention-Geometry Adapter for Incorrect Information Detection
summary: Incorrect information poses significant challenges by disrupting content veracity and integrity, yet most detection approaches struggle to jointly balance textual content verification with external knowledge modification under collapsed attention geometries. To address this issue, we propose a dual-head reasoning framework, BiMind, which disentangles content-internal reasoning from knowledge-augmented reasoning. In BiMind, we introduce three core innovations: (i) an attention geometry adapter that reshapes attention logits via token-conditioned offsets and mitigates attention collapse; (ii) a self-retrieval knowledge mechanism, which constructs an in-domain semantic memory through kNN retrieval and injects retrieved neighbors via feature-wise linear modulation; (iii) the uncertainty-aware fusion strategies, including entropy-gated fusion and a trainable agreement head, stabilized by a symmetric Kullback-Leibler agreement regularizer. To quantify the knowledge contributions, we define a novel metric, Value-of-eXperience (VoX), to measure instance-wise logit gains from knowledge-augmented reasoning. Experiment results on public datasets demonstrate that our BiMind model outperforms advanced detection approaches and provides interpretable diagnostics on when and why knowledge matters.

AI.tldr: BiMind是一个双头推理框架，通过分离内容内部推理和知识增强推理来解决错误信息检测问题，引入注意力几何适配器、自检索知识机制和不确定性感知融合策略，显著提升检测性能。
AI.motivation: 错误信息对内容真实性和完整性构成重大挑战，现有检测方法难以在注意力几何崩溃的情况下同时平衡文本内容验证和外部知识修正。
AI.method: 提出BiMind双头推理框架，包含三个核心创新：1)注意力几何适配器通过令牌条件偏移重塑注意力对数并缓解注意力崩溃；2)自检索知识机制通过kNN检索构建领域内语义记忆并通过特征级线性调制注入检索到的邻居；3)不确定性感知融合策略，包括熵门控融合和可训练的一致性头，通过对称KL一致性正则化器稳定。
AI.result: 在公共数据集上的实验结果表明，BiMind模型优于先进的检测方法，并提供了关于何时以及为何知识重要的可解释诊断。定义了新的度量标准VoX来衡量知识增强推理带来的实例级对数增益。
AI.conclusion: BiMind通过分离内容推理和知识推理，有效解决了错误信息检测中的注意力几何崩溃问题，提供了更平衡和可解释的检测框架。

title: MARL-GPT: Foundation Model for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advances in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) have demonstrated success in numerous challenging domains and environments, but typically require specialized models for each task. In this work, we propose a coherent methodology that makes it possible for a single GPT-based model to learn and perform well across diverse MARL environments and tasks, including StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge, Google Research Football and POGEMA. Our method, MARL-GPT, applies offline reinforcement learning to train at scale on the expert trajectories (400M for SMACv2, 100M for GRF, and 1B for POGEMA) combined with a single transformer-based observation encoder that requires no task-specific tuning. Experiments show that MARL-GPT achieves competitive performance compared to specialized baselines in all tested environments. Thus, our findings suggest that it is, indeed, possible to build a multi-task transformer-based model for a wide variety of (significantly different) multi-agent problems paving the way to the fundamental MARL model (akin to ChatGPT, Llama, Mistral etc. in natural language modeling).

AI.tldr: MARL-GPT：基于GPT的单模型方法，通过离线强化学习在多种多智能体环境中实现通用性能，无需任务特定调优
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体强化学习需要为每个任务设计专门模型，缺乏通用性。本文旨在探索能否构建一个统一的Transformer模型来处理多样化的多智能体问题
AI.method: MARL-GPT方法：使用基于GPT的单一模型，通过离线强化学习在大规模专家轨迹上训练（SMACv2 400M、GRF 100M、POGEMA 1B），采用单一Transformer观察编码器，无需任务特定调优
AI.result: 实验表明，MARL-GPT在所有测试环境（StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge、Google Research Football、POGEMA）中均达到与专门基线模型相当的竞争性性能
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，确实可以构建基于Transformer的多任务模型来处理各种显著不同的多智能体问题，为构建基础MARL模型（类似于NLP中的ChatGPT、Llama等）铺平道路

title: Let Geometry GUIDE: Layer-wise Unrolling of Geometric Priors in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual tasks but still exhibit limited physical spatial awareness when processing real-world visual streams. Recently, feed-forward geometric foundation models, which implicitly extract geometric priors, have provided a new pathway to address this issue. However, existing geometry-aware MLLMs are predominantly constrained by the paradigm of single deep-layer extraction and input-level fusion. This flattened fusion leads to the loss of local geometric details and causes semantic mismatches in the early layers. To break this bottleneck, we propose GUIDE (Geometric Unrolling Inside MLLM Early-layers), a progressive geometric priors injection framework. GUIDE performs multi-level sampling within the geometric encoder, comprehensively capturing multi-granularity features ranging from local edges to global topologies. Subsequently, we rigorously align and fuse these multi-level geometric priors step-by-step with the early layers of the MLLM. Building upon the injection of multi-granularity geometric information, this design guides the model to progressively learn the 2D-to-3D transitional process. Furthermore, we introduce a context-aware gating that enables the model to fetch requisite spatial cues based on current semantics, thereby maximizing the utilization efficiency of spatial priors and effectively suppressing redundant geometric noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GUIDE significantly outperforms existing baselines on multiple complex spatial reasoning and perception tasks, establishing a novel paradigm for integrating 3D geometric priors into large models.

AI.tldr: GUIDE框架通过在MLLM早期层逐步注入多粒度几何先验，提升模型对物理空间的感知能力，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在2D视觉任务上取得显著进展，但在处理真实世界视觉流时物理空间感知能力有限。现有几何感知MLLM主要受限于单深度层提取和输入级融合的范式，导致局部几何细节丢失和早期层语义不匹配。
AI.method: 提出GUIDE框架：1）在几何编码器中进行多级采样，全面捕获从局部边缘到全局拓扑的多粒度特征；2）逐步将这些多级几何先验与MLLM早期层对齐融合；3）引入上下文感知门控机制，使模型能基于当前语义获取所需空间线索，最大化空间先验利用效率并抑制冗余几何噪声。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GUIDE在多个复杂空间推理和感知任务上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GUIDE为将3D几何先验集成到大模型中建立了新范式，通过渐进式几何先验注入和多粒度特征融合，有效提升了模型的物理空间感知能力。

title: Towards Trustworthy Report Generation: A Deep Research Agent with Progressive Confidence Estimation and Calibration
summary: As agent-based systems continue to evolve, deep research agents are capable of automatically generating research-style reports across diverse domains. While these agents promise to streamline information synthesis and knowledge exploration, existing evaluation frameworks-typically based on subjective dimensions-fail to capture a critical aspect of report quality: trustworthiness. In open-ended research scenarios where ground-truth answers are unavailable, current evaluation methods cannot effectively measure the epistemic confidence of generated content, making calibration difficult and leaving users susceptible to misleading or hallucinated information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel deep research agent that incorporates progressive confidence estimation and calibration within the report generation pipeline. Our system leverages a deliberative search model, featuring deep retrieval and multi-hop reasoning to ground outputs in verifiable evidence while assigning confidence scores to individual claims. Combined with a carefully designed workflow, this approach produces trustworthy reports with enhanced transparency. Experimental results and case studies demonstrate that our method substantially improves interpretability and significantly increases user trust.

AI.tldr: 提出一种具有渐进置信度估计和校准功能的新型深度研究代理，通过深思熟虑的搜索模型和多跳推理生成可信赖的研究报告，显著提升可解释性和用户信任度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于代理的研究报告生成系统虽然能自动生成跨领域研究报告，但其评估框架通常基于主观维度，无法有效衡量报告的可信度。在开放研究场景中缺乏真实答案的情况下，现有方法难以测量生成内容的认知置信度，导致校准困难，用户容易受到误导或幻觉信息的影响。
AI.method: 提出一种新型深度研究代理，在报告生成流程中整合渐进置信度估计和校准。系统采用深思熟虑的搜索模型，结合深度检索和多跳推理，将输出基于可验证的证据，并为每个声明分配置信度分数。通过精心设计的工作流程，生成具有增强透明度的可信赖报告。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了报告的可解释性，并大幅增强了用户对生成内容的信任度。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合置信度估计和校准机制，提出的深度研究代理能够生成更可信赖的研究报告，解决了现有系统在开放研究场景中评估可信度的局限性，为自动研究代理的发展提供了重要方向。

title: From Hallucination to Structure Snowballing: The Alignment Tax of Constrained Decoding in LLM Reflection
summary: Intrinsic self-correction in Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently fails in open-ended reasoning tasks due to ``hallucination snowballing,'' a phenomenon in which models recursively justify early errors during free-text reflection. While structured feedback can mitigate this issue, existing approaches often rely on externally trained critics or symbolic tools, reducing agent autonomy. This study investigates whether enforcing structured reflection purely through Outlines-based constrained decoding can disrupt error propagation without additional training. Evaluating an 8-billion-parameter model (Qwen3-8B), we show that simply imposing structural constraints does not improve self-correction performance. Instead, it triggers a new failure mode termed ``structure snowballing.'' We find that the cognitive load required to satisfy strict formatting rules pushes the model into formatting traps. This observation helps explain why the agent achieves near-perfect superficial syntactic alignment yet fails to detect or resolve deeper semantic errors. These findings expose an ``alignment tax'' inherent to constrained decoding, highlighting a tension between structural granularity and internal model capacity in autonomous workflows. Code and raw logs are available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/hongxuzhou/agentic_llm_structured_self_critique.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在开放推理任务中，仅通过大纲约束解码来强制结构化反思并不能改善LLM的自我修正能力，反而会导致"结构雪球"现象，即模型过度关注格式要求而忽略语义错误。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在开放推理任务中的内在自我修正经常因"幻觉雪球"现象而失败，即模型在自由文本反思中递归地为早期错误辩护。虽然结构化反馈可以缓解此问题，但现有方法通常依赖外部训练的批评器或符号工具，降低了智能体自主性。
AI.method: 本研究调查是否仅通过基于大纲的约束解码来强制结构化反思可以中断错误传播而不需要额外训练。评估了一个80亿参数的模型（Qwen3-8B），测试了简单施加结构约束是否能改善自我修正性能。
AI.result: 结果显示，简单施加结构约束并不能改善自我修正性能，反而触发了一种新的失败模式——"结构雪球"。研究发现，满足严格格式规则所需的认知负荷将模型推入格式陷阱，导致模型在表面语法对齐上近乎完美，却无法检测或解决更深层的语义错误。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了约束解码固有的"对齐税"，突显了在自主工作流中结构粒度与内部模型能力之间的紧张关系。仅靠格式约束不足以解决幻觉雪球问题，反而可能引入新的失败模式。

title: Beyond Compromise: Pareto-Lenient Consensus for Efficient Multi-Preference LLM Alignment
summary: Transcending the single-preference paradigm, aligning LLMs with diverse human values is pivotal for robust deployment. Contemporary Multi-Objective Preference Alignment (MPA) approaches predominantly rely on static linear scalarization or rigid gradient projection to navigate these trade-offs. However, by enforcing strict conflict avoidance or simultaneous descent, these paradigms often prematurely converge to local stationary points. While mathematically stable, these points represent a conservative compromise where the model sacrifices potential global Pareto improvements to avoid transient local trade-offs. To break this deadlock, we propose Pareto-Lenient Consensus (PLC), a game-theoretic framework that reimagines alignment as a dynamic negotiation process. Unlike rigid approaches, PLC introduces consensus-driven lenient gradient rectification, which dynamically tolerates local degradation provided there is a sufficient dominant coalition surplus, thereby empowering the optimization trajectory to escape local suboptimal equilibrium and explore the distal Pareto-optimal frontier. Theoretical analysis validates PLC can facilitate stalemate escape and asymptotically converge to a Pareto consensus equilibrium. Moreover, extensive experiments show that PLC surpasses baselines in both fixed-preference alignment and global Pareto frontier quality. This work highlights the potential of negotiation-driven alignment as a promising avenue for MPA. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/aaa-6BB8.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pareto-Lenient Consensus (PLC)框架，通过共识驱动的宽松梯度修正，解决多目标偏好对齐中的局部最优问题，实现更好的Pareto前沿探索。
AI.motivation: 当前多目标偏好对齐方法主要依赖静态线性标量化或刚性梯度投影，这些方法通过强制冲突避免或同时下降，往往过早收敛到局部稳定点，牺牲了潜在的全局Pareto改进机会。
AI.method: 提出Pareto-Lenient Consensus (PLC)框架，将对齐重新构想为动态协商过程，引入共识驱动的宽松梯度修正，动态容忍局部退化，只要存在足够的优势联盟盈余，从而帮助优化轨迹逃离局部次优均衡并探索远端Pareto最优前沿。
AI.result: 理论分析验证PLC能够促进僵局逃离并渐近收敛到Pareto共识均衡。大量实验表明，PLC在固定偏好对齐和全局Pareto前沿质量方面均超越基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作突出了协商驱动对齐作为多目标偏好对齐的有前景方向，PLC框架能够有效解决现有方法的局限性，实现更好的Pareto前沿探索。

title: Short Data, Long Context: Distilling Positional Knowledge in Transformers
summary: Extending the context window of language models typically requires expensive long-context pre-training, posing significant challenges for both training efficiency and data collection. In this paper, we present evidence that long-context retrieval capabilities can be transferred to student models through logit-based knowledge distillation, even when training exclusively on packed short-context samples within a long-context window. We provide comprehensive insights through the lens of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) and establish three key findings. First, consistent with prior work, we show that phase-wise RoPE scaling, which maximizes rotational spectrum utilization at each training stage, also achieves the best long-context performance in knowledge distillation setups. Second, we demonstrate that logit-based knowledge distillation can directly enable positional information transfer. Using an experimental setup with packed repeated token sequences, we trace the propagation of positional perturbations from query and key vectors through successive transformer layers to output logits, revealing that positional information systematically influences the teacher's output distribution and, in turn, the distillation signal received by the student model. Third, our analysis uncovers structured update patterns in the query state during long-context extension, with distinct parameter spans exhibiting strong sensitivity to long-context training.

AI.tldr: 通过基于logit的知识蒸馏，可以在仅使用短上下文样本的情况下，将长上下文检索能力从教师模型转移到学生模型，无需昂贵的长上下文预训练。
AI.motivation: 扩展语言模型上下文窗口通常需要昂贵的长上下文预训练，这对训练效率和数据收集都构成重大挑战。本文旨在探索是否可以通过知识蒸馏在短上下文样本上训练出具有长上下文能力的学生模型。
AI.method: 使用基于logit的知识蒸馏方法，在长上下文窗口中打包短上下文样本进行训练。通过Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)分析，采用分阶段RoPE缩放策略，并设计实验追踪位置信息从查询和键向量通过transformer层到输出logits的传播过程。
AI.result: 1. 分阶段RoPE缩放在知识蒸馏设置中也能获得最佳长上下文性能；2. 基于logit的知识蒸馏可以直接实现位置信息转移；3. 发现了长上下文扩展期间查询状态的结构化更新模式，某些参数跨度对长上下文训练表现出强烈敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 通过知识蒸馏可以在仅使用短上下文样本的情况下有效转移长上下文检索能力，为扩展语言模型上下文窗口提供了一种更高效、成本更低的替代方案。

title: Flowr -- Scaling Up Retail Supply Chain Operations Through Agentic AI in Large Scale Supermarket Chains
summary: Retail supply chain operations in supermarket chains involve continuous, high-volume manual workflows spanning demand forecasting, procurement, supplier coordination, and inventory replenishment, processes that are repetitive, decision-intensive, and difficult to scale without significant human effort. Despite growing investment in data analytics, the decision-making and coordination layers of these workflows remain predominantly manual, reactive, and fragmented across outlets, distribution centers, and supplier networks. This paper introduces Flowr, a novel agentic AI framework for automating end-to-end retail supply chain workflows in large-scale supermarket operations. Flowr systematically decomposes manual supply chain operations into specialized AI agents, each responsible for a clearly defined cognitive role, enabling automation of processes previously dependent on continuous human coordination. To ensure task accuracy and adherence to responsible AI principles, the framework employs a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM. Central to the framework is a human-in-the-loop orchestration model in which supply chain managers supervise and intervene across workflow stages via a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled interface, preserving accountability and organizational control. Evaluation demonstrates that Flowr significantly reduces manual coordination overhead, improves demand-supply alignment, and enables proactive exception handling at a scale unachievable through manual processes. The framework was validated in collaboration with a large-scale supermarket chain and is domain-independent, offering a generalizable blueprint for agentic AI-driven supply chain automation across large-scale enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: Flowr是一个用于自动化大型超市零售供应链端到端工作流程的智能AI框架，通过分解手动操作为专门的AI代理，结合微调的专业领域大语言模型和人工监督，显著减少人工协调开销并提高供需匹配。
AI.motivation: 超市零售供应链涉及持续、高容量的手动工作流程，包括需求预测、采购、供应商协调和库存补货等重复性、决策密集且难以扩展的过程。尽管数据分析投资增加，但这些工作流程的决策和协调层仍然主要是手动、反应式且分散的，需要大量人工努力。
AI.method: Flowr框架将手动供应链操作系统地分解为专门的AI代理，每个代理负责明确定义的认知角色。框架采用由中央推理LLM协调的微调、领域专业化大语言模型联盟。核心是人工参与循环编排模型，供应链经理通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接口监督和干预工作流程阶段，保持问责制和组织控制。
AI.result: 评估表明，Flowr显著减少了手动协调开销，改善了供需匹配，并实现了通过手动流程无法达到的规模化主动异常处理。该框架与大型超市连锁合作验证，具有领域独立性，为大规模企业环境中的智能AI驱动供应链自动化提供了可推广的蓝图。
AI.conclusion: Flowr为自动化端到端零售供应链工作流程提供了一个有效的智能AI框架，通过专业化AI代理、微调领域模型和人工监督的结合，实现了规模化、高效的供应链管理，同时保持组织控制和问责制。

title: Stories of Your Life as Others: A Round-Trip Evaluation of LLM-Generated Life Stories Conditioned on Rich Psychometric Profiles
summary: Personality traits are richly encoded in natural language, and large language models (LLMs) trained on human text can simulate personality when conditioned on persona descriptions. However, existing evaluations rely predominantly on questionnaire self-report by the conditioned model, are limited in architectural diversity, and rarely use real human psychometric data. Without addressing these limitations, it remains unclear whether personality conditioning produces psychometrically informative representations of individual differences or merely superficial alignment with trait descriptors. To test how robustly LLMs can encode personality into extended text, we condition LLMs on real psychometric profiles from 290 participants to generate first-person life story narratives, and then task independent LLMs to recover personality scores from those narratives alone. We show that personality scores can be recovered from the generated narratives at levels approaching human test-retest reliability (mean r = 0.750, 85% of the human ceiling), and that recovery is robust across 10 LLM narrative generators and 3 LLM personality scorers spanning 6 providers. Decomposing systematic biases reveals that scoring models achieve their accuracy while counteracting alignment-induced defaults. Content analysis of the generated narratives shows that personality conditioning produces behaviourally differentiated text: nine of ten coded features correlate significantly with the same features in participants' real conversations, and personality-driven emotional reactivity patterns in narratives replicate in real conversational data. These findings provide evidence that the personality-language relationship captured during pretraining supports robust encoding and decoding of individual differences, including characteristic emotional variability patterns that replicate in real human behaviour.

AI.tldr: LLMs能够基于真实心理测量数据生成具有个性特征的生活叙事，并能从这些叙事中准确恢复人格特质分数，恢复准确度接近人类重测信度水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的人格评估主要依赖条件化模型的自报告问卷，缺乏架构多样性，很少使用真实人类心理测量数据。需要验证人格条件化是否能产生具有心理测量学意义的个体差异表征，还是仅仅与特质描述符表面对齐。
AI.method: 基于290名参与者的真实心理测量档案条件化LLMs，生成第一人称生活故事叙事；然后让独立的LLMs仅从这些叙事中恢复人格分数。使用10个LLM叙事生成器和3个LLM人格评分器，涵盖6个提供商。
AI.result: 人格分数可以从生成的叙事中恢复，平均相关系数r=0.750，达到人类重测信度的85%。恢复效果在10个LLM叙事生成器和3个LLM人格评分器中均表现稳健。内容分析显示人格条件化产生行为差异化的文本：10个编码特征中有9个与参与者真实对话中的相同特征显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 预训练中捕获的人格-语言关系支持个体差异的稳健编码和解码，包括在真实人类行为中复现的特征性情绪变异性模式。这表明LLMs能够产生具有心理测量学意义的人格表征。

title: Epistemic Blinding: An Inference-Time Protocol for Auditing Prior Contamination in LLM-Assisted Analysis
comment: code and LLM skill at: https://github.com/mcuccarese/epistemic-blinding 7 pages 3 figures
summary: This paper presents epistemic blinding in the context of an agentic system that uses large language models to reason across multiple biological datasets for drug target prioritization. During development, it became apparent that LLM outputs silently blend data-driven inference with memorized priors about named entities - and the blend is invisible: there is no way to determine, from a single output, how much came from the data on the page and how much came from the model's training memory. Epistemic blinding is a simple inference-time protocol that replaces entity identifiers with anonymous codes before prompting, then compares outputs against an unblinded control. The protocol does not make LLM reasoning deterministic, but it restores one critical axis of auditability: measuring how much of an output came from the supplied data versus the model's parametric knowledge. The complete target identification system is described - including LLM-guided evolutionary optimization of scoring functions and blinded agentic reasoning for target rationalization - with demonstration that both stages operate without access to entity identity. In oncology drug target prioritization across four cancer types, blinding changes 16% of top-20 predictions while preserving identical recovery of validated targets. The contamination problem is shown to generalize beyond biology: in S&P 500 equity screening, brand-recognition bias reshapes 30-40% of top-20 rankings across five random seeds. To lower the barrier to adoption, the protocol is released as an open-source tool and as a Claude Code skill that enables one-command epistemic blinding within agentic workflows. The claim is not that blinded analysis produces better results, but that without blinding, there is no way to know to what degree the agent is adhering to the analytical process the researcher designed.

AI.tldr: 提出"认知盲化"协议，解决LLM在药物靶点优先排序中混合数据推理与记忆先验的问题，通过匿名化实体标识符来区分数据贡献与模型记忆
AI.motivation: 在开发基于LLM的多生物数据集药物靶点优先排序系统时，发现LLM输出会无声地混合数据驱动推理和记忆的实体先验知识，且无法从单个输出中区分两者来源
AI.method: 提出认知盲化协议：在推理时将实体标识符替换为匿名代码再提示，然后与未盲化控制组比较输出；还包括LLM引导的评分函数进化优化和盲化智能体推理
AI.result: 在四种癌症类型的肿瘤药物靶点优先排序中，盲化改变了16%的top-20预测，同时保持了已验证靶点的相同恢复率；在S&P 500股票筛选中，品牌认知偏见改变了30-40%的top-20排名
AI.conclusion: 认知盲化协议不产生更好结果，但提供了关键的可审计性：能够测量输出中数据贡献与模型参数知识的比例；协议已开源发布，便于在智能体工作流中采用

title: LAG-XAI: A Lie-Inspired Affine Geometric Framework for Interpretable Paraphrasing in Transformer Latent Spaces
summary: Modern Transformer-based language models achieve strong performance in natural language processing tasks, yet their latent semantic spaces remain largely uninterpretable black boxes. This paper introduces LAG-XAI (Lie Affine Geometry for Explainable AI), a novel geometric framework that models paraphrasing not as discrete word substitutions, but as a structured affine transformation within the embedding space. By conceptualizing paraphrasing as a continuous geometric flow on a semantic manifold, we propose a computationally efficient mean-field approximation, inspired by local Lie group actions. This allows us to decompose paraphrase transitions into geometrically interpretable components: rotation, deformation, and translation. Experiments on the noisy PIT-2015 Twitter corpus, encoded with Sentence-BERT, reveal a "linear transparency" phenomenon. The proposed affine operator achieves an AUC of 0.7713. By normalizing against random chance (AUC 0.5), the model captures approximately 80% of the non-linear baseline's effective classification capacity (AUC 0.8405), offering explicit parametric interpretability in exchange for a marginal drop in absolute accuracy. The model identifies fundamental geometric invariants, including a stable matrix reconfiguration angle (~27.84°) and near-zero deformation, indicating local isometry. Cross-domain generalization is confirmed via direct cross-corpus validation on an independent TURL dataset. Furthermore, the practical utility of LAG-XAI is demonstrated in LLM hallucination detection: using a "cheap geometric check," the model automatically detected 95.3% of factual distortions on the HaluEval dataset by registering deviations beyond the permissible semantic corridor. This approach provides a mathematically grounded, resource-efficient path toward the mechanistic interpretability of Transformers.

AI.tldr: LAG-XAI框架将释义建模为嵌入空间中的仿射变换，通过几何分解实现Transformer的可解释性，在保持80%非线性模型性能的同时提供参数化解释能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管Transformer模型在NLP任务中表现优异，但其潜在语义空间仍是不透明的黑盒，缺乏可解释性。需要一种数学基础扎实、资源高效的方法来实现Transformer的机制可解释性。
AI.method: 提出LAG-XAI几何框架，将释义建模为语义流形上的连续几何流，采用局部李群作用的平均场近似，将释义转换分解为旋转、变形和平移三个几何可解释分量。
AI.result: 在PIT-2015 Twitter语料上，仿射算子AUC达0.7713，捕获了非线性基线80%的有效分类能力。发现稳定矩阵重配置角(~27.84°)和接近零的变形，表明局部等距性。在HaluEval数据集上，通过"廉价几何检查"自动检测出95.3%的事实失真。
AI.conclusion: LAG-XAI为Transformer提供了数学基础扎实、资源高效的可解释性路径，通过几何分解实现参数化解释，在保持性能的同时显著提升模型透明度，并在幻觉检测等实际应用中展现价值。

title: Beyond Semantics: Disentangling Information Scope in Sparse Autoencoders for CLIP
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful tool for interpreting the internal representations of CLIP vision encoders, yet existing analyses largely focus on the semantic meaning of individual features. We introduce information scope as a complementary dimension of interpretability that characterizes how broadly an SAE feature aggregates visual evidence, ranging from localized, patch-specific cues to global, image-level signals. We observe that some SAE features respond consistently across spatial perturbations, while others shift unpredictably with minor input changes, indicating a fundamental distinction in their underlying scope. To quantify this, we propose the Contextual Dependency Score (CDS), which separates positionally stable local scope features from positionally variant global scope features. Our experiments show that features of different information scopes exert systematically different influences on CLIP's predictions and confidence. These findings establish information scope as a critical new axis for understanding CLIP representations and provide a deeper diagnostic view of SAE-derived features.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出信息范围作为解释CLIP视觉编码器中稀疏自编码器特征的新维度，量化特征从局部到全局的证据聚合程度
AI.motivation: 现有对CLIP视觉编码器中稀疏自编码器的分析主要关注单个特征的语义含义，缺乏对特征信息聚合范围（从局部到全局）的系统研究
AI.method: 引入信息范围概念，提出上下文依赖分数来量化特征的位置稳定性，区分局部范围特征和全局范围特征
AI.result: 实验表明不同信息范围的特征对CLIP预测和置信度有系统性不同影响，位置稳定特征与位置变异特征表现出本质区别
AI.conclusion: 信息范围是理解CLIP表示的关键新维度，为稀疏自编码器特征提供了更深入的诊断视角

title: How LLMs Follow Instructions: Skillful Coordination, Not a Universal Mechanism
summary:
Instruction tuning is commonly assumed to endow language models with a domain-general ability to follow instructions, yet the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Does instruction-following rely on a universal mechanism or compositional skill deployment? We investigate this through diagnostic probing across nine diverse tasks in three instruction-tuned models.
  Our analysis provides converging evidence against a universal mechanism. First, general probes trained across all tasks consistently underperform task-specific specialists, indicating limited representational sharing. Second, cross-task transfer is weak and clustered by skill similarity. Third, causal ablation reveals sparse asymmetric dependencies rather than shared representations. Tasks also stratify by complexity across layers, with structural constraints emerging early and semantic tasks emerging late. Finally, temporal analysis shows constraint satisfaction operates as dynamic monitoring during generation rather than pre-generation planning.
  These findings indicate that instruction-following is better characterized as skillful coordination of diverse linguistic capabilities rather than deployment of a single abstract constraint-checking process.

AI.tldr: 指令调优并非赋予语言模型通用的指令遵循能力，而是通过协调多种语言技能来实现任务执行，缺乏统一的机制。
AI.motivation: 研究指令调优的底层机制：指令遵循是依赖通用机制还是组合技能部署？理解指令调优模型如何执行多样化任务。
AI.method: 在三个指令调优模型上，对九个多样化任务进行诊断性探测分析，包括通用探测与任务特定探测比较、跨任务迁移分析、因果消融实验、层级复杂度分层分析以及时间动态分析。
AI.result: 1) 通用探测始终不如任务特定探测，表明表征共享有限；2) 跨任务迁移微弱且按技能相似性聚类；3) 因果消融显示稀疏不对称依赖而非共享表征；4) 任务按复杂度在层级间分层，结构约束早期出现，语义任务晚期出现；5) 约束满足在生成过程中作为动态监控而非预生成规划。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循应被理解为多种语言能力的熟练协调，而非单一抽象约束检查过程的部署，不存在统一的指令遵循机制。

title: Single-Stage Signal Attenuation Diffusion Model for Low-Light Image Enhancement and Denoising
summary:
Diffusion models excel at image restoration via probabilistic modeling of forward noise addition and reverse denoising, and their ability to handle complex noise while preserving fine details makes them well-suited for Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE). Mainstream diffusion based LLIE methods either adopt a two-stage pipeline or an auxiliary correction network to refine U-Net outputs, which severs the intrinsic link between enhancement and denoising and leads to suboptimal performance owing to inconsistent optimization objectives. To address these issues, we propose the Signal Attenuation Diffusion Model (SADM), a novel diffusion process that integrates the signal attenuation mechanism into the diffusion pipeline, enabling simultaneous brightness adjustment and noise suppression in a single stage.
  Specifically, the signal attenuation coefficient simulates the inherent signal attenuation of low-light degradation in the forward noise addition process, encoding the physical priors of low-light degradation to explicitly guide reverse denoising toward the concurrent optimization of brightness recovery and noise suppression, thereby eliminating the need for extra correction modules or staged training relied on by existing methods. We validate that our design maintains consistency with Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models(DDIM) via multi-scale pyramid sampling, balancing interpretability, restoration quality, and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出信号衰减扩散模型(SADM)，将信号衰减机制集成到扩散过程中，实现单阶段低光照图像增强，同时进行亮度调整和噪声抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的低光照图像增强方法采用两阶段流程或辅助校正网络，这切断了增强与去噪之间的内在联系，导致次优性能。需要一种能够同时处理亮度恢复和噪声抑制的单阶段方法。
AI.method: 提出信号衰减扩散模型(SADM)，在正向噪声添加过程中引入信号衰减系数模拟低光照退化的固有信号衰减，将物理先验编码到扩散过程中，通过多尺度金字塔采样与DDIM保持一致性。
AI.result: SADM能够在单阶段同时实现亮度调整和噪声抑制，无需额外的校正模块或分阶段训练，在保持可解释性的同时平衡了恢复质量和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: SADM通过将信号衰减机制集成到扩散过程中，解决了现有方法中增强与去噪目标不一致的问题，为低光照图像增强提供了一种更有效和高效的单阶段解决方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Structure of Mathematics
summary: Recent progress in artificial intelligence (AI) is unlocking transformative capabilities for mathematics. There is great hope that AI will help solve major open problems and autonomously discover new mathematical concepts. In this essay, we further consider how AI may open a grand perspective on mathematics by forging a new route, complementary to mathematical\textbf{ logic,} to understanding the global structure of formal \textbf{proof}\textbf{s}. We begin by providing a sketch of the formal structure of mathematics in terms of universal proof and structural hypergraphs and discuss questions this raises about the foundational structure of mathematics. We then outline the main ingredients and provide a set of criteria to be satisfied for AI models capable of automated mathematical discovery. As we send AI agents to traverse Platonic mathematical worlds, we expect they will teach us about the nature of mathematics: both as a whole, and the small ribbons conducive to human understanding. Perhaps they will shed light on the old question: "Is mathematics discovered or invented?" Can we grok the terrain of these \textbf{Platonic worlds}?

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨AI如何通过分析证明的全局结构来理解数学的本质，提出了一种补充数理逻辑的新途径，旨在利用AI探索柏拉图式数学世界并回答数学是发现还是发明的问题。
AI.motivation: AI的进步为数学研究带来了变革性能力，有望帮助解决重大开放问题并自主发现新的数学概念。作者希望探索AI如何通过分析形式证明的全局结构来理解数学的本质，这为传统数理逻辑方法提供了补充路径。
AI.method: 论文提出了基于通用证明和结构超图的形式数学结构框架，并制定了AI模型实现自动化数学发现所需满足的标准。通过让AI代理探索柏拉图式数学世界来理解数学的整体结构。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个理论框架，但没有提供具体的实验结果。主要贡献在于概念性框架的建立和未来研究方向的规划。
AI.conclusion: AI有望通过探索数学证明的全局结构来帮助我们理解数学的本质，包括数学是发现还是发明这一古老问题。AI代理在柏拉图式数学世界中的探索将揭示数学的整体结构以及适合人类理解的特定部分。

title: FoleyDesigner: Immersive Stereo Foley Generation with Precise Spatio-Temporal Alignment for Film Clips
summary: Foley art plays a pivotal role in enhancing immersive auditory experiences in film, yet manual creation of spatio-temporally aligned audio remains labor-intensive. We propose FoleyDesigner, a novel framework inspired by professional Foley workflows, integrating film clip analysis, spatio-temporally controllable Foley generation, and professional audio mixing capabilities. FoleyDesigner employs a multi-agent architecture for precise spatio-temporal analysis. It achieves spatio-temporal alignment through latent diffusion models trained on spatio-temporal cues extracted from video frames, combined with large language model (LLM)-driven hybrid mechanisms that emulate post-production practices in film industry. To address the lack of high-quality stereo audio datasets in film, we introduce FilmStereo, the first professional stereo audio dataset containing spatial metadata, precise timestamps, and semantic annotations for eight common Foley categories. For applications, the framework supports interactive user control while maintaining seamless integration with professional pipelines, including 5.1-channel Dolby Atmos systems compliant with ITU-R BS.775 standards, thereby offering extensive creative flexibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior spatio-temporal alignment compared to existing baselines, with seamless compatibility with professional film production standards. The project page is available at https://gekiii996.github.io/FoleyDesigner/ .

AI.tldr: FoleyDesigner是一个基于多智能体架构的音频生成框架，通过视频分析、时空可控的Foley生成和专业音频混合，自动化电影拟音创作流程，解决了手动制作时空对齐音频的难题。
AI.motivation: 电影拟音艺术对增强沉浸式听觉体验至关重要，但手动创建时空对齐的音频非常耗时费力。现有方法缺乏高质量立体声音频数据集和专业制作流程的集成。
AI.method: 采用多智能体架构进行精确时空分析；使用基于视频帧时空线索训练的潜在扩散模型实现时空对齐；结合LLM驱动的混合机制模拟电影后期制作实践；引入首个专业立体声音频数据集FilmStereo。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在时空对齐方面优于现有基线，能够无缝兼容专业电影制作标准（包括5.1声道杜比全景声系统），并提供广泛的创作灵活性。
AI.conclusion: FoleyDesigner提供了一个创新的拟音创作框架，将专业工作流程与先进AI技术结合，显著提升了电影音频制作的效率和质量，同时保持了与专业制作管道的无缝集成。

title: ACE-Bench: Agent Configurable Evaluation with Scalable Horizons and Controllable Difficulty under Lightweight Environments
summary: Existing Agent benchmarks suffer from two critical limitations: high environment interaction overhead (up to 41\% of total evaluation time) and imbalanced task horizon and difficulty distributions that make aggregate scores unreliable. To address these issues, we propose ACE-Bench built around a unified grid-based planning task, where agents must fill hidden slots in a partially completed schedule subject to both local slot constraints and global constraints. Our benchmark offers fine-grained control through two orthogonal axes: Scalable Horizons, controlled by the number of hidden slots $H$, and Controllable Difficulty, governed by a decoy budget $B$ that determines the number of globally misleading decoy candidates. Crucially, all tool calls are resolved via static JSON files under a Lightweight Environment design, eliminating setup overhead and enabling fast, reproducible evaluation suitable for training-time validation. We first validate that H and B provide reliable control over task horizon and difficulty, and that ACE-Bench exhibits strong domain consistency and model discriminability. We then conduct comprehensive experiments across 13 models of diverse sizes and families over 6 domains, revealing significant cross-model performance variation and confirming that ACE-Bench provides interpretable and controllable evaluation of agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: ACE-Bench是一个新的智能体基准测试，通过统一的网格规划任务解决现有基准测试的环境交互开销高和任务难度分布不平衡问题，提供可扩展的时间跨度和可控的难度设置。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试存在两个关键限制：1）环境交互开销高（占总评估时间高达41%）；2）任务时间跨度和难度分布不平衡，使得聚合分数不可靠。需要一个新的基准测试来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出ACE-Bench基准测试，围绕统一的网格规划任务构建，智能体必须在部分完成的日程表中填充隐藏槽位，同时满足局部槽位约束和全局约束。通过两个正交轴提供细粒度控制：可扩展的时间跨度（由隐藏槽位数量H控制）和可控难度（由诱饵预算B控制，决定全局误导性候选数量）。采用轻量级环境设计，所有工具调用都通过静态JSON文件解析，消除设置开销。
AI.result: 验证了H和B能够可靠地控制任务时间跨度和难度，ACE-Bench表现出强大的领域一致性和模型区分能力。对13个不同规模和家族的模型在6个领域进行了全面实验，揭示了显著的跨模型性能差异，确认ACE-Bench能够提供可解释和可控的智能体推理评估。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Bench通过统一的网格规划任务和轻量级环境设计，解决了现有智能体基准测试的关键限制，提供了可扩展、可控且高效的评估框架，能够可靠地评估智能体推理能力。

title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
summary: The rapid growth of scientific literature has made it increasingly difficult for researchers to efficiently discover, evaluate, and synthesize relevant work. Recent advances in multi-agent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for understanding user intent and are being trained to utilize various tools. In this paper, we introduce Paper Circle, a multi-agent research discovery and analysis system designed to reduce the effort required to find, assess, organize, and understand academic literature. The system comprises two complementary pipelines: (1) a Discovery Pipeline that integrates offline and online retrieval from multiple sources, multi-criteria scoring, diversity-aware ranking, and structured outputs; and (2) an Analysis Pipeline that transforms individual papers into structured knowledge graphs with typed nodes such as concepts, methods, experiments, and figures, enabling graph-aware question answering and coverage verification. Both pipelines are implemented within a coder LLM-based multi-agent orchestration framework and produce fully reproducible, synchronized outputs including JSON, CSV, BibTeX, Markdown, and HTML at each agent step. This paper describes the system architecture, agent roles, retrieval and scoring methods, knowledge graph schema, and evaluation interfaces that together form the Paper Circle research workflow. We benchmark Paper Circle on both paper retrieval and paper review generation, reporting hit rate, MRR, and Recall at K. Results show consistent improvements with stronger agent models. We have publicly released the website at https://papercircle.vercel.app/ and the code at https://github.com/MAXNORM8650/papercircle.

AI.tldr: Paper Circle是一个基于多智能体大语言模型的研究发现与分析系统，通过两个互补的流水线帮助研究人员高效发现、评估和组织学术文献。
AI.motivation: 科学文献的快速增长使得研究人员难以高效发现、评估和综合相关工作，需要自动化工具来减少文献调研的工作量。
AI.method: 系统包含两个流水线：发现流水线整合离线/在线检索、多标准评分、多样性感知排序和结构化输出；分析流水线将论文转换为结构化知识图谱，支持图感知问答和覆盖验证。采用基于coder LLM的多智能体编排框架。
AI.result: 在论文检索和论文综述生成任务上进行了基准测试，报告了命中率、MRR和Recall@K指标，结果显示随着智能体模型的增强，性能有持续改进。
AI.conclusion: Paper Circle系统通过多智能体架构有效减少了学术文献发现和分析的工作量，提供了可复现的结构化输出，已公开网站和代码供研究社区使用。

title: ASSR-Net: Anisotropic Structure-Aware and Spectrally Recalibrated Network for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
summary: Hyperspectral image fusion aims to reconstruct high-spatial-resolution hyperspectral images (HR-HSI) by integrating complementary information from multi-source inputs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face two critical challenges: (1) inadequate reconstruction of anisotropic spatial structures, resulting in blurred details and compromised spatial quality; and (2) spectral distortion during fusion, which hinders fine-grained spectral representation. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{ASSR-Net}: an Anisotropic Structure-Aware and Spectrally Recalibrated Network for Hyperspectral Image Fusion. ASSR-Net adopts a two-stage fusion strategy comprising anisotropic structure-aware spatial enhancement (ASSE) and hierarchical prior-guided spectral calibration (HPSC). In the first stage, a directional perception fusion module adaptively captures structural features along multiple orientations, effectively reconstructing anisotropic spatial patterns. In the second stage, a spectral recalibration module leverages the original low-resolution HSI as a spectral prior to explicitly correct spectral deviations in the fused results, thereby enhancing spectral fidelity. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets demonstrate that ASSR-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior spatial detail preservation and spectral consistency.

AI.tldr: ASSR-Net是一个用于高光谱图像融合的两阶段网络，通过各向异性结构感知和光谱重新校准来解决空间细节模糊和光谱失真的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱图像融合方法面临两个关键挑战：1) 各向异性空间结构重建不足，导致细节模糊和空间质量下降；2) 融合过程中的光谱失真，阻碍了细粒度光谱表示。
AI.method: 提出ASSR-Net网络，采用两阶段融合策略：第一阶段为各向异性结构感知空间增强(ASSE)，通过方向感知融合模块自适应捕获多方向结构特征；第二阶段为分层先验引导光谱校准(HPSC)，利用原始低分辨率HSI作为光谱先验来显式校正光谱偏差。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，ASSR-Net始终优于最先进的方法，实现了卓越的空间细节保持和光谱一致性。
AI.conclusion: ASSR-Net通过各向异性结构感知和光谱重新校准，有效解决了高光谱图像融合中的空间细节模糊和光谱失真问题，为高质量HR-HSI重建提供了有效解决方案。

title: Claw-Eval: Toward Trustworthy Evaluation of Autonomous Agents
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents executing multi-step workflows in real-world software environments. However, existing agent benchmarks suffer from three critical limitations: (1) trajectory-opaque grading that checks only final outputs, (2) underspecified safety and robustness evaluation, and (3) narrow modality coverage and interaction paradigms. We introduce Claw-Eval, an end-to-end evaluation suite addressing all three gaps. It comprises 300 human-verified tasks spanning 9 categories across three groups (general service orchestration, multimodal perception and generation, and multi-turn professional dialogue). Every agent action is recorded through three independent evidence channels (execution traces, audit logs, and environment snapshots), enabling trajectory-aware grading over 2,159 fine-grained rubric items. The scoring protocol evaluates Completion, Safety, and Robustness, reporting Average Score, Pass@k, and Pass^k across three trials to distinguish genuine capability from lucky outcomes. Experiments on 14 frontier models reveal that: (1) trajectory-opaque evaluation is systematically unreliable, missing 44% of safety violations and 13% of robustness failures that our hybrid pipeline catches; (2) controlled error injection primarily degrades consistency rather than peak capability, with Pass^3 dropping up to 24% while Pass@3 remains stable; (3) multimodal performance varies sharply, with most models performing poorer on video than on document or image, and no single model dominating across all modalities. Beyond benchmarking, Claw-Eval highlights actionable directions for agent development, shedding light on what it takes to build agents that are not only capable but reliably deployable.

AI.tldr: Claw-Eval是一个端到端的智能体评估套件，解决了现有基准的三个关键限制：轨迹不透明评分、安全性和鲁棒性评估不足、模态覆盖范围窄。它包含300个人工验证任务，通过三个独立证据通道记录每个动作，实现细粒度评分。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准存在三个关键限制：(1) 仅检查最终输出的轨迹不透明评分，(2) 安全性和鲁棒性评估不足，(3) 模态覆盖范围和交互范式狭窄。需要更全面的评估框架来准确衡量智能体在实际软件环境中的表现。
AI.method: Claw-Eval包含300个人工验证任务，涵盖9个类别和三个组别（通用服务编排、多模态感知与生成、多轮专业对话）。每个智能体动作通过三个独立证据通道记录：执行轨迹、审计日志和环境快照。评分协议评估完成度、安全性和鲁棒性，报告平均分数、Pass@k和Pass^k。
AI.result: 对14个前沿模型的实验显示：(1) 轨迹不透明评估系统不可靠，遗漏了44%的安全违规和13%的鲁棒性失败；(2) 受控错误注入主要降低一致性而非峰值能力；(3) 多模态性能差异显著，大多数模型在视频任务上表现较差，没有单一模型在所有模态上占主导。
AI.conclusion: Claw-Eval提供了一个全面的智能体评估框架，揭示了轨迹感知评估的重要性，并指出了智能体开发的实际方向，帮助构建不仅有能力而且可靠可部署的智能体。

title: On the Robustness of Diffusion-Based Image Compression to Bit-Flip Errors
summary: Modern image compression methods are typically optimized for the rate--distortion--perception trade-off, whereas their robustness to bit-level corruption is rarely examined. We show that diffusion-based compressors built on the Reverse Channel Coding (RCC) paradigm are substantially more robust to bit flips than classical and learned codecs. We further introduce a more robust variant of Turbo-DDCM that significantly improves robustness while only minimally affecting the rate--distortion--perception trade-off. Our findings suggest that RCC-based compression can yield more resilient compressed representations, potentially reducing reliance on error-correcting codes in highly noisy environments.

AI.tldr: 扩散压缩器基于RCC范式，相比传统和学习的编解码器对比特翻转更鲁棒，提出改进的Turbo-DDCM在保持率-失真-感知平衡的同时显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现代图像压缩方法通常针对率-失真-感知权衡进行优化，但很少考虑其对比特级损坏的鲁棒性。本文旨在研究压缩方法在噪声环境中的鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 基于反向信道编码（RCC）范式的扩散压缩器，并提出改进的Turbo-DDCM变体，在保持率-失真-感知平衡的同时增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: RCC-based压缩器比传统和学习编解码器对比特翻转更鲁棒，改进的Turbo-DDCM显著提升鲁棒性且对率-失真-感知平衡影响最小。
AI.conclusion: RCC-based压缩能产生更具弹性的压缩表示，在高噪声环境中可能减少对纠错码的依赖。

title: Improving Controllable Generation: Faster Training and Better Performance via $x_0$-Supervision
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion/flow models have recently achieved remarkable progress in visual fidelity and text alignment. However, they remain limited when users need to precisely control image layouts, something that natural language alone cannot reliably express. Controllable generation methods augment the initial T2I model with additional conditions that more easily describe the scene. Prior works straightforwardly train the augmented network with the same loss as the initial network. Although natural at first glance, this can lead to very long training times in some cases before convergence. In this work, we revisit the training objective of controllable diffusion models through a detailed analysis of their denoising dynamics. We show that direct supervision on the clean target image, dubbed $x_0$-supervision, or an equivalent re-weighting of the diffusion loss, yields faster convergence. Experiments on multiple control settings demonstrate that our formulation accelerates convergence by up to 2$\times$ according to our novel metric (mean Area Under the Convergence Curve - mAUCC), while also improving both visual quality and conditioning accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/CEA-LIST/x0-supervision

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进可控扩散模型训练的方法，通过x0监督或等效的损失重加权，加速收敛并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像扩散模型在视觉保真度和文本对齐方面取得了显著进展，但在精确控制图像布局方面仍有局限。自然语言无法可靠表达精确布局，现有可控生成方法虽然通过额外条件增强模型，但使用与初始网络相同的损失函数训练，导致收敛时间过长。
AI.method: 通过分析可控扩散模型的去噪动态，提出直接对干净目标图像进行监督（x0监督）或等效的扩散损失重加权方法，以加速训练收敛。
AI.result: 在多种控制设置下的实验表明，该方法根据新的度量指标（平均收敛曲线下面积-mAUCC）可将收敛速度提升高达2倍，同时改善了视觉质量和条件准确性。
AI.conclusion: 重新审视可控扩散模型的训练目标，提出的x0监督方法能显著加速训练收敛，同时提升生成质量，为可控图像生成提供了更高效的训练策略。

title: Beyond the Beep: Scalable Collision Anticipation and Real-Time Explainability with BADAS-2.0
summary:
We present BADAS-2.0, the second generation of our collision anticipation system, building on BADAS-1.0 [7], which showed that fine-tuning V-JEPA2 [1] on large-scale ego-centric dashcam data outperforms both academic baselines and production ADAS systems.
  BADAS-2.0 advances the state of the art along three axes.
  (i) Long-tail benchmark and accuracy: We introduce a 10-group long-tail benchmark targeting rare and safety-critical scenarios. To construct it, BADAS-1.0 is used as an active oracle to score millions of unlabeled drives and surface high-risk candidates for annotation. Combined with Nexar's Atlas platform [13] for targeted data collection, this expands the dataset from 40k to 178,500 labeled videos (~2M clips), yielding consistent gains across all subgroups, with the largest improvements on the hardest long-tail cases.
  (ii) Knowledge distillation to edge: Domain-specific self-supervised pre-training on 2.25M unlabeled driving videos enables distillation into compact models, BADAS-2.0-Flash (86M) and BADAS-2.0-Flash-Lite (22M), achieving 7-12x speedup with near-parity accuracy, enabling real-time edge deployment.
  (iii) Explainability: BADAS-2.0 produces real-time object-centric attention heatmaps that localize the evidence behind predictions. BADAS-Reason [17] extends this with a vision-language model that consumes the last frame and heatmap to generate driver actions and structured textual reasoning.
  Inference code and evaluation benchmarks are publicly available.

AI.tldr: BADAS-2.0是第二代碰撞预警系统，在BADAS-1.0基础上通过三个方向提升：构建长尾基准提升罕见场景检测精度，通过知识蒸馏实现边缘设备实时部署，以及增强可解释性生成注意力热图和结构化推理。
AI.motivation: BADAS-1.0已证明在大型车载摄像头数据上微调V-JEPA2优于学术基准和生产级ADAS系统，但需要进一步提升在罕见安全关键场景的检测能力、实现边缘设备实时部署，并增强系统的可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 使用BADAS-1.0作为主动标注器，从数百万未标注驾驶视频中筛选高风险场景构建10组长期尾基准，结合Atlas平台定向数据收集，将标注视频从4万扩展到17.85万；2) 在225万未标注驾驶视频上进行领域特定自监督预训练，然后蒸馏到紧凑模型（86M和22M参数）；3) 生成实时物体中心注意力热图，并通过BADAS-Reason结合视觉语言模型生成驾驶员动作和结构化文本推理。
AI.result: 1) 在所有子组上获得一致提升，在最具挑战性的长尾案例上改进最大；2) 紧凑模型实现7-12倍加速，精度接近原模型，支持实时边缘部署；3) 系统能提供实时注意力热图和结构化推理，增强可解释性。推理代码和评估基准已公开。
AI.conclusion: BADAS-2.0在碰撞预警的三个关键维度上取得了显著进展：通过主动标注构建的长尾基准提升了罕见场景检测能力，知识蒸馏实现了边缘设备的高效部署，注意力机制和视觉语言模型增强了系统的可解释性，为下一代ADAS系统的发展提供了重要参考。

title: PDMP: Rethinking Balanced Multimodal Learning via Performance-Dominant Modality Prioritization
summary: Multimodal learning has attracted increasing attention due to its practicality. However, it often suffers from insufficient optimization, where the multimodal model underperforms even compared to its unimodal counterparts. Existing methods attribute this problem to the imbalanced learning between modalities and solve it by gradient modulation. This paper argues that balanced learning is not the optimal setting for multimodal learning. On the contrary, imbalanced learning driven by the performance-dominant modality that has superior unimodal performance can contribute to better multimodal performance. And the under-optimization problem is caused by insufficient learning of the performance-dominant modality. To this end, we propose the Performance-Dominant Modality Prioritization (PDMP) strategy to assist multimodal learning. Specifically, PDMP firstly mines the performance-dominant modality via the performance ranking of the independently trained unimodal model. Then PDMP introduces asymmetric coefficients to modulate the gradients of each modality, enabling the performance-dominant modality to dominate the optimization. Since PDMP only relies on the unimodal performance ranking, it is independent of the structures and fusion methods of the multimodal model and has great potential for practical scenarios. Finally, extensive experiments on various datasets validate the superiority of PDMP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种性能主导模态优先（PDMP）策略，认为不平衡学习而非平衡学习才是多模态学习的最优设置，通过让性能主导模态主导优化来解决多模态学习中的优化不足问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习常面临优化不足问题，即多模态模型性能甚至不如单模态模型。现有方法将此归因于模态间学习不平衡，但本文认为平衡学习并非最优设置，真正问题在于性能主导模态学习不足。
AI.method: 提出性能主导模态优先（PDMP）策略：1）通过独立训练的单模态模型性能排序挖掘性能主导模态；2）引入非对称系数调节各模态梯度，让性能主导模态主导优化过程。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的广泛实验验证了PDMP的优越性，该方法不依赖于多模态模型的结构和融合方法，具有实际应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 多模态学习的最优设置是不平衡学习而非平衡学习，让性能主导模态主导优化能有效解决优化不足问题，PDMP策略为此提供了有效解决方案。

title: RHVI-FDD: A Hierarchical Decoupling Framework for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light images often suffer from severe noise, detail loss, and color distortion, which hinder downstream multimedia analysis and retrieval tasks. The degradation in low-light images is complex: luminance and chrominance are coupled, while within the chrominance, noise and details are deeply entangled, preventing existing methods from simultaneously correcting color distortion, suppressing noise, and preserving fine details. To tackle the above challenges, we propose a novel hierarchical decoupling framework (RHVI-FDD). At the macro level, we introduce the RHVI transform, which mitigates the estimation bias caused by input noise and enables robust luminance-chrominance decoupling. At the micro level, we design a Frequency-Domain Decoupling (FDD) module with three branches for further feature separation. Using the Discrete Cosine Transform, we decompose chrominance features into low, mid, and high-frequency bands that predominantly represent global tone, local details, and noise components, which are then processed by tailored expert networks in a divide-and-conquer manner and fused via an adaptive gating module for content-aware fusion. Extensive experiments on multiple low-light datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in both objective metrics and subjective visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出RHVI-FDD框架，通过分层解耦方法解决低光图像中的噪声、细节丢失和颜色失真问题，在宏观层面使用RHVI变换实现亮度-色度解耦，在微观层面使用频域解耦模块分离不同频率特征。
AI.motivation: 低光图像通常存在严重噪声、细节丢失和颜色失真，这些问题阻碍了下游多媒体分析和检索任务。现有方法难以同时校正颜色失真、抑制噪声并保留细节，因为亮度与色度耦合，而色度内部噪声与细节深度纠缠。
AI.method: 提出分层解耦框架RHVI-FDD：1）宏观层面引入RHVI变换，减少输入噪声引起的估计偏差，实现鲁棒的亮度-色度解耦；2）微观层面设计频域解耦模块，使用离散余弦变换将色度特征分解为低频（全局色调）、中频（局部细节）和高频（噪声）三个频带，分别由专门的专家网络处理，最后通过自适应门控模块进行内容感知融合。
AI.result: 在多个低光数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在客观指标和主观视觉质量方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分层解耦框架RHVI-FDD能够有效解决低光图像增强中的复杂退化问题，通过宏观和微观两个层面的解耦策略，实现了颜色校正、噪声抑制和细节保留的平衡。

title: WikiSeeker: Rethinking the Role of Vision-Language Models in Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a highly effective paradigm for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA). Despite recent advancements, prevailing methods still primarily depend on images as the retrieval key, and often overlook or misplace the role of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), thereby failing to leverage their potential fully. In this paper, we introduce WikiSeeker, a novel multi-modal RAG framework that bridges these gaps by proposing a multi-modal retriever and redefining the role of VLMs. Rather than serving merely as answer generators, we assign VLMs two specialized agents: a Refiner and an Inspector. The Refiner utilizes the capability of VLMs to rewrite the textual query according to the input image, significantly improving the performance of the multimodal retriever. The Inspector facilitates a decoupled generation strategy by selectively routing reliable retrieved context to another LLM for answer generation, while relying on the VLM's internal knowledge when retrieval is unreliable. Extensive experiments on EVQA, InfoSeek, and M2KR demonstrate that WikiSeeker achieves state-of-the-art performance, with substantial improvements in both retrieval accuracy and answer quality. Our code will be released on https://github.com/zhuyjan/WikiSeeker.

AI.tldr: WikiSeeker是一个创新的多模态检索增强生成框架，通过重新定义视觉语言模型的作用，显著提升了基于知识的视觉问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖图像作为检索键，忽视了视觉语言模型的潜力，未能充分发挥其在多模态检索增强生成中的作用。
AI.method: 提出多模态检索器，并将视觉语言模型重新定义为两个专门代理：Refiner（根据输入图像重写文本查询）和Inspector（选择性路由可靠检索上下文到LLM进行答案生成）。
AI.result: 在EVQA、InfoSeek和M2KR数据集上的实验表明，WikiSeeker在检索准确率和答案质量方面都取得了最先进的性能，实现了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: WikiSeeker通过创新的多模态检索器和重新定义的视觉语言模型角色，为基于知识的视觉问答提供了一个高效的多模态检索增强生成框架。

title: Learn to Rank: Visual Attribution by Learning Importance Ranking
summary: Interpreting the decisions of complex computer vision models is crucial to establish trust and accountability, especially in safety-critical domains. An established approach to interpretability is generating visual attribution maps that highlight regions of the input most relevant to the model's prediction. However, existing methods face a three-way trade-off. Propagation-based approaches are efficient, but they can be biased and architecture-specific. Meanwhile, perturbation-based methods are causally grounded, yet they are expensive and for vision transformers often yield coarse, patch-level explanations. Learning-based explainers are fast but usually optimize surrogate objectives or distill from heuristic teachers. We propose a learning scheme that instead optimizes deletion and insertion metrics directly. Since these metrics depend on non-differentiable sorting and ranking, we frame them as permutation learning and replace the hard sorting with a differentiable relaxation using Gumbel-Sinkhorn. This enables end-to-end training through attribution-guided perturbations of the target model. During inference, our method produces dense, pixel-level attributions in a single forward pass with optional, few-step gradient refinement. Our experiments demonstrate consistent quantitative improvements and sharper, boundary-aligned explanations, particularly for transformer-based vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接优化删除和插入指标的学习方案，通过可微排序松弛实现端到端训练，为视觉模型生成密集像素级归因图
AI.motivation: 现有视觉模型可解释性方法存在三方面权衡：传播方法高效但有偏且架构特定；扰动方法因果基础好但计算昂贵且对视觉transformer只能得到粗粒度解释；学习方法快速但通常优化代理目标或从启发式教师蒸馏
AI.method: 提出直接优化删除和插入指标的学习方案，将非可微的排序和排名问题框架为排列学习，使用Gumbel-Sinkhorn进行可微松弛，实现端到端训练，通过目标模型的归因引导扰动进行训练
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在定量指标上持续改进，生成更清晰、边界对齐的解释，特别对基于transformer的视觉模型效果显著，推理时单次前向传播即可生成密集像素级归因图
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了现有可解释性方法的三方权衡，通过直接优化评估指标实现了更准确、边界对齐的视觉归因解释，特别适用于现代视觉transformer模型

title: Reading Between the Pixels: An Inscriptive Jailbreak Attack on Text-to-Image Models
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models can now render legible, paragraph-length text, enabling a fundamentally new class of misuse. We identify and formalize the inscriptive jailbreak, where an adversary coerces a T2I system into generating images containing harmful textual payloads (e.g., fraudulent documents) embedded within visually benign scenes. Unlike traditional depictive jailbreaks that elicit visually objectionable imagery, inscriptive attacks weaponize the text-rendering capability itself. Because existing jailbreak techniques are designed for coarse visual manipulation, they struggle to bypass multi-stage safety filters while maintaining character-level fidelity. To expose this vulnerability, we propose Etch, a black-box attack framework that decomposes the adversarial prompt into three functionally orthogonal layers: semantic camouflage, visual-spatial anchoring, and typographic encoding. This decomposition reduces joint optimization over the full prompt space to tractable sub-problems, which are iteratively refined through a zero-order loop. In this process, a vision-language model critiques each generated image, localizes failures to specific layers, and prescribes targeted revisions. Extensive evaluations across 7 models on the 2 benchmarks demonstrate that Etch achieves an average attack success rate of 65.57% (peaking at 91.00%), significantly outperforming existing baselines. Our results reveal a critical blind spot in current T2I safety alignments and underscore the urgent need for typography-aware defense multimodal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的文本到图像模型攻击方法——铭文式越狱攻击，通过Etch框架将对抗性提示分解为三个正交层，成功在视觉良性场景中嵌入有害文本内容，攻击成功率显著高于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现代文本到图像模型能够渲染可读的段落长度文本，这为滥用创造了新机会。作者发现并形式化了"铭文式越狱攻击"，即攻击者迫使T2I系统在视觉良性场景中生成包含有害文本内容（如欺诈文档）的图像。与传统描绘式越狱攻击不同，铭文式攻击利用文本渲染能力本身作为武器。
AI.method: 提出了Etch黑盒攻击框架，将对抗性提示分解为三个功能正交层：语义伪装层、视觉空间锚定层和排版编码层。这种分解将完整提示空间的联合优化简化为可处理的子问题，通过零阶循环迭代优化。在过程中，视觉语言模型对生成的图像进行批判，将失败定位到特定层，并规定有针对性的修订。
AI.result: 在7个模型和2个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，Etch平均攻击成功率达到65.57%（峰值91.00%），显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了当前T2I安全对齐中的一个关键盲点，强调了迫切需要开发排版感知的多模态防御机制。

title: Is CLIP Cross-Eyed? Revealing and Mitigating Center Bias in the CLIP Family
summary: Recent research has shown that contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP often lack fine-grained understanding of visual content. While a growing body of work has sought to address this limitation, we identify a distinct failure mode in the CLIP family, which we term center bias, that persists even in recent model variants. Specifically, CLIP tends to disproportionately focus on the central region of an image, overlooking important objects located near the boundaries. This limitation is fundamental as failure to recognize relevant objects makes it difficult to perform any sophisticated tasks that depend on those objects. To understand the underlying causes of the limitation, we conduct analyses from both representation and attention perspectives. Using interpretability methods, i.e., embedding decomposition and attention map analysis, we find that relevant concepts especially those associated with off-center objects vanish from the model's embedding in the final representation due to information loss during the aggregation of visual embeddings, particularly the reliance on pooling mechanisms. Finally, we show that this bias can be alleviated with training-free strategies such as visual prompting and attention redistribution by redirecting models' attention to off-center regions.

AI.tldr: CLIP模型存在中心偏见问题，过度关注图像中心区域而忽略边界重要物体，这限制了其细粒度视觉理解能力
AI.motivation: 研究发现对比视觉语言模型如CLIP缺乏细粒度视觉理解能力，存在中心偏见问题，即使最新变体也未能解决。这种偏见是根本性的，因为无法识别相关物体就难以执行依赖这些物体的复杂任务
AI.method: 从表示和注意力两个角度进行分析：使用嵌入分解和注意力图分析等可解释性方法，发现由于视觉嵌入聚合过程中的信息损失（特别是池化机制），导致与偏离中心物体相关的概念在最终表示中消失
AI.result: 发现CLIP模型在聚合视觉嵌入时存在信息损失，特别是池化机制导致偏离中心物体的相关概念在最终表示中消失。这种中心偏见可以通过无需训练的策略缓解
AI.conclusion: CLIP模型存在中心偏见问题，但可以通过视觉提示和注意力重分布等无需训练的策略来缓解，通过将模型注意力重新引导到偏离中心区域

title: Neural Network Pruning via QUBO Optimization
summary: Neural network pruning can be formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem, yet most existing approaches rely on greedy heuristics that ignore complex interactions between filters.
